article_title: Xi-Putin Meet - Trump-Xi Call - Wang Huning's Message to KMT Vice Chair

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with US President Donald Trump, readout in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past year, we have enjoyed sound communication and had a successful meeting in Busan. I attach great importance to this relationship. In the new year, I hope to work with you to steer the giant ship of China-U.S. relations steadily forward through winds and storms, and accomplish more big things and good things. Just as the U.S. has its concerns, China for its part also has concerns. If the two sides work in the same direction in the spirit of equality, respect and mutual benefit, we can surely find ways to address each other's concerns.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with US President Donald Trump, readout in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should follow the common understandings we have reached, enhance dialogue and communication, manage differences properly, and expand practical cooperation. We should make progress step by step to build mutual trust, find the right way to get along, and make 2026 a year where our two major countries advance toward mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with US President Donald Trump, readout in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is the most important issue in China-U.S. relations. Taiwan is China's territory. China must safeguard its own sovereignty and territorial integrity, and will never allow Taiwan to be separated. The U.S. must handle the issue of arms sales to Taiwan with prudence.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Inspection visit to Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Research Center in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The depth of change and the intensity of disorder in the current international situation are rare in history, and China's development is at a stage in which strategic opportunities coexist with risks and challenges, with uncertain and unpredictable factors increasing. The more complex and intricate the international situation becomes, the more the diplomatic front must study well, research well, and apply well Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy.

article_title: China-Uruguay Joint Statement - CPC-KMT Think Tank Forum - Wang Yi Meets Vietnam's Le Hoai Trung

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Uruguayan President Yamandú Orsi, readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is undergoing changes unseen in a century, the international situation is volatile and turbulent, and unilateral bullying practices are growing more rampant. China supports strengthening solidarity and cooperation across the Global South, jointly promote an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Uruguayan President Yamandú Orsi, Xinhua report
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to import more high-quality Uruguayan products and encourage competitive Chinese enterprises to invest in Uruguay. China fully supports Uruguay in its rotating presidencies of CELAC and Mercosur, and in chairing the Group of 77 and China for 2026. China will maintain close multilateral communication and coordination with Uruguay to safeguard multilateralism and free trade, defend the common interests of the Global South, and uphold international order, fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister (implied from context of meeting with Vietnamese envoy)
statements.context: Meeting with Le Hoai Trung, special envoy of CPV General Secretary To Lam, Xinhua report
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: General Secretary Xi Jinping and General Secretary To Lam agreed that both countries should unite and cooperate to promote development. China is willing to work with Vietnam to follow important consensus between top leaders, grasp the strategic nature of bilateral relations, and strengthen high-level exchange. Both countries should unite and cooperate closely, coordinate development and security, and resolutely safeguard the international system with the UN at its core and the international order based on international law. Both countries should protect their own legitimate rights and interests and the common interests of the Global South, and work together to become forces for peace, stability and development.

statements.speaker: Song Tao
statements.speaker_title: Director of Taiwan Affairs Office of the CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Think tank forum between CPC and KMT research institutes, People's Daily report
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two parties must unswervingly uphold the '1992 Consensus' and oppose 'Taiwan independence' as their common political foundation. We will show no leniency whatsoever in striking at die-hard 'Taiwan independence' elements and their hired thugs and accomplices, and we will tolerate absolutely no external forces that attempt to 'use Taiwan to contain China.' Compatriots on both sides should act as participants, contributors, and beneficiaries of national reunification and national rejuvenation.

article_title: China’s Vision of South Asian Order

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Symposium addressing at end of year 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's relations with states along its periphery were 'at their best since modern times', but regional dynamics were increasingly 'deeply affected by the changes in the international landscape' and 'maintaining prosperity and stability' across the periphery required 'persistent efforts'

statements.speaker: Chinese leadership/Central Committee
statements.context: First-ever Central Conference on Peripheral Work, April 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The periphery was a 'vital foundation' for China's development and prosperity and needed to be viewed from a 'global perspective'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Media address during visit to Islamabad, August 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Described the region as 'an important direction for China to build a community with a shared future in its neighbourhood'. China would be a 'trustworthy partner and a strong support for South Asian countries' as they contended with 'unilateral and bullying acts' of the United States

article_title: PLA Daily Commentary on Anti-Corruption Pivots to Future Planning & Combat Effectiveness - Sergei Shoigu Opposes 'Japan’s Attempts to Accelerate Re-militarization'

statements.speaker: PLA Daily
statements.context: Front-page commentary on anti-corruption campaign
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The PLA steadfastly safeguards national sovereignty, security, and development interests. Its original aspiration of seeking happiness for the people and rejuvenation for the nation remains unchanged. Its conviction to listen to the Party and follow the Party remains as firm as a rock. Its will to devote itself to strengthening the military and march toward first-class remains unwavering.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Sergei Shoigu, Russian Security Council Secretary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is increasingly undergoing both changes and turbulence, with the post-war international order and norms governing international relations severely impacted, and the world faces a real risk of regressing to the law of the jungle. As major countries and permanent members of the UN Security Council, China and Russia have the responsibility and obligation to practice true multilateralism, safeguard the international system with the UN at its core, advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.
statements.framing: accusatory (implicit critique of current international order)

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Sergei Shoigu, Russian Security Council Secretary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia are each other's largest neighbours and comprehensive strategic partners in the new era. They should maintain close communication on major issues concerning bilateral relations, increase mutual support on issues involving each other's core interests, and safeguard their respective and common interests. The leadership of the two heads of state is the greatest advantage and fundamental guarantee for the high-level development of China-Russia relations.

article_title: PLA Daily Commentary: Anti-Corruption Campaign Rectifying the Roots Politically; Cleansing the Poison Ideologically; & Generating New Flesh Organisationally

statements.speaker: PLA Daily
statements.context: Front-page commentary on anti-corruption investigations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The history of the PLA is a history of moving toward strength through political rectification and innovation under the Party's leadership. Since the Party Congress, the Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has promoted political rectification, rectifying conduct, enforcing discipline, and fighting corruption with unprecedented determination and intensity, eliminating major political hidden dangers that affected the Party's absolute leadership over the military.

statements.speaker: PLA Daily
statements.context: Front-page commentary on anti-corruption investigations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The military is the one that holds the gun; within the armed forces, there must absolutely be no place for corrupt elements to hide. The current anti-corruption struggle is a continuation of the rectification of work style and anti-corruption efforts since the 18th Party Congress, and a deepening of the reshaping of the PLA. The entire military must maintain a high-pressure posture without wavering.

article_title: Keir Starmer's Visit to Beijing - Corruption in Chinese Football - Work Plan to Boost Service Consumption

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with British Prime Minister Keir Starmer in Beijing, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is always committed to peaceful development, has never started a war, and has never taken an inch of foreign land. No matter how strong and developed China becomes, it will never be a threat to other countries. Unilateralism, protectionism, and power politics are running rampant. International law can be truly effective only when all countries abide by it. Major countries in particular should set an example, otherwise the world will revert to the law of the jungle.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with British Prime Minister Keir Starmer in Beijing, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is the world's second-largest economy and a major country with significant influence. Recently, unilateralism, protectionism, and hegemonic bullying have been rampant internationally. As permanent members of the UN Security Council, China and the UK should demonstrate their responsibilities as major powers, strengthen multilateral communication and coordination, uphold the authority of the United Nations, safeguard multilateralism and free trade, and promote the international order towards a more just and reasonable direction.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Meeting with British Prime Minister Keir Starmer in Beijing, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As the world today is undergoing both changes and turbulence, developing sound China-Britain relations is of great contemporary value and global significance. China stands ready to work with Britain to resume normal exchanges between the legislative bodies of the two countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UK National Security Advisor Jonathan Powell, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Amid a complex and volatile international landscape, both sides should all the more uphold the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, strengthen dialogue and cooperation, work together to address challenges, and jointly safeguard the international system with the UN at its core. The important common understandings reached between the leaders of both countries on developing a long-term and stable comprehensive strategic partnership between China and the UK will inject strong momentum into institutional exchanges and cooperation across various fields and open a new chapter in China-UK relations.

article_title: China-Finland Ties - Li Qiang Warns: Discipline Work Will Only Become Stricter - Henan Party Chief on Advancing 'High-Efficiency Governance' - China-Russia Defense Ministers' Call

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the EU are partners, not rivals, and their cooperation and common ground far outweigh their competition and differences. Expressed hope for Finland to play a constructive role in promoting healthy and steady development of China-Europe relations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Pointing to a world facing various risks and challenges, major countries should take the lead in upholding equality, the rule of law, cooperation and integrity. China is ready to work with Finland to firmly uphold the U.N.-centered international system and the international order underpinned by international law.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, unilateralism and protectionism are on the rise around the world, and the global economy is being impacted. China and Finland should work together to safeguard an open and cooperative international economic and trade order, adhere to multilateralism and free trade, maintain the multilateral trading system with the WTO at its core.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with Senegal's Malick Ndiaye (President of Senegalese National Assembly)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Senegal has publicly reaffirmed its steadfast adherence to the one-China principle, and China highly appreciates this. China will continue to support Senegal in pursuing an independent, autonomous development path.

statements.speaker: Dong Jun
statements.context: Video call with Russian Defense Minister Andrei Belousov
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Noting that this year marks both the 30th anniversary of the establishment of the China-Russia strategic partnership of coordination and the 25th anniversary of the signing of the China-Russia Treaty of Good-Neighborliness and Friendly Cooperation, expressed China's readiness to work with Russia to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, enhance strategic coordination, enrich the content of cooperation, improve exchange mechanisms, and jointly enhance the ability to cope with various risks and challenges.

article_title: Xi Calls To Lam - Li Seeks Feedback on 15th FYP - National Sci-Tech Conference - Tackling 'Involution-style' Competition in Gov't Procurement - Japanese 'neo-militarism' is 'a Real Threat'

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Symposium on draft government work report and 15th Five-Year Plan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The external environment is becoming more uncertain, and economic development still faces many risks and challenges. It is necessary to scientifically and accurately grasp the changing situation, confront difficulties, strengthen confidence, concentrate efforts on doing our own work well, implement more proactive and effective macroeconomic policies.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Central Science and Technology Commission
statements.context: National conference on science and technology
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The deeper the scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation develop, the more it is necessary to strive to seize the commanding heights of international competition and firmly grasp the initiative in scientific and technological competition.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with To Lam, General Secretary of Communist Party of Vietnam
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should hold firm to their beliefs, uphold fundamental principles and break new ground, fend off and defuse various risks and challenges, jointly defend the cause of socialism, and preserve the political essence of China-Vietnam relations. Both sides should strengthen coordination and collaboration in international and regional affairs, jointly oppose hegemonism and bloc confrontation, and work together to promote the building of a community with a shared future for humanity.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with OIC Secretary-General Hissein Brahim Taha in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates the OIC's emphasis on its relationship with China, and hopes Islamic countries will continue to staunchly support China on the Taiwan question, Xinjiang-related issues, and other issues concerning China's core interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with OIC Secretary-General Taha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Changes unseen in a century are accelerating across the world. China is ready to work with Islamic countries to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of developing nations. China opposes a return of the world to the law of the jungle, and insists that the historical injustice of the rich getting richer and the poor staying poor must come to an end.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary on Japan's neo-militarism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's measures, taken in accordance with laws and regulations, to prohibit the export of all dual-use items to Japanese military users, for military purposes, and to all other end-users and uses involved in enhancing Japan's military capabilities, are a legitimate and necessary step to safeguard peace and security.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary on Japan's neo-militarism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For some time now, the Japanese side has continuously pushed to revise the 'Three Non-Nuclear Principles', and its politicians have repeatedly made public statements advocating nuclear armament. This not only constitutes a serious challenge to the international nuclear non-proliferation regime, but also completely deviates from Japan's self-proclaimed commitment of 'following the path of peaceful development', and has already triggered strong opposition and condemnation from the international community.

article_title: Understanding 'Comprehensive, Deep & Accurate' Implementation of Building a Modern Industrial System - Interview with Housing Minister Ni Hong - MIIT Briefing on Tech-Industry Agenda

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary on Xi's speech at Party School
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development is characterized by coexistence of strategic opportunities and risks and challenges, with uncertainty and unpredictability increasing. The more complex and volatile the situation becomes, the more necessary it is to firmly hold onto the real economy and accelerate building a modern industrial system. This provides strong material support for achieving the second centennial goal and winning strategic initiative in increasingly fierce international competition.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference (CPPCC)
statements.context: CPPCC symposium on macroeconomic situation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The CPPCC should assist the Party and government in publicising policies, clarifying doubts, stabilising expectations, and strengthening confidence, guiding all sectors of society to comprehensively and dialectically view the economic situation and development trends, and tell the China story well.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: MFA press conference responding to CGTN question about EU cybersecurity package
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China noted relevant reports and expresses grave concern. Chinese companies have long been conducting lawful operation in Europe and are law-abiding and high-quality providers for the EU's telecom and digital sector. They are never a security threat to European countries. To forcefully limit or ban companies from the market without any evidence and based on non-technical standards seriously violates market principles and fair competition. This act of protectionism is yet another example of turning normal cooperation into political and security issues. We urge the EU to stop pursuing the wrong path of protectionism. China will do what is necessary to defend Chinese companies' lawful rights and interests.

article_title: Xi Addresses Key Provincial & Ministerial Officials on 15th FYP - Officials Hint at Fiscal Deficit Expansion; Announce New Support for Specific Sectors & Consumption - Chinese National Killed in Kabul

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Study session at the Central Party School (National Academy of Governance) for principal officials at provincial and ministerial levels
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development is in a period where strategic opportunities and risks and challenges coexist, and uncertain and unpredictable factors are increasing. When analysing the situation, we must consider all factors comprehensively and be adept at grasping some key factors, such as the new changes in the international situation and the new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation.

statements.speaker: CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Congratulatory message on the convening of the 14th National Congress of the Communist Party of Vietnam, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The CPC and the government of China attach great importance to developing the relations between the two parties and countries, and are willing to work together with the Vietnamese side to adhere to the principles of 'long-term stability, future orientation, good-neighborly friendship and all-round cooperation', and the spirit of 'good neighbors, good friends, good comrades, good partners,' to implement the important consensus reached by the top leaders of the two parties and countries...the CPC and the government of China will join Vietnam to promote the continuous development and achieve fruitful results of the China-Vietnam community with a shared future that carries strategic significance.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic globalization – driven by international specialization, collaboration, complementary strength and the pursuit of win-win – is a prevailing trend of history. It has benefited many countries, including China, and enabled them to achieve fast development. On the contrary, tariff and trade wars have no winners. Beyond driving up costs for production and trade, they fragment the world economy forward and disrupt the global distribution of resources.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China advocates a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization. We are committed to building bridges, not walls. We will firmly support trade and investment, liberalization and facilitation, and continue to share development opportunities with the world.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is glad to see countries reach trade agreements that are mutually beneficial. But these agreements should comply with WTO rules and not undermine the interests of third parties.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to fostering common prosperity with its trading partners through its own development, and making the pie bigger for the global economy and trade. We never seek trade surplus; on top of being the world's factory, we hope to be the world's market too. However, in many cases, when China wants to buy, others don't want to sell. Trade issues often become security hurdles.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US had managed to keep 'the economic and trade relationship generally stable' through dialogue last year. To be frank, it's normal for countries with different social systems, status development, histories and cultures to encounter divergences and frictions as they develop and interact. At times, these are just misunderstandings. The key is to uphold the spirit of equality, respect mutual benefits, build trust through dialogue, and to resolve disputes through consultation.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Instead of looking for answers through confrontation or antagonism, we must find a way out through communication and consultation, and explore the path of win-win and all-win. China is a trading partner, not a rival, for other countries. China's development presents an opportunity, not threat, to the world economy.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past five years, China has imported more than $15 trillion of goods and services. Its overseas investment has generated over $300 million of tax revenue, created numerous jobs and boosted local economies. China's development has been achieved mainly through reform, opening up and innovation, rather than so-called government subsidy.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Speech at the World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Scientific and technology progress cannot be achieved without international cooperation, and innovation brings both opportunities and risks. China is ready to work with all other countries in a spirit of openness and cooperation to advance sci-tech innovation, empower the world economy and address global challenges in such areas as AI governance.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: MFA press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A blast hit a Chinese restaurant in Kabul, Afghanistan yesterday and killed and injured many. One Chinese national was killed and five were wounded. China expresses deep condolences over the lives lost and heartfelt sympathies to the injured. China has made urgent representations with Afghanistan and has urged Afghanistan to make every possible effort to save and treat the injured, do more to keep Chinese nationals, projects and institutions safe, get to the bottom of the attack, and bring the perpetrators to justice as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: MFA press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China strongly condemns and firmly opposes any form of terrorism, and supports Afghanistan and regional countries in jointly fighting all forms of terrorist and violent activities.

article_title: 2025 Economic Data - Li Seeks Opinions on 15th FYP - Central Political and Legal Work Conference

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Symposium with experts, entrepreneurs, and representatives from education, science, culture, health, and sports on draft Government Work Report and 15th Five-Year Plan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past year, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, we implemented more proactive and effective macro policies, calmly responded to external shocks, and our country's economy pressed ahead under pressure. The external situation remains complex and volatile with increasing uncertain and unpredictable factors, but the supporting conditions and basic trend of our country's economy improving over the long term have not changed, and the prospects for high-quality development are broad. As long as we remain confident, face the problems head-on, and concentrate our efforts on managing our own affairs well, we will certainly be able to continuously consolidate and expand the momentum of steady economic growth.
statements.framing: resilient and assertive in face of external challenges

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with Sardar Ayaz Sadiq, speaker of the National Assembly of Pakistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to work with Pakistan to implement the important consensus reached by leaders of the two countries, accelerate the development of an even closer China-Pakistan community with a shared future in the new era, and bring greater benefits to the two peoples. China is willing to strengthen the alignment of its 15th Five-Year Plan with Pakistan's National Economic Transformation Plan for 2024-2029. China is ready to advance the construction of the upgraded Version 2.0 of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor and to deliver further achievements in key areas such as industry, agriculture, mining, transportation and people's livelihoods. China supports Pakistan's resolute efforts to combat terrorism.
statements.topic: bilateral relations (China-Pakistan), not directly about US

article_title: Zhang Yongsheng: Xi Jinping Thought on Ecological Civilization Transcends Industrial Civilization & Is Going Global

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Canada relationship has achieved a turnaround and is widely welcomed. China is willing to work with Canada to adhere to strategic partnership positioning, strengthen dialogue and communication, enhance political mutual trust, respect each other's core interests, seek common ground while reserving differences, continuously expand practical cooperation in trade, science and technology, agriculture, clean energy, digital technology, modern agriculture, aerospace, advanced manufacturing, and finance. China welcomes Canadian companies to invest and hopes Canada provides fair and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese companies. Both sides should support exchanges in education, culture, tourism, sports, youth, and local areas. China willing to strengthen cooperation within UN, WTO, G20, and APEC frameworks to jointly safeguard multilateralism and free trade.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Canada to implement important consensus reached by leaders, respect each other's core interests and major concerns, strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation and people-to-people exchanges, and promote healthy, stable and sustainable development of bilateral ties. The NPC is willing to enhance friendly exchanges with Canadian parliament, carry out experience exchanges on legislation and supervision, and provide legal safeguards for practical cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Prime Minister Carney's visit signals a turning point in bilateral relations and holds symbolic significance. Leaders will hold meetings expected to open new prospects. China is ready to strengthen communication, enhance mutual trust, eliminate interference, and deepen cooperation with Canada. China and Canada have different social systems based on different historical and cultural backgrounds and people's choices. Both should view each other with rational and amicable attitude and inclusive mindset, handle issues with mutual respect, focus on cooperation agenda, send positive messages to provide optimistic expectations and inject confidence into bilateral relations development, and jointly build new type of strategic partnership.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China consistently advocates for abiding by UN Charter purposes and international law, opposes use or threat of force in international relations, opposes imposing one's will on other countries, and opposes world regressing to 'law of the jungle'. China believes Iranian government and people will unite to overcome difficulties, maintain national stability, and safeguard legitimate rights and interests. Hope all parties cherish peace, exercise restraint, and resolve differences through dialogue. China willing to play constructive role.

article_title: Xi Focuses on Implementing Central Goals, Self-Revolution & Anti-Corruption at CCDI Plenary - Li Lecheng Details Agenda for Building Modern Industrial System

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with Timothy Geithner, former US Secretary of Treasury and chairman of Warburg Pincus
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes foreign enterprises including Warburg Pincus and long-term capital to continue expanding their investment in China and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation with China. China is fully implementing the guiding principles of the fourth plenary session of the 20th CPC Central Committee and advancing the building of a unified national market, unswervingly expanding high-level opening-up and promoting high-quality economic development.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on China-EU negotiations over electric vehicle subsidies
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the European Union have agreed on the necessity of providing general guidance on price undertakings for Chinese companies exporting battery electric vehicle passenger cars to the EU. The move aims to address relevant concerns in a way that is more practical, targeted and consistent with WTO rules. The progress fully reflects the spirit of dialogue and shows that the two sides have the ability and willingness to resolve differences properly through dialogue and consultation under the framework of WTO rules. This is conducive to ensuring the healthy development of China-EU economic and trade relations and safeguarding the rules-based international trade order.

article_title: Political Supervision Message ahead of CCDI Plenary - Coverage of Wang Yi's Africa Visit - Zhong Caiping Commentary on Opening-up Policy

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Reply letter dated January 7, 2026 to American youth education exchange delegation from Diamond Minds Transformational Leadership Academy in Miami, Florida, the University of Florida and the Miami-Dade College
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The hope of China-U.S. relations lies in the people, and its future relies on the youth. Since the launch of the '50,000 in Five Years' initiative, over 40,000 U.S. youth have actively participated, opening a window for them to understand the real China and building a bridge to carry forward the friendship between the two peoples. This fully demonstrates that fostering friendly exchanges and cooperation is the shared aspiration of the people of both China and the United States. Xi looks forward to more American youth joining the cause of China-U.S. friendship, becoming a new generation of envoys of friendship between the two countries, and making greater contributions to enhancing people-to-people exchanges and promoting the development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Tanzanian President Samia Suluhu Hassan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The essence of China-Tanzania relations is mutual trust and mutual support, and the defining feature of China-Tanzania cooperation is mutual assistance and mutual achievement. China appreciates Tanzania's commitment to the one-China principle and firmly supports Tanzania in safeguarding its sovereignty, independence and national dignity, as well as pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Tanzanian Minister of Foreign Affairs and East African Cooperation Mahmoud Thabit Kombo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China always views its cooperation with Africa from the perspective of South-South cooperation featuring mutual support and assistance, and is willing to achieve common development with Africa and jointly build an all-weather China-Africa community with a shared future for the new era. As countries of the Global South, China and Tanzania should join hands to safeguard the central role of the United Nations and the authority of international law, firmly support multilateralism, promote a more just and equitable global governance system, and defend the legitimate rights and interests of the vast number of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Lesotho Prime Minister Ntsokoane Samuel Matekane
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Lesotho's commitment to the one-China principle and supports Lesotho in defending state sovereignty, national dignity, and development rights and interests. China will accelerate the implementation of its zero-tariff policy for Africa in Lesotho, expand bilateral economic, trade, investment, and industrial cooperation. statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Zambia are good brothers, good friends and good partners. Currently, unilateralism and protectionism are intensifying and seriously impacting the international system and the world economy. China and Zambia should strengthen multilateral coordination and cooperation, and work with countries in the Global South to safeguard international economic and trade order and fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Remarks at Tanzania-Zambia Railway revitalization project groundbreaking ceremony in Lusaka
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Today, China-Africa cooperation has embarked on a new journey toward the shared dream of modernization. China stands ready to work with Zambia and Tanzania to ensure that this railway shines with renewed splendor in the new era and injects greater vitality into the development of Tanzania and Zambia, and even the entire Africa.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with South African President Cyril Ramaphosa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and South Africa have treated each other as close brothers, with a friendship that spans mountains and seas and has grown ever stronger. China is ready to continue working with South Africa to carry forward their traditional friendship and expand cooperation across various fields. China is ready to strengthen alignment with South Africa in development strategies and promote the early implementation of zero-tariff treatment in the country.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at G20 Leaders' Summit on Saturday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Currently, the world economy is facing enormous challenges again, with unilateralism and protectionism rampant, and various trade restrictions and confrontations increasing. The G20 should face these problems squarely, explore solutions, and push all parties back onto the track of unity and cooperation. We must adhere to mutual assistance and solidarity, firmly uphold free trade, and build an open world economy.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: G20 Leaders' Summit speech
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with governance challenges, we must keep pace with the times, take the lead in upholding multilateralism, accelerate the reform of institutions such as the World Bank, the International Monetary Fund, and the World Trade Organization, enhance the voice of developing countries, and build a more equitable and open international economic and trade order.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: G20 Leaders' Summit speech on climate and environment
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Climate and ecological issues are crucial to the long-term development of all humanity. The G20 should uphold the spirit of science, adhere to the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities, demonstrate commitment, and take swift action. China has announced a new round of nationally determined contributions and is willing to strengthen cooperation with all parties within the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: G20 Leaders' Summit speech on green energy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Promoting a green transition in the energy system will not only provide strong momentum for human development but also better guarantee the equal development rights of all countries. China has built the world's largest renewable energy system and cooperates with more than 100 countries and regions in green energy. Over the past five years, the wind and solar power products provided to the world have cumulatively reduced carbon emissions by approximately 4.1 billion tons.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: G20 Leaders' Summit speech on artificial intelligence
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: AI development relies on the collective wisdom of all humanity, and openness and inclusiveness are essential. The G20 should actively promote cooperation in AI research and development and the sharing of results, bridging the intelligence gap and improving governance rules. China is a major contributor to open-source AI technology and welcomes more countries to join the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to allow Italy to continue to promote two-way opening-up, strengthen market and industrial connectivity, promote the optimised and balanced development of bilateral trade. China welcomes more Italian companies to enter the Chinese market and hopes that Italy will provide a fair, transparent, non-discriminatory, and predictable business environment for Chinese companies investing in Italy.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Mutual respect is the principle guiding China-Germany relations, and win-win cooperation is their defining feature. Developing a stable, sustainable and high-quality all-round strategic partnership is in the fundamental interests of both peoples. China is willing to strengthen strategic communication with Germany, adhere to respecting each other's core interests and major concerns.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Germany are important economic and trade partners. The two governments should work together to strengthen dialogue and communication and properly handle their respective concerns. China hopes Germany will uphold a rational and pragmatic policy towards China, eliminate interference and pressure, and focus on common interests.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks the 50th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the EU. China hopes Germany will encourage the EU to view China-EU relations with a broader vision, a longer-term perspective, and a more open mind, uphold its partnership with China, strengthen dialogue and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Kyrgyzstan, Uzbekistan and Tajikistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will leverage the unique advantages of the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and advance Chinese-style modernisation. China's commitment to high-quality development and high-level opening-up will bring new development opportunities and open up new spaces for cooperation to peripheral countries, including Central Asian countries, and countries around the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Next year will be the first year of China's 15th FYP. The Chinese side will use this as an opportunity to expand areas of cooperation with all Central Asian countries, enrich the content of cooperation, enhance the quality and efficiency of cooperation, and release the potential of cooperation, becoming fellow travelers on the road toward modernisation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Compared with other C5+1 mechanisms, the most distinctive feature of China-Central Asia cooperation is that it is a neighbourly and brotherly relationship; its greatest advantage is having mutual need and complementarity; and its greatest consensus is mutual benefit and win-win cooperation. Central Asian countries generally believe that China is their most trustworthy and reliable partner.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries on Taiwan and Japan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: I exposed the erroneous words and deeds of the current Japanese leader who has openly infringed upon China's core interests and challenged the post-World War II international order. The three countries publicly emphasised that there is only one China in the world; Taiwan is an inseparable part of China's territory; they oppose any form of 'Taiwan independence'; and firmly support all efforts made by the Chinese government to achieve national reunification.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year is the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War. The return of Taiwan—which Japan 'stole'—to China is clearly stipulated in a series of international documents, including the Cairo Declaration, the Potsdam Declaration, and the Japanese Instrument of Surrender. In this crucial year, what Japan most ought to do is deeply reflect on the history of its invasion and colonial rule of Taiwan.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What is shocking is that Japan's current serving leader actually publicly sent out wrong signals, attempting to intervene by force in the Taiwan question. The Chinese side must respond forcefully; this is both to safeguard China's sovereignty and territorial integrity, and also to defend the post-war gains won with blood and life, and uphold international justice and human conscience.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese people love peace and cherish benevolent relations with neighbours, but on major issues of principle involving national sovereignty and territorial integrity, there will absolutely not be any compromise or retreat. The Japanese government has made a solemn commitment in the four China–Japan political documents regarding the Taiwan issue. Without credibility, a person cannot establish himself; without credibility, a country cannot stand in the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview following visit to Central Asian countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side urges the Japanese side to reflect and correct its mistakes as soon as possible, and not obstinately refuse to see reason or admit mistakes. If the Japanese side insists on going its own way and repeatedly makes mistakes, then all countries and peoples who uphold justice have the right to re-settle accounts for Japan's historical crimes, and have the responsibility to resolutely prevent the revival of Japanese militarism.

article_title: How GGI Combines Marxist Viewpoints & Chinese Cultural Traditions - China-Kyrgyzstan Joint Statement

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: Quoted in Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs article on Global Governance Initiative published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international balance of power is undergoing profound changes, but reform of the global governance system has long lagged behind. We must practice true multilateralism, adhere to the global governance concept of consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, and guide global governance reform with the concepts of fairness and justice, openness and inclusiveness.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: Quoted in Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs article on Global Governance Initiative published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The collective rise of the Global South is a distinctive hallmark of the profound changes in the world unseen in a century.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: Quoted in Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs article on Global Governance Initiative published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Communist Party of China is a party that seeks happiness for the Chinese people and rejuvenation for the Chinese nation, and is also a party that seeks progress for humanity and great harmony for the world.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: General Secretary Xi Jinping solemnly put forward the Global Governance Initiative at the SCO+ meeting, explicitly answering the era's question of 'what kind of global governance system to build and how to reform and improve global governance', providing direction and guidance for the international community to cooperate in resolving global issues.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The GGI directly faces the challenges of the times and, from five aspects, clarifies the direction for reforming and improving the global governance system: upholding sovereign equality and advocating for equal participation, equal decision-making, and equal benefit-sharing among all nations; observing the rule of international law; practicing multilateralism and strengthening the central role of the UN; championing a people-centered approach; and emphasising action-orientation. This major initiative provides a systematic framework for addressing global challenges.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The shadows of hegemony, unilateralism, and protectionism persist, and the United Nations and multilateralism face mounting challenges. The number of armed conflicts worldwide has reached a new high since World War II, severely slowing human development, with over 600 million people facing hunger.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For a long time, Western developed countries have relied on their first-mover advantages to occupy a dominant position in the global governance system, promoting Western-centered governance concepts, propagating arguments such as 'hegemonic stability theory' and 'civilizational superiority theory', and frequently engaging in double standards and small-circle governance.
statements.topic: criticism of Western dominance in global governance

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The GGI opposes the law of the jungle where 'might makes right', advocating that global affairs should be discussed together by everyone; abandons the outdated logic of 'winner takes all', advocating that governance achievements should be shared together by everyone; transcends the narrow-minded concepts of bloc politics, advocating focus on the future and destiny of humanity and safeguarding the common interests of all countries.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the GGI was put forward, it has rapidly received explicit support from over 140 countries and international organizations. All parties generally believe that this major initiative demonstrates General Secretary Xi Jinping's far-sighted vision and mission commitment as a world-class leader, and highly praise China's important constructive role as a stabilizing force in the international community.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily on Global Governance Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The GGI is a practical summary and conceptual sublimation of China's long-term participation in leading the reform and construction of the global governance system, and will surely guide Chinese diplomacy to demonstrate greater accomplishments in the process of reforming and improving global governance.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Kyrgyzstan, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will always be a trustworthy friend and reliable partner of Kyrgyzstan. China will continue to firmly support Kyrgyzstan in safeguarding its sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity, support it in pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions, and oppose any external interference in its internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Kyrgyzstan, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to work with Kyrgyzstan to build an even closer community with a shared future, strengthen strategic communication and alignment, deepen economic ties, and do a good job in building the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Kyrgyzstan, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China fully supports Kyrgyzstan in assuming the SCO rotating presidency, commends Kyrgyzstan's constructive role in the China-Central Asia mechanism, and stands ready to strengthen coordination and cooperation within the United Nations and other multilateral platforms.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov in Kyrgyzstan, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China looks forward to Kyrgyzstan's early accession to the International Organization for Mediation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Strategic dialogue with Kyrgyz Foreign Minister Jeenbek Kulubaev, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Kyrgyzstan in accelerating the realization of national revitalization, and is the most trustworthy and reliable partner of Kyrgyzstan. Working together to build a China–Kyrgyzstan community of shared future featuring good-neighbourliness, friendship, and common prosperity accords with the fundamental interests of both countries, meets the aspirations of the people, and conforms to the trend of the times.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Strategic dialogue with Kyrgyz Foreign Minister Jeenbek Kulubaev, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Kyrgyzstan to deepen communication and cooperation on international affairs, and to improve and strengthen platforms such as the SCO and the China–Central Asia mechanism. China fully supports Kyrgyzstan in assuming the work of the rotating chairmanship of the SCO.

statements.speaker: China-Kyrgyzstan Joint Statement
statements.context: Joint statement signed by both sides following Wang Yi's meetings in Kyrgyzstan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Kyrgyzstan reiterated its adherence to the one-China principle, recognising Taiwan as an inseparable part of China's territory and the government of the People's Republic of China as the sole legal government representing the whole of China. Kyrgyzstan firmly opposes any form of 'Taiwan independence' and firmly supports the Chinese government's efforts to achieve national reunification and UN General Assembly Resolution 2758.

statements.speaker: China-Kyrgyzstan Joint Statement
statements.context: Joint statement signed by both sides following Wang Yi's meetings in Kyrgyzstan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Kyrgyz side highly appreciates and supports the GDI, GSI, GCI and GGI proposed by China.

article_title: Central Conference on Comprehensive Law-Based Governance - Li Qiang Meets Putin - SCO Meeting in Moscow - Zhong Sheng to Japanese PM: Withdraw Erroneous Statements & Deeds'

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: SCO heads of state meeting in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Various unilateralist and protectionist actions, especially the increase in trade barriers such as high tariffs, have severely impacted the international economic and trade order and posed enormous challenges to the development of many countries

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: SCO heads of state meeting in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Artificially hindering technological exchange and creating developmental divisions will only plunge the world into more conflict

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Regular press briefing regarding Japanese Self-Defense Force military reforms
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is alarming that in recent years, Japan has drastically readjusted its security and defense policy, increased defense budget year after year, relaxed restrictions on arms export, sought to develop offensive weapons, and planned to abandon its three non-nuclear principles. Japan's far-right forces are trying every means to break free from the pacifist constitution, and going further down the path of boosting Japan's military buildup

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official press briefing statements on Taiwan issue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The prime minister's remarks seriously violate international law and basic norms in international relations, erode the post-WWII international order, and go against the one-China principle and the spirit of the four political documents between China and Japan. Those remarks have caused fundamental damage to the political foundation of China-Japan relations. China seriously urges Japan to retract Sanae Takaichi's wrongful remarks

article_title: Li Meets Mishustin in Moscow - ZhongYin Commentary on Boosting Consumption while Cutting Waste - Wang Yi Meets Syrian FM - Shen Yiqin on China's Social Sector Agenda

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin in Moscow; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to work with Russia to follow the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, further strengthen communication, continuously deepen mutually beneficial cooperation between the two sides, and create more benefits for the two peoples. China is willing to deepen cooperation with Russia in investment, energy, agriculture, and other fields, welcomes more high-quality Russian agricultural and food products into the Chinese market, and hopes Russia will provide more convenience for Chinese enterprises investing and operating in Russia.

statements.speaker: Yang Bojiang and Tang Yongliang
statements.speaker_title: Researchers at Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era Research Center of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi's dangerous remarks involving Taiwan and her refusal to withdraw them constitute an open provocation against the postwar international order, a serious damage to Sino-Japanese relations, and a blatant challenge to China's core interests. Her remarks clearly violate the spirit of the four political documents between China and Japan, and seriously damage the political foundation and mutual trust in Sino-Japanese relations.

statements.speaker: Yang Bojiang and Tang Yongliang
statements.speaker_title: Researchers at Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era Research Center of the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Adhering to the one-China principle is a serious political commitment that Japan must fulfill. Any attempt to militarily interfere in China's internal affairs will inevitably be met with a resounding defeat. Sanae Takaichi's political attempt to achieve military expansion by hyping up the Taiwan issue, and her military adventurism that ignores the trend of the times and China's determination for reunification, will inevitably be met with a resounding defeat by the Chinese people and will certainly be opposed by peace-loving Asian countries.

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Official statement through spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang regarding US arms sales to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The arms sales seriously violate the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiques, grossly interfere in China's internal affairs, undermine China's sovereignty and security interests, and send a gravely wrong signal to 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces. We are strongly dissatisfied with and firmly opposed to this, and have lodged solemn representations with the U.S. side.
statements.topic: Taiwan, US arms sales, US-China relations

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Official statement through spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang regarding US arms sales to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any attempt to aid 'Taiwan independence' with military means will only invite trouble upon oneself, and the scheme to 'use Taiwan to contain China' is doomed to fail. We urge the U.S. side to immediately stop its wrongful actions of arming Taiwan so as to avoid harming the development of the relations between the two countries and the two militaries.
statements.topic: Taiwan, US arms sales, US-China relations

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Official statement through spokesperson Zhang Xiaogang regarding Taiwan authorities
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We warn the Democratic Progressive Party authorities that squandering the hard-earned money of people in Taiwan to purchase weapons is nothing but a dead end, and that any attempt to seek independence by relying on external forces or resist reunification with arms is destined to fail.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Syrian Minister of Foreign Affairs Asaad Hassan al-Shibani in Beijing; official readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Syria's commitment to upholding the one-China principle, and hopes that Syria will continue to staunchly support the Chinese people's just cause of opposing 'Taiwan independence' separatism and striving for national reunification, so as to jointly safeguard the political foundation of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Syrian Minister of Foreign Affairs Asaad Hassan al-Shibani in Beijing; official readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Eastern Turkistan Islamic Movement is designated by the United Nations Security Council as an international terrorist organization. Syria has pledged not to allow any entity to use Syrian territory to undermine China's interests. China appreciates this promise and hopes that Syria will take effective measures to implement it, so as to remove security obstacles to the sound and steady development of China-Syria relations.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.speaker_title: Vice Premier of the State Council
statements.context: Co-chairing the fourth China-Germany High-Level Financial Dialogue with German Vice Chancellor and Federal Minister of Finance Lars Klingbeil in Beijing; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Germany to implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries, and to make new contributions to the stability and growth of the global economy.

article_title: Zhang Youxia Outlines Roadmap for Military Modernisation during 15th FYP period

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: Article in People's Daily following Fourth Plenum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must resolutely oppose hegemonism and power politics, resolutely defend international fairness and justice, actively fulfill our responsibilities and obligations commensurate with our international status, and contribute to building a community with a shared future for mankind. We must always remain a steadfast force for maintaining world peace.
statements.framing: assertive opposition to perceived threats to international order

article_title: Fujian Aircraft Carrier Enters Service - EV Charging Facilities Goal for 2027 - Wang Yi's Call with Yvette Cooper - Li Shulei Outlines China's Vision for Cultural & Discourse Power

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister (implied from context of call with British Foreign Secretary)
statements.context: Phone call with British Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current international situation is intertwined with turbulence and transformation, and China–UK relations, if they do not advance, will retreat. Both sides should strengthen strategic communication, and promote the sustainable development of bilateral relations along a healthy, mutually beneficial, and stable track. China firmly upholds the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, safeguards the leading role of the UN in the international system, respects the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries, advocates resolving disputes through peaceful means, supports global free trade and WTO rules, and ensures the stability of global production and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with British Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the UK are both major countries and permanent members of the UN Security Council, and bear important international responsibilities for world peace, stability, and development. On major international issues, China and the UK have broadly consistent positions, which constitutes an important connotation of deepening the strategic cooperative relationship between the two countries. China is willing to work together with the British side, join hands to address global challenges, and promote world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with British Foreign Secretary Yvette Cooper
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the UK have different histories and cultures, and it is normal for differences to exist between the two sides. However, they should, on the basis of mutual respect, strive to enhance mutual understanding, providing a solid guarantee for the stability of bilateral relations. Regarding occasional discordant voices and interference, it is especially important to maintain a clear head, handle them actively and prudently, and maintain the main theme of the development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.speaker_title: Vice Premier (implied from context of high-level visit to Brazil)
statements.context: Visit to Brazil, meeting with President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's readiness to work with Brazil to strengthen political mutual trust, firmly support each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and major concerns, and jointly oppose unilateralism, protectionism and hegemonism. China is firmly committed to promoting high-quality development and higher-level opening up, which will create more opportunities for deepening practical cooperation between China and Brazil. China stands ready to expand practical cooperation across various fields and upgrade cooperation so as to achieve more landmark and exemplary outcomes.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Visit to Brazil, meeting with President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the strategic guidance of Xi and Lula, the building of a China-Brazil community with a shared future and the alignment of the two countries' development strategies have got off to a good start. China-Brazil cooperation has become a model for collaboration between major developing countries, with its strategic, comprehensive and long-term significance increasingly evident.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Visit to Brazil, meeting with President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China calls on the two sides to strengthen coordination and collaboration in multilateral arenas, advance the reform and improvement of global governance, and safeguard the interests of the developing countries. China will enhance cooperation on poverty reduction and implement the Global Development Initiative to deliver more benefits to both peoples and the people of the world. China supports Brazil in playing its active role as a major country in the region, safeguarding peace and stability in Latin America and the Caribbean.

statements.speaker: Zhang Guoqing
statements.context: 2025 BRI Ministers' Meeting on Natural Disaster Prevention and Emergency Management in Sanya
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Through practical measures such as dispatching international rescue teams and providing disaster relief material assistance, China has contributed its strength to international cooperation in natural disaster prevention and control. China is willing to work with all parties to actively implement the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative, Global Civilization Initiative, and Global Governance Initiative, continuously promote the building of relevant cooperation mechanisms, join hands in deepening disaster prevention capabilities, strengthen technological empowerment for disaster reduction, and enhance international responses to major disasters.

article_title: Li Qiang: Economic Development Remains China's 'Central Task' - Invoking Zou Taofen’s 'Patriotic Spirit' for Journalists - Wang Jiang on Financial Sector Policy Direction

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to Fijian President on 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Fiji have always respected each other, treated each other as equals and pursued win-win cooperation. China attaches great importance to the development of China-Fiji relations and stands ready to strengthen political mutual trust, expand cooperation across various fields, and elevate the China-Fiji comprehensive strategic partnership to a higher level.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with Uruguayan President Yamandu Orsi and Vice President Carolina Cosse during visit to Uruguay
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Uruguay under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state to continue the traditional friendship, continuously enrich the connotation of the China-Uruguay comprehensive strategic partnership, and make greater contributions to world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with Uruguayan Vice President Carolina Cosse
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Uruguay's long-term, firm adherence to the one-China principle and believes that both sides will continue to firmly support each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and major concerns.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with Uruguayan Vice President Carolina Cosse
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always viewed its relations with Latin American and Caribbean countries from a strategic height and a long-term perspective. China stands ready to work with Uruguay and other Latin American countries to implement five programs ranging from solidarity, development and civilization to peace and people-to-people connectivity, and jointly build a China-Latin America community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Remarks at opening of China International Import Expo (CIIE)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The reason the CIIE has been increasingly successful is because it adheres to the principle of 'seeking shared benefits with the world'. In contrast, some unilateralist and protectionist actions in the international arena are severely impacting the international economic and trade order and disrupting the global economy.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Remarks at opening of China International Import Expo (CIIE)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must adhere to equal and mutually beneficial cooperation, embrace free trade, and promote the resolution of contradictions and problems through joint development. We should balance righteousness and interests, work together, and help each other. China is willing to work with all parties to actively promote the implementation of the Global Governance Initiative in the international economic and trade field and reform and improve the multilateral trading system with the WTO at its core.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China attaches great importance to the development of China-Iran relations. Chinese President Xi Jinping and Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian reached important consensus on and provided strategic guidance for deepening bilateral ties. China is readiness to work with Iran to implement the consensus reached between the two heads of state, seek development and rejuvenation of the two countries and deepen their mutually beneficial cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Iran's active support for the four major global initiatives proposed by Xi, and is willing to work with Iran and the rest of the international community to make positive contributions to building a more just and equitable global governance system.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always maintained an objective and impartial position on the Iranian nuclear issue. The current political settlement process has reached a deadlock, which is not in the common interests of the international community. China hopes that all parties will maintain dialogue and communication to bring the Iranian nuclear issue back to the track of dialogue and negotiation.

statements.speaker: Dong Jun
statements.context: Meeting with Serbian Defense Minister Bratislav Gasic, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Serbia are iron-clad friends who have stood together through thick and thin. China is ready to work with Serbia to implement the important consensus reached between the two heads of state on building a community with a shared future for the new era.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on easing tariff measures against the US, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To implement the consensus of the China-U.S. Kuala Lumpur economic and trade talks, China has decided that related measures against 15 U.S. entities will be lifted on Nov. 10, 2025, while related measures against 16 U.S. entities will remain in suspension for one year.

statements.speaker: Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council
statements.context: Official announcement on suspension of tariff measures against the US
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to suspend the 24-percent additional tariff on imports from the United States for one year while retaining the 10-percent rate. The move aims to implement the outcomes and consensus reached in the China-U.S. economic and trade talks. The continued suspension of certain additional tariffs will help promote the sound, stable and sustainable development of bilateral economic and trade relations, bring benefits to the people of both countries, and contribute to global prosperity.

statements.speaker: Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council
statements.context: Official announcement on termination of tariff measures against the US
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will terminate the additional tariff measures on certain imports originating from the United States including chicken, wheat, corn, cotton, sorghum, soybeans, pork, beef, aquatic products, fruits, vegetables and dairy products. The termination serves the fundamental interests of both countries and their people, meets expectations of the international community, and will help advance bilateral economic and trade relations to a higher level.

article_title: Xi Meets Russian PM - Li Meets PMs of Georgia & Serbia - Wang Yi's Article on China post-Fourth Plenum Approach to Foreign Affairs
