statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current situation in the Middle East is very critical, which again proves that the world has entered a new period of turbulence and transformation. If the conflict escalates further, not only will the conflicting parties suffer greater losses, but regional countries will also suffer greatly. Proposed four points: (1) promoting ceasefire and stopping war as urgent priority; (2) protecting civilians as top priority; (3) opening dialogue and negotiation as fundamental way out; (4) international community's peacemaking efforts are indispensable, especially major countries and UN Security Council.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Same telephone call with Putin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to continue to strengthen communication and coordination with all parties, pool efforts, uphold justice, and play a constructive role in restoring peace in the Middle East.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaohong
statements.context: Meeting with David Perdue, US Ambassador to China, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with the United States to well implement the important consensus reached between their two heads of state, and based on the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, strengthen practical cooperation in law enforcement fields such as drug control and the repatriation of illegal immigrants, to achieve results conducive to the well-being of the people in both countries. Hopes the United States will work together with China, uphold an attitude of equality, respect each other's concerns, and inject positive energy into the development of bilateral relations.

article_title: Takeaways from Xi's Astana Visit - He Lifeng Seeks More Support for Foreign Trade Enterprises - Wang Talks to Egyptian, Omani FMs - How are Central SoEs Boosting Tech Self-Reliance?

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: China-Central Asia Summit in Kazakhstan; reported by Wang Yi in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Announced the 'China-Central Asia Spirit' emphasizing mutual respect and equal treatment, deepening mutual trust, mutual benefit and win-win cooperation, and watching out for and helping each other. Stated opposition to any actions violating other countries' sovereignty, security, and territorial integrity. Military conflict is not the way to solve problems; all parties should work to cool down conflicts and avoid escalation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Summary of Xi Jinping's Kazakhstan visit; People's Daily article
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Central Asian countries have established comprehensive cooperation framework with 13 ministerial-level platforms. All parties agreed that tariff wars and trade wars have no winners, and unilateralism and protectionism have no way out. Sharing development experience with developing countries is China's responsibility and duty, implementing the Global Development Initiative. China pursues joint development and win-win cooperation, not modernisation for itself alone.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Egyptian Foreign Minister Badr Abdelatty; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Israel's disregard for international law and international rules has caused the situation in the Middle East to suddenly become tense. China is deeply concerned the situation could go out of control. China calls on parties to the conflict, especially Israel, to put regional peoples' interests and well-being first, immediately achieve ceasefire, ease tensions, and create conditions for dialogue and negotiations. China fully supports Egypt's joint statement with 20 Arab and Islamic countries calling for ceasefire and end to war, restarting Iranian nuclear negotiations.
statements.topic: Middle East, Israel-Iran conflict, international law
statements.framing: accusatory toward Israel, supportive of Egypt

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Omani Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr bin Hamad bin Hamood Albusaidi; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The rights and wrongs of the current situation are crystal clear. Israel's actions violate international law and norms of international relations, infringe upon Iran's sovereignty and security, and undermine regional peace and stability. China has always advocated peaceful settlement of all disputes and opposed the use or threat of force, expressing immediate opposition to Israel's use of force. Top priority is to cease fire and end fighting. China supports the joint statement by 21 Arab and Islamic countries calling for respecting sovereignty and territorial integrity and resolving disputes through peaceful means.
statements.topic: Middle East, Israel-Iran conflict, international law, regional stability
statements.framing: accusatory toward Israel, constructive toward regional peace

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Inspection of foreign trade and economic work in Shandong (June 17-18); People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's foreign trade manufacturing enterprises have overcome numerous difficulties, demonstrated tenacious resilience, withstood pressure in a complex and severe international environment. With high-quality and competitively-priced export products enjoying reputation in international markets, they have supported domestic economic development and benefited global economic stability while maintaining stable flow of global industrial and supply chains.
statements.framing: assertive about China's capabilities and resilience

article_title: What Happened at the China-Central Asia Summit?

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at China-Central Asia Summit in Astana
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is no winner in tariff wars or trade wars. Unilateralism, protectionism and hegemonism will surely backfire while hurting others. History should move forward, not backward; and the world should be united, not divided. Humanity must not regress to the law of the jungle.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at China-Central Asia Summit in Astana
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes hegemonism and power politics, and promotes an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev at China-Central Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should strengthen collaboration within multilateral platforms to jointly safeguard international equity and justice and uphold the international economic and trade order.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Uzbek President Shavkat Mirziyoyev at China-Central Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply worried as Israel's military operation against Iran has caused a sudden escalation of tensions in the Middle East. China opposes any actions that infringe upon sovereignty, security and territorial integrity of other countries. Military conflicts are not the solution to problems, and the escalation of regional situations is not in the common interests of the international community. China is ready to work with all parties to play a constructive role in restoring peace and stability in the Middle East.
statements.topic: Middle East policy and international conflict

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Chief of International Department of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Sri Lankan JVP delegation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with the turbulent international situation, regional countries should strengthen unity and self-reliance, and jointly respond to risks and challenges. China and Sri Lanka should strengthen cooperation in international and regional affairs, jointly defend international fairness and justice and the global economic and trade order.

article_title: China-Kazakhstan Ties - May Economic Data - Wang Huning on Deepening Cross-Strait Integrated Development

statements.context: Meeting with Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev in Astana ahead of Second China-Central Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always viewed and developed China-Kazakhstan relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective. China is willing to work with Kazakhstan to unswervingly consolidate China-Kazakhstan friendship and make more contributions to regional and even world peace and development with the stability and positive energy of China-Kazakhstan relations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Kazakh President Kassym-Jomart Tokayev in Astana
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of the turbulent international situation, China and Kazakhstan should firmly safeguard the international system with the UN at its core and the international order based on international law, practice true multilateralism, and clearly safeguard the common interests of the vast number of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Special meeting on construction of cross-Strait integrated development demonstration zone in Xiamen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to adhere to Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era as the guide, thoroughly implement the spirit of the 20th Party Congress and the Third Plenary Session, implement the overall strategy of the Party for resolving the Taiwan issue in the new era, and build the Cross-Strait Integrated Development Demonstration Zone with high quality.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Special meeting on construction of cross-Strait integrated development demonstration zone in Xiamen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Deepening cross-strait integrated development is of great significance and responsibility. It is necessary to focus on the goals and tasks of building the cross-Strait integrated development demonstration zone, strengthen responsibility and commitment, enhance planning and advancement, and launch more innovative measures and outcomes of integrated development.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Special meeting on construction of cross-Strait integrated development demonstration zone in Xiamen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Firmly grasp the focus of cross-strait integration and development. Strengthen innovation and breakthroughs, optimize the business environment related to Taiwan, strengthen care and assistance for Taiwan compatriots and Taiwan enterprises, and attract more Taiwan compatriots and Taiwan enterprises to develop in the mainland and participate in the process of Chinese-style modernisation.

article_title: NDRC's Party Group on 15th Five-Year Plan Agenda

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article in Qiushi magazine (published in People's Daily report)

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article in Qiushi magazine (published in People's Daily report)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The people's yearning for a beautiful life is the goal of our struggle, and the people's confidence and support are the driving force of China's progress. statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: Remarks at the 17th Straits Forum in Xiamen, Fujian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: General Secretary Xi Jinping has emphasized that compatriots on both sides of the strait are one family, and no one can sever our blood ties and no one can stop the historical trend of the reunification of the motherland. statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: Remarks at the 17th Straits Forum in Xiamen, Fujian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks the 80th anniversary of the victory of the Chinese People's War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and the World Anti-Fascist War, as well as the 80th anniversary of the recovery of Taiwan. statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: Remarks at the 17th Straits Forum in Xiamen, Fujian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We always grasp the overall situation of cross-strait relations from the perspective of the overall interests and long-term development of the Chinese nation, resolutely serve as a strong backing and support for Taiwan compatriots, and are committed to deepening cross-strait integrated development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quote cited in Wang Chengguo's article on common prosperity published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is neither a fixed modernisation model nor a universal modernisation standard in the world. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quote cited in Wang Chengguo's article on common prosperity published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Entering a new development stage, we must pay greater attention to the issue of common prosperity in order to fully, accurately and comprehensively implement the new development concept.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quote cited in Wang Chengguo's article on common prosperity published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Developing new quality productive forces is an inherent requirement and important focus of promoting high-quality development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quote cited in Wang Chengguo's article on common prosperity published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Constructing a new development pattern with the domestic major circulation as the mainstay and the domestic and international dual circulation mutually promoting each other is an inevitable choice to meet the requirements of China's new development stage and to shape new advantages in international cooperation and competition.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quote cited in Wang Chengguo's article on common prosperity published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We persist in and develop Chinese socialism, promoting coordinated development of material civilization, political civilization, spiritual civilization, social civilization, and ecological civilization, creating a new path of Chinese modernization and a new form of human civilization.

statements.speaker_title: State Councillor, Member of the Politburo Standing Committee

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Qinghai is a strategic location for stabilizing Xinjiang and securing Tibet. Maintaining Qinghai's security and stability is extremely important. statements.speaker: Chen Wenqing
statements.speaker_title: State Councillor, Member of the Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: Official visit to Qinghai Province
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must always keep taut the string of anti-terrorism struggle, punish religious extremism according to law, strengthen prevention in key regions and key areas, and firmly hold the bottom line of not allowing violent terrorist cases and incidents to occur.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
statements.context: Official policy document issued in June 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has issued its first policy document in the manufacturing metrology field, setting targets to achieve breakthroughs in more than 100 key metrology calibration technologies, formulate and revise more than 300 industry metrology calibration specifications, and develop more than 100 sets of measuring instruments and reference materials by 2027.

The two sides will further leverage the China-US economic and trade consultation mechanism, continue to maintain communication and dialogue, continuously enhance consensus, reduce misunderstandings, strengthen cooperation, and jointly promote the steady and long-term development of China-US economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: He Yadong
statements.context: Report on talks between US and China in London, People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding the rare earth issue, China as a responsible major power, fully considers the reasonable demands and concerns of various countries in the civilian field, conducts reviews of rare earth-related items export license applications in accordance with law and regulations, has already lawfully approved a certain quantity of compliant applications, and will continuously strengthen the approval work for compliant applications.

statements.speaker: He Yadong
statements.context: Report on talks between US and China in London, People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position of opposing unilateral tariff measures is consistent; it urges the US to abide by WTO rules and work with China in accordance with the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation to jointly promote the stable and sustainable development of China-US economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.context: Speech at the 22nd Oslo Forum on China's role in global mediation and peacemaking
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is the UN Security Council permanent member that dispatches the most peacekeeping personnel and the UN's second-largest peacekeeping contributor. It has never actively provoked any war or conflict; it has repeatedly stated publicly that no matter how developed it is, it will never seek hegemony, expansion, sphere of influence, or arms race; it is the only country that publicly promised not to use nuclear weapons first and not to use or threaten to use nuclear weapons against non-nuclear weapon states and nuclear-weapon-free zones. China in the new era has become an important force in maintaining world peace.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.context: Speech at the 22nd Oslo Forum on China's role in global mediation and peacemaking
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For some time, the basic norms of international relations have been challenged, globalisation has encountered headwinds, unilateralism has risen, power politics has proliferated, localised conflicts and turmoil have occurred frequently, and certainty and stability have become increasingly scarce resources in the world. In the face of the above challenges, countries should unite and cooperate to inject stability and certainty into the world.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.context: Speech at the 22nd Oslo Forum on China's role in global mediation and peacemaking
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding disputes and conflicts in the world, China has always adhered to the principles of sovereign equality, fairness and justice, solidarity and cooperation, multilateralism, and respect for international rule of law, and advocated promoting political solutions through dialogue and consultation. The GSI proposed by President Xi Jinping has been appreciated and supported by more than 120 countries and international organizations. China supports the UN in playing a core role in international conflict mediation and calls on all countries to jointly uphold the humanitarian spirit and actively participate in global humanitarian assistance operations.

article_title: Analysing the China-Africa Changsha Declaration - What's the Big Deal with the China-US London Deal? Guangdong's New AI & Robotics Alliance - Li Qiang's Tough Message to State Council Officials

statements.context: Congratulatory letter to FOCAC Ministerial Meeting in Changsha, reported by Xinhua

China is ready to negotiate and sign the agreement of China-Africa Economic Partnership for Shared Development to implement zero-tariff treatment for 100 percent tariff lines for 53 African countries. China will work with Africa to deepen implementation of 10 partnership actions for modernization, strengthen cooperation in green industry, e-commerce, science and technology, and artificial intelligence.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with US head of state on June 5, referenced in He Lifeng's remarks on London meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides reached strategic consensus that teams should continue to implement Geneva consensus and hold new round of talks as soon as possible. Both sides should make good use of the established economic and trade consultation mechanism.

statements.speaker: China-Africa Ministerial Meeting (Joint Declaration)
statements.context: China-Africa Changsha Declaration issued at FOCAC ministerial meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We agree that the frequent occurrence of unilateralism, protectionism and economic bullying has created severe difficulties for African countries and other developing countries. We call on all countries, the United States in particular, to return to the right track of resolving trade disputes through consultation based on equality, respect and mutual benefit.

statements.speaker: China-Africa Ministerial Meeting (Joint Declaration)
statements.context: China-Africa Changsha Declaration issued at FOCAC ministerial meeting

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting between Chinese and American officials in London
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's attitude and position on Sino-US economic and trade issues are clear and consistent. The essence of Sino-US economic and trade relations is mutual benefit and win-win. China and the United States will benefit from cooperation in the economic and trade field, but will suffer from confrontation. There are no winners in a trade war. China does not want to fight, but it is not afraid of fighting.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting between Chinese and American officials in London
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should resolve economic and trade differences through equal dialogue and mutually beneficial cooperation. China is sincere and principled in economic and trade consultations. Both sides should move toward each other, match words with deeds, act on their commitments with sincerity and practical efforts, jointly safeguard the hard-won outcomes of dialogue, maintain communication and dialogue, and promote steady and long-term development of China-US economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: State Council constitutional oath ceremony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The task of comprehensively advancing Chinese-style modernisation through high-quality development is extremely arduous and heavy, and the external environment is increasingly complex and severe. We must carry forward the spirit of not avoiding difficulties and courageously taking responsibility, strengthen the will to dare to struggle and be good at struggling. We must unwaveringly handle our own affairs well and firmly grasp the initiative in development.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on London economic and trade talks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The talks in London were a new step taken by both sides to resolve bilateral economic and trade issues through equal dialogue. Both China and the US recognise the importance of stable China-US economic and trade relations to the economies of both countries and the global economy. The constructive results achieved by the meeting have brought new optimism to the world.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on London economic and trade talks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facts have proved that the unilateral trade restrictions taken by the United States have not only harmed the interests of Chinese companies, but also domestic companies and consumers in the United States, and have dragged down the long-term stable growth of the world economy.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on London economic and trade talks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is sincere about economic and trade consultations, but at the same time is also principled. As a responsible major country, the Chinese side takes seriously, strictly implements, and actively maintains the Geneva economic and trade talks consensus. We hope that the US side, like the Chinese side, will match words with deeds and deeds with results, showing the spirit of integrity in keeping commitments and concrete actions in earnestly implementing consensus, resolving bilateral economic and trade issues through equal dialogue.

The key is to be guided by the important consensus of the two heads of state, and based on the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation, to find proper ways to resolve issues through equal dialogue and consultation. Confrontation, conflict, and trade wars do not serve the interests of either China or the US.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To fundamentally solve the problems, the US side needs to thoroughly correct the erroneous practice of unilateral tariff increases, continuously strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation, and work with China to actively implement the important consensus reached during the phone call between the leaders of the two countries on January 17 this year.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The road ahead might not be smooth, but China is willing to work together with the US side, using this round of high-level China-US economic and trade talks as a good foundation, to continue advancing with a pragmatic attitude toward problem-solving, maintain the momentum of dialogue, deeply explore cooperation potential, extend the list of cooperative projects, enlarge the scope of cooperation, and promote the healthy and stable development of China-US economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meetings with foreign ministers at China-CELAC Forum in Beijing and article preview of the forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In particular, certain major powers pursue a 'country first' approach, attempting to seize the development achievements of China, Latin America and other 'Global South' countries, delaying or even interrupting the modernisation process of China and Latin America. Modernisation is the legitimate right of all peoples, not the private patent of a few countries. Turning back the wheel of history does not win people's hearts, and hegemonism has no future.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article preview of China-CELAC Forum in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China–Latin America cooperation is an inevitable choice for upholding fairness and justice for humankind. China advocates consultation, joint construction, and shared benefits, in sharp contrast to hegemonic and bullying behaviour. China's investment in Latin America and the Caribbean does not come with any political conditions, aligns with the needs of the Latin American side, and 'empowers' their development. In contrast, the actions of certain major powers in Latin America bring only 'negative energy'.

China hopes for and supports an early ceasefire between Pakistan and India. Once a ceasefire is reached, it must be jointly observed to prevent recurrence of conflict. China is willing to continue playing a positive role. statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on upcoming US-China talks

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on upcoming US-China talks

statements.speaker: People's Daily

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Article on China's major power diplomacy

statements.speaker: People's Daily

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

Countries need to translate the Call to Action on Global Governance Reform launched by the G20 foreign ministers into action and firmly safeguard the international system with the U.N. at its core.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: G20 Foreign Ministers' meeting in South Africa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Recently the calls for peace talks are rising and the window of opportunity for peace is opening. China always calls for an early and peaceful settlement of the crisis and has been actively promoting peace talks. China supports all efforts dedicated to peace, including the recent consensus reached between the United States and Russia.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: G20 Foreign Ministers' meeting in South Africa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports the African people in independently resolving African problems, and opposes external interference in the internal affairs of African countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia, as major victorious nations of World War II and permanent members of the United Nations Security Committee, jointly bear the crucial responsibility of safeguarding the victorious results of World War II and maintaining the post-war international order. Both nations are duty-bound to uphold their international moral obligations as major countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides should take the opportunity of jointly commemorating the 80th anniversary to deepen China-Russia strategic coordination, actively promote the correct view on World War II, firmly defend the international system with the United Nations at its core, safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Global South countries, and promote the building of an equal and orderly multipolar world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to play a constructive role in promoting peace talks and political settlement of the [Ukraine] crisis.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Russian Foreign Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: While promoting initiatives for a peaceful settlement of the Ukrainian crisis, Beijing believes it necessary to eradicate its root causes in accordance with the corresponding principles of the UN Charter, above all unconditional respect for human rights.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Indian Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi Jinping and Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi held a successful meeting in Kazan last year, which set the general direction for the improvement and development of bilateral relations. China and India, as two ancient civilizations and neighboring countries, should trust and support each other and help each other succeed.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of the two countries, China-Australia relations have stabilized. China appreciates Australia's repeated commitment to the one-China principle, and hopes that Australia will continue to respect China's core interests and major concerns, safeguard the political foundation of bilateral relations, and properly manage differences.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Australian Foreign Minister Penny Wong at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Major countries, in particular, should demonstrate exemplary responsibility in firmly opposing 'turning back the wheel of history' and returning to the 'law of the jungle'. China is ready to work with Australia and other members of the international community to defend the victorious outcomes of World War II and uphold the international system with the United Nations at its core.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Palestinian question is the core of the Middle East issue. China will continue to stand firmly with Arab brothers and make efforts to redress historical injustice thoroughly and restore lasting peace in the region at an early date.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan at G20
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China attaches great importance to its relations with Türkiye and places bilateral relations at an important position in its Middle East diplomacy. Resolutely countering terrorism in all forms serves the common interests of both China and Türkiye and is a strong consensus of the international community.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A multipolar world is both a historical inevitability and is becoming a new reality. Promoting the construction of an equal and orderly multipolar world is an important proposition put forward by President Xi Jinping. China will be a factor of certainty in the multipolar system and will firmly be a constructive force in a changing world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We advocate treating each other as equals, adhering to equality of rights, equality of opportunity, and equality of rules. Countries big and small are all equal. We should enhance the representation and voice of developing countries in the international system.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Major powers should take the lead in being trustworthy and upholding the rule of law, resolutely abandon zero-sum games, should not return to jungle law, and cannot practice double standards in complying with international law.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Protectionism is not the way out, 'decoupling and breaking chains' cuts off opportunities, 'small yards with high walls' only closes oneself off. We must support equal and orderly world multipolarity with inclusive economic globalisation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always viewed China-EU relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective, regarding Europe as an important direction of major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics and a key partner in achieving Chinese-style modernization. China-EU relations are not targeted at, dependent on, or subject to any third party.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During this European trip, I felt that under the strategic guidance of head-of-state diplomacy, Europe's policy towards China is becoming more rational and pragmatic. Europe hopes to understand China's thoughts and actions, is willing to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with China, handle differences through dialogue.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peace and stability are the common pursuit of the international community, with the vast majority of countries hoping for the cessation of warfare, expecting hot spots to cool down, worrying about division and confrontation, and opposing the resort to force at every turn.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Development and prosperity are the urgent expectations of all countries, with Global South countries having an even more urgent desire for development and revitalisation. Trade wars are unpopular, and unilateral sanctions will inevitably backfire.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview captured in People's Daily following European and South African visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Expecting China to play a role is a universal call. More and more countries realize that China is a stable anchor in a turbulent world, hoping that China will play a role and make contributions in responding to various global challenges.

article_title: What Private Entrepreneurs Told Xi During Monday's Meeting - State Council Studies Consumption Policies - Lan Fo’an on Fiscal Policy Priorities for 2025 - What Indonesia Desires from BRICS

statements.speaker: Lei Jun
statements.context: Symposium with private entrepreneurs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We firmly believe that despite changing international circumstances, as long as we have the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core leading the people of the whole country united in moving forward, there is nothing that cannot be overcome.

article_title: Xi Attaches 'Great Importance' to Private Economy - China's Development Philosophy Now a Global Public Good? - Wang Yi's Multilateralism Pitch at UNSC - 20-Point Plan on Foreign Investment

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UN Security Council high-level meeting on 'Practicing Multilateralism, Reforming and Improving Global Governance'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to uphold practicing multilateralism, defend the vision of the United Nations, and firmly safeguard the authority of the United Nations. China is ready to work with all countries for a better future.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UN Security Council high-level meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Upholding sovereign equality: all countries participate as equals, make decisions as equals, and benefit as equals. Members must respect the development paths chosen independently by people of all countries, uphold the principle of non-interference in internal affairs, and not impose one's will upon others. Any unilateral sanction that circumvents Security Council authorization lacks legal basis, defies justification and contradicts common sense.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UN Security Council high-level meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Upholding fairness and justice: International affairs should no longer be monopolized by a small number of countries. Countries in the Global South have the right to speak up for and defend their legitimate rights and interests. The reform of the U.N. Security Council should continue to emphasize democratic consultation, increase the representation and say of developing countries, especially African countries, and effectively redress historical injustice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UN Security Council high-level meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Upholding solidarity and coordination: Countries should commit to the principle of extensive consultation and joint contribution for shared benefit, replace confrontation with coordination, prevent lose-lose through win-win cooperation, and break down small circles with greater solidarity. The U.N. Security Council must rise above narrow-minded geopolitical considerations, champion the spirit of solidarity and cooperation, fulfill its duties conferred by the U.N. Charter, and effectually play its role for the maintenance of international peace and security.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistani FM Mohammad Ishaq Dar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Pakistan are all-weather strategic cooperative partners, and the two sides have always trusted and supported each other. China prioritizes relations with Pakistan in its neighborhood diplomacy and will continue to uphold justice and speak up for Pakistan on international occasions. China will seek greater synergy of development strategies with Pakistan, in particular, deepen cooperation on agricultural modernization and industrialization, and help Pakistan enhance its capacity for independent development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Hungarian Foreign Minister Péter Szijjártó
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Hungary's rational and objective stance on hotspot conflict issues and believes that Hungary will continue to contribute to peace and stability in Europe. Regardless of changes in the international landscape, China will always be a trustworthy partner for Hungary. Hungary will continue to play a constructive role in the sound and stable development of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Ugandan Foreign Minister Jeje Odongo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international community cannot promote multilateralism without African voices, or improve global governance without African participation. China is willing to work with African partners to build a just and equitable global governance system and make joint efforts for world peace, stability, development and prosperity. China and Uganda have always respected, trusted and supported each other.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Bolivian Foreign Minister Celinda Sosa Lunda
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Standing at a new historical starting point, China is ready to make joint efforts with Bolivia to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation and take China-Bolivia strategic partnership to new heights. China supports Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in Bolivia to help the country accelerate development and improve people's livelihood. Latin America is the homeland of the Latin American people, not the backyard of any country. China supports Latin American countries in safeguarding sovereignty, independence and national dignity. China will always be a reliable friend and partner of Latin America.

article_title: What's Xi's Message to Private Entrepreneurs? - Wang Yi Visits Ireland - Plan for New-energy Storage Manufacturing Industry

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Irish Taoiseach Micheal Martin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to promoting broader and deeper reform across the board, advancing Chinese modernization, and building a higher-standard open economy, which will bring new opportunities to all countries, including Ireland. China is ready to work with Ireland to strengthen dialogue, enhance mutual trust, and properly manage differences.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Irish Foreign Minister Simon Harris
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Ireland to implement consensus reached by leaders and be partners based on mutual trust, respect and support. China calls for building an equal and orderly multipolar world. China and the EU are key forces in a multipolar world and should collaborate to uphold UN authority, adhere to fundamental norms of international relations, oppose unilateralism, and reject resurgence of 'the law of the jungle'.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Editorial commentary on China-Europe relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always viewed China-EU relations from a strategic height and long-term perspective. China and the EU share broad common interests, with cooperation outweighing competition. Both sides should oppose unilateralism and protectionism, safeguard the international system with the UN at its core, and work together to promote an equal and orderly multipolar world based on equal rights, equal opportunities, and equal rules.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Editorial commentary on China-Europe relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a factor of certainty in a multipolar system and is firmly committed to being a constructive force in a changing world. China has always believed Europe is an important pole in a multipolar world and supports European integration and EU strategic autonomy. Both sides should cooperate rather than compete and oppose camp confrontation.

article_title: Xi Meets Thai PM & Sultan of Brunei - China-Pakistan Joint Statement

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Sultan of Brunei Haji Hassanal Bolkiah Mu'izzaddin Waddaulah
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two countries should enhance synergy between the Belt and Road Initiative and Brunei's Wawasan 2035, advance flagship projects of the Guangxi-Brunei Economic Corridor and Hengyi Petrochemical project, and China is willing to encourage more Chinese businesses to invest in Brunei and support development of digital economy, artificial intelligence, and new energy industries

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Sultan of Brunei Haji Hassanal Bolkiah Mu'izzaddin Waddaulah
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Brunei should jointly advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, safeguard international fairness and justice, and play a positive role in promoting global and regional peace and stability

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of profound changes unseen in a century, China and Thailand should consolidate strategic mutual trust, firmly support each other, and respond to uncertainties in the external environment with the stability and certainty of China-Thailand relations. China is ready to work with Thailand to align development strategies, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, and implement flagship projects such as the China-Thailand Railway

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Thai Prime Minister Paetongtarn Shinawatra
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to work closely with Thailand to firmly defend the international system with the United Nations at its core and the international order based on international law, enhance unity and cooperation in the Global South, safeguard world peace and promote common development

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan President Zardari
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to forge synergy between development strategies, jointly promote high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, advance construction of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor, push forward construction of major projects concerning roads, railways and ports, deepen cooperation in agriculture, mining, new energy, information technology and artificial intelligence

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan President Zardari
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to continue to support each other and strengthen coordination with Pakistan at multilateral forums in order to safeguard their respective sovereignty, security and development interests

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Sultan of Brunei Hassanal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports ASEAN in strengthening unity and strategic autonomy, and is willing to work with ASEAN countries including Brunei to promote the building of a closer China-ASEAN community with a shared future

article_title: Xi Meets Zardari & Japarov - Boosting Self-reliance in Military Equipment - Li Wants Breakthroughs in Domestic Circulation, Tech & Industrial Upgrading - Cai Qi on Fighting Formalism

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistani President Asif Ali Zardari, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Pakistan enjoy ironclad friendship and are all-weather strategic cooperative partners. China will support Pakistan firmly in safeguarding its sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity, in combating terrorism, and in following a development path suited to its national conditions.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Kyrgyzstan are good neighbors, good friends and good partners. China supports Kyrgyzstan in taking a development path that suits its national conditions and is willing to deepen cooperation. China hopes Kyrgyzstan will strengthen security measures for Chinese personnel, projects and institutions.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz President Sadyr Japarov, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work closely with Kyrgyzstan to adhere to the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, resist unilateralism and hegemony, strengthen multilateral cooperation, and safeguard the common interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Panama Canal issue, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has recently made irresponsible remarks on the Panama Canal issue, and intentionally distorted, attacked and mischaracterized relevant cooperation. China firmly opposes it and made stern demarches to the U.S. side.
statements.topic: US-China relations, Panama Canal, bilateral disputes

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Official statement on Panama Canal issue, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation between China and Panama under the framework of the BRI is carrying out normally and has achieved fruitful outcomes. China hopes relevant parties will strengthen confidence, resist external interruption, and make the right decision while keeping in mind the overall bilateral relations and the long-term interests of the people of the two countries.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Official statement on Gaza ceasefire and Trump's Gaza remarks, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has all along believed that 'the Palestinians governing Palestine' is the fundamental principle of post-conflict governance of Gaza. We oppose the forced displacement of the people in Gaza, and hope that relevant parties will take the opportunity of the ceasefire and post-conflict governance in Gaza to bring the Palestinian question back to the right track of a political settlement based on the two-State solution.
statements.topic: US policy, Gaza, Middle East, international affairs

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: State Council plenary meeting on government work report, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with new situations and tasks, it is necessary to coordinate efforts to address domestic economic issues while responding to external challenges, be good at transforming pressure into motivation, and take strong measures to achieve new breakthroughs while responding to external challenges.
statements.topic: US-China relations, economic policy, external challenges

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Announcement regarding Chinese naval fleet participation in multinational joint exercise in Pakistan, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A Chinese naval fleet consisting of the vessels of Baotou and Gaoyouhu will participate in a multinational joint exercise in Pakistan this February at the invitation of the Pakistani military. During the exercise, code-named 'Peace-2025', participating vessels will conduct drills focused on maritime resupply, joint anti-piracy operations, search and rescue, and air defense.
statements.topic: military operations, bilateral military cooperation, maritime security

article_title: Xi: 'Our Historical Course to Build a Strong Country & Rejuvenate the Nation Will Not be Blocked' - Indian Foreign Secretary's Beijing Visit

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Chinese New Year reception remarks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States share extensive common interests and broad space for cooperation and can become partners and friends. China and the United States can achieve mutual success and common prosperity for the benefit of both countries and the world at large.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Chinese New Year card to friends in Iowa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi expressed hope that the two peoples will pay more visits to each other and have more exchanges, jointly write new stories of friendship between the two peoples, and make new contributions to the development of China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Indian Foreign Secretary Vikram Misri in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides should seize opportunities, move towards each other, explore more substantive measures, and be committed to mutual understanding, mutual support, and mutual achievement, rather than mutual suspicion, mutual estrangement, and mutual consumption.

article_title: Xi's Liaoning Visit - Wang-Rubio Call - Zhang Youxia & He Weidong Stress Combat Readiness - Deep Dive: Chinese Scholars Discuss China's Role as 'Defender of the International Order'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi Jinping had an important phone call with President Trump last Friday, during which a series of consensuses were reached. The development of China-US relations has reached a new critical juncture. Xi comprehensively elaborated on China's policy toward the US, and Trump responded positively, expressing his expectation of maintaining a good relationship with Xi. Both teams must implement the important consensus reached by the two leaders, uphold the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation, maintain communication, manage differences, expand cooperation, and promote the stable, healthy, and sustainable development of China-US relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The leadership of the Communist Party of China is the choice of the Chinese people, and China's development follows a clear historical logic and possesses strong internal momentum. Our goal is to enable the people to live better lives and to contribute more significantly to the world. We have no intention of surpassing or replacing anyone, but we must defend our legitimate right to development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan has been a part of China's territory since ancient times, and China will never allow Taiwan to be separated from the country. The US has made solemn commitments to the one-China policy in the three China-US Joint Communiqués and must not breach its word.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio, readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Major countries should act like major countries and should take on their due international responsibilities, safeguard world peace and help all countries achieve common development. He expressed hope that Rubio would conduct himself responsibly, playing a constructive role in the future of the peoples of China and the US, as well as in maintaining global peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Chen Dongxiao
statements.speaker_title: President of Shanghai Institutes for International Studies
statements.context: Theory page interview-based article in People's Daily on China as defender of international order
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Face of the United States beginning a new round of withdrawing from UN mechanisms, China has taken concrete actions to firmly support the United Nations and other organizations in playing a greater role in international affairs. For example, China strictly fulfills its obligations of the NPT and is the only one among the five nuclear-weapon states to pledge unconditionally not to use or threaten to use nuclear weapons against non-nuclear-weapon states and regions.

statements.speaker: Chen Dongxiao
statements.speaker_title: President of Shanghai Institutes for International Studies
statements.context: Theory page interview-based article in People's Daily on China as defender of international order
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Unity and cooperation are the only correct choices for maintaining international order stability and addressing global challenges. Currently, the 'new Cold War' mentality and hegemonic practices primarily damage international cooperation and mutual trust, exacerbate the risk of bloc confrontations in the international community, harm global partnerships, and make trust-building mechanisms difficult to establish. While some countries may appear to gain short-term benefits on specific issues, they ultimately will fall into a cycle of isolation and confrontation.

statements.speaker: Chen Dongxiao
statements.speaker_title: President of Shanghai Institutes for International Studies
statements.context: Theory page interview-based article in People's Daily on China as defender of international order
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current world economic order is facing severe challenges of anti-globalisation and pan-securitisation. Advocating the construction of an open world economic system and promoting economic globalisation in a more open, inclusive, balanced and universally beneficial direction are important international public goods provided by China.

article_title: Xi-Putin Meeting - New Rural Revitalisation Plan - Getting Long-term Funds into Stock Market - China-Bangladesh Ties - Zhong Caiwen Article on Balancing Key Economic Relationships

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Video call meeting with Vladimir Putin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi stressed readiness to work with Putin to guide China-Russia relations to a new height in 2025, to respond to external uncertainties with stability and resilience of China-Russia ties, to defend legitimate interests, and to uphold international fairness and justice. Noted the need to jointly safeguard the UN-centered international system.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Speech at World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic globalization is an overwhelming trend of history demonstrating strong resilience. Protectionism leads nowhere and trade war has no winners. Called for multilateralism, WTO-centered trading system, equal rights and opportunities for all countries, and joint fostering of new drivers for global economic development including AI, quantum technology and biomedicine.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Speech at World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's door of opening up will not be closed and will only open even wider. Welcomed foreign enterprises to invest and do business in China. Highlighted improvements in IPR protection, government procurement, cross-border data flow, and business environment. China lifted all restrictions on foreign investment in manufacturing and established negative-list system for cross-border trade in services.
statements.topic: economic policy, foreign investment, trade liberalization

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Speech at World Economic Forum in Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's pursuit of green transition is a long-term commitment rather than expediency. No matter how international landscape evolves, China's determination for climate response will not change. Built world's largest and most complete new energy industry chain with 70% of global photovoltaic components and 60% of wind power equipment from China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Celso Amorim, special advisor to Brazil's president
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Brazil in assuming BRICS presidency and pushing for new achievements in greater BRICS cooperation. China supports Brazil in hosting UN climate change conference. On Ukraine: the 'six-point consensus' jointly issued by China and Brazil and establishment of 'Friends of Peace' platform are to gather consensus from Global South and create conditions for peace talks.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.context: Meeting with Bangladesh interim government's Advisor for Foreign Affairs Touhid Hossain
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Bangladeshi people in choosing their own development path and supports interim government in advancing political reform and election agenda. China willing to work with Bangladesh to promote Belt and Road cooperation and develop China-Bangladesh comprehensive strategic partnership. CPC willing to maintain friendly exchanges with all political parties in Bangladesh.

article_title: Politburo Meeting - Xi Meets Non-party Personages - Li Qiang Seeks Ideas on Government Work Report - Han Zheng's Washington Visit - China's Oil & Gas Production at 400 Million Tons

statements.speaker: CPC Politburo
statements.context: Politburo meeting on January 20, 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The meeting affirmed the work of five party groups and agreed with their work arrangements for 2025. In the new year, the five Party Groups must take Xi Jinping Thought as their guide, adhere to the centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee, ensure unity of thought and consistency of direction, establish correct political achievement views, prioritize action and strive for progress, work together to promote reform and breakthroughs, steadily advance high-quality development, and demonstrate new responsibilities on the new journey of comprehensively advancing Chinese-style modernization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at meeting with non-CPC political parties, ACFIC, and non-party personages ahead of Spring Festival
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 2024 was a year to overcome difficulties and forge ahead steadfastly. The CPC Central Committee united and led the people, responding calmly and implementing comprehensive measures, successfully completing main economic and social development objectives. Chinese-style modernization took new solid steps. The Chinese economy rebounded and improved with GDP growth of 5%. We strengthened independent innovation, achieved breakthroughs in science and technology frontiers, and powerfully drove new quality productive forces. We deepened comprehensive reform, provided solid livelihood protection, coordinated development and security, and deeply advanced major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics, injecting positive energy into maintaining world peace and stability and promoting human development and progress.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at meeting with non-CPC political parties, ACFIC, and non-party personages ahead of Spring Festival
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 2025 is the final year of the 14th Five-Year Plan. We must adhere to the general tone of seeking progress while maintaining stability, implement more proactive and impactful macro policies, focus wholeheartedly on promoting high-quality development, promote high-level scientific and technological self-reliance and self-strengthening, maintain sound momentum in economic and social development, successfully complete the 14th Five-Year Plan objectives and tasks, and lay a solid foundation for a good start to the 15th Five-Year Plan.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Symposium with experts, entrepreneurs and representatives from education, science, culture, health and sports fields
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the past year, under the strong leadership of the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping as the core, the entire country has worked hard and overcome difficulties. The overall economic operation has been stable and steady, and main development goals and tasks have been successfully completed. High-quality development has been steadily promoted. At the same time, China's development still faces many difficulties and challenges, especially rising uncertain and unstable factors in the external environment. We must accurately grasp the situation and be good at turning crises into opportunities. China possesses comprehensive advantages in systems, markets, industries, and talents. The basic trend of long-term economic improvement has not changed and will not change. As long as we unswervingly manage our own affairs well, we will surely promote stable and healthy development of the Chinese economy.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Symposium with experts, entrepreneurs and representatives from education, science, culture, health and sports fields
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to implement a more proactive fiscal policy and a moderately loose monetary policy. Fiscal policy should proactively exert force in advance and form actual expenditure as soon as possible, monetary policy should maintain abundant liquidity and promote funds to fully flow to the real economy. It is necessary to further deepen reform and expand opening up, clear bottlenecks and blockages around expanding and strengthening the domestic circulation, create a first-class business environment, and stimulate the vitality of various business entities. It is necessary to expand independent opening up and unilateral opening up in an orderly manner.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.speaker_title: Special representative of President Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Vice President-elect J.D. Vance in Washington
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Han conveyed Xi's greetings to Trump and congratulated Vance on his election. Xi recently had an important phone call with Trump, during which the two leaders reached many important consensuses on the development of China-U.S. relations in the next stage. China is ready to work with the United States to adhere to the strategic guidance of head-of-state diplomacy and follow through on the important consensus reached between Xi and Trump, so as to push for the steady, healthy and sustainable development of bilateral ties.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.speaker_title: Special representative of President Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Vice President-elect J.D. Vance in Washington
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides are currently working hard to achieve their respective development goals and dreams. As long as the two sides uphold the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, they will contribute to each other's progress, bring benefits to the two countries, and make important contributions to world peace and development. Economic and trade relations are important issues of common concern to both sides. Despite differences and frictions between China and the United States, they share huge common interests and space for cooperation, and the two sides can strengthen dialogue and consultation in this regard.
statements.topic: US-China relations, economic and trade cooperation

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.speaker_title: Special representative of President Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with representatives of the U.S. business community in Washington
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A good start and stable development of China-U.S. relations align with the common well-being of both peoples and meet the shared expectation of the international community. The U.S. business community has been a participant, witness, contributor and beneficiary of China-U.S. economic and trade cooperation as well as China's reform and opening-up. China will unswervingly advance reform and opening-up, and continue to improve and optimize the business environment. It is hoped that U.S. companies will continue to invest and take root in China, play an active role as a bridge, and make greater contribution to the development of China-U.S. relations.
statements.topic: US-China relations, US business investment in China, trade

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Statement on Nigeria becoming BRICS partner country
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Nigeria is a major developing country and a significant country of the Global South. The country's participation in BRICS cooperation will serve Nigeria's development, the common interests of BRICS members and partners, and those of the Global South, and will make contributions to the development of the BRICS mechanism. The inclusion of a new partner country marks an expansion of BRICS representativeness, widening its appeal and influence.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Statement on Myanmar ceasefire agreement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under China's mediation, the Myanmar government and MNDAA held their seventh round of peace talks in Kunming and reached a ceasefire agreement. The easing of tensions in northern Myanmar is in the common interests of various parties in Myanmar and regional nations, and will contribute to the security, stability and development of the China-Myanmar border area. China and Myanmar are friendly neighbors, and China firmly opposes any conflict or unrest in Myanmar. It is hoped that all parties would maintain the momentum of the ceasefire and peace talks, earnestly implement consensus reached, de-escalate tensions proactively, and resolve related issues through further dialogues and consultations. China will firmly support Myanmar's efforts to safeguard its independence, sovereignty, national unity, and territorial integrity, secure domestic peace, stability, and economic development, and achieve political reconciliation and advance its domestic political agenda within the constitutional framework. China will continue to actively promote peace talks and provide support and assistance for the peace process in northern Myanmar.

Xi stressed that both countries are pursuing their own dreams and committed to making lives of their people better, share extensive common interests and broad space for cooperation, and can become partners and friends. Xi said it is inevitable that the two major countries have some differences, and the key is to respect each other's core interests and major concerns. He stressed that the Taiwan question concerns China's national sovereignty and territorial integrity, and hoped the U.S. side handles it with caution. Xi said the nature of China-U.S. economic and trade relations is mutually beneficial and win-win, and confrontation and conflict should not be the choice of the two countries. He called on both sides to step up cooperation based on principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

We stand ready to work with the new U.S. government to enhance dialogue and communication, properly manage differences, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, jointly pursue a stable, healthy and sustainable China-U.S. relationship and find the right way for the two countries to get along with each other.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

The key lies in respecting each other's choice of social systems and development paths, as well as each other's core interests and major concerns. China regards Europe as an important pole in a multipolar world and firmly supports European integration and the EU's pursuit of strategic autonomy.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

Both sides serve as defenders of the multilateral trading system and have formed a strong economic symbiotic relationship. At present, China-Japan relations are facing an important opportunity for improvement and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng

Both sides should respect each other, seek common ground while reserving differences, and adopt constructive ways to enhance understanding and expand consensus. Regulations were 'selectively enforced,' criteria for determining foreign subsidies were vague, scope was overly broad, and key concepts were defined in a 'subjective and arbitrary' manner. Chinese enterprises incurred significant economic losses including approximately 7.6 billion yuan in abandoned bidding projects. The ministry will take measures including bilateral consultations to urge the European side to adjust or change relevant practices.

China practices genuine multilateralism and will continue to speak out for the reasonable demands of African countries in multilateral forums.

The two sides should adhere to the correct strategic perception, treat each other as equals, engage in dialogue and cooperation, and promote steady and long-term cooperation in drug control and law enforcement. Wang also expressed hope that the U.S. side will show more sincerity for cooperation, and respect and address China's concerns.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce

For a long time, the United States has generalized the concept of national security, abused export control measures and suppressed and contained other entities, which has seriously harmed the legitimate rights and interests of relevant entities, undermined the security and stability of global industrial and supply chains, and hindered the recovery and development of the world economy. China urges the U.S. side to immediately stop its wrong practices, and the country will take necessary measures to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese entities.

China is ready to work with Namibia to implement these plans.

statements.speaker: Xinhua
statements.context: Commentary on Biden administration's decision to block Nippon Steel's acquisition of US Steel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is 'putting political considerations above economic logic and generalising the concept of 'national security' to practice protectionism.' The US has become the biggest 'violator' of WTO rules, with two-thirds of WTO violations caused by the US. The US refuses to implement WTO rulings and has paralyzed the WTO's Appellate Body. The US approach to international law is 'use if it suits, abandon if it doesn't suit.'

statements.speaker: Xinhua
statements.context: Commentary on Biden administration's decision to block Nippon Steel's acquisition of US Steel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any enterprise or country that threatens America's hegemonic position can become a target of the US hunt, including allies. The US signed the Plaza Accord with Japan using coercion, dealt a heavy blow to Japan's economy leading to the 'lost 30 years', used 'long-arm jurisdiction' to dismember French firm Alstom, imposed tariffs on steel and aluminum from the EU, and restricted trade of Dutch firm ASML. Such unilateral and protectionist measures disrupt global supply chains and show none of the free market spirit the US preaches.

statements.speaker: Xinhua
statements.context: Commentary on Biden administration's decision to block Nippon Steel's acquisition of US Steel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US over-protectionism has caused the decline of the US steel industry. Long-term trade protection policies have led to persistently high domestic steel prices, no improvement in mills' profitability, and caused downstream industries like automobiles and construction to pay a heavy price in global competition. US protectionist measures on steel have not prevented manufacturing job losses but have increased costs in other areas of the economy and reduced industry competitiveness.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Centre for BRICS Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article in Global Times dated January 1, 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international economic system dominated by Western countries is structurally unfair to Global South countries, including insufficient representation of developing countries in decision-making in the IMF and World Bank. The world is increasingly feeling negative impacts from the abuse of hegemony by dominant Western countries, especially the structural hegemonic power with dollar hegemony at the core.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Centre for BRICS Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article in Global Times dated January 1, 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The BRICS cooperation mechanism has not adopted Western-style ideological confrontations or bloc divisions. Its advocacy for a multilateral cooperation model avoids zero-sum games between major powers, offering a more inclusive paradigm for international relations. Through the BRICS platform, the Global South can break free from the pressure to 'choose sides' within the traditional geopolitical framework and pursue greater autonomy in a multipolar world.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Centre for BRICS Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article in Global Times dated January 1, 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The BRICS mechanism provides an alternative to bridge the global governance deficit against the backdrop of an increasingly dysfunctional multilateral system dominated by the West. The BRICS cooperation mechanism has broken the monopoly of Western countries in rule-making in traditional international institutions and brought a more balanced perspective to global governance.

Xi and Peng expressed hope that youth of China and the US will participate in China's initiative of inviting 50,000 young Americans to China for exchange and study programs over five years, strengthen exchanges and interactions, enhance mutual understanding, carry forward traditional friendship, and contribute to the development of China-U.S. relations and world peace.
