statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to US President-elect Donald Trump on November 7
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A stable, healthy and sustainable China-US relationship is in the common interests of the two countries and the expectation of the international community. It is hoped that the two sides will uphold the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, strengthen dialogue and communication, properly manage differences, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, and find a correct way for China and the United States to get along in a new era, benefiting both countries and the world.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Promoting the stability, improvement and progress of China-US relations is the right choice to be responsible to history, the people and the world.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China consistently develops US-China relations with an attitude of responsibility to history, to the people, and to the world, adhering to mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation. China will continue to view and handle China-US relations in accordance with these principles. At the same time, China has interests that must be maintained, principles that must be defended, and bottom lines that must be upheld.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US will benefit from cooperation, while confrontation will harm both. Suppression and containment cannot solve the problems facing the US. Only when both sides move towards each other can they find the correct way for two countries with different civilizations, systems, and paths to peacefully coexist and develop together in the new era.

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency (commentary)
statements.context: Xinhua commentary article
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Getting the China-U.S. relationship right is not optional, but something the two sides must do and must do well. Mutual respect is the precondition, peaceful coexistence is the bottom line, and win-win cooperation is the goal. China-U.S. interactions should be defined by dialogue and win-win cooperation, not confrontation and zero-sum competition. The successes of China and the United States are opportunities, not challenges, for each other.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Response to question about possible US tariffs and tech sector actions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to strengthen communication, expand cooperation and resolve differences with the United States for stable, sound and sustainable development of bilateral economic and trade relations. Under the principle of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, China is willing to work with the United States and bring greater benefits to both countries and the rest of the world.

article_title: Xi Calls Trump - Xi's Hubei Inspection - Xi's Thought on Social Work - 4th Round of Central Inspections Begin - Why does China Need to Improve Foreign-related National Security Mechanisms?

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC, President of China, Chairman of the Central Military Commission
statements.context: Phone call with US President-elect Donald Trump, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: History shows that cooperation between China and the United States benefits both, while confrontation harms both. A stable, healthy, and sustainably developing China-US relationship aligns with the common interests of both countries and the expectations of the international community. Both sides should uphold the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation, strengthen dialogue and communication, properly manage differences, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, and find a correct way for China and the United States to engage in this new era, benefiting both countries and the world.

article_title: Xi Tells Airborne Corps to 'Strengthen the Awareness of Preparing for War' - Li Qiang's Openness Pitch at CIIE - Li Xi Visits Kenya - Huai Jinpeng on 'Double First-Class' Construction

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to Botswana president
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Botswana enjoy traditional friendship; bilateral relations have sound momentum with remarkable achievements in infrastructure, clean energy, medical care and public health cooperation; attaches great importance to China-Botswana relations and stands ready to push bilateral strategic partnership to higher level

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to Fiji president
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Fiji was first Pacific island country to establish diplomatic relations with China; two countries have made substantial progress in relations over 49 years, improved wellbeing of peoples and promoted regional peace, stability and development; attaches great importance to China-Fiji relations and stands ready to promote sustained, sound and steady development of comprehensive strategic partnership

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Keynote speech at opening ceremony of 7th CIIE and Hongqiao International Economic Forum in Shanghai
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hosting CIIE is important measure for China to expand opening up and cooperation, representing solemn commitment to world; noted current context of profound global changes, anti-globalization tide, unilateralism and protectionism rising, increased instability and uncertainty; emphasized need to adhere to openness, expand openness and enhance openness to promote lasting peace, stability, development and prosperity; proposed three areas: building consensus on opening up while keeping promises and adhering to international economic and trade orders; expanding opening up space through mutual benefit and win-win results; shouldering opening up mission while adhering to common destiny; committed to safeguarding multilateral trading system with WTO at core, supporting developing countries in sharing globalization benefits; pledged China willing to further open markets, provide zero-tariff treatment for least developed countries, continue hosting CIIE and Canton Fair; noted Chinese economy fundamentals remain sound and government capable of promoting steady growth and contributing to global development

statements.speaker: Li Xi
statements.speaker_title: Member of Politburo Standing Committee, Secretary of Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
statements.context: Meeting with Kenyan President William Ruto during three-day visit to Kenya
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China willing to work with Kenya under guidance of important consensus between two heads of state to remain reliable friends and partners, firmly support each other on core interests and major concerns, build even closer China-Kenya community with shared future in new era; noted practical cooperation has yielded fruitful results; referenced Chinese president's announcement of 10 partnership actions for modernization to deepen China-Africa cooperation at FOCAC Beijing summit; willing to align summit outcomes with Kenya's Vision 2030 to support Kenya's economic development; appreciates and welcomes Kenya's participation in Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative, and Global Civilization Initiative; looks forward to strengthening communication and coordination on international multilateral institutions reform, jointly safeguarding Global South common interests

statements.speaker: Li Xi
statements.speaker_title: Member of Politburo Standing Committee, Secretary of Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
statements.context: Meeting with Kenyan UDA Secretary General Hassan Omar during visit to Kenya
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: CPC and UDA are both ruling parties shouldering historical mission of strengthening party, rejuvenating country and benefiting people; CPC attaches importance to developing relations with UDA and willing to strengthen high-level exchanges, strategic communication, and political mutual trust; willing to enhance governance experience exchange and improve capacity and level of governance; promote local and cultural exchanges to consolidate public opinion foundation; strengthen solidarity and cooperation to jointly uphold international fairness and justice to contribute to building community with shared future for humanity; willing to enhance anti-corruption experience exchange and mutual learning with Kenya, jointly combat cross-border corruption

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Malaysia relations entered new stage of historical development moving toward building China-Malaysia community with shared future; ready to work with Malaysia to implement important consensus reached by leaders, uphold mutual respect and trust, treat each other as equals, cooperate for win-win results; willing to continue firmly supporting each other on core interests and major concerns, strengthen docking of development strategies and governance experience exchange, improve cooperation in various fields, boost modernization with high-level strategic cooperation; called to steadily advance flagship projects like East Coast Rail Link and Malaysia-China 'Two Countries, Twin Parks', tap cooperation potential in emerging areas; will continue promote cultural exchanges and mutual learning with Malaysia, strengthen education cooperation and visa facilitation, encourage people-to-people visits; will strongly support Malaysia in assuming ASEAN rotating presidency next year, ready to strengthen coordination and cooperation within China-ASEAN and multilateral frameworks to jointly advance regional economic integration, safeguard ASEAN centrality and peaceful development of Asia

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Mongolian Prime Minister Luvsannamsrai Oyun-Erdene
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China values friendly cooperation with Mongolia highly, considers Mongolia priority in neighborhood diplomacy; both sides should implement important consensus reached by two heads of state to deepen practical cooperation for benefit of both peoples; China will synergize development strategy with Mongolia further, step up trade and investment cooperation, enhance cooperation on infrastructure construction in areas like port connectivity, mining and hydropower stations; encouraged both sides to tap cooperation potential of emerging industries like high-tech and green development, support more capable Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in Mongolia; will work with Mongolia and other Asian countries in pursuit of peace, solidarity and cooperation, enhance exchange and coordination within multilateral mechanisms like Shanghai Cooperation Organization

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Serbian Prime Minister Milos Vucevic
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China willing to work with Serbia to strengthen docking of development strategies, jointly implement China-Serbia free trade agreement, build and operate key cooperation projects, accelerate cooperation in green, digital and artificial intelligence innovation areas, achieve mutually beneficial and win-win results; hoped Serbia will continue provide sound business environment for Chinese enterprises to invest and do business; two sides should further deepen exchanges and cooperation on culture, tourism, education, sports, media and youth to consolidate popular support for building China-Serbia community with shared future

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Speaker of Hungarian Parliament László Kövér
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Expressed China's willingness to strengthen policy communication with Hungary in various fields, deepen high-level political mutual trust, firmly support each other's core interests, consolidate political foundation of China-Hungary friendship; willing to promote deep synergy of Belt and Road Initiative with Hungary's 'Opening to the East' policy, accelerate construction of Hungary-Serbia railway, expand cooperation in emerging areas like clean energy, digital economy and artificial intelligence to comprehensively elevate cooperation level; noted China's NPC and Hungarian National Assembly have maintained long-standing good relationship and should further strengthen exchanges and interactions to enhance mutual understanding, trust and friendship; called on legislative institutions of both sides to strengthen coordination and cooperation in multilateral forums, promoting global governance more conducive to maintaining world peace and international fairness and justice

article_title: Xi Calls to Strengthen Confidence in Reform Agenda - China-Finland Ties - New Inspections Target Propaganda & United Front Organisations - Made in China 2025 a Success? - No BRI for Brazil

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President, Chairman of the Central Military Commission
statements.context: Remarks at the opening of the study session at the Party School of the CPC Central Committee for principal officials at the provincial and ministerial level
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China must continue to deepen the study and implementation of the spirit of the Third Plenum, guide the entire Party and people to strengthen confidence in reform, and advance reform in a steady and sustained manner. Reform has direction and principles - adhering to Party leadership, Marxism, socialism with Chinese characteristics, and people's democratic dictatorship are fundamental matters that must not waver. The comprehensive deepening of reform in the new era has provided strong momentum and institutional guarantees for building a moderately prosperous society and continued development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Finnish President Alexander Stubb in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Finland was one of the first Western countries to establish diplomatic ties with the People's Republic of China and the first Western country to sign an intergovernmental trade agreement with China. China and Finland have always existed in friendship, respected and trusted each other. As the world undergoes accelerated changes, the future-oriented new-type cooperative partnership between China and Finland holds exceptional value. China is willing to work with Finland to strengthen strategic cooperation, carry forward friendly traditions, and advance the new type of cooperative partnership for the future.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Finnish President Alexander Stubb in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The most important reason for long-term healthy and stable China-Finland relations is that the two countries have always adhered to mutual respect, equal treatment, and taken care of each other's core interests and major concerns. The Third Plenary Session will bring new impetus and new opportunities to China-Finland cooperation and global development. Finland is welcome to actively participate in Chinese-style modernization and expand cooperation in green transformation, information technology, digital economy, artificial intelligence, and new energy. China is willing to further expand cultural exchanges with Finland and has decided to include Finland in the scope of unilateral visa-free policy.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Finnish President Alexander Stubb in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and Finland love peace and advocate multilateralism and free trade. China is willing to strengthen communication and cooperation on climate change, biodiversity protection, global sustainable development, and artificial intelligence governance, and work together to maintain world peace and stability and promote a multipolar world order that is fair and orderly with inclusive economic globalization. statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce

The EU's anti-subsidy investigation is irrational, fraught with non-compliance issues, and is a protectionist move under the guise of 'fair competition.' China has appealed to the WTO's dispute settlement mechanism and will continue to take all necessary measures to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises. China advocates resolution of trade disputes through dialogue and consultation and hopes the European side will work constructively following principles of pragmatism and balance to reach a mutually acceptable solution and avoid escalation of trade frictions.

article_title: Politburo Discusses Inspections - Building Cultural Power - Zhong Yin Commentary: 3 Perspectives on China's Economy - Birth Support Policies - Boosting EV Procurement - New Zhejiang Party Secretary

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is strongly dissatisfied with and firmly opposes the United States' move of placing Chinese entities on its export-control 'entity list' and 'unverified list' on so-called military and Iran-related issues. The US has generalized the concept of national security, abused export control measures and sanctioned enterprises from other countries including China, seriously damaging their legitimate rights and interests and undermining global industrial and supply chain security. The US should immediately stop its wrongdoing, and China will take necessary measures to resolutely safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of its enterprises.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian

BRICS is an open and inclusive mechanism, and China welcomes more like-minded partners, including Indonesia, to join the BRICS family.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with Ben Keswick, executive chairman of Jardine Matheson, in Beijing, reported on People's Daily Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deepening its reform and opening up in a comprehensive manner, fostering new quality productive forces and making headway in high-quality development. China welcomes Jardine Matheson and enterprises of various countries to continue deepening cooperation with China to achieve mutual benefits and win-win results.
statements.topic: economic cooperation, foreign investment, opening-up policy

article_title: Xi's Global South Pitch at BRICS+ Meeting - Wang Huning Visits Xinjiang - Aligning People’s Congresses with Party Agenda - China's Diplomatic Push at UNHRC

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks at BRICS+ dialogue in Kazan, Russia on October 24, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peace and development still face severe challenges, and the road to prosperity for the Global South will not be straight. Parties should uphold peace and strive for common security, strengthen global security governance, and explore solutions to address hotspot issues. Many parties have warmly responded to the Global Security Initiative. China and Brazil jointly issued a six-point consensus on the Ukraine crisis. China will continue to promote comprehensive ceasefire in Gaza and revive the two-state solution, stop flames of war from spreading in Lebanon, and end sufferings in Palestine and Lebanon.
statements.topic: diplomacy, peace and security, Global South development

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks at BRICS+ dialogue in Kazan, Russia on October 24, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Development Initiative has helped make available nearly US$20 billion of development funds and launch more than 1,100 projects since its introduction three years ago. The Global Alliance on Artificial Intelligence for Industry and Manufacturing Center of Excellence has been established in Shanghai. China will build a World Smart Customs Community Portal and a BRICS Customs Center of Excellence.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks at BRICS+ dialogue in Kazan, Russia on October 24, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Diversity of civilization is the innate quality of the world. Countries should be advocates for exchanges among civilizations, enhance communication and dialogue, and support each other in taking paths to modernization suited to respective national conditions. The Global Civilization Initiative is for building a garden of world civilizations in which we can share and admire the beauty of each civilization. China will coordinate with others to form a Global South Think Tanks Alliance to promote people-to-people exchanges and experience-sharing in governance.

statements.speaker: Chen Xu
statements.speaker_title: Head of Chinese delegation to 57th session of UN Human Rights Council and China's permanent representative to the UN Office in Geneva
statements.context: Speech at 57th session of UN Human Rights Council on September 18, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will further deepen reforms in an all-round way, promote Chinese-style modernization, enhance the well-being of all people, and strengthen human rights law enforcement and judicial protection. China has built a comprehensively moderately prosperous society as scheduled and historically solved the problem of absolute poverty; continuously developed whole-process people's democracy; promoted legal protection of human rights; and improved levels of employment, education, social security and living environment quality.

statements.speaker: Chinese delegation
statements.speaker_title: Government delegation to UN Human Rights Council
statements.context: 57th session of UN Human Rights Council, September 24, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China advocates respecting each country's right to independently choose its path to human rights development and opposes using human rights as a pretext to interfere in the internal affairs of other countries or hinder their development. In response to attacks from the United States and some other countries, China resolutely defended its position. Xinjiang, Hong Kong, and Tibet are internal affairs of China and should not be subject to politicization of human rights issues or double standards.
statements.topic: human rights, US relations, internal affairs

statements.speaker: Li Xiaomei
statements.speaker_title: Deputy head of Chinese delegation to 57th session of UN Human Rights Council
statements.context: Interactive dialogue with UN Human Rights Council's Special Rapporteur on Unilateral Coercive Measures at 57th session
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States and other Western countries should immediately lift illegal unilateral sanctions against China. Unilateral sanctions seriously violate the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, seriously violate basic norms of international relations, and seriously infringe on human rights. The United States has a poor human rights record but often abuses 'long-arm jurisdiction' based on domestic law, completely violating human rights in the name of democracy and human rights.

article_title: BRICS Summit Special: Examining Leaders' Remarks & the Kazan Declaration

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Summit in Kazan, Russia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must build BRICS into a primary channel for strengthening solidarity and cooperation among Global South nations and a vanguard for advancing global governance reform.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Summit in Kazan, Russia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should build a BRICS committed to peace. The Ukraine crisis still persists. China and Brazil, in collaboration with other countries from the Global South, initiated a group of Friends for Peace. We must uphold three key principles: no expansion of battlefields, no escalation of hostilities, and no fanning flames.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Summit in Kazan, Russia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must promote an immediate ceasefire and an end to the killing in Gaza and Lebanon. We must make unremitting efforts toward a comprehensive, just and lasting resolution of the Palestinian question.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Summit in Kazan, Russia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should build a BRICS committed to justice and act as forerunners in reforming global governance. The international power dynamics is undergoing profound changes, but global governance reform has lagged behind. We should champion true multilateralism and adhere to the vision of global governance characterized by extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Summit in Kazan, Russia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current developments make the reform of the international financial architecture all the more pressing. BRICS countries should play a leading role in the reform. We should deepen fiscal and financial cooperation and ensure that the international financial system more effectively reflects the changes in the global economic landscape.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side supports Iran in safeguarding national sovereignty, security and national dignity, steadily advancing its own economic and social development. China is willing to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with Iran in various fields.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply concerned about the current situation in the Middle East. An early ceasefire and end of war in Gaza are the key to easing regional tensions. The international community should work together to urge relevant parties to implement UN Security Council resolutions and avoid further instability.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah al-Sisi at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Egypt in safeguarding its national sovereignty, security and development interests. The two sides should continue to firmly support each other, consolidate political mutual trust, deepen practical cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah al-Sisi at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply worried about the current situation in the Middle East. Wars and chaos in the region serve no one's interests and the Palestinian issue is the core of the Middle East issue. The pressing task now is to fully and effectively implement UN Security Council resolutions and end the fighting in Gaza as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian President Abdel-Fattah al-Sisi at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Only by implementing the two-state solution can a comprehensive, just and lasting settlement of the Palestinian issue be promoted at an early date. China appreciates Egypt's efforts to promote a ceasefire and stands ready to strengthen coordination and cooperation with Egypt to jointly push for an early end to the Palestinian-Israeli conflict.

statements.speaker: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian
statements.context: Meeting with Xi Jinping at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is Iran's most important partner for cooperation. Iran is also ready to work with China to continue firmly supporting each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and opposing hegemony and bullying.

statements.speaker: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian
statements.context: Remarks at the open meeting of BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The period of unilateralism, when prosperity and development can only be realized on the path determined by Western directions, is coming to an end. The Americans have contributed to the growth of conflicts and wars throughout the world, including the unleashing of various wars and conflicts in Lebanon and Palestine.

statements.speaker: Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian
statements.context: Remarks at the open meeting of BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Independent parties can no longer pay for the United States' misguided financial policies or ineffectiveness in combating organized corruption in its financial sector. The efforts to reduce the dollar's dominance must be strengthened. Western settlement systems pose a big threat to all countries.

statements.speaker: BRICS Summit (Kazan Declaration)
statements.context: Official Kazan Declaration issued at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We are deeply concerned about the disruptive effect of unlawful unilateral coercive measures, including illegal sanctions, on the world economy, international trade, and the achievement of sustainable development goals. Such measures undermine the UN Charter, the multilateral trading system, and sustainable development.

statements.speaker: BRICS Summit (Kazan Declaration)
statements.context: Official Kazan Declaration issued at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We reiterate that unilateral coercive measures in the form of unilateral economic sanctions and secondary sanctions contrary to international law have far-reaching implications for human rights and the right to development of populations of targeted states. Therefore, we call for their elimination.

statements.speaker: BRICS Summit (Kazan Declaration)
statements.context: Official Kazan Declaration issued at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We reject unilateral trade restrictive measures that are inconsistent with WTO rules. We call for the reform of the Bretton Woods institutions to include increased representation of EMDCs in leadership positions to reflect the contribution of EMDCs to the global economy.

statements.speaker: BRICS Summit (Kazan Declaration)
statements.context: Official Kazan Declaration issued at BRICS Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We reject unilateral, punitive and discriminatory protectionist measures under the pretext of environmental concerns, such as unilateral and discriminatory carbon border adjustment mechanisms (CBAMs), due diligence requirements, and taxes.

statements.speaker: Zhang Hanhui
statements.context: Article on BRICS+ Cooperation published in People's Daily

statements.speaker: Zhang Hanhui
statements.context: Article on BRICS+ Cooperation published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia maintain close strategic cooperation within BRICS; China actively supports Russia in its rotating presidency; both countries work together to promote equal and orderly world multi-polarization and inclusive economic globalization, and promote building of community with shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message to the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations annual gala dinner

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message to the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations annual gala dinner

China views its relations with Pakistan from a strategic and long-term perspective and places Pakistan as a priority in China's neighborhood diplomacy. China is willing to work with Pakistan to push the China-Pakistan friendship and cooperation to new levels. China is ready to strengthen cooperation in governance experience exchange, align development strategies, expand economic and trade cooperation, deepen people-to-people and cultural exchanges, and turn the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor into a landmark project of high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. China is willing to strengthen cooperation in the field of security.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with President of the Australian Senate Sue Lines
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Consolidating and developing bilateral ties serves the common interests of the two countries and is conducive to regional peace, stability and prosperity. China is ready to work with Australia to implement the important consensus reached by leaders of the two countries and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation to build a more mature, stable and fruitful China-Australia comprehensive strategic partnership and contribute to peace and development in the region and the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Speech at the opening of the 6th World Buddhist Forum in Ningbo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peace, amity, and harmony are concepts passed down through Chinese civilization for over 5,000 years. Chinese civilization is renowned for its openness and inclusiveness, advocating seeking common ground while preserving differences, harmony without uniformity, and respecting and accepting others. This forum showcases the openness and inclusiveness of Chinese Buddhism and promotes dialogue among different civilizations. China adheres to the policy of freedom of religious belief and encourages and supports the religious community to conduct international exchanges on the basis of independence, equality, friendship and mutual respect. The Chinese government supports the Chinese Buddhist community to actively participate in global religious and civilization dialogues.

statements.speaker: Wu Qian
statements.speaker_title: Spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Comment on the ongoing Malabar drills involving American, Indian, Japanese and Australian navies
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called Quad mechanism has become a sheer political tool for the United States to contain China and maintain its hegemony. Security cooperation among relevant countries should not harm the interests of any third party or undermine regional peace and stability. China firmly opposes relevant parties using China as an excuse to stir up confrontation and escalate regional tensions. The Asia-Pacific should be a grand stage where countries join hands to cooperate, rather than an arena for geopolitical competition. Relevant countries should give up their obsession with zero-sum mindset and put more efforts on protecting regional security.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Kyrgyz Prime Minister Akylbek Zhaparov
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China looks to enhance coordination and cooperation with Kyrgyzstan under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state. statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Tajik Prime Minister Kokhir Rasulzoda
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Tajikistan to further implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, carry forward traditional friendship, deepen mutual political trust, firmly support each other on core interests, and lift China-Tajikistan all-round cooperation to a new level. China will work with Tajikistan to strengthen synergy of development strategies, advance cooperation in trade, investment, mining, agriculture, and emerging industries including new energy and digital economy. China will work with Tajikistan to implement outcomes of the China-Central Asia Summit, strengthen multilateral cooperation, jointly carry out the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative and Global Civilization Initiative, advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, and practice true multilateralism.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Russia to further strengthen and develop their relationship built on enduring good-neighborliness, deep strategic trust, and mutually beneficial cooperation. Both sides should maintain close high-level exchanges, deepen and expand military relations, safeguard the sovereignty, security and development interests of their respective countries, and work together to uphold international and regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang

China supports Pakistan's efforts to combat terrorism and stands ready to deepen counterterrorism cooperation with Pakistan, pool counterterrorism efforts among regional countries and jointly safeguard peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji

statements.context: Meeting with Vietnam's Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Vietnam in advancing on the socialist path suited to its national conditions. China is willing to strengthen alignment of development strategies with Vietnam, leverage bilateral cooperation mechanisms, implement BRI cooperation plans, deepen cooperation in connectivity, trade, investment, tourism, healthcare, disaster prevention, expand local currency settlement and cooperation in digital economy and green development. Both sides should manage differences through friendly consultations and expand maritime cooperation. China is willing to strengthen coordination with Vietnam on multilateral platforms like the UN and APEC to promote more just and equitable global governance and safeguard developing countries' interests in building a shared future for humanity.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese business leaders
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Vietnam are traditional socialist friendly neighbors. Their respective development is an important opportunity for each other. Economic and trade cooperation has always been a highlight and important driving force of bilateral ties. There is still space for expansion and greater potential in further alignment of development strategies, stronger connectivity, releasing complementary advantages, and economic-trade cooperation. The two countries share the same social system, strong political trust, geographical proximity, and profound 'comrades and brothers' friendship. Entrepreneurs should actively engage in national development strategies, utilize multilateral and bilateral trade agreements and policy dividends like RCEP and China-ASEAN FTA Version 3.0. They should jointly promote integrated industrial development, deepen supply-demand integration, and build stable cross-border industrial and supply chains. Pool innovation and creativity, strengthen whole-chain innovation cooperation between industry, academia and research, particularly in clean energy, biomedicine and artificial intelligence to jointly foster new development drivers.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnam's National Assembly Chairman Tran Thanh Man
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to enhance exchanges and cooperation with Vietnam's legislative bodies, strengthen coordination and cooperation in multilateral fields, and provide solid support for promoting each other's socialist construction. Legislatures of both countries should strongly support practical cooperation in various fields, focus on innovation, and provide legal guarantees for strengthening cooperation in emerging industries such as digital economy, new energy and 5G, and jointly cultivate and strengthen new development drivers. The two countries' legislatures should actively provide public guidance to enhance mutual understanding and goodwill between peoples, especially young people, and consolidate the social foundation for bilateral cooperation.
statements.topic: bilateral relations, legislative cooperation, institutional engagement

statements.speaker: State Council Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office
statements.context: Official statement on Sam Hou Fai's election as Macau chief executive designate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The successfully concluded election is significant for implementing the principle of 'patriots administering Macao' and advancing the successful practice of 'one country, two systems' with Macao characteristics. Sam received broad public support for his deep affection and sense of responsibility toward Macao and the country, willingness to collaborate with various social groups and sectors, and commitment to promoting socio-economic development and improving residents' well-being. Sam, who previously served as president of Macao's Court of Final Appeal, has handled major cases and effectively safeguarded national security and the constitutional order of the Macao SAR. The Macao society has confidence in Sam to safeguard both the country's overall interests and Macao's fundamental interests, and ensure steady practice of 'one country, two systems' with Macao characteristics. Sam demonstrates capability of adapting to changes and seeking transformation, and the will to seize opportunities and pursue reform.
statements.topic: Hong Kong and Macao affairs, governance, 'one country, two systems'

statements.speaker: People's Daily editorial
statements.context: Front page commentary on Sam Hou Fai's election
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The election fully reflects Macau society's heartfelt support for 'one country, two systems'. Practice has fully proven that 'one country, two systems' is a great initiative under socialism with Chinese characteristics and the best institutional arrangement for maintaining long-term prosperity and stability after the return of Hong Kong and Macau to the motherland, and it must be adhered to for a long time. The destinies of Hong Kong, Macau, and the mainland have always been closely linked, and national development has always been the strongest foundation for the development of Hong Kong and Macau.
statements.topic: Hong Kong and Macao affairs, 'one country, two systems', governance

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Jin Sheping byline)
statements.context: Article discussing economic policy and calling for confidence
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Overall economic performance has been stable with steady progress; however, some new situations and problems have also emerged. To strive to achieve the year's goals, we must strengthen our confidence in overcoming difficulties. Currently, all regions and departments are conscientiously implementing General Secretary Xi Jinping's important speech and the decisions and arrangements of the Party Central Committee. A series of measures to support stable economic growth and high-quality development have been introduced in quick succession, effectively guiding societal expectations and strengthening confidence in China's economy.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Jin Sheping byline)
statements.context: Article discussing external environment and economic challenges
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The external environment has become increasingly complex, severe, and uncertain. The adverse effects of changes in the external environment on China's economy have increased. The IMF said 'global economy is stagnant'. Currently, major world economies are experiencing weak growth momentum and heavy debt burdens. Global trade protectionism has intensified, and uncertainty and instability have increased. Some external forces are trying to contain, blockade, and suppress China, deliberately attempting to hinder the historical process of building a socialist modern power in an all-round way and realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation. Rhetoric about 'decoupling and breaking supply chains' and 'small yards with high walls' has become louder, reflecting the increasing complexity, severity, and uncertainty of the external environment China faces.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Jin Sheping byline)
statements.context: Article on economic development advantages and confidence
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development benefits from five strategic advantages: the strong leadership of the Communist Party of China, the notable advantages of the socialist system with Chinese characteristics, the solid foundation accumulated through sustained rapid development, a long-term stable social environment, and the spiritual strength of self-confidence and self-reliance. Additionally, China possesses the institutional advantage of a socialist market economy, the demand advantages of a super-large-scale market, the supply advantages of a complete supporting industrial system, and the talent advantages of a large number of high-quality workers and entrepreneurs. History and reality have repeatedly proven that the creation and continuation of China's economic miracle is inseparable from the strong leadership of the Communist Party of China and the fundamental guarantee of the socialist system with Chinese characteristics.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech marking the 70th anniversary of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: People are the creators of history, and building a community with a shared future for mankind is the future of the people of all countries in the world. China is willing to strengthen friendly exchanges with friends from all countries, give full play to the unique role of people-to-people diplomacy, and work together to build a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech marking the 70th anniversary of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should build a broad consensus on promoting the building of a community with a shared future for mankind in the spirit of 'shared responsibility as dwellers of the same planet'. China is willing to work with all countries in the world to promote the common values of peace, development, fairness, justice, democracy and freedom, advocate an equal and orderly multi-polar world and an inclusive economic globalization that benefits all, and make the planet Earth a peaceful, friendly and harmonious home for all.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech marking the 70th anniversary of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must gather a strong force to promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind through the concept of win-win cooperation. The Communist Party of China is a party that seeks happiness for the Chinese people and rejuvenation for the Chinese nation. It is also a party that seeks progress for mankind and world harmony. I proposed the building of a community with a shared future for mankind and the GDI, GSI and GCI, all in order to promote the building of a better world and create a better life for people of all countries. Only through win-win cooperation can we accomplish things, do good things, and do great things. China does not pursue self-centered modernization, and welcomes more foreign friends to actively participate in China's modernization process. The country is committed to providing new opportunities for global development with its achievements in modernization, and promoting a global modernization that features peaceful development, mutually beneficial cooperation and common prosperity to better benefit people of all countries.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech marking the 70th anniversary of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should embrace all civilizations to build a community with a shared future for humanity with an open and inclusive mindset. Harmony while maintaining diversity is the law governing the occurrence and development of all things, as well as the principle behind the transmission and development of human civilization. Mutual exchange and learning are essential requirements for the advancement of civilization and serve as important driving forces for the progress of human civilization, as well as for world peace and development. Chinese civilization is an open system formed in constant exchange and mutual learning with other civilizations. The Chinese nation is an open and inclusive nation, and the Chinese people are kind and friendly people. China is willing to work with all parties to practice the GCI, promote a view of civilization that emphasizes equality, mutual learning, dialogue, and inclusiveness, enhance understanding and deepen friendship through sincere communication, transcend civilizational barriers through civilizational exchanges, transcend civilizational conflicts through civilizational mutual learning, and promote the world to develop in the direction of a community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency
statements.context: Report on Eastern Theater Command drills
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Li Xi, spokesperson for the theater command, said the Joint Sword-2024B drills involve vessels and planes closing in on the island from multiple directions and assaults by joint forces. The drills focus on joint sea-air combat readiness patrol, the blockade and control of key ports and areas, strikes on sea and land targets, and the seizure of comprehensive battlefield control, so as to test the joint real-combat capabilities of the forces of the command. The drills are a powerful deterrent to the separatist activities of 'Taiwan independence' elements, and are legitimate and necessary actions to safeguard national sovereignty and national unity.

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency
statements.context: Commentary on Taiwan President Lai Ching-te's Double Tenth speech
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Lai continued to brazenly preach his 'two states' claim, openly clamoring that 'Taiwan has sovereignty' and that 'the People's Republic of China has no right to represent Taiwan'. The Taiwan regional leader repeatedly referred to the mainland as 'China' while playing with concepts and confusing right and wrong. By attempting to highlight political differences between the two sides of the Strait and break up their historical ties, Lai fabricated the false concept that 'the Republic of China equals Taiwan' to further advance his 'Taiwan independence' plot. Lai has been indulging in outright secessionist and blatantly provocative remarks. His increasingly hostile words lead nowhere, only escalating tensions and undermining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. If Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party authorities continue going against the historical trend and pursuing their separatist line, they would plunge people in Taiwan into serious calamity.

article_title: Xi on Ethnic Affairs Policy - PRC's 75th Anniversary - Li Calls to Accelerate Economic Measures - Friends for Peace Group on Ukraine - China's Afghan Quartet Meeting - China-Russia Coast Guard Drills

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: National Conference on Commending Models for Ethnic Unity and Progress
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Addressing China's ethnic issues is our internal affairs, and no external forces have the right to interfere. The Communist Party of China and the Chinese people have found the correct path to solving ethnic issues with Chinese characteristics, and we do not need anyone else to point fingers at us or act as an 'instructor'. We must resolutely oppose all attempts to infiltrate, sabotage, slander, contain and suppress our country by using ethnicity, religion and other issues.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China proposes to uphold peaceful coexistence and put in place a security architecture that ensures enduring stability; uphold openness and inclusiveness and foster a development paradigm that promotes shared prosperity; uphold harmony without uniformity and adopt an approach to civilizations that promotes exchange and mutual learning; and uphold fairness and justice and develop a governance structure that pools strengths for shared benefit.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In today's world, the security of all countries is tied together. In face of various kinds of global challenges and risks, no one can stay immune or enjoy security alone. Countries need to be guided by a vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security. We should respect each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity, take the legitimate security concerns of others seriously, and resolve disputes and differences through dialogue and consultation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Achieving modernization is a legitimate right of the people of all countries, not a prerogative of a few. We should be committed to advancing global modernization, and ensure that no one and no country is left behind on the journey toward modernization. We should advocate a universally beneficial and inclusive globalization, unequivocally oppose unilateralism and protectionism.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of unilateral, bullying acts such as sanctions and blockade, China firmly supports countries in defending their legitimate rights, upholding the equity and openness of the international system. China will jointly oppose technology blockade and reject decoupling or severing supply chains. Sanctions and pressure will not bring monopolistic advantages. Suppressing and containing others will not solve problems at home.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We once again urge the United States to completely lift its blockade, sanctions and terrorism-related designation against Cuba.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At the global level, the principle of common but differentiated responsibilities must be upheld, and the Paris Agreement must be implemented in earnest. Developed countries should assist developing countries in building their capacity to cope with climate change. Touting the need of climate response while suppressing the green industries of others will only hold back global progress in green transition.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China maintains that all countries' right to independently choose their path of human rights development should be respected. No country should impose its own will on others, or arbitrarily interfere in others' internal affairs citing human rights as an excuse.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory. This is the history and the reality. Both the Cairo Declaration and the Potsdam Proclamation stated in explicit terms that all the territories Japan had stolen from the Chinese, such as Taiwan and the Penghu Islands, shall be restored to China. The complete reunification of China will be achieved. Taiwan will eventually return to the embrace of the motherland. This is the overwhelming trend of history that no one and no force can stop.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The stabilization of China-U.S. relations serves the interests of the two peoples and meets the expectation of the international community. Whether or not this momentum can be sustained depends on the efforts of both sides. The United States should not always approach China with two faces: On the one hand encircling and suppressing China brazenly, and on the other hand, having dialogue and cooperation with China as if nothing is wrong.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the United States has expressed multiple times that it has no intention to have conflict with China, then fundamentally, it needs to establish a rational perception of China, and find the right way to get along with it. The United States needs to carry out dialogue with respect, advance cooperation in the spirit of reciprocity, and address differences with great prudence, rather than act willfully as it sees fit from a position of strength or use previous mistakes as excuses to make more mistakes.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The intensifying 'Taiwan independence' activities by Lai Ching-te and others pose the greatest danger to the situation across the Taiwan Strait. 'Taiwan independence' and cross-Strait peace are irreconcilable. If the United States truly hopes to see peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait, it should abide by the one-China principle, implement the three China-U.S. Joint Communiqués, stop arming Taiwan, publicly oppose 'Taiwan independence', and support the peaceful reunification of China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is firmly opposed to U.S. suppression in trade and technology. National security should not be politicized, and 'small yard, high fence' should not become 'big yard, iron curtain'. China will never accept finger-pointing by human rights preachers, still less interference in China's internal affairs under the pretext of human rights.
statements.topic: trade, technology, human rights, US policy

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: People-to-people exchanges between the two countries are very important, and the United States should remove obstacles with real actions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China articulated China's firm position on the South China Sea issue. China remains committed to resolving differences through dialogue and consultation with countries directly concerned. The United States should not stir up trouble in the South China Sea, or undermine regional countries' efforts to safeguard peace and stability there.
statements.topic: South China Sea, US policy, regional security

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Ukraine issue is aboveboard. It has been committed to promoting talks for peace and has been making its efforts toward peaceful settlement. The United States should stop smearing, scapegoating and arbitrarily imposing sanctions on China, and stop using this issue to create antagonism and incite camp-based confrontation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: An end to the Ukraine crisis remains elusive. The top priority is to commit to 'no expansion of the battlefield, no escalation of fighting and no provocation by any party,' and push for deescalation of the situation as soon as possible. China is committed to playing a constructive role, engaging in shuttle mediation and promoting talks for peace, not throwing oil on the fire or exploiting the situation for selfish gains.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Korean Peninsula should not experience war again. The important thing is to make persistent effort for deescalation, commit to seeking solutions through dialogue and consultation, realize a transition from the armistice to a peace mechanism, and safeguard peace and stability on the Peninsula.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: United Nations General Assembly general debate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply aware that Asia needs stability and development and opposes division and conflict. We are firmly against the meddling by countries outside the region, and will resolutely resist attempts by any force to stoke trouble and confrontation in the region.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with South Korean Foreign Minister Cho Tae-yul
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The deployment of U.S. intermediate-range missiles in the region undermines regional peace and stability and does not serve the interests of regional countries. War and chaos must not occur on the Korean Peninsula and maintaining peace and stability on the Peninsula is in the common interest of all parties.
statements.topic: Korea, US military deployment, regional security

article_title: Stimulating the Economy - Wang Yi's AI, GDI & BRICS Pitches - Wang Meets 'Old Friend of the Chinese People' Muhammad Yunus - China on Hopes for Ties with US - Boosting Medium & Long-term Capital

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Foreign Ministers Meeting in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No country has the right to manipulate the global security agenda, let alone build its own security on the insecurity of other countries. On the Ukraine issue, the crisis should be resolved through dialogue and negotiation, preventing spillover of conflict and escalation of warfare.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at BRICS Foreign Ministers Meeting in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must uphold multilateralism and improve global governance. When multilateralism is under attack, the world falls into chaos. When hegemonic behaviour runs rampant, human civilization regresses to the law of the jungle.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at High-level Conference on International Cooperation on AI Capacity Building
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: AI should not and cannot be reduced to a tool for maintaining hegemony and pursuing superiority. Establishing an AI governance mechanism with universal participation from all countries under the UN framework, so that all countries can participate and benefit equally.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always advocated the peaceful settlement of disputes. China does not engage in geopolitical games or pursue its own self-interests, but has always actively promoted peace and negotiations. China has provided four batches of humanitarian assistance to Ukraine and is willing to provide new assistance according to Ukraine's needs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with American representatives from various US organizations (National Committee on US-China Relations, US-China Business Council, US Chamber of Commerce, Aspen Institute, Asia Society, Council on Foreign Relations)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks the 45th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations between China and the United States. The two countries should be partners, not adversaries; they should help each other succeed rather than engage in vicious competition. President Xi Jinping has proposed three principles: mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with American representatives from various US organizations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In contrast to China's stable and consistent policy towards the US, the US often sends mixed signals and presents two different faces in its China policy. The root cause lies in the inability of some in the US to view and accept China's development objectively. The US needs to recognize that China also has the right to develop, and that China's development is an opportunity for both the US and the world, rather than a challenge.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with American representatives from various US organizations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US as permanent members of the UN Security Council and the world's two largest economies should strive for stable, healthy, and sustainable development of their bilateral relationship. China-US relations require continuous dialogue and communication to eliminate unnecessary misunderstandings and misjudgments.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaohong
statements.context: Meeting with US Department of Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides have achieved many visible outcomes in areas such as drug control, repatriation of illegal immigrants and cooperation on individual cases. China is willing to maintain communication with the U.S. at all levels, and push for steady and long-term law enforcement cooperation between the two countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaohong
statements.context: Meeting with US Department of Homeland Security Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. side should attach importance to addressing China's concerns, demonstrate sincerity with concrete actions, and remove obstacles for deepening cooperation.

article_title: Politburo Meeting Signals Economic Easing - Wang Yi's Diplomacy in New York - Guidelines to Implement Employment-first Policy - Song Tao Meets KMT's Sean Lien - Quad Summit & China

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo Standing Committee meeting on economic situation (reported by Xinhua)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the beginning of this year, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core has united and led the people to overcome difficulties and respond calmly, enhance macroeconomic regulation, focus on deepening reform and opening up, expand domestic demand, and optimize economic structure.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: UN General Assembly Address in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A winner-takes-all approach is a sure way to lose the whole game, and the 'small yard with high fences' would only imprison the builder and tear the world apart. Major countries should break geopolitical circles by pursuing the greater good, rise above bloc confrontation with a broad vision for mutual prosperity.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Politicizing economic and trade issues and abusing tariff measures would serve no one's interests. Germany and the EU should stick to open cooperation, continue to hold dialogue and consultations with China, and jointly uphold international trade rules and a fair environment for competition.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Lebanese Foreign Minister Abdallah Bou Habib in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is firmly opposed to indiscriminate attacks against civilians. Force does not equate to rightness and violence against violence will not solve the problems in the Middle East. China calls for realizing a 'permanent ceasefire and comprehensive withdrawal of troops' and ensuring effective implementation of 'the two-state solution.'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to support Iran in safeguarding its sovereignty, security, territorial integrity and national dignity, and opposes external interference in Iran's internal affairs and exerting sanctions and pressure on the country.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: UN Security Council high-level meeting on Ukraine
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is not a creator of the Ukraine crisis, nor is it a party concerned. China has always sided with peace, and maintained contact with all parties, including Russia and Ukraine. Any attempt to blame, attack or smear China on the Ukraine issue is irresponsible and will not succeed.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UN Human Rights High Commissioner and foreign ministers at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States and a few other countries used the Xinjiang issue to attack and smear China's human rights situation. The political manipulation of the United States and its followers has become increasingly unpopular. Nearly 80 countries, including the majority of Muslim countries, supported China's position, demonstrating opposition to politicization of human rights issues and interference in internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UN Human Rights High Commissioner and foreign ministers at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If the United States is so concerned about Muslim human rights, why does it continuously provoke or support wars in the Middle East causing Muslim casualties? Why does it fail to support Palestine as a UN member or play its due role in achieving ceasefire in Gaza?

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Official statement regarding ICBM test
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The missile fell into expected sea areas. This was a routine arrangement in the annual training plan and relevant countries had been notified in advance. The launch tested weaponry performance and military training effectiveness and achieved desired goals.

statements.speaker: Song Tao
statements.speaker_title: Head of Taiwan Work Office of CPC Central Committee and Taiwan Affairs Office of State Council
statements.context: Meeting with Sean Lien, vice chairman of Chinese Kuomintang party, in Liaoning Province
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We will always keep the well-being of Taiwan compatriots in mind and share development opportunities with them. We oppose 'Taiwan independence' separatism and external interference, seeking peace for the Taiwan Strait, welfare for compatriots, reunification for the country, and rejuvenation for the nation.

article_title: Xi on China's Space Ambitions - Xi's Message to Dissanayake - What are the Three Concentrations for SoEs & State Capital? - Wang Yi Meets Muizzu - MoFA on Quad Summit

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech meeting with space scientists and engineers on Chang'e-6 lunar mission
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Outer space is a domain shared by humanity, and space exploration is humanity's common cause. The lunar exploration project has always followed principles of equality, mutual benefits, peaceful utilization and win-win cooperation. The Chang'e lunar missions belong to both China and all people in the world, and have provided a broad stage for international scientific and technological cooperation.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular Ministry of Foreign Affairs press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Quad is identified as the premier regional grouping that plays a leading role in the US's Indo-Pacific strategy. It is a tool the US uses to contain China and perpetuate US hegemony. The Indo-Pacific strategy attempts to patch up forces to exclude and contain China by peddling the 'China threat' narrative. Though the US claims that it does not target China, the first topic of the summit is about China and China was made an issue throughout the event. The US is lying through its teeth.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular Ministry of Foreign Affairs press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China believes that cooperation between countries should not target any third party or even harm their interests. Ganging up to form exclusive groupings undermines mutual trust and cooperation between regional countries. The US needs to get rid of its obsession with perpetuating its supremacy and containing China, stop using regional countries as its tool, and stop glossing over the strategic intention behind exclusive groupings.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular Ministry of Foreign Affairs press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The situation in the East and South China Seas is generally stable. Some country outside the region keeps cobbling together small groupings and tries every means to meddle in maritime issues at China's doorstep in order to incite bloc confrontation, escalate the situation, and undermine regional peace and stability. No interference from any force will weaken China's determination in defending its territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests.
statements.topic: South China Sea, East China Sea, maritime issues

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular Ministry of Foreign Affairs press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation between countries should be conducive to peace, stability, and prosperity in the region, rather than focusing on forming exclusive groupings that undermine trust and cooperation among regional countries. China is open to normal cooperation between relevant countries at sea, but the cooperation should not target other countries or undermine regional peace and stability under any pretext.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Maldivian President Mohamed Muizzu in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the Maldives have always understood, trusted and supported each other. China's development will enhance the force for peace in the world and augment the strength of developing countries. China-Maldives relations have become an example of countries large and small treating each other equally, helping and supporting each other, and striving for mutual benefits and win-win results. China will always support the Maldives' effort to protect its sovereignty, independence, territorial integrity and national dignity.

article_title: CPPCC's 75th Anniversary - State Council Discusses Retirement Age Reform-related Policies - C919 Lands in Lhasa - Zhong Sheng Lashes out at US Tariff Hike Proposal

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on US tariff announcement following USTR four-year review
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has politicized, instrumentalized, and weaponized economic and trade issues, and has insisted on imposing tariffs, which is protectionism that goes against the trend of the times. The United States should immediately correct its wrong practices and cancel all tariffs imposed on China.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on US tariff announcement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US government did not respect the opinions of the people, and insisted on raising the 301 tariffs on China out of domestic political compulsions. The US approach cannot achieve its declared goals; rather it will only backfire and weaken the competitiveness of American industries.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on US tariff announcement
