statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As long as both sides fully and thoroughly implement the important consensus reached by the two countries' heads of state, uphold the spirit of equality, respect, and reciprocity, persist in resolving contradictions through dialogue, and discard the practice of applying pressure at every turn, it is possible to push the two countries' relationship to stabilise and move forward.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is hoped that both sides will move toward each other, make good preparations for high-level China-US interactions, and create conditions for the development of the two countries' relationship.

article_title: Xi's Unified Market Agenda - New Rules for Chinese Employees in Foreign Missions - TikTok Deal & Chips Friction - Wang Yi's Poland Visit

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, extracted from speech at Sixth meeting of 20th Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission on July 1, 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a unified national market is necessary for gaining the initiative in international competition. As the world's second-largest consumer market, China must build a well-developed unified national market to strengthen confidence in calmly responding to risks and challenges.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Talks with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessant and USTR Jameson Greer in Madrid; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is unwavering in its determination to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests and will resolutely safeguard national interests and the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese-funded enterprises overseas. Regarding TikTok, China will carry out technology export approval in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Talks with US Treasury Secretary and USTR in Madrid; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The essence of China-US economic and trade relations is mutual benefit and win-win outcomes. Cooperation between China and the US benefits both, while confrontation hurts both. The US should cancel relevant restrictive measures against China as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Li Chenggang
statements.context: Press briefing by Chinese side on TikTok framework; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always opposed politicization, instrumentalization and weaponization of technology as well as economic and trade matters and will never seek to reach any agreement at the expense of principles, interests of companies, or international fairness and justice. China will firmly safeguard national interests and carry out technology export approval in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.

statements.speaker: Wang Jingtao
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Director of Cyberspace Administration of China
statements.context: Press briefing on TikTok framework; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides reached a basic consensus regarding full respect for the will of the business and the law of the market on resolving the TikTok issue. The Chinese government will examine and approve relevant matters involving TikTok, such as technology export and license use of intellectual property, in accordance with relevant laws and regulations.

statements.speaker: Li Chenggang
statements.context: Press briefing on US-China talks outcomes; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has overstretched the concept of national security and continuously expanded the list of sanctions against Chinese entities, which are typical acts of unilateral bullying that violate international law. China firmly opposes this. The US cannot ask China to take care of US concerns while continuously suppressing Chinese enterprises.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs press conference; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is fully legitimate and lawful for China to carry out normal economic, trade and energy cooperation with all countries, including Russia. What the US has done is a typical move of unilateralism, bullying and economic coercion that seriously disrupts international trade rules. China's position on the Ukraine crisis is consistent—dialogue and negotiation is the only viable way out.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs press conference; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes the US directing the Ukraine issue at China and abusing unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction. If China's legitimate rights and interests are harmed, China will resolutely take countermeasures to safeguard sovereignty, security and development interests.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on US tariff threats; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US actions seriously violate the consensus reached during the call between the leaders of China and the US and could have severe impact on global trade and stability of production and supply chains. China firmly opposes this and will take all necessary measures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.

statements.speaker: State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR)
statements.context: Preliminary probe announcement; reported by Reuters
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China accused Nvidia of violating the country's anti-monopoly law based on a preliminary probe into the company's business practices.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official announcement of anti-discrimination investigation; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has launched an anti-discrimination investigation into US measures targeting the country's integrated circuit sector, obtaining preliminary evidence that US measures constitute prohibitive and discriminatory actions under China's Foreign Trade Law. China will take corresponding measures against the United States based on the actual situation following the probe.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on US semiconductor restrictions; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has implemented a series of prohibitions and restrictions against China in the integrated circuit field, such as Section 301 investigations and export control measures. These protectionist practices discriminate against China and constitute containment and suppression of China's development of high-tech industries. They harm China's development interests and seriously undermine the stability of the global semiconductor industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Polish President Karol Nawrocki; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China values Poland's role and influence in Europe and the world, and is ready to further deepen strategic mutual trust and cooperation. China expressed hope that Poland will play an active role in helping the European Union develop an objective and rational understanding of China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Polish President Karol Nawrocki; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The separatist activities of 'Taiwan independence' forces, which attempt to split the country and challenge the outcomes of World War II victory, run counter to the tide of history and are doomed to fail. China expressed confidence that Poland will continue to uphold the one-China policy and support China's cause of national reunification.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Polish Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and Poland are nations of self-reliance and resilience. The two countries should carry forward their friendship based on mutual respect, equality, and win-win cooperation. Over recent days, Wang has observed arbitrary tariffs that violate international trade rules and harm legitimate interests of all countries, and called on China and Europe to stand together to oppose such measures.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Polish Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of unilateral bullying, compromise offers no way out, and acting as an accomplice will eventually harm one's own interests. The more complex the international situation becomes, the more China, Poland and Europe should strengthen solidarity and coordination and safeguard legitimate rights and interests and international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Polish Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister on Ukraine crisis; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Escalation of the conflict is not in the interest of any party. China is ready to maintain close communication with Poland and all relevant parties to promote the conclusion of a comprehensive, lasting and binding peace agreement and build a balanced, effective and sustainable European security architecture.

statements.speaker: Geng Shuang
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: Remarks to UN Security Council on Poland drone incident; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China calls on all parties to exercise calm and restraint, properly settle disputes through dialogue and consultation, and avoid misunderstanding and misjudgment. In the current context, any misunderstanding or misjudgment will deepen the trust deficit, and any confrontational rhetoric may spark escalation.

statements.speaker: Geng Shuang
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: Remarks to UN Security Council on Ukraine crisis; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This drone incident is the result of a spillover of the Ukraine crisis. What the international community needs most at present is goodwill rather than hostility, mutual accommodation rather than military confrontation, and de-escalation rather than further escalation. China calls on all parties to adhere to three principles: no expansion of the battlefield, no escalation of fighting, and no provocation by any party.

statements.speaker: Geng Shuang
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: Remarks to UN Security Council on Ukraine crisis; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Ukraine issue has been objective, impartial and consistent. China is committed to promoting peace talks and seeking a political solution. China stands ready to continue working with the international community to play a constructive role in promoting an early political settlement of the crisis.

article_title: Sixth Inspections Round Set to Begin - New Housing Rental Regulations - Central SoEs Projects in Tibet

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Croatian FM Grlic Radman in Beijing, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-CEEC cooperation is an important part of China-EU relations. China is willing to continue to strengthen cooperation with Croatia based on principles of openness, transparency and mutual benefit. A stable, healthy and positively developing China-EU relationship is in line with the fundamental interests and common aspirations of both sides.

article_title: China's New Urban Development Framework - Aus PM Visits China - Xi's Qiushi Article on Opening Up Policy - Xi's Thought on the Significance of Grasping the 'Key Minority'

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's determination to pursue peaceful development will not waver, its commitment to common development will not waver, and its policy of promoting cooperation in the Asia-Pacific will not waver

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Australia should treat each other as equals, seek common ground while shelving differences, engage in mutually beneficial cooperation, enhance strategic mutual trust, deepen cooperation, and cultivate people-to-people friendship

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with foreign ministers and heads of Shanghai Cooperation Organization
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Face international turbulence by keeping direction clear, strengthening confidence, acting efficiently; firmly oppose hegemony, domineering, and bullying to make multipolar world more equal and orderly; insist on joint consultation, joint construction, shared benefits for more inclusive economic globalisation

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia should implement important consensus reached between leaders, deepen comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership, strengthen mutual support on multilateral platforms, safeguard development and security interests, unite Global South countries, and promote international order development in more just and reasonable direction

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Qiushi article on opening up
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic globalisation is objective requirement for social productivity development and inevitable result of scientific progress. Unilateralism and protectionism are intensifying; China adheres to correct direction of economic globalisation, promotes trade and investment liberalisation and facilitation, opposes protectionism, 'building walls and barriers', 'decoupling and breaking chains', unilateral sanctions and extreme pressure

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 10th China-Australia Annual Leaders' Meeting (co-chaired with Prime Minister Albanese)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to continue working with Australia to promote continuous deepening and expansion of bilateral cooperation, achieve higher level of mutual benefit and win-win results, better benefit people of both countries

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 10th China-Australia Annual Leaders' Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese and Australian economies are highly complementary; broad cooperation space exists in energy, minerals, agriculture, green development, and technology. Both sides should strengthen dialogue mechanisms, plan cooperation, find interest alignment points, and unleash economic potential

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 10th China-Australia Annual Leaders' Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hope Australia will provide fair, open, non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese companies in Australia; China will continue supporting exchanges in culture, education, tourism, and local areas

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 10th China-Australia Annual Leaders' Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Australia are both supporters and beneficiaries of multilateralism and free trade; should strengthen communication and cooperation under UN, WTO, APEC frameworks; maintain rules-based multilateral trading system; work together to promote good international economic and trade cooperation environment

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 8th China-Australia CEO Roundtable
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under current international economic and trade situation, must deepen China-Australia cooperation. Two countries have highly complementary economic structures with solid foundations for industrial and market alignment; are natural cooperation partners; should further tighten cooperation bonds, persist in promoting trade and investment liberalisation and facilitation

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 8th China-Australia CEO Roundtable
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Large Chinese market will continuously release huge consumption potential; strengthening cooperation in AI and life sciences will better empower both industries; enterprises working together on clean energy, electric vehicles, energy storage will create world-class green industrial chain

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: 8th China-Australia CEO Roundtable
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue promoting high-level opening up, treat domestic and foreign-funded enterprises equally, protect foreign enterprises' and entrepreneurs' rights and interests in China by law; hope Australia treats Chinese enterprises fairly, solves problems in market access and investment review

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with European Council President Antonio Costa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At the beginning of this year, President Xi Jinping had a phone call with Mr. President, marking the beginning of the 50th anniversary celebrations of China-Europe diplomatic relations. Both sides agreed to uphold partnership positioning, carry out mutually beneficial cooperation, uphold multilateralism, and properly handle differences. China regards Europe as an important pole in a multipolar world and maintains continuity and stability in its policy toward Europe. China always supports European integration and is pleased to see the EU strengthen strategic autonomy.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with European Council President Antonio Costa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Today's world is intertwined with changes and chaos, and unilateralism and bullying practices are severely impacting the international order and international rules. As two major powers and economies, if China and Europe adhere to dialogue and cooperation, bloc confrontation will be hard to take shape. The more severe and complex the international situation, the more China and Europe need to strengthen unity and coordination and serve as a stabilizing force in a turbulent world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with European Council President Antonio Costa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always determined its position based on the rights and wrongs of the matter itself regarding the Ukraine crisis, and will continue to firmly stand on the side of peace, playing a constructive role in promoting talks for peace and a political resolution to the crisis.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The more complex and challenging the international landscape becomes, the more China and the EU, as two great civilizations and major forces, need to strengthen communication, enhance mutual trust, and serve as forces of global stability and certainty. China looks forward to working with the EU to summarize valuable experience from 50 years of relations and map out future direction for dialogue and cooperation for the next 50 years. China has always supported European integration and calls on both sides to uphold multilateralism and free trade. China remains committed to high-quality development and high-level opening-up and is ready to deepen economic and trade cooperation with the EU.

article_title: What Does Xi's 'Sweet Potato Economy' Theory Tell Us About China's Private Sector Policies? - China Backs Denmark on Greenland Issue

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President, Chairman of the Central Military Commission
statements.context: Instructions on the work of formulating the 15th Five-Year Plan, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Scientifically formulating and successively implementing five-year plans is an important experience of our Party's governance of the country, and also an important political advantage of socialism with Chinese characteristics. The formulation and implementation of the 15th Five-Year Plan are of great significance for fully implementing the strategic deployment of the 20th Party Congress and advancing Chinese-style modernisation.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with President of the Chamber of Deputies of Mexico Sergio Gutiérrez Luna, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to jointly carry out the five programs to build a community with a shared future between China and Latin American and Caribbean (LAC) countries, enrich the China-Mexico comprehensive strategic partnership and promote China-LAC solidarity and prosperity. China welcomes Mexico to participate in Belt and Road projects in a flexible manner and to deepen cooperation in traditional fields such as infrastructure construction and expand cooperation in emerging fields such as electric vehicles, new energy, and agricultural machinery.

statements.speaker: Chen Xu
statements.speaker_title: China's Ambassador to the United Nations
statements.context: Statement regarding World Health Assembly rejection of Taiwan observer status, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan's return to China is an important part of the victory of the Second World War and the post-war international order. UN General Assembly Resolution 2758 and World Health Assembly Resolution 25.1 have long resolved the issue of representation rights for all of China, including Taiwan. The World Health Assembly has rejected so-called Taiwan-related proposals for many years in a row, defending the authority of the United Nations and the post-war international order. Facts have proved that the evil path of 'Taiwan independence' is simply untenable.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Taiwan's participation in WHA, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Taiwan region's participation in the activities of international organizations, including the WHO, is consistent and clear. That is, it must be handled in line with the one-China principle. China's Taiwan region, unless given approval by the central government, has no basis, reason or right to participate in the WHA. Due to the DPP authorities' persistent separatist stance, the political foundation for the Taiwan region to participate in the WHA no longer exists.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on DPP and international support for one-China principle
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For quite some time, the DPP authorities and certain countries have been blatantly turning back the wheel of history by deliberately distorting and challenging UNGA Resolution 2758 to challenge the one-China principle. They are essentially trying to challenge not only China's sovereignty and territorial integrity, but also international justice and prevailing consensus as well as the post-war international order. The overwhelming majority of countries in the international community have reaffirmed to the Chinese side that they uphold UNGA Resolution 2758, firmly support the one-China principle, and oppose Taiwan's participation in the WHA.

statements.speaker: Chen Binhua
statements.speaker_title: Spokesperson for the Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council
statements.context: Statement on Taiwan Affairs Office criticism of DPP and external actors, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Criticized the DPP authorities and external actors for challenging China's 'sovereignty and territorial integrity', 'international justice and universal consensus' and 'the post-World War II international order'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Germany should deepen mutually beneficial cooperation and jointly oppose unilateralism and protectionism. China-Germany relations carry significance beyond the bilateral scope and exert an important influence on global economic development and strategic stability. The Taiwan question concerns China's core interests. China expects that the EU will work with the Chinese side in the same direction, properly resolve the anti-subsidy case involving Chinese-made electric vehicles (EVs) at an early date, and promote the upgrading of China-EU cooperation. Both sides should jointly advocate and uphold free trade, jointly oppose unilateralism and protectionism, safeguard the security and stability of global industrial and supply chains, practice true multilateralism and uphold the international system with the United Nations at its core.
statements.topic: diplomacy, EU relations, Taiwan, trade, multilateralism

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Polish Foreign Minister Radoslaw Sikorski, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Poland is an important strategic partner of China in Europe. This year marks the 80th anniversary of the victory of the World Anti-Fascist War and the founding of the United Nations. China is willing to work with Poland to uphold the post-World War II international order, safeguard the central role of the United Nations, and defend the international law and the basic norms governing international relations. The return of Taiwan to China is an integral part of the victory in World War II and the postwar international order. China hopes that Poland will uphold the international consensus, continue to adhere to the one-China policy, and oppose any form of 'Taiwan independence' separatist attempts.
statements.topic: diplomacy, EU relations, Taiwan, international order
statements.framing: cooperative with assertive elements on Taiwan

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Danish Foreign Minister Lars Lokke Rasmussen in Beijing, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Denmark was one of the first Western countries to recognize and establish diplomatic relations with the People's Republic of China. The most important experience of developing healthy and stable China-Denmark relations over the past 75 years is to adhere to the principle that all countries, big or small, are equal, and accommodate each other's core interests. China fully respects Denmark's sovereignty and territorial integrity on the Greenland issue and hopes that Denmark will continue to support China's legitimate position on issues related to its own sovereignty and territorial integrity. China is willing to work with Denmark to adhere to two-way opening up, take green development as the key point to give new impetus to practical cooperation. We also hope Denmark can provide a fair, transparent and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese enterprises.
statements.topic: diplomacy, Denmark relations, trade, green development

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Statement criticizing US export controls on Chinese chips, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is abusing export control measures, imposing stricter controls on Chinese chip products based on fabricated charges, and even interfering with Chinese companies using Chinese-made chips within China's borders. The US is overreaching, which is a typical act of unilateral bullying, and China firmly opposes this. China urges the US to immediately correct its erroneous practices and stop discriminatory measures against China.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Statement on US semiconductor and AI chip export controls, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US' actions seriously harm the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises, severely threaten the security and stability of the global semiconductor supply chain, and seriously impact global technological innovation. 'Tripping others' will not make oneself run faster. This approach of using unilateral protectionist measures in an attempt to contain and isolate other countries will ultimately damage the US' industrial competitiveness, resulting only in lifting a rock to drop on one's own feet. Both sides should jointly uphold the consensus reached at the China-US high-level talks in Geneva, strengthen communication of positions through mechanisms such as China-US economic and trade consultations, effectively manage differences, negotiate solutions to each other's concerns, and promote the construction of a sustainable, long-term, and mutually beneficial bilateral economic and trade relationship. If the US persists in its own way and continues to substantially harm China's interests, China will take resolute measures to protect its legitimate rights and interests.

article_title: Xi & Putin Deepen Ties to Combat US Policy of 'Dual Containment'

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Meeting with Vladimir Putin in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the countercurrent of unilateralism and acts of power and bullying in the international arena, China will shoulder the special responsibility of being a major power and permanent UN Security Council member to defend the outcomes of World War II, safeguard the rights and interests of China, Russia, and developing countries, and work to promote a more equal and orderly multipolar world

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Meeting with Vladimir Putin in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia should eliminate external interference and expand high-quality mutually beneficial cooperation in trade, energy, agriculture, aerospace, and artificial intelligence. Both sides should strengthen coordination on multilateral platforms and unite the Global South to adhere to true multilateralism

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Tea conversation with Vladimir Putin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As long as China and Russia maintain strategic determination and strategic cooperation, no force can stop the two countries from achieving their respective development and rejuvenation, cannot stop the will of the people for China-Russia friendship, and cannot stop the trend toward a multipolar world and economic globalization

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Discussion on Ukraine crisis with Putin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding the Ukraine crisis, China advocates a common, comprehensive, cooperative, and sustainable global security concept. China believes the legitimate security concerns of all countries should be addressed and the root causes of the crisis should be eliminated. China welcomes all efforts conducive to peace and looks forward to reaching a fair, lasting, binding peace agreement accepted by all parties through dialogue

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Press briefing following meetings in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Russia is the country I have visited most as President. This is my 11th visit. The past 10 years have been a decade of great turbulence and transformation in the international situation and a decade of great development in China-Russia relations. Facing changes in the world, times, and history, China and Russia must firmly grasp the forward direction of bilateral relations and make contributions to promoting development and maintaining international fairness and justice

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Press briefing following meetings in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia should strengthen generational friendship, adhere to mutual benefit and win-win outcomes, adhere to fairness and justice as defenders of the international order, and adhere to solidarity and mutual assistance as leaders in global governance

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Press briefing following meetings in Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia should firmly uphold the spirit of permanent good-neighborliness, comprehensive strategic coordination, and mutually beneficial cooperation, weather storms together, comprehensively enhance the height, dimension, and resilience of China-Russia relations, inject more stability into world peace and security, and provide stronger impetus for global development and prosperity

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Deepening the Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US and its allies are attempting to advance NATO's eastward expansion to the Asia-Pacific, creating 'small circles' in the Asia-Pacific region, and drawing in regional countries to implement its 'Indo-Pacific Strategy', undermining regional peace, stability, and prosperity

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Deepening the Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia will strengthen coordination and resolutely respond to the United States' implementation of 'dual containment' against China and Russia

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Deepening the Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Certain countries and their allies attempt to stealthily alter legal concepts, pressure countries that pursue independent foreign policies, and distort historical truths. Both sides strongly condemn such hegemonic behavior and urge them to stop interfering in other countries' internal affairs, undermining existing security architectures, artificially drawing lines between countries, and advocating camp confrontation

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Deepening the Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides firmly oppose unilateral coercive measures that have no basis in international law and are not authorized by the Security Council, and condemn the use of intimidation, restrictions, coercion and other means to put pressure on other countries

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Deepening the Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides oppose the construction of 'nuclear sharing' military alliances targeting China and Russia, oppose the deployment of nuclear weapons systems in this region under the pretext of strengthening 'extended deterrence' arrangements, and oppose the deployment of global anti-missile systems and land-based intermediate-range missile systems that undermine strategic stability
statements.topic: nuclear weapons, military alliances, Asia-Pacific security

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Global Strategic Stability
statements.speaker_title: State institution/Joint statement on strategic stability
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: One of the most pressing strategic risks is the expansion of existing and newly formed military alliances by some nuclear-weapon states close to the frontiers of other nuclear-weapon states in an attempt to establish or expand permanent footholds for projecting military power, exerting forceful pressure and committing hostile activities that threaten core security interests
statements.topic: nuclear weapons, military alliances, NATO expansion

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Global Strategic Stability
statements.speaker_title: State institution/Joint statement on strategic stability
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides strongly condemn plans and practical steps by individual nuclear-weapon states to deploy outside their national territories ground-launched intermediate-range and shorter-range missiles with short flight time targeting other nuclear-weapon states

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Global Strategic Stability
statements.speaker_title: State institution/Joint statement on strategic stability
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides express concern about the military biological activities of the United States of America and its allies and demand that they cease such activities that threaten the security of other states and relevant regions

statements.speaker: Joint Statement of the Russian Federation and the People's Republic of China on Global Strategic Stability
statements.speaker_title: State institution/Joint statement on strategic stability
statements.context: Official joint statement signed during Xi Jinping's visit to Moscow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides oppose the self-serving use by some countries of export control mechanisms to technologically and economically contain other states and to apply illegitimate policy of unilateral restrictive measures

article_title: Employment Stability - Cai Run on China-EU Ties - May Day Holiday Spending Up 8%

statements.speaker: Cai Run
statements.context: Article marking 50th anniversary of China-EU ties published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Adhere to the strategic guidance of head-of-state diplomacy. President Xi Jinping has had in-depth exchanges with EU leaders, reached important consensus on the development of China-EU relations, and provided strategic guidance for promoting healthy and stable development of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Cai Run
statements.context: Article marking 50th anniversary of China-EU ties published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Europe have no fundamental conflicts of interest or geopolitical contradictions. Cooperation far outweighs competition, and consensus far outweighs differences. They are partners in mutual achievement.

statements.speaker: Cai Run
statements.context: Article marking 50th anniversary of China-EU ties published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-EU economic and trade cooperation is large in scale, and it is inevitable that there will be some differences and frictions. It is hoped that the EU will meet China halfway, implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of both sides to properly handle economic and trade frictions through dialogue and consultation, and turn differences and frictions into practical cooperation and growth points for bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Cai Run
statements.context: Article marking 50th anniversary of China-EU ties published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and the EU advocate maintaining the international system with the United Nations at its core and the multilateral trading system with the World Trade Organization at its core. Both oppose unilateral bullying and are committed to promoting world multi-polarization and economic globalization.

article_title: Wang Tells BRICS FMs: China's Pushback in Trade War is in 'Common Interests of All Countries'

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President, General Secretary of CPC Central Committee, Chairman of Central Military Commission
statements.context: Visit to Shanghai AI incubation platform and BRICS NDB, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has rich data resources, a complete industrial system, and a huge market space. The prospects for developing AI are broad. It is necessary to strengthen policy support and talent cultivation, and strive to develop more safe, reliable, and high-quality products.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President, General Secretary of CPC Central Committee, Chairman of Central Military Commission
statements.context: Meeting with NDB President Dilma Rousseff in Shanghai, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The collective rise of the Global South has become an important force in maintaining world peace, promoting common development and improving global governance. China's development relies on self-reliance and hard work, and it will firmly safeguard its legitimate rights and interests and the common interests of the international community.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Rio, reported by Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States goes all out to seek unilateralism and supremacy, and puts its own interests over the international public good. The existing international system has supported global stability and prosperity, yet the United States, as the largest beneficiary of the system, is now moving toward the opposite direction. People are witnessing that the law of the jungle, where the strong prey on the weak, is blatantly taking the stage.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Rio, reported by Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Safeguarding multilateral trade rules is the most pressing issue at present. The United States has long benefited greatly from free trade, but now it is using tariffs as a bargaining chip to demand exorbitant prices from various countries. Choosing to remain silent, compromise or flinch will only invite more bullying.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting in Rio, reported by Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the situation in which the US is wielding the big stick of tariffs globally, every country should make a choice: Do we allow the world to return to the jungle where the strong prey on the weak? Do we accept that one country's private interests can override the public interests of all countries? Regarding the trade war, China's answer is clear and firm: if you insist on fighting, we will fight till the end; if you are prepared to talk, there must be equality and respect.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with South African Foreign Minister Ronald Lamola at BRICS meetings, reported by Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US believes in putting its own interests first, extensively practicing protectionism, arbitrarily imposing tariffs on the whole world including Africa, which is typical unilateral bullying behaviour. China's necessary countermeasures are not only to defend its own legitimate rights and interests, but also to safeguard the common interests of the Global South.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Nigerian Foreign Minister at BRICS meetings, reported by Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with rampant unilateral protectionism and increasing uncertainty and instability in the international situation, China is willing to work with Africa and developing countries to jointly resist protectionism, oppose hegemony and bullying, and put forth a strong voice for upholding multilateralism and defending fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.context: Meeting with Hiroshi Moriyama, chairman of Japan-China Friendship Parliamentarians' Union, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to work with Japan to implement the important outcomes reached by the leaders of the two countries, abide by the principles and consensus of the four political documents between China and Japan, adhere to win-win cooperation, and promote the steady and long-term development of bilateral ties along the right track.

article_title: Signalling via Fiction: What Nüwa Mending the Sky, Pandora's Box & The Wizard of Oz Tell Us About China's View of US Tariffs

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at event with Vietnamese leaders launching 'Red Study Tours' project
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: People are the creators of history, and the support of the peoples of the two countries is the solid foundation for building a China-Vietnam community with a shared future. China will invite Vietnamese youth for 'Red Study Tours' in the next three years.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Farewell chat with Vietnamese Communist Party General Secretary To Lam
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides reaffirmed political will to jointly strengthen world socialism, resist external risks and challenges, and safeguard regional peace and stability as well as international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks at Kuala Lumpur airport during first visit to Malaysia in 12 years
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Malaysia are friendly neighbors with traditional friendship stretching back thousands of years. As important developing countries and members of the Global South, deepening high-level strategic cooperation between China and Malaysia conforms to common interests and is beneficial to regional and world peace, stability, and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Malaysian newspaper
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In 2023, Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and I agreed on building the China-Malaysia community with a shared future. China and Malaysia must enhance strategic communication, increase mutual political trust, follow through on Belt and Road cooperation, strengthen synergy between development strategies, expand experience sharing on national governance, and promote bilateral relations through high-standard strategic cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Malaysian newspaper
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes Malaysia as a BRICS partner country. The earth is big enough to accommodate the common development and prosperity of China and the United States. Only through mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation can we inject certainty and provide positive energy to the world.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech delivered at 17th study session of the Politburo on October 28, 2024, published in Qiushi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For over 70 years, China's development has always been based on self-reliance and hard work. It has never depended on anyone's handouts, and has never feared any unreasonable suppression. No matter how the external environment changes, China will firmly maintain confidence and composure, and focus its energy on handling its own affairs well.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech delivered at 17th study session of the Politburo on October 28, 2024, published in Qiushi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There are no winners in a tariff war. Going against the world will only lead to isolating oneself. Blowing out someone else's lamp will not make your own brighter.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech on cultural power delivered at 17th study session of the Politburo on October 28, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As a responsible major power, we must more proactively promote China's propositions, spread Chinese culture, and display China's image. We should advance the restructuring of international communication patterns, strengthen coordination of external propaganda work, and construct a multi-channel, three-dimensional external communication pattern.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Investigation and research tour in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current external environment is undergoing profound changes, causing adverse effects on China's foreign trade. Everyone must unite, take initiative, overcome difficulties, and forge ahead, actively explore diversified markets, innovate trade channels and methods, and strive to stabilise the fundamentals of foreign trade.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Yin commentary on tariff pressure
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the US' reckless tariff blows, its methods of extreme pressure, and its delusions of subduing China, the Chinese people do not believe in evil, are not afraid of pressure, and have the confidence, capability, and resolve to overcome all difficulties and achieve victory.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Yin commentary on tariff war impacts
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This protectionist trade weapon has severely impacted the multilateral trading system, created enormous chaos and uncertainty globally, triggered major tremors in capital markets across multiple countries, increased the probability of global economic recession, and caused a 'confidence crisis'.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Yin commentary on US economic impacts and tariffs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Blowing out someone else's lamp will not make your own brighter. Clinging to beggar-thy-neighbor practices, zero-sum game thinking, and arrogant self-admiration will not attract fellow travelers. The recklessly waving of the 'sanctions stick' harms the American public, drastically raising the cost of living and leading to widespread protests.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Yin commentary on economic globalization and cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The essence of China-U.S. economic and trade relations is precisely mutual benefit and win-win outcomes. American companies have tremendous interests in China, with more than 70,000 American companies investing and doing business in China. Only through mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation can we inject certainty and provide positive energy to the world.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Public Security
statements.context: Report on cyberattacks during Asian Winter Games in Harbin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Three NSA operatives engaged in cyberattacks targeting the Asian Winter Games held in Harbin. Investigations revealed that the cyberattacks were carried out by the Office of Tailored Access Operations of the NSA. The NSA focused its pre-event cyberattacks on critical systems including registration, arrival/departure management, and competition entry platforms, and also launched cyberattacks targeting critical infrastructure sectors in Heilongjiang Province.

article_title: China Signals Preparedness & Resolve Amid Trump's Tariffs - PD Commentary: 'The Sky Will Not Fall'

statements.speaker: Chinese Government
statements.context: Official statement on Saturday in response to US tariff policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has imposed tariffs on all trading partners under various pretexts, severely infringing upon legitimate rights and interests of countries, violating WTO rules, undermining the rules-based multilateral trading system, and disrupting global economic order. The Chinese government strongly condemns and resolutely opposes such moves. The US defies fundamental economic laws, weaponizes tariffs for selfish interests in a typical act of unilateralism, protectionism and economic bullying. The US is playing a zero-sum game to pursue 'America First' and 'American exceptionalism' and advance hegemonic ambitions. China will continue to take resolute measures to safeguard sovereignty, security, and development interests. China-US economic relations should be mutually beneficial and win-win.

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency
statements.context: Article published on front page of People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US 'reciprocal tariff' policy is illogical and violates basic economic laws. The US calculation method is arbitrary and lacks reasonable grounds. The US goal of achieving 'zero trade deficit' is not feasible as the US trade deficit is rooted in low savings and high consumption domestic imbalance, an endogenous structural phenomenon. Protectionism will not bring US manufacturing back or achieve zero trade deficit. The US policy is typical tariff bullying that violates WTO rules, subverts international economic order, puts US interests above international community interests, and violates WTO MFN principles.

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency
statements.context: Article published on front page of People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's countermeasures are reasonable, legal, and justified. China does not want to fight a trade war because there are no winners, but China is not afraid of trade war. If the US introduces reciprocal tariff measures, China will inevitably implement reciprocal countermeasures. The essence of Sino-US economic relations should be mutual benefit and win-win. The two sides should find solutions through consultations based on mutual respect and equal treatment, not through unilateral containment, suppression or extreme pressure.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US arbitrary imposition of tariffs will cause shock but 'the sky will not fall.' China is a super-large economy with strong resilience. Dependence on the US market has declined from 19.2% in 2018 to 14.7% in 2024. Many US consumer goods and investment products are highly dependent on Chinese imports, with some categories exceeding 50% dependence. Emerging markets provide important basis for stabilizing foreign trade. China is the main trading partner for 150+ countries. Among export companies in 2024, 85% also conduct domestic sales accounting for 75% of total sales.
statements.topic: trade, economic resilience, US market dependency

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economy is stabilizing and improving, providing confidence and strength to respond to US tariff impacts. Since 2017 when the US provoked a trade war, China has maintained development and progress demonstrating resilience that grows stronger under pressure. Economic circulation continues to improve with strengthened endogenous momentum. Technology empowerment continues advancing with breakthroughs in integrated circuits, AI, and humanoid robots. Three major risks have been effectively controlled. International organizations and Wall Street have raised forecasts for China's economic growth and regard China's certainty as a safe haven against American uncertainty.
statements.topic: economy, US-China trade war, economic outlook

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing America's reckless abuse of tariffs, China knows what it is doing and has clear countermeasures. China has 8 years of trade war experience with accumulated rich struggle experience. The Party Central Committee anticipated this new round of economic and trade suppression and has fully estimated possible impacts with sufficient advance preparedness. Response plans include enriching and improving policy toolbox, dynamically adjusting policies, strengthening counter-cyclical adjustments. Monetary policy tools like reserve requirement cuts and interest rate cuts have sufficient room. Fiscal policy can expand further as needed. China will use extraordinary measures to boost domestic consumption and stabilize capital markets.
statements.topic: trade, monetary policy, fiscal policy, economic response

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has not closed the door to negotiations but does not harbor illusions and has made various preparations to respond to shocks. Governments at all levels will provide precise assistance to industries and enterprises more severely impacted with one approach per sector and one strategy per enterprise. We will urge the United States to correct its wrong practices and consult with China and other countries in equal, respectful, and mutually beneficial manner to properly resolve trade differences. China must turn pressure into motivation and regard US policy impacts as a strategic opportunity to accelerate building a new development pattern and promote high-quality development.
statements.topic: trade negotiations, US-China relations, economic strategy

article_title: Xi & the 8-point Central Regulations - Li Qiang & He Lifeng Meet Global CEOs - New TV Show on Xi's Economic Thought - China-Japan Dialogue

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech to CEOs of major global companies at China Development Forum on Sunday, March 23, 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has set its economic growth target at around 5% based on deep understanding of China's economic conditions and firm confidence in governance capabilities. China will implement more proactive macroeconomic policies, deepen economic reform, promote unified national market construction, and create good development environment for business entities. China will unswervingly promote open cooperation, practice true multilateralism, and maintain free trade and stable global supply chains. China will continue to welcome enterprises from all countries and further expand market access.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Senator Steve Daines and American business people, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-U.S. relations have reached a new important juncture. History has proven both countries stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation. Both sides should choose dialogue over confrontation and win-win cooperation over zero-sum games. Economic and trade cooperation is an important foundation of China-U.S. relations. Nobody gains from a trade war, and no country achieves development through tariffs. The two countries should solve trade imbalance by making the pie of cooperation bigger. China welcomes US companies to share development opportunities and will treat domestic and foreign companies as equals.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-Japan High-Level Economic Dialogue, March 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Japan are partners, not rivals. Amid global economic landscape adjustments, rising unilateralism and protectionism, both countries should establish correct understanding, demonstrate responsibility, seek development with innovative thinking. Enterprises should collaborate in AI, digital economy, energy, environment and green trade. The two countries should avoid politicization of economic security to maintain stable supply chains. They should advocate openness over isolation and inclusiveness over exclusiveness. Negotiations for China-Japan-Korea FTA should resume and Asia-Pacific Free Trade Area process should advance.
statements.topic: China-Japan relations, trade, regional cooperation, economic security

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Foreign Minister Takeshi Iwaya during visit to Japan, March 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Japan are important neighbors; their relations have significance beyond bilateral scope. Both sides should implement important consensus from leaders, uphold principles of facing history squarely and looking toward future, enhance mutual trust and dispel doubts. This year marks 80th anniversary of Chinese victory in War of Resistance Against Japanese Aggression and World Anti-Fascist War. Correctly understanding and treating history is important prerequisite for Japan's international role, political foundation for relations with neighbors, and criterion for testing Japan's commitment to peaceful development. Four political documents between China and Japan on history and Taiwan must be strictly observed and not blurred or regressed. The China-Japan Treaty of Peace and Friendship states provisions should be strictly observed—the statement and treaty are inseparable and constitute legally-binding guiding document that must be faithfully observed and not distorted.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Ishiba during visit to Japan, March 2025
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Japan, both with significant influence, have common mission to work together to build better future for Asia. In face of complex international situation and global challenges, both sides should enhance mutual trust and strengthen cooperation to provide more stability and certainty to world. As close neighbors, treating each other with sincerity, keeping good faith and pursuing harmony are correct ways to be neighbors. Japanese side should adhere to principles of four political documents including China-Japan Joint Statement, safeguard political and legal foundation for bilateral relations, and earnestly fulfill important political commitments on historical issues and Taiwan question. This year marks 80th anniversary of victory of Chinese People's War of Resistance against Japanese Aggression. At this important juncture, Japanese side should make wise choice and send right signal with responsible attitude toward history, people and future.
statements.topic: China-Japan relations, history, Taiwan, regional cooperation

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with CEOs of Apple, Pfizer, Brookfield Asset Management, Medtronic, Mastercard, Eli Lilly, Cargill and Corning Incorporated
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economy has strong resilience, vast potential and ample vitality. China is committed to promoting high-quality development, expanding high-standard opening up, and continuously improving business environment. China welcomes increased investment by multinational companies to share in country's development opportunities.

article_title: Why China Will Never Give Up on Manufacturing Prowess - Wang Yi Courts European Partners in Munich - 10th China-UK Strategic Dialogue

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A multipolar world is not only a historical inevitability; it is also becoming a reality. China will surely be a factor of certainty in this multipolar system, and strive to be a steadfast constructive force in a changing world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Munich Security Conference speech
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries believe might makes right and have opened a Pandora's box marked the law of the jungle. The multipolar paradigm must not be a state of disarray. Without norms and standards, one may be at the table yesterday but end up on the menu tomorrow.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Munich Security Conference Q&A
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's policy toward the US remains stable and consistent, and will not be easily changed. China is ready to build a stable, healthy and sustainable bilateral relationship with the United States in accordance with the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation. But if the US is unwilling, and insists on suppressing and containing China, then it will stand its ground to the end.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Munich Security Conference Q&A
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will steadfastly defend its national sovereignty, dignity and legitimate rights of development. The Chinese people have never believed in superstitions and are not afraid of ghosts. An old saying in China reads 'as the Nature changes vigorously, a man of virtue should strive continuously to strengthen himself'.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Munich Security Conference Q&A
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia are two major neighbors with a long border. The two countries have established a comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination for a new era, characterized by non-alliance, non-confrontation and not targeting any third party. China has normal economic trade with Russia. If China does not import oil and gas from Russia, how can it make up for the gap and ensure the needs of more than 1.4 billion Chinese people?

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Munich Security Conference Q&A
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Ukraine, China did not create the crisis, nor is it a party to the crisis. From the day after the crisis broke out, China has called for resolution through dialogue and consultation. The ultimate resolution of any conflict lies at the negotiation table. China welcomes all efforts committed to peace, including the peace talks consensus reached by the United States and Russia.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Munich Security Conference Q&A
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some have claimed that China seeks to change the current order and start a new one; however, the country that is truly challenging the order, breaking agreements, and withdrawing from international organizations is making Europe feel the chill every day. China is in the current international order and has benefited from it. Our efforts are to push the international order toward a more just and reasonable direction.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with British Prime Minister Keir Starmer, February 13
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Labour Government's rational and pragmatic policy toward China is in line with the interests of the country and the people and conforms to the trend of the times. China is willing to work with the UK to deepen cooperation in areas such as infrastructure, trade and investment, and clean energy.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: 10th China-UK Strategic Dialogue with Foreign Secretary David Lammy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is guided by four points about what must be done put forward by President Xi Jinping on Ukraine, and has called for 'no expansion of the battlefields, no escalation of hostilities and no fanning flames'. China welcomes all efforts toward peace talks and supports the establishment of a balanced, effective and sustainable European security architecture.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Spanish Foreign Minister Jose Manuel Albares Bueno in Munich
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: With the current international situation in transformation and turbulence and the world facing the risk of a return to 'the law of the jungle', China and Spain should jointly practice multilateralism, promote the democratization of international relations, build broad international consensus, and work together toward equal and orderly multipolarity.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Graham Allison
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of the accelerated evolution of the once-in-a-century changes and the complex international situation, China needs to maintain strategic determination, undertake responsibilities of a major country, and continue to inject more certainty into the world. China's policy toward the US maintains continuity and stability, and will follow the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with German CDU chairman Friedrich Merz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Germany's friendly policy towards China has proven to align with its own national interests and the aspirations of its people, as well as the trend of globalization. China is extensively advancing Chinese-style modernization and will bring new opportunities for Sino-German cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with German FM Annalena Baerbock
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Multipolarization is an inevitable trend of historical development. Facing the current rise of protectionism, resurgence of Cold War mentality and rampant unilateral bullying, China is willing to strengthen communication and coordination with Germany to build broad consensus for maintaining international peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Chancellor Olaf Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Germany should strengthen unity, coordination and cooperation to uphold free trade, practice multilateralism, and safeguard the authority of the United Nations. China appreciates Germany's rational and pragmatic stance on the EU's tariff issue concerning Chinese electric vehicles and hopes Germany to play a constructive role in promptly resolving China-EU trade frictions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Kaja Kallas, EU High Representative for Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There are no fundamental conflicts of interest or geopolitical contradictions between China and the EU. Both sides uphold multilateralism, support the central role of the United Nations, advocate for resolving international hotspot issues through dialogue and negotiation, and oppose unilateral bullying.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Argentine Foreign Minister Gerardo Werthein
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not seek spheres of influence or participate in geopolitical competition, and it firmly practices multilateralism in international affairs. China is willing to work with Argentina and other Latin American countries to firmly safeguard international rule of law and basic norms of international relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China expressed hope that NATO would adopt a rational and pragmatic approach, develop an objective and accurate perception of China, and pursue a positive and responsible policy toward China. China is a force for maintaining peace and stability and the largest contributor of peacekeeping personnel among UN Security Council permanent members.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Palestinian issue is the core of the Middle East issue. Violence in exchange for violence will only bring a new vicious cycle. The humanitarian disaster in the Gaza region must end as soon as possible. The fundamental way out lies in the implementation of the 'two-state solution'.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with French Foreign Minister Jean-Noel Barrot
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and France should uphold their tradition of independence and self-reliance, adhere to openness and win-win cooperation and act as stabilizing forces in maintaining international order. Trade frictions are issues in the process of cooperation between China and the EU, but as comprehensive strategic partners, China and France have the wisdom and capability to properly resolve these issues.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has been Ukraine's largest trading partner in recent years, demonstrating the potential and space for cooperation. China views Ukraine as a friend and partner. On the Ukraine crisis, the principles and propositions put forward by President Xi Jinping are objective, impartial, rational, and pragmatic.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Czech Foreign Minister Jan Lipavsky
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to enhance mutually beneficial cooperation with the Czech Republic provided that the Czech side respects China's core interests. Bilateral relations have experienced a downturn in recent years, a situation that China does not wish to see. The key is to respect China's core interests, particularly adherence to the one-China principle.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Austrian interim Chancellor Alexander Schallenberg
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Austria as a permanently neutral country has long played the role of a bridge-builder. China welcomes Austria to seize new opportunities brought by China's development, deepen mutually beneficial cooperation, and advance China-Austria relations to continue leading China-EU relations.

article_title: Dear Elon, Let's Talk Cooperation

statements.speaker: Hua Ping
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Green and low-carbon development is a universal trend, which cannot be blocked by 'small yards and high walls'. Faced with 'additional tariffs' and other big sticks, global consumers have expressed their love for quality products and pursuit of green and low-carbon concepts.

statements.speaker: Hua Ping
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation and mutual benefit are the right path and broad way, while isolation and exclusivity are dead ends. Only through cooperative win-win can things be accomplished, be done well, and be done on a grand scale.

statements.speaker: Hua Ping
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese-style modernization is modernization on the path of peaceful development. Based on the concept of win-win cooperation, we continue to provide new opportunities for world development with new achievements in Chinese-style modernization, and are willing to work with all parties to promote the realization of world modernization of peaceful development, mutually beneficial cooperation and common prosperity.

article_title: Li Meets CEOs - NPCSC Meeting Wrap - China & Japan High-level Political Dialogue - Xu Feihong's Wishlist for India: Ease Visas, Restart Direct Flights, Lift Investment Curbs & Let's Talk Bollywood

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to members of grassroots lecture program (老杨树宣讲汇) in Shanghai, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cities should be built by the people and for the people. Called on members to inspire more people to embrace and implement the concept of a people-oriented city.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with exhibitors and buyers at China International Import Expo (CIIE)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The CIIE has become a globally shared international public good and platform for mutual engagement between China and the world. Regardless of changes in the international landscape, China's door will only open wider and wider. China will further relax market access and optimize the business environment. The Chinese market is still one of the best choices for enterprises from all countries.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with exhibitors and buyers at CIIE
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hope foreign-funded enterprises will continue to take root in the Chinese market and deepen cooperation with Chinese buyers. Chinese and foreign entrepreneurs should continue to firmly support economic globalization, integrate resources, plan industry layout, and expand markets globally. Call on all to strengthen joint research and coordinated efforts to tackle challenges, promote technological advancement and industrial upgrading, and foster new drivers of world economic growth.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Japan Association of Corporate Executives (Keizai Doyukai) delegation in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi Jinping sent congratulatory message to new Japanese PM Ishiba, hoping Japan would work with China to meet halfway, abide by principles and consensus of four political documents between China and Japan, comprehensively promote the strategic and mutually beneficial relationship, and strive to build a constructive and stable China-Japan relationship that meets requirements of the new era.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Japan Association of Corporate Executives delegation in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic and trade cooperation between China and Japan has sound foundation, large space and strong complementarity. China's door to the outside world will open even wider. Hope Keizai Doyukai will encourage Japanese companies to have comprehensive and accurate understanding of China and seize China's development opportunities.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Consultations with Takeo Akiba under China-Japan high-level political dialogue mechanism in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Japan relations are at a critical stage of improvement. Two sides should follow consensus of leaders, stick to right direction of improving and developing bilateral relations, and build constructive and stable China-Japan relationship that meets requirements of the new era.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Consultations with Takeo Akiba under China-Japan high-level political dialogue mechanism in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japanese side should establish objective and rational understanding of China, honor political commitment on Taiwan question, and safeguard political foundation of China-Japan relations.
