statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Consultations with Takeo Akiba under China-Japan high-level political dialogue mechanism in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two sides will abide by principles and consensus in four political documents between China and Japan and commit to comprehensively advancing strategic relationship of mutual benefit. Will maintain high-level intercourse, dialogue and exchanges in various fields and send more positive signals to outside world. China and Japan should not and will not decouple, pledging to jointly promote healthy development of economic and trade cooperation and stable and smooth production and supply chain.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Consultations with Takeo Akiba under China-Japan high-level political dialogue mechanism in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is firmly committed to path of peaceful development, pursues national defence policy that is defensive in nature, and is major country with best record of peace and security. China will continue to uphold fairness and justice to prevent war and chaos in region. Hoped all parties will jointly resist non-regional forces inciting confrontation and take concrete actions to safeguard regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Kazakh PM Olzhas Bektenov at sidelines of CIIE
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China ready to work with Kazakhstan to implement important consensus of heads of state, deepen political mutual trust, firmly support each other on core interests, expand mutually beneficial cooperation. China willing to strengthen alignment of development strategies, expand bilateral trade, consolidate production capacity cooperation, enhance energy and mineral cooperation, improve connectivity. Jointly work for success of Year of Chinese Tourism in Kazakhstan next year. Coordinate closely within multilateral frameworks including UN, SCO, China-Central Asia mechanism to implement three global initiatives and promote global governance toward more just and equitable direction.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Uzbek PM Abdulla Aripov at sidelines of CIIE
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will work with Uzbekistan to transform common understandings into concrete cooperation results. Two countries should view relations from strategic, long-term perspective, provide firm mutual support on core interests and major concerns. Should align development strategies, expand economic and trade cooperation, strengthen connectivity infrastructure, build China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway as flagship Belt and Road project. Tap cooperation potential in emerging industries including new energy, digital economy, AI, e-commerce, 5G, green mining. Strengthen cooperation in culture, education, tourism, poverty reduction. Continue coordination within UN, SCO, China-Central Asia Mechanism to safeguard legitimate rights and interests of developing countries.
statements.topic: bilateral relations, trade, Belt and Road, development

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on China's appeal to WTO against EU countervailing measures on Chinese electric vehicles
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes EU's final measures to impose high countervailing duties on Chinese-made EVs. China decided to appeal to WTO dispute settlement mechanism to safeguard development interests of EV industry and global cooperation on green transformation. EU's ruling lacks factual and legal basis while violating WTO rules; it is abuse of trade remedy measures and practice of trade protectionism in name of countervailing. China urged EU to face up to its mistakes, immediately correct illegal practices, and jointly safeguard stability of global EV industrial chain and supply chain as well as overall China-EU economic and trade cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xu Feihong
statements.context: Speech at Merchants' Chamber of Commerce & Industry (MCCI) event in Kolkata
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two sides (Modi-Xi meeting) reached common understandings including strengthening communication and cooperation, enhancing strategic mutual trust. Will hold talks between foreign ministers and officials at various levels to bring relationship back to sound and steady development at early date. Will make good use of Special Representatives mechanism on China-India boundary question to ensure peace and tranquility in border areas and find fair and reasonable settlement. Will strengthen communication and cooperation in multilateral fora to safeguard common interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Xu Feihong
statements.context: Speech at MCCI event in Kolkata
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year, Chinese Embassy and Consulates in India issued over 240,000 visas, 80% of which were business visas, showing vitality of economic and trade exchanges. Chinese companies made important contributions to local development and exports. China-India commercial exchanges are inseparable. Indian media reported that electronic, chemical, and renewable energy products still need to be imported from China. Imposing tariffs and restrictions on Chinese products is not conducive to development of downstream industries and consumer interests in India. Indian companies need highly skilled workers from China to install equipment and carry out repairs.

statements.speaker: Xu Feihong
statements.context: Speech at MCCI event in Kolkata
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is advancing rejuvenation of Chinese nation on all fronts through Chinese path to modernization. India has put forward vision of 'Viksit Bharat 2047'. Two countries have same development goals and broad cooperation prospects. China wants to develop well for itself and hopes India will develop well too. No country understands better than China what a great cause it is to enable more than 1.4 billion Indians to live a good life. China would like to work with India to help each other succeed, achieve common development and revitalization, promote unity and cooperation of Global South, and join hands to build community with shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Xu Feihong
statements.context: Speech at MCCI event in Kolkata
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: India's high-quality products will have broad business opportunities in China. In Fiscal Year 2024, products such as pepper, iron ore, and cotton yarn achieved increases of more than 17%, 160%, and 240% in exports to China. China welcomes more Indian companies to make full use of platforms such as China International Import Expo to help more Indian high-quality products be exported to China and share China's development dividends.

statements.speaker: Xu Feihong
statements.context: Speech at MCCI event in Kolkata
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Actively attracting FDI and effectively protecting rights and interests of foreign enterprises are reasons behind China's rapid development. By maintaining stability and continuity of FDI policies, China continues to consolidate confidence of foreign companies. Third Plenary Session proposed removing all restrictions on foreign investment in manufacturing industry, and foreign companies encouraged to participate in Chinese upstream and downstream supply chains. Indian companies can enhance 'Make in India' by 'investing in China'. Industrial structures of China and India highly complementary - India competitive in IT, software, biomedicine; China seeing rapid expansion in electronic manufacturing and emerging industries. India major drive to improve infrastructure where China has rich experience. Business community hopes India will lift restrictions on investment and government procurement against neighboring countries to promote common development of industries and benefit peoples of two nations.

statements.speaker: Xu Feihong
statements.context: Speech at MCCI event in Kolkata
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two large ancient civilizations with population of over 1.4 billion should relax visa restrictions and restart direct flights - this has great significance for enhancing people-to-people exchanges and bringing relationship between nations back to sound and steady development at early date. In 2024, number of Chinese outbound tourists expected to reach 130 million. India should not miss this opportunity. China and India can strengthen cooperation in movie industry. Indian films including 'Dangal' and 'Bajrangi Bhaijaan' very popular in China. The two countries can strengthen cooperation in movie sector and promote mutual understanding between peoples.

article_title: No Party Spirit, No Membership - Breakdown of US NSA's China Visit & Beijing's Questions About VP Harris - India-China Talks - Xi Presses Reform Agenda

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In this changing and turbulent world, countries need solidarity and coordination, not division or confrontation. As two major countries, China and the United States should be responsible for history, for the people and for the world, and should be a source of stability for world peace and a propeller for common development. The No. 1 issue is to develop a right strategic perception and answer whether China and the US are rivals or partners.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's foreign policy is open and transparent and its strategic intentions are aboveboard. China is focused on managing its own affairs well and will continue deepening reform comprehensively. China follows a path of peaceful development and is ready to work with other countries for common development and jointly build a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's U.S. policy is highly consistent. While great changes have taken place in the two countries and in China-U.S. relations, China's commitment to the goal of a stable, healthy and sustainable China-U.S. relationship remains unchanged, its principle in handling the relationship based on mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation remains unchanged, its position of firmly safeguarding the country's sovereignty, security and development interests remains unchanged, and its efforts to carry forward the traditional friendship between the Chinese and American people remain unchanged.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China hopes the United States will work in the same direction with China, view China and its development in a positive and rational light, see each other's development as an opportunity rather than a challenge, work with China to find a right way for the two countries to coexist in peace and achieve common development, and work to maintain the stability of China-U.S. relations and improve and take forward the relationship.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two heads of state had a successful meeting in San Francisco last November and a phone call in April, mapping out the direction for sound, stable and sustainable development of China-US relations. Maintaining stability in the field of military security serves the common interests of the two sides. The US should work in concert with China on the path of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US side should correct its strategic perceptions of China, adopt a rational and pragmatic policy toward China, truly respect China's core interests, promote military-to-military communication and exchanges together with China, and jointly shoulder responsibilities as major countries.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is at the very core of China's core interests, the bedrock of the political foundation of China-US relations, and the first red line that must not be crossed in China-US relations. 'Taiwan independence' forces are as incompatible with peace and stability of the Taiwan Strait as fire with water. The PLA will take countermeasures against the provocations of 'Taiwan independence' forces. China urges the US side to stop military collusion with Taiwan, stop arming Taiwan, and stop spreading false narratives on Taiwan.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/briefing on Sullivan visit (via Director General Yang Tao of Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang summed up the experience and lessons as 'five keys': First, the key to keeping the China-U.S. relations to the right direction lies in the guidance and stewardship of the two presidents; Second, the key to avoiding conflict and confrontation lies in abiding by the three joint communiques; Third, the key to smooth interactions lies in treating each other as equals; Fourth, the key to a steady and sustained relationship lies in cementing the popular foundation; Fifth, the key to peaceful coexistence lies in developing a right perception.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/briefing on Sullivan visit (via Director General Yang Tao of Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan, democracy and human rights, path and system, and right to development are the four red lines China has drawn in China-U.S. relations. The Taiwan question is the first and foremost red line that must not be crossed in China-U.S. relations; China's political system and development path must not be challenged; and the Chinese people's right to development must not be deprived of. Touching these red lines would take away the floor for China-U.S. relations and render the guardrails useless. Since the U.S. side stated many times that it is committed to the one-China policy, it does not support 'Taiwan independence', it should honor its commitments with real actions, abide by the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiques, stop arming Taiwan, and support China's peaceful reunification.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/briefing on Sullivan visit (via Director General Yang Tao of Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called 'small yard with high fences' of the United States has kept expanding and become limitless. The so-called 'national security' has become a basket in which anything can be put. The narrative of so-called 'overcapacity' is but another excuse for protectionism. Behind these are still the U.S. misperception of China, and its hegemonic mentality of seeking absolute security and absolute advantage. The United States should know that it is impossible for China to permanently stay at the medium and low end of the industrial chain. China has the capability, the need and the right to climb up toward the medium and high end.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/briefing on Sullivan visit (via Director General Yang Tao of Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-U.S. economic and trade relations are mutually beneficial in nature, and suppressing China's economic and technological advancement hurts itself as well as others, and will not succeed.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/briefing on Sullivan visit (via Director General Yang Tao of Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Developing alliances and partnerships is something up to the United States itself, but it should not use it to hurt China's interests. The Philippines should keep its word, and the United States should also do things that are conducive to regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/briefing on Sullivan visit (via Director General Yang Tao of Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We do not seek gains from the conflict [in Ukraine], still less do we fuel the flames. China follows an independent foreign policy of peace and does not seek alliance nor bloc confrontation. The United States should stop spreading the false narrative of 'China supporting Russia's defense industrial base,' and stop smearing, scapegoating or shifting the blame onto China. Still less should it wield illegal, unilateral sanctions.

article_title: Wang-Sullivan Meeting - China-Japan Ties - Wang Huning's Tibet Visit - National Defense Education Month Activities - White Paper on Energy Transition - Song Tao Meets KMT's Andrew Hsia

statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Treating each other as equals is key to ensuring China-U.S. interactions are smooth. Acting from the position of strength is not the right way of interaction between countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cementing the foundations of public opinion is key to pursuing the steady, sustained development of China-U.S. relations. The two countries should build more bridges and pave more roads for people-to-people exchange, rather than raising obstacles.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Establishing correct perception is key for China and the United States to achieve peaceful coexistence. China is committed to ensuring better lives for its people at home and making greater contributions to world peace and development abroad. The United States should not speculate about China based on its own historical path, nor assume that China will follow the path of past world powers that sought hegemony.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan belongs to China and China will be reunified. 'Taiwan independence' poses the biggest risk to peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. The United States should act on its commitment of not supporting 'Taiwan independence', adhere to the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiques, cease arming Taiwan, and support the peaceful reunification of China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: National security should be common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable. One country's security should not be built upon the insecurity of others. National security requires clear boundaries, particularly in the economic domain, where scientific delineation is crucial. The United States should end its suppression of China in the economic, trade and sci-tech fields, and refrain from undermining China's legitimate interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Using 'overcapacity' as an excuse to pursue protectionism will only harm global green development and impede world economic growth.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Jake Sullivan, US National Security Advisor, Tuesday to Wednesday

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Briefing on Jake Sullivan's visit to China (August 27-29)

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Briefing on Jake Sullivan's visit to China (August 27-29)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's U.S. policy is consistent, which is underpinned by the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation put forward by China. statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Briefing on Jake Sullivan's visit to China (August 27-29)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should stop abusing unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction, and stop smearing, framing, pressuring and blackmailing China. China will continue to take strong and resolute measures to safeguard its major interests and legitimate rights.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Briefing on Jake Sullivan's visit to China (August 27-29)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests in the region have sufficient historical and legal basis, and that countries in the region have full confidence, wisdom and capability to properly handle the issue. statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Briefing on Jake Sullivan's visit to China (August 27-29)

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On top of the previous RMB100 million yuan of emergency humanitarian assistance, China will provide an additional RMB500 million yuan of assistance to help ease the humanitarian crisis in Gaza and support post-conflict reconstruction. We will donate U.S.$3 million to the U.N. Relief and Works Agency for Palestine Refugees in the Near East.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with UAE's Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The trend towards a multi-polar world is unstoppable. Multi-polarization in essence should mean mutual respect and peaceful coexistence among different civilizations, systems and paths.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with UAE's Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports countries in the region to continue to follow their development paths suited to their national conditions, firmly follow the path of unity and strength, peace and reconciliation, resolve differences through communication and consultation, and hold their future and destiny in their own hands.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with UAE's Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with the UAE and other Arab countries to host the second China-Arab States Summit and promote the building of a community of shared future between China and Arab states.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: High-level China-Russia think tank forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is in a period of turbulence and experiencing accelerating changes unseen in a century. The world now requires major powers to take responsibility, and China-Russia cooperation has become even more precious.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: High-level China-Russia think tank forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will remain committed to its original intentions, build on past achievements and forge ahead with Russia. The two sides should seek common development and rejuvenation through mutual support, achieve mutual benefits through opening-up and cooperation, strengthen public support through exchange and mutual learning, lead global governance with commitment, and participate in international affairs from a just position.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian President Sisi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Egypt in pursuing a development path that suits its national conditions and safeguarding its national sovereignty, security, and development interests.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian President Sisi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to strengthen coordination and cooperation with Egypt in multilateral mechanisms such as the United Nations, BRICS and Shanghai Cooperation Organization, work together to end the fighting in Gaza and ease the humanitarian crisis there as soon as possible, and make unremitting efforts for a comprehensive, just, and lasting settlement of the Palestinian issue.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Tunisian President Kais Saied
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Tunisia in actively exploring a development path with Tunisian characteristics and firmly opposes external interference in Tunisia's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Speech at event sponsored by Japan-China Society in Tokyo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question concerns China's sovereignty and territorial integrity and is a very serious matter, highly significant in the minds of the Chinese people. Neither the government nor the people in the Chinese mainland can afford to be ambiguous or take chances.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Speech at event sponsored by Japan-China Society in Tokyo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is firmly committed to achieving peaceful reunification. This is our ideal goal. However, if the forces advocating for 'Taiwan independence' do not give peaceful reunification a chance and insist on moving toward 'Taiwan independence', they will face a strong reaction from the Chinese people.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Speech at event sponsored by Japan-China Society in Tokyo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We believe these dialogues are beneficial. At the same time, we hope that the ultimate goal of these dialogues is to solve problems and promote the forward development of China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Speech at event sponsored by Japan-China Society in Tokyo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We call on Washington to adhere to its expressed sincerity, to match its words with actions.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Speech at event sponsored by Japan-China Society in Tokyo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As the region with the world's largest population and most vibrant economy, Asia has maintained relative stability. However, negative trends such as 'camp confrontation', 'small yards and high walls', and 'decoupling and breaking links' are quietly growing, casting a shadow over the grand vision of development and revitalization in Asia.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Speech at event sponsored by Japan-China Society in Tokyo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is an active advocate and faithful practitioner of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence. China's prosperity is the result of the hard work of the Chinese people. It has not and will not follow the old path of colonial plunder and the crooked path of a strong country seeking hegemony.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Kishida
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Maintaining stability in the Taiwan Strait is in the common interests of China and Japan. Japan should abide by the one-China principle, earnestly maintain the political foundation of Sino-Japanese relations, and properly handle sensitive issues such as the discharge of nuclear contaminated water into the sea.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Kishida
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Communist Party of China is willing to strengthen exchanges with all political parties in Japan to promote the improvement and development of Sino-Japanese relations. China is willing to work with Japan to realize mutual benefits and win-win results, and promote common development.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of the Communist Party of China (ILD)
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Foreign Minister Yōko Kamikawa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries, strengthen exchanges between political parties, promote the resumption of personnel exchanges at all levels and in all fields. The Japanese side should view China's development objectively and rationally, abide by the one-China principle, properly resolve the issue of nuclear contaminated water discharge into the sea, and remove obstacles to the development of China-Japan relations.

article_title: Public Security Conference - China-Egypt Joint Statement - What's Up with the Latest Warnings on Taiwan?

statements.speaker: Zhu Fenglian
statements.context: Regular press briefing on May 29, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If the U.S. side truly hopes for peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait, it should abide by the one-China principle and its commitments with China to oppose 'Taiwan independence' with concrete action.

statements.speaker: Zhu Fenglian
statements.context: Regular press briefing on May 29, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Lai's administration is begging external forces to support its 'independence' provocations and acting as a 'pawn' for external forces to contain China's development. Taiwan is China's Taiwan, Taiwan question is purely China's internal affairs and not subject to foreign interference.

statements.speaker_title: President and CPC Central Committee General Secretary

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Promoting high-quality and sufficient employment is the new positioning and mission of employment work in the new era. Must unswervingly implement the new development concept and prioritize high-quality and sufficient employment as a primary goal of economic and social development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, President of Equatorial Guinea
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Developing countries need to strengthen solidarity and cooperation more than ever. China is willing to work with Equatorial Guinea and other developing countries to carry forward the spirit of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, strengthen coordination and cooperation in international affairs, and safeguard the common interests of developing countries and international equity and justice.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo, President of Equatorial Guinea
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to hold a new FOCAC summit with Africa, further carry forward traditional friendship, deepen solidarity and cooperation, discuss future development and cooperation plans, and open a new chapter in building a China-Africa community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.context: Meeting with Puan Maharani, Speaker of Indonesia's House of Representatives
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Indonesia share broad common interests and should consolidate high-level strategic mutual trust and firmly support each other's core interests. China is ready to work with Indonesia and other ASEAN countries to strengthen multilateral coordination on the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative and Global Civilization Initiative, build a closer China-ASEAN community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Hussein Awad, Sudan's Foreign Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Sudan in safeguarding its national sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity, achieving domestic peace and stability, and exploring a development path suited to its own national conditions. China will continue to promote the international community to provide favorable external conditions for the settlement of the Sudan issue.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Shayea Mohsen Al-Zindani, Yemen's Minister of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports the sovereignty, independence, unity and territorial integrity of Yemen. The tense situation in the Red Sea is a prominent manifestation of the spillover from the Gaza conflict, and the urgent task is to promote an immediate ceasefire in Gaza. China calls for an end to the harassment of civilian vessels and to ensure the safety of waterways in the Red Sea.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on China-Arab States Cooperation Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since October last year, the Palestinian-Israeli conflict has erupted violently, causing large-scale civilian casualties and humanitarian crisis. China has always stood on the side of justice and righteousness. It has been pushing the international community to focus on ceasefire, civilian protection, expanded humanitarian assistance, and implementation of the 'two-state solution', aiming to achieve a comprehensive, just, and lasting solution to the Palestinian issue as soon as possible.
statements.topic: Middle East peace and Palestinian-Israeli conflict

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on China-Arab States Cooperation Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will establish strategic partnerships with more Arab countries, support each other in safeguarding core interests as always. China will continue to strengthen cooperation with Arab countries in regional and international affairs, determine its policy positions based on the merits of the matter, promote peace and stability in the Middle East, maintain international fairness and justice, and advance global governance in a direction that serves the interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Song Tao
statements.speaker_title: Director of the CPC Central Committee's International Department
statements.context: Meeting with KMT leader Hung Hsiu-chu in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation is irreversible and the reunification of the motherland will surely be realized. No matter how the situation on the island changes or who is in power, it cannot change the direction of cross-strait relations development and motherland reunification. Taiwan patriotic forces must adhere to the one-China principle, recognize the essence of 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces as 'harming Taiwan' and 'selling Taiwan', resolutely oppose provocations by the Taiwan region leader, and resolutely resist 'de-Sinicization'.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol in Seoul, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: South Korea should work with China to grasp the general direction of mutual trust between the two countries, respect each other's core interests and major concerns, be trustworthy neighbours and partners in achieving mutual success, and promote sound, stable, and practical development of China-South Korea relations.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol in Seoul, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Industrial and supply chains of China and South Korea are deeply intertwined. The two sides should resist the pan-politicization and pan-securitization of economic and trade issues, and maintain stable and smooth industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Kishida, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The issues of history and Taiwan are major issues of principle related to the political foundation of the Sino-Japanese relationship. The Taiwan issue is the core of China's core interests and a red line. Japan should keep its promise and create a positive atmosphere for continuous development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Kishida, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The development of China and Japan is an important opportunity for each other. Chinese and Japanese economies are closely intertwined. There is huge potential for cooperation in technological innovation, digital economy, green development, and third-party markets. Both sides should achieve mutual success and maintain stability and smoothness of industrial and supply chains and global free trade system.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Prime Minister Kishida, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The release of Fukushima nuclear-contaminated wastewater bears on the health of humanity and global marine environment. China hopes Japan will further demonstrate sincerity and constructive attitude toward long-term international monitoring arrangements and seriously address legitimate concerns at home and abroad.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Comments at 2024 National Science and Technology Week and Beijing Science and Technology Week, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Scientific researchers need to shoulder the mission and responsibility of achieving high-level scientific and technological self-reliance and strength. Scientists should integrate their personal ideals into the national mission and make contributions to Chinese-style modernization.

statements.speaker: Chen Wenqing
statements.speaker_title: Head of Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission
statements.context: Visit to Xinjiang from May 22-26, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xinjiang political and legal affairs agencies must maintain social stability as the top priority, firmly assume primary responsibility for counter-terrorism and stability maintenance, deepen long-term mechanisms, and firmly uphold the bottom line of security.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Symposium with businesses and academia in Jinan City, Shandong Province
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Reform is the driving force for development. To further comprehensively deepen reforms, we must anchor the overall goal of improving and developing the socialist system with Chinese characteristics and advancing the modernization of the national governance system and governance capabilities. We should closely adhere to the promotion of Chinese-style modernization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Symposium with businesses and academia in Jinan City, Shandong Province
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Reform involves both breaking down old structures and establishing new ones. No matter how and where reform goes, we must never waver on fundamental things such as upholding the overall leadership of the Party, adhering to Marxism, sticking to the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics, and upholding the people's democratic dictatorship.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to China-GCC Countries Forum on Industrial and Investment Cooperation in Xiamen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Deepening industrial and investment cooperation between China and GCC countries is conducive to better synergizing the Belt and Road Initiative with the development strategies, visions and plans of the GCC countries, tapping into complementary advantages, jointly fostering new growth engines, and promoting the prosperity and development of both sides. China is willing to work with the GCC countries to promote unity, pursue cooperation and write a new chapter in China-GCC relations.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Speech at China-GCC Countries Forum on Industrial and Investment Cooperation in Xiamen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the GCC countries are good brothers, friends and partners. The two sides are highly complementary in development advantages. The two sides should enhance synergy between the Belt and Road Initiative and the development strategies and visions of GCC countries. China will steadily expand institutional opening up and provide more space and convenience for enterprises from GCC countries to invest in China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Celso Amorim, special advisor to the president of Brazil
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world today is undergoing profound changes unseen in a century, with the international situation becoming chaotic and intertwined. It is heartening to see that 'Global South' countries represented by China and Brazil have achieved a collective rise and promoted a more balanced and reasonable structure of world power. China will fully support Brazil's work as the rotating presidency of the G20 this year.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Celso Amorim, special advisor to the president of Brazil
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China attaches importance to promoting cooperation with the Southern Common Market (Mercosur) and the Community of Latin American and Caribbean States (CELAC), and is willing to strengthen coordination with Brazil to push for greater development of relations between China and Latin American countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The joint drills of the PLA Eastern Theater Command are a necessary and legitimate move to safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity, crack down on 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces and their separatist moves and send a warning to external interference and provocation. Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory. We urge the US to stop conniving at or supporting 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces and stop meddling in China's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Each time 'Taiwan independence' separatists make waves, it garners stronger effort from China and the rest of the world to defend the one-China principle.

statements.speaker: Taiwan Affairs Office
statements.context: Official statement on PLA drills
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The drills are a resolute punishment for the Taiwan regional leader's provocative May 20 speech that sought 'independence.' It is also a stern warning to external forces that support 'Taiwan independence' and interfere in China's internal affairs, and a rightful move to safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Taiwan Affairs Office
statements.context: Official statement on PLA drills
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If the 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces insist on going their own way or even take risks, we will take decisive action to resolutely crush the 'Taiwan independence' separatist plot and resolutely defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Taiwan Affairs Office
statements.context: Official statement on PLA drills
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: All our countermeasures are aimed at 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities and interference from external forces, and are by no means aimed at the broad masses of Taiwan compatriots.

statements.speaker: PLA Eastern Theater Command
statements.context: Statement on Joint Sword-2024A exercises
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The drills focus on joint sea-air combat-readiness patrols, joint seizure of comprehensive battlefield control, and joint precision strikes on key targets. The drills serve as a strong punishment for the separatist acts of 'Taiwan independence' forces and a stern warning against interference and provocation by external forces.

statements.speaker: Dong Jun
statements.context: Meeting with Qatari defense minister Khalid bin Mohamed Al Attiyah in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called for efforts from both sides to enhance strategic mutual trust, expand areas of cooperation, and strengthen personnel exchanges to elevate military cooperation to a higher level.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.speaker_title: Head of the Central Financial Commission
statements.context: National conference of directors of local Party committees' financial commission offices, Beijing, May 21, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the Central Financial Work Conference, adhere to the centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee on financial work, and unswervingly follow the path of financial development with Chinese characteristics. Financial services must serve the real economy, do a good job in the 'five major financial tasks' (technology finance, green finance, inclusive finance, pension finance and digital finance), coordinate financial opening and security, and accelerate the construction of a modern financial system with Chinese characteristics.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Central Financial Commission
statements.context: National conference of directors of local Party committees' financial commission offices, Beijing, May 21, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to coordinate the strict prevention and control of intertwined risks such as real estate risks, local government debt risks, and risks of local small and medium-sized financial institutions, and severely crack down on illegal financial activities. Comprehensively strengthen the supervision of local financial organisations and coordinate the strengthening of supervision of small and medium-sized financial institutions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: SCO Foreign Ministers' meeting, Astana, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Currently, the once-in-a-century changes in the world are accelerating, and the international situation is undergoing a turbulent transformation. A few countries are pursuing hegemony and power politics, forming small circles, setting unofficial rules, engaging in interference and suppression, promoting 'decoupling and breaking of chains' and are even fanning the flames of the 'three evil forces' in the region. The aim is to suppress the strategic autonomy of the 'Global South' and block the path to revitalization for emerging markets and developing countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: SCO Foreign Ministers' meeting, Astana, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan issue is at the core of China's core interests, and 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities are the most destructive factor when it comes to maintaining peace across the Taiwan Strait. The outrageous behaviour of Lai Ching-te and others in betraying the nation and our ancestors is disgraceful. But regardless of how hard they try, nothing can stop China from finally achieving complete reunification; Taiwan will return to the embrace of the motherland. All 'Taiwan independence' separatists will be nailed to the pillar of shame in history.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, Astana, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides should prepare well for bilateral exchanges within the year, continue to strengthen mutual support, consolidate the foundation of cooperation, and safeguard the security and stability of the shared surrounding areas of China and Russia.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, Astana, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: I believe that Russia will continue to provide China with firm support on issues involving China's core interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Belarusian Foreign Minister Sergei Aleinik, Astana, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Belarus' firm adherence to the one-China principle and its valuable support for China on issues involving Xinjiang, Tibet, Hong Kong and other issues involving China's core interests. China also supports the Belarusian people in pursuing a development path of their own choosing, and opposes external forces interfering in Belarus' internal affairs and illegal unilateral sanctions by the United States and the West.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Bilateral meeting with Kyrgyz Foreign Minister Jeenbek Kulubaev, Astana, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Kyrgyzstan's adherence to the one-China principle and its immediate support for China's position after the election in Taiwan.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Antony Blinken congratulating Lai Ching-te, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What the US has done seriously violates the one-China principle and the three China-US joint communiqués, and breaches its political commitment to maintaining only cultural, commercial, and other unofficial relations with the Taiwan region. This sends a seriously wrong signal to 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces. China deplores and opposes it, and has made serious protests to the US.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Antony Blinken congratulating Lai Ching-te, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is at the very core of China's core interests and is the first red line that must not be crossed in China-US relations. China firmly opposes official interaction in any form between Taiwan and the US and opposes US interference in Taiwan affairs in any form or under any pretext. We urge the US to correct its wrongdoing at once, act on President Biden's commitment of not supporting 'Taiwan independence', 'two Chinas' or 'one China, one Taiwan' and not using Taiwan as a tool to contain China, stop fudging and hollowing out the one-China principle, stop emboldening and supporting 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces in any form.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press statement on foreign lawmakers congratulating Lai, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China strongly opposes official interaction of any form between China's Taiwan region and countries that have diplomatic relations with China. The wrongful words and actions of a handful of countries and political figures violate the one-China principle and basic norms governing international relations, constitute blatant interference in China's internal affairs, undermine the sovereignty and territorial integrity of China, and damage the peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press statement on foreign lawmakers congratulating Lai, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To use Taiwan to contain China is to play with fire and will definitely backfire. China will take all necessary measures to firmly safeguard its interests.

statements.speaker: Chen Binhua
statements.context: Official comment on Lai Ching-te's inauguration speech, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Lai Ching-te made a confession of 'Taiwan independence' in his speech. His speech was full of hostility, provocation, lies and deception. He is pedalling the 'two states theory' and pursuing 'Taiwan independence'. This indicates that from the very beginning of taking office, he is eagerly revealing the true intention of 'Taiwan independence'. This attitude is extremely risky and radical.

statements.speaker: Chen Binhua
statements.context: Official comment on Lai Ching-te's inauguration speech, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Lai Ching-te used 'self-determination of Taiwan residents' to hide his 'Taiwan independence' ambitions. His remarks about Taiwan being strategically positioned in the first island chain and being an important link in the global chain of democracies is nothing more than begging external forces to support and encourage 'independence' provocations and demonstrating a determination to act as a 'pawn' and 'vanguard' for external forces to contain China's development.

statements.speaker: Chen Binhua
statements.context: Official comment on Lai Ching-te's inauguration speech, May 22, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Compatriots on both sides of the Straits are Chinese and belong to the Chinese nation. We desire to achieve national reunification through peaceful means. However, in response to the Democratic Progressive Party authorities' collusion with external forces to provoke and seek independence, we must counteract and punish them. Lai's attempts to incite 'anti-China' sentiments and pursue 'independence' by force will only push Taiwan into a dangerous situation of military conflict.

article_title: Lashing out at Lai Ching-te - More Overcapacity Pushback - Wang Yi in Kazakhstan - Saudi Finance Minister Visits China

statements.speaker: Ding Weishun
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Director, Political Research Office of the Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Xinhua's China Economic Roundtable discussion
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To equate China's high export of new energy products with 'overcapacity' is illogical and contrary to common sense. Developed countries like the US, Europe and Japan have long exported large numbers of products globally. The US exports 80% of manufactured chips, Japan exports 50% of cars, and Germany exports nearly 80% of auto output. In contrast, China's NEV exports constitute only about 12.7% of total production.

statements.speaker: Qu Fengjie
statements.context: Xinhua's China Economic Roundtable discussion
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hyping China's new energy overcapacity is a clear double standard behaviour. The US is rehashing the same old story to create a new narrative trap targeting China. On one hand, it aims to lock China in the low-end of the industrial chain and curb the development of China's new energy industry; on the other hand, it makes excuses for trade protectionism.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Tajik Foreign Minister Sirojiddin Muhriddin, prior to SCO Foreign Ministers meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides will steadfastly safeguard regional security and stability. China and Tajikistan will enhance exchanges and consultations on counter-intervention, and collectively guard against 'color revolution'. China supports the establishment of a Shanghai Cooperation Organization anti-drug center in Dushanbe.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Kazakhstan Foreign Minister Murat Nurtleu
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to firmly support Kazakhstan in safeguarding its independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity. China's development represents a growing peaceful force in the world, enhances stability and strengthens the capabilities of developing countries and emerging economies.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Response to Lai Ching-te's inaugural speech, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The one-China principle is the solid anchor for peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait. There is only one China in the world, and Taiwan is part of China. This is a historical and legal fact. No matter how the situation in Taiwan changes, it cannot change this fact.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Response to Lai Ching-te's inaugural speech and international attendance, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Anyone who attempts to challenge the one-China principle will ultimately fail. Each time they stir up trouble, the international community's consensus on adhering to one-China is strengthened, and its understanding and support for China's position is enhanced.

We welcome quality French farm products and cosmetics, investment from French companies, and have expanded market access to telecom and medical services. We oppose de-risking approaches to economic and technological cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Signed article published in Le Figaro
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past 70-plus years since its founding, New China never provoked a war or occupied an inch of foreign land. China is the only major nuclear-weapon state committed to no-first-use of nuclear weapons.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Signed article published in Le Figaro
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China did not start the Ukraine crisis, nor is it a party to or participant in it. China has been playing a constructive role in striving for peaceful settlement. China has stressed that nuclear weapons must not be used and a nuclear war must not be fought. China has delivered humanitarian aid to Ukraine and sent its special representative to mediate.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Signed article published in Le Figaro
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China quoted Confucius on moral integrity being 'both friendly but independent, and who does not compromise his principles' and referenced Romain Rolland on the importance of thinking for oneself rather than being guided. This implicitly calls for France to maintain strategic autonomy rather than follow US policy on China.

statements.speaker: Zheng Jianbang
statements.context: Visit to Gambia for Organization of Islamic Cooperation meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China values relations with the OIC and Islamic countries as a whole, demonstrating strategic importance Beijing attaches to these relationships.

China must promote the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind and win strategic initiative amid increasingly fierce international competition.

statements.context: Official statement in People's Daily on Xi Jinping's upcoming visit to France, Serbia, and Hungary

The visit will be President Xi's second state visit to France after five years and take place during the 60th anniversary year of China-France diplomatic ties. China looks forward to working with France to carry forward good tradition, embrace the future, and further enhance political mutual trust, solidarity and cooperation, and jointly elevate comprehensive strategic partnership.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Official statement in People's Daily on Xi Jinping's visit to Serbia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To further deepen China-Serbia relations is in the fundamental and long-term interest of both countries and peoples, and conducive to upholding international justice and fairness and keeping the region and the world peaceful and stable. President Xi will hold talks with President Vučić for in-depth exchange of views on bilateral relations and international and regional issues. China looks forward to further cement iron-clad friendship, deepen political mutual trust and expand practical cooperation.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Official statement in People's Daily on Xi Jinping's visit to Hungary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hungary is an important country in Central and Eastern Europe and China's important partner in Belt and Road cooperation. This milestone visit will elevate bilateral relations to a new height, open a new chapter in China-Hungary friendship and cooperation, inject impetus to China-EU relations and provide elements of stability and positive energy to a turbulent world.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on Xi's upcoming European visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This is a major diplomatic move by China towards Europe. An interconnected and chaotic world needs China and Europe to work together as partners to jointly safeguard and practice true multilateralism and respond to global challenges. President Xi Jinping's visit will help China and the EU adhere to the correct positioning of the comprehensive strategic partnership, enhance understanding and mutual trust, and jointly provide greater stability for the world and more impetus for development.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on China-EU relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always regarded the EU as a strategic force in the international landscape, and has always regarded the development of China-EU relations as a priority direction of China's diplomacy. China's policy toward Europe will remain stable in the long term, and it will always regard Europe as an independent pole in a multi-polar world. China will insist that China-EU relations are not targeted at, not dependent on, and not controlled by any third party.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on China-EU relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Sino-French relations have always been at the forefront of China's relations with Western countries. Over the past 60 years, China and France have always adhered to independent strategic choices, and have always been committed to achieving common development through mutually beneficial cooperation, promoting mutual learning among civilizations through equal exchanges, and jointly responding to global challenges through multilateral coordination.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Argentina's Foreign Minister Diana Mondino reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks the 10th anniversary of the establishment of the comprehensive strategic partnership between the two countries. The development of bilateral ties serves the long-term interests of the two countries and meets the expectations of the two peoples. China is ready to continue working with Argentina, understand and support each other, be fellow partners in development, continuously enhance political mutual trust, push for steady and long-term practical cooperation, and deliver benefits to the two peoples.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Peru's Foreign Minister Javier Gonzalez-Olaechea Franco reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Peru to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, maintain the momentum of high-level exchanges, strengthen the synergy of development strategies, fully tap cooperation potential, pursue high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, and push for new progress in China-Peru relations. China supports Peru in its hosting of this year's Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) Economic Leaders' Meeting.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Peru's Foreign Minister Javier Gonzalez-Olaechea Franco reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Peru are good friends and partners who trust each other sincerely. China stands ready to work with Peru to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, carry forward the traditional friendship, promote high-quality and mutually beneficial cooperation with a high level of political mutual trust, and push the China-Peru comprehensive strategic partnership to a new level. China is willing to strengthen development-strategy synergy with Peru, complete negotiations on upgrading the China-Peru free trade agreement as soon as possible, expand practical cooperation in various fields, and aid Peru's industrialization process. China supports Peru in its hosting of this year's APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting.
