statements.context: Speech at meeting with representatives of young Chinese and Vietnamese and people who have contributed to China-Vietnam Friendship, Vietnam visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Our two Parties are both Marxist parties that bear in mind the overall interests of the world, and our two countries are both responsible members of the international community. And both of us should play a major role in advancing human progress. To build a community with a shared future for mankind is an inspiring goal, a goal that requires generations of efforts to achieve.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnam President Vo Van Thuong, Vietnam visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides must guard against and oppose any attempt to destabilize the Asia-Pacific, and at the same time strengthen coordination and collaboration on international affairs and jointly safeguard a sound external environment.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh, Vietnam visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides must guard against and oppose any attempt to destabilize the Asia-Pacific, and at the same time strengthen coordination and collaboration on international affairs and jointly safeguard a sound external environment.

article_title: Xi's Expectations from Vietnam Visit - Industrial System Advancements - Wang Talks to Iranian FM - Integrating Domestic & Foreign Trade - HK's Patriots Only Election

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Nhan Dan Newspaper of Vietnam
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has long been Vietnam's largest trading partner, and Vietnam is China's biggest trading partner in ASEAN and the fourth largest globally. China and Vietnam should align development, build a community with a shared future, maintain strategic communication, support each other on core interests, coordinate on development and security priorities including GDI, GSI and GCI, deepen exchanges on socialist development theory and practice, make use of complementary strengths through BRI and Two Corridors cooperation, step up friendly exchanges, and properly manage differences on maritime issues.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Nhan Dan Newspaper of Vietnam
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In today's world, changes on a scale unseen in a century are unfolding at an accelerated pace. Hegemonism, unilateralism and protectionism are on the rise. Peace and development in the region are confronted with fairly grave challenges of instability and uncertainty. Asia's future is in the hands of no one but Asians.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict can be summarized as realizing a cease-fire and ending the conflict as soon as possible, ensuring humanitarian relief, and returning to the two-state solution. China's position is consistent with that of Arab countries and is highly congruous with that of Islamic countries and the international community. Any arrangement concerning the future and destiny of Palestine should fully reflect the will of the Palestinian people, fully respect their right to statehood and self-determination. China is ready to strengthen communication and coordination with Arab and Islamic countries to gradually create conditions for returning to the two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Public statement/press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We regret and are disappointed at the US veto—the only veto on the Security Council draft resolution calling for an immediate humanitarian ceasefire.

statements.speaker: Hong Kong and Macao Affairs Office
statements.context: Article on the Seventh District Council Ordinary Election in Hong Kong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The HKSAR is reshaping the district council system and bringing the district councils back onto the right track stipulated in the Basic Law. The new district council system effectively prevents anti-China elements in Hong Kong from entering the district councils, decisively putting an end to the attempts by anti-China elements and external forces such as the United States and the West to seize governance rights in the HKSAR through elections.

article_title: China-EU Summit - New Measures for Shanghai FTZ Opening - Liu Jianchao's Iran Visit - China & Myanmar's Internal Strife - Cui Tiankai: US Needs More Diplomats Like Kissinger

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President of European Council Charles Michel and President of European Commission Ursula von der Leyen, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and EU are two major forces advancing multipolarity and two major markets supporting globalization. Amid turbulent international situation, China-EU relationship has strategic significance for global peace, stability and prosperity. The two sides should not view each other as rivals because systems differ, reduce cooperation because competition exists, or engage in confrontation because disagreements exist. China sees EU as key partner for economic-trade cooperation, preferred partner for scientific-technological cooperation, and trustworthy partner for industrial and supply chain cooperation.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Co-chairing 24th China-EU Summit, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is undergoing profound changes; we must find constants amid changes: persisting in dialogue and opposing confrontation, persisting in cooperation and opposing decoupling, persisting in peace and opposing conflict. China opposes violation of basic market economy norms and opposes politicizing economic-trade issues or overextending the concept of security. China hopes EU will carefully formulate restrictive economic-trade policies and use trade remedies prudently while maintaining trade and investment market openness.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chairing 8th Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers meeting with Myanmar's Deputy PM and Foreign Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will pursue principles of amity, sincerity, mutual benefit and inclusiveness to work with Mekong countries to jointly build a Lancang-Mekong community with shared future, jointly make the region an example for Belt and Road cooperation, a pacesetter for implementing Global Development Initiative, a pioneer for implementing Global Security Initiative and a front-runner for implementing Global Civilization Initiative.
statements.topic: regional diplomacy, Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Sok Chenda Sophea
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Cambodia and other countries to crack down on online gambling and transnational crimes, thoroughly eradicate relevant criminal gangs and safeguard social stability in regional countries.
statements.topic: law enforcement, regional security, transnational crime

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Myanmar's foreign minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation between China and Myanmar on combating telecom fraud in northern Myanmar has achieved remarkable results. The two sides should strengthen law enforcement and security cooperation, and thoroughly eradicate online gambling and telecom fraud.
statements.topic: law enforcement, transnational crime, regional security

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Angolan Foreign Minister Téte António, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to share development experience and market opportunities with Angola, expand practical cooperation on infrastructure, digital economy, clean energy, healthcare and food security, deepen people-to-people exchanges. China is willing to strengthen coordination on multilateral platforms with Angola, advance Forum on China-Africa Cooperation mechanism building, build closer China-Africa community with shared future, jointly safeguard legitimate rights and interests of developing countries, and promote development of international order in more just and reasonable direction.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Speech at Institute of Politics and International Studies of Iranian Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under strategic guidance of two heads of state, China and Iran have seen increasingly close exchanges at all levels. Currently China-Iran Comprehensive Cooperation Agreement is being implemented. China is willing to work with Iran to steadily promote practical cooperation in various fields, restore and expand people-to-people exchanges, enhance communication and coordination in international and regional affairs, continue to firmly support each other on core interests issues, uphold multilateralism and democratization of international relations, promote greater development in China-Iran relations, and safeguard international fairness, justice, and legitimate rights and interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes Iran's announcement of visa-free entry for Chinese tourists and inclusion of Iran in second batch of pilot countries for resumption of outbound group tourism. China hopes both sides will strengthen cultural exchanges, injecting new momentum into bilateral relations. China appreciates and supports Iran's efforts to improve relations with neighboring countries and play active role in Shanghai Cooperation Organization and BRICS cooperation mechanism. China is willing to work with Iran to continue to firmly support each other on core interests and major concerns issues, jointly oppose external interference, resist unilateralism, safeguard sovereignty, security, and development interests of China and Iran and uphold common interests of developing countries and international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of International Department of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Ali Akbar Ahmadian, Secretary of Iran's Supreme National Security Council
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Iran has special influence in regional affairs, and China supports Iran in playing its role in maintaining regional peace and stability. China is willing to work with Iran to practice true multilateralism, adhere to basic principles of global governance through consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, respect and uphold authority and status of United Nations, and safeguard international fairness, justice, and Asia's enduring security. China is willing to conduct exchanges and cooperation with Iran's Supreme National Security Council, implement consensus of two heads of state, communicate on diplomatic affairs and international and regional situation, adhere to comprehensive security perspective, and implement Global Security Initiative.
statements.topic: China-Iran security cooperation, multilateralism, regional affairs

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong co-chairing China-Singapore Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two sides agreed to promote high-quality Belt and Road cooperation, continue to expand and strengthen building of New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor, deepen cooperation in third-party markets, upgrade key cooperation projects, actively expand cooperation in digital economy and ocean energy, build pattern of diversified and interactive cultural and people-to-people exchanges, and jointly uphold multilateral trading system. Announced 24 outcomes of cooperation including protocol to further upgrade China-Singapore Free Trade Agreement and 30-day mutual visa exemption arrangement.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.context: Meeting with Luis Redondo, President of National Congress of Honduras
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Establishment of diplomatic ties between China and Honduras was major political decision of historic significance made by two heads of state and has opened new chapter in bilateral relations. China highly appreciates Honduras' firm adherence to one-China principle and firmly supports Honduras' efforts to safeguard national sovereignty and independence, promote development and improve people's well-being. China welcomes Honduras to join Belt and Road Initiative and is willing to accelerate synergy of development strategies and promote new achievements in practical cooperation. China appreciates Honduras' support for global initiatives China has put forward and hopes to strengthen coordination on multilateral occasions to promote building of community with shared future for humanity. Chinese NPC is willing to facilitate dialogue and exchanges with Honduran National Congress, consolidate political mutual trust, and work with Honduras to safeguard achievements of diplomatic ties. Legislatures of two countries should carry out duties fully, improve legal systems to create sound legal environment for investment, cooperation and personnel exchanges, and serve as bridge for exchanges between communities to consolidate popular support for bilateral relations. China is willing to increase exchanges with Honduras on governance experience and on developing economy and improving people's livelihoods.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on Xi Jinping's planned visit to Vietnam
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi Jinping will visit Vietnam on December 12 and 13. During visit, Xi will hold talks with General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong and State President Vo Van Thuong, and meet with Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh and Chairman of National Assembly Vuong Dinh Hue. Two sides will discuss upgrading China-Vietnam relations, focus on six major areas including politics, security, practical cooperation, public support, multilateral affairs and maritime issues, and work to deepen and substantiate comprehensive strategic cooperation between the two countries.

statements.speaker: Customs Tariff Commission of the State Council
statements.context: Official statement on tariff exemptions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Starting December 25, 98 percent of taxable products from Angola, Gambia, Democratic Republic of Congo, Madagascar, Mali and Mauritania will be exempt from tariffs when entering China. Commission planned to expand zero-tariff treatment to all least-developed countries that have diplomatic relations with Beijing. Tariff relief will enable countries to export to China without facing customs duties on over 8,000 different products or items.

statements.speaker: Cui Tian kai
statements.context: Article in People's Daily commemorating Henry Kissinger and his legacy for Sino-US ties
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Kissinger's diplomatic wisdom stemmed from his appreciation, understanding and respect for China and Chinese civilization. Because of his wisdom and knowledge, his discussions about China were free from some Western biases and superficial views. This is why he consistently earned respect of Chinese people and Chinese leaders. Kissinger understood world history and wanted a stable world order, which requires China and US to learn to coexist. The United States needs more diplomats like Kissinger, transcending ideological prejudice, taking responsible attitude towards history, people and world, and working with China to explore correct way for China and US to get along in new era, in order to promote healthy and stable development of Sino-US relations and benefit two countries and world.

article_title: Xi Seeks Adherence to Constitution - Xi-Lukashenko Meeting - China-EU Summit Preview - Imperial Springs Forum - He Weidong Visits Cambodia - Liu Jianchao Meets German & Croatian Delegations

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko in Beijing, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China always views its relations with Belarus from a strategic and long-term perspective, firmly supports Belarus in pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions, and opposes external interference in Belarus' internal affairs. China is willing to continue to strengthen strategic coordination with Belarus, firmly support each other, promote practical cooperation and deepen bilateral relations. China welcomes Belarus to continue its active participation in the Belt and Road Initiative and gain more tangible development opportunities from it.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to the 2023 Imperial Springs International Forum in Guangzhou, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing unprecedented changes in the world, the times, and history, human society must unite, uphold mutual learning, openness, inclusiveness and win-win cooperation, advocate common values of humanity, and jointly build a better world. It is hoped that all distinguished guests will brainstorm their ideas, speak out for the practice of real multilateralism, and contribute to the building of a community with a shared future for humanity.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at 2023 Imperial Springs International Forum in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Achieve peaceful coexistence on the premise of seeking common ground while shelving differences, seek integrated development in the process of equal exchanges, and make common progress on the basis of mutual learning. Under the guidance of the concept of a community with a shared future for mankind, parties should implement the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative, and advance high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. Make global governance fairer and more equitable on the basis of consultation and consensus. Oppose hegemonism, power politics, and unilateral practices in the name of multilateralism. Stick to the right direction of globalization, oppose protectionism and 'decoupling and severing industrial and supply chains', and make bigger the pie of mutually beneficial cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with envoys from EU member states in China, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the EU relations have shown a good momentum of recovery and steady progress under the strategic guidance of leaders from both sides. Leaders from the two sides will have in-depth exchange of strategic and global issues concerning China-EU relations at the upcoming 24th China-EU Summit. China-EU relations should follow three enlightenments: First, the two sides should adhere to mutual respect. Second, the two sides should stay calm and focus on pragmatic cooperation. Third, the two sides should view bilateral relations from a strategic perspective. China's policy towards EU remains stable and will not change due to any single incident, as it is in line with the trend of multipolarity in the world and greater democracy in international relations.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of International Liaison Department (ILD) of CPC
statements.context: Meeting with Croatian delegation led by Davorko Vidović, President of the Social Democrats, reported by ILD website
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Croatia to continue to deepen political mutual trust, intensify exchanges in various fields, and continuously enrich the connotation of China-Croatia comprehensive cooperative partnership. It is hoped that Croatia will continue to play a positive role in promoting greater development of cooperation between China and Central and Eastern European countries and China-EU relations. The Communist Party of China attaches great importance to the friendly relations with the Social Democratic Party of Croatia, and is willing to deepen the communication of ideas and exchanges of experience in state governance, promote exchanges between the youth, media, local governments, and people-to-people and cultural exchanges between the two countries, and promote pragmatic projects such as the joint construction of the Belt and Road Initiative.
statements.topic: diplomacy, party-to-party relations, Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of International Liaison Department (ILD) of CPC
statements.context: Meeting with German delegation led by Johann Wadephul, reported by ILD website
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Germany to implement the consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries and continuously enrich the connotation of China-Germany all-round strategic partnership. China and the EU are about to hold their first offline leaders' meeting since the pandemic. It is hoped that the meeting will enhance mutual understanding through dialogue, send a signal of cooperation, and demonstrate the independent value of China-EU relations. Germany plays an important role in the EU, and China is willing to strengthen exchanges with Germany on China-EU relations and promote the stability and long-term development of China-EU relations. The CDU/CSU coalition is an important political force in Germany, and the CPC and the coalition have maintained traditional friendly exchanges. China is willing to intensify high-level exchanges with the coalition, deepen exchanges and dialogues, increase trust and dispel doubts, build consensus, strengthen youth and local exchanges and cooperation.
statements.topic: Germany-China relations, EU-China relations, party-to-party relations

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.speaker_title: Vice Chairman of National Development and Reform Commission
statements.context: Meeting with Richard Haass, former president of the United States' Council on Foreign Relations, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with the United States to implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state at their San Francisco meeting, promote mutually beneficial cooperation in various fields of the economy and trade, and push bilateral relations in a sound, stable and sustainable direction. China will advance its opening-up steadfastly and at a high level, and enhance its liberalization and facilitation of trade and investment. China welcomes companies from all over the world, including the United States, to continue to invest and do business in China.

statements.speaker: He Weidong
statements.speaker_title: Vice Chairman of Central Military Commission
statements.context: Meeting with Cambodia's Prime Minister Hun Manet in Phnom Penh, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Cambodia are true steadfast friends, supporting each other in maintaining national stability and promoting prosperity and development. The two countries jointly safeguard international fairness and justice, setting an example for building a new type of international relations. Under the strategic guidance of the leaders of both countries, the exchanges and cooperation between the two militaries have always maintained a high level development. China is willing to work together with Cambodia to maintain communication at all levels, strengthen overall planning, build cooperative brands, and enhance multilateral cooperation. Continuous efforts will be made to consolidate and expand pragmatic cooperation in various fields, making new and greater contributions to jointly building a China-Cambodia community with a shared future in the new era.

article_title: Xi's Shanghai Inspection - Understanding China Conference - World Media Summit - Fu Hua on Xi Thought on Culture - Railways Fixed-Asset Investment to hit RMB 760 Bln

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee and President
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to the Understanding China conference held in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Today, confronted with a weak global recovery and escalating geopolitical conflicts, humanity has once again come to a crossroads in history. It is all the more important that countries work together to meet various global challenges, promote common development, and improve the well-being of humanity. To understand China, the key lies in understanding Chinese modernization. China is advancing the noble cause of building a great country and national rejuvenation on all fronts through a Chinese path to modernization, and promoting the building of a community with a shared future for mankind. China's future is closely linked with the future of the entire humanity. China is pursuing high-quality development through high-standard opening up and China will continue to foster a market-oriented, world-class business environment underpinned by a sound legal framework, and steadily expand institutional opening up with regard to rules, regulations, management and standards. China is committed to broadening the convergence of interests with other countries, and will continue to provide the world with new growth momentum and opportunities through its own development. China looks forward to working hand in hand with the rest of the world to realize global modernization that features peaceful development, mutually beneficial cooperation, and prosperity for all.
statements.topic: diplomacy, global development, US-China relations context

statements.speaker: Sun Weidong
statements.context: Speech at the Understanding China conference in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To understand major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics, one needs to understand the concept of building a community with a shared future for mankind. Building a community with a shared future for humanity is an inevitable choice for grasping historical trends and promoting human development. It is the embodiment of the Chinese Communist Party's broad-minded spirit and the value of China's excellent traditional culture. It is an open and inclusive ideological system that leads the times, and a firm action initiated by China partnering with the world. We welcome more friends to actively participate in understanding China, tell the true story of China to the world, and enable the world to better understand China.

statements.speaker: Hu Heping
statements.speaker_title: Executive Deputy Head of the Propaganda Department
statements.context: Speech at the World Media Summit held in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is hoped that media from all countries will adhere to fairness and justice, stay unbiased, uphold their responsibilities, strengthen cultural exchanges, promote mutual learning among civilizations, deepen practical cooperation, strive for mutual benefit and win-win results, and contribute wisdom and strength to promoting the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind and building a better world.

statements.speaker: Fu Hua
statements.context: Speech at the World Media Summit in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Media outlets should build consensus and boost confidence in development, uphold objectivity and truth to enhance media's credibility, and deepen exchanges and collaboration to contribute to building an open, inclusive, clean and beautiful world that enjoys lasting peace, universal security and common prosperity.

article_title: Xi on Yangtze River Delta's Development - China Mourns Kissinger - Messages from Liu Jianchao's Visit to Australia

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message of condolences to President Joe Biden over Henry Kissinger's death, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Kissinger was a world-renowned strategist and an old friend and good friend of the Chinese people. Half a century ago, with outstanding strategic vision, Kissinger made historic contributions to the normalization of China-U.S. relations, which has not only benefited the two countries, but also changed the world. China is ready to work with the United States to carry forward the cause of friendship between the two peoples and promote the sound and steady development of China-U.S. relations, so as to benefit the two peoples and make due contribution to world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Comments on Henry Kissinger's death, Page 2 of People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Dr. Henry Kissinger was a dear old friend of the Chinese people and a trail-blazer and contributor to China-US relations. He will be greatly missed and fondly remembered by the people of China for his personal commitment and extraordinary contribution to China-US relations. Both sides in China and the US need to carry forward Dr. Kissinger's strategic vision, political courage and diplomatic wisdom and, as President Xi and President Biden agreed in San Francisco, uphold the principle of mutual respect, peaceful co-existence and win-win cooperation and work to deliver a healthy, stable and sustainable China-US relationship.

statements.speaker: Wu Qian
statements.speaker_title: Spokesperson for the Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Statement on military-to-military relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese military stands ready to work with its United States counterpart to implement the consensuses reached by the two heads of state. According to the consensus reached between the two heads of state, the two countries will resume, on the basis of equality and respect, high-level communication between the two militaries, the China-U.S. Defense Policy Coordination Talks, and the China-U.S. Military Maritime Consultative Agreement meetings, and conduct telephone conversations between theater commanders.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of the International Department of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Speech at University of Technology Sydney during visit to Australia (November 27-30, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a beneficiary and defender of the current international order, and has no intention of establishing a so-called China-centred international order. China is willing to work with Australia to jointly safeguard peace and stability in the Asia-Pacific region and jointly address various global challenges including climate change.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of the International Department of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Speech at University of Technology Sydney and remarks to Australian officials
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The fundamentals of China's long-term economic growth have not changed and will not change. China will adhere to a high level of opening up to the outside world, share development opportunities and rights with other countries, including Australia, and continue to provide new impetus for world economic recovery and global development and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of the International Department of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Meeting with Australian Trade Minister Don Farrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic and trade relations are one of the core contents of China-Australia relations. China and Australia must jointly safeguard the multilateral trading system with the WTO at its core, oppose the pan-securitisation and pan-politicization of economic and trade issues, and oppose isolationism and protectionism under the pretext of 'de-risking'. China is willing to strengthen cooperation with Australia in various fields such as economy, trade, and tourism, welcomes Australian companies to continue investing and operating in China.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of the International Department of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Comments on the HMAS Toowoomba incident during visit to Australia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The encounter happened outside Japanese territorial waters and the Chinese warship caused no harm. We do urge the Australian government and also the military to act with great prudence in this area. Such a small incident could really escalate if it's not properly managed.

article_title: Xi's Agenda for Building a Legal System Related to Foreign Affairs & Global Governance

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at the 10th Politburo study session, People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The foreign-related rule of law is an important part of the socialist rule of law system with Chinese characteristics, related to comprehensive law-based governance and China's opening to the outside world and diplomatic work. The fundamental purpose is to use the rule of law to better safeguard national and people's interests, promote progress of international rule of law, and promote construction of a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at the 10th Politburo study session, People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to firmly safeguard the international order based on international law, actively participate in the formulation of international rules, and promote the rule of law in international relations. Actively participate in the reform and construction of the global governance system, promote global governance in a more just and reasonable direction, and promote global good governance with good international laws.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at the first China International Supply Chain Expo (CISCE) and the Global Supply Chain Innovation and Development Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Consolidating and strengthening cooperation in global industrial and supply chains is the interest and urgent expectation of all parties. The whole world will benefit when cooperation on global industrial and supply chains remains stable and continues to deepen; otherwise the globe will generally bear losses when cooperation is hindered and stagnates.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at the first China International Supply Chain Expo (CISCE) and the Global Supply Chain Innovation and Development Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with all parties to make global industrial and supply chains more resilient, efficient and dynamic, and make greater contributions to promoting global economic recovery, development and prosperity. China will continue to provide the world with high-quality made-in-China products and stable supply. China will promote high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and step up innovation cooperation in smart manufacturing and digital economy. China will stand against protectionism and various forms of 'decoupling and supply chain disruption', promote green and low-carbon transformation, and actively promote industrial and production capacity cooperation with other countries.
statements.topic: trade, supply chains, Belt and Road, economic cooperation

article_title: Politburo Meeting on Foreign Affairs - China-Kazakstan Ties - Boosting Finance for Private Sector - Countering De-risking with Supply Chain Expo - Viewing the World via Xi Thought on Diplomacy

statements.speaker: Politburo
statements.context: Politburo meeting on Monday, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The meeting emphasized regulations on CPC leadership over foreign affairs are of great significance to sound implementation of policies, principles and strategic plans made by the CPC Central Committee on foreign affairs. The meeting stressed the need to further strengthen centralized and unified leadership of the Party Central Committee over foreign affairs, expedite formation of comprehensive system of laws and regulations on foreign-related matters, and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy in all aspects of foreign affairs work.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Congratulatory message to Christopher Luxon on taking office as New Zealand Prime Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese government highly values China-New Zealand relations. He stands ready to work with the new government led by Luxon to maintain high-level exchanges, strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation and enhance friendly communication, so as to push for new progress in China-New Zealand comprehensive strategic partnership and greater benefits for their people.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Visit to Kazakhstan, meeting with Kazakh leadership and co-chairing China-Kazakhstan Cooperation Committee
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Kazakhstan cooperation enjoys solid foundation, huge potential and broad prospects. China stands ready to work with Kazakhstan to cement the foundation of mutual trust, strengthen the synergy of development strategies, enhance policy coordination and expand mutually beneficial cooperation. China is ready to work with Kazakhstan to promote the stable operation of China-Central Asia mechanisms to jointly maintain regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Spokesperson statement regarding Wang Yi chairing UN Security Council meeting on Palestinian-Israeli issue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China hopes that by holding the high-level meeting, all parties can promote in-depth exchanges and build consensus, take concrete actions and make due contribution to easing the humanitarian crisis in Gaza, realizing a ceasefire and cessation of fighting, protecting civilians and ultimately promoting a comprehensive, just and lasting solution to the Palestinian question through the two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Li Ming
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on China-Serbia BRI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In 2022, China became Serbia's largest source of foreign investment with total investment reaching 4.6 billion euros. The bilateral trade volume between China and Serbia has increased fourfold in the past 10 years. China has maintained its position as Serbia's second-largest trading partner for many consecutive years. Chinese acquisitions of Serbian industrial enterprises have revitalized century-old factories and mines and become Serbia's major export enterprises, making important contributions to promoting local economic development and improving people's livelihood.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Reuters report on first China International Supply Chain Promotion Expo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We are willing to build closer production and industrial supply chain partnerships with all countries. The international community needs to be more wary of the challenges and risks brought about by protectionism and uncontrolled globalisation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Research Center
statements.context: Theory article on Page 9 of People's Daily

China will continue to play constructive role in promoting political settlement.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)

China advocates win-win cooperation but has interests that must be safeguarded, principles that must be defended and bottom lines and red lines that must be adhered to. Only by adhering to mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit can dialogue and cooperation be stable and long-term.

China-EU cooperation outweighs competition and opportunities outnumber challenges. China hopes Ireland will continue to play a constructive role in promoting the development of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs

statements.speaker: Su Hui
statements.speaker_title: CPPCC National Committee Vice Chairman and Vice Chairman of the China Association for the Promotion of Peaceful Reunification

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cross-Strait reunification is the irresistible trend, the will of the people and the fundamental interests of the Chinese nation, and it cannot be stopped by anyone or any force. In the struggle against 'Taiwan independence' and for national reunification, compatriots in Hong Kong, Macao, Taiwan, and overseas Chinese have upheld the cause of national justice. Must fully understand the legitimacy and righteousness of opposing 'independence' and promoting reunification, accurately grasp the principled and flexible nature of the struggle against separatism and interference, comprehend the importance and urgency of fostering cross-Strait exchanges and cooperation, and unswervingly advance the great cause of national reunification.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng

Hong Kong should continue to retain its characteristics as an internationalised region and bolster its status in the global financial sector. Hong Kong needs to better integrate into China's overall development and make greater contributions to advancing national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization.

China pursues a win-win strategy of opening up.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at China International Import Expo

statements.context: Meeting with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese at China International Import Expo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the Asia-Pacific region, China does not engage in exclusive cliques, bloc politics, or camp confrontation. He urged vigilance against and opposition to those attempts to throw the region into chaos.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is strongly dissatisfied with and resolutely opposed to the decision of the U.S. Department of the Treasury to list some Chinese entities as 'Specially Designated Nationals' under so-called Russia-related excuses. The U.S. side should immediately cease its unreasonable suppression of Chinese companies.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The leaders of the two countries met in Bali, Indonesia, last year, charting the course for the improvement and development of bilateral relations. We have enhanced mutual understanding and taken a step forward to improve our relations every time we have met since then. He called on the two sides to focus more on the positive aspects, view each other in a rational, friendly, and inclusive way, pursue a proactive, pragmatic and objective policy, handle differences properly, expand cooperation, and ensure a sustained, healthy, and stable development of relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with former New Zealand Prime Minister John Key
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Mutual respect and mutually beneficial cooperation between China and New Zealand are fully in line with the interests of the country and people of New Zealand, and the sustained and steady development of bilateral relations had also injected stability into the region. China is willing to establish good working relations with the new government of New Zealand, strengthen high-level exchanges, jointly open a new chapter in the bilateral comprehensive strategic partnership.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to support and encourage sub-national and people-to-people exchanges with the United States, and also hopes that the United States will work with China to create favorable conditions and the atmosphere for sub-national and people-to-people exchanges and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

China and Canada need to strengthen coordination and cooperation to address climate change and other global challenges. China welcomes more Canadian companies to invest in China and share development opportunities.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

China is willing to strengthen international cooperation with Honduras and safeguard the legitimate interests of developing countries and international equity and justice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No responsible country with a conscience can allow the tragedy in Gaza to continue. China supports convening an international peace conference to push the Palestinian issue back to the two-state solution track. China will strengthen coordination with all parties, especially Arab countries, to de-escalate conflicts, protect civilians, and ease the humanitarian situation.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia

statements.context: Meeting with Defense Minister of Suriname Krishna Mathoera, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to strengthen strategic communication with Suriname and promote high-quality development of relations between the two militaries.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary on Beijing Xiangshan Forum, People's Daily Page 2, November 2, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly pursues an independent foreign policy of peace, decides positions according to merits, upholds basic norms of international relations and international fairness/justice. China strives for development while safeguarding world peace, actively engages in multilateral security cooperation and mediation diplomacy, makes unremitting efforts to promote political solutions to hot-spot issues, and exemplifies its role as a responsible major nation.

statements.speaker: Long Guoqiang
statements.speaker_title: Official at Development Research Center of the State Council
statements.context: Article on Belt and Road Initiative Forum, People's Daily Page 9, November 2, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly stands on the right side of history, adheres to the general direction of economic globalization, unequivocally advocates free trade and true multilateralism, opposes unilateralism and protectionism, and opposes the politicization, weaponization, and over-securitization of economic and trade issues.

statements.speaker: Long Guoqiang
statements.speaker_title: Official at Development Research Center of the State Council
statements.context: Article on Belt and Road Initiative Forum, People's Daily Page 9, November 2, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes all countries to take the 'free ride' of China's development, promotes the 'China Opportunity Theory', and strongly refutes the 'China Threat Theory', winning more friends and partners.

statements.speaker: Long Guoqiang
statements.speaker_title: Official at Development Research Center of the State Council
statements.context: Article on Belt and Ridge Initiative Forum, People's Daily Page 9, November 2, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will oppose protectionism, oppose 'building walls and erecting barriers' and 'decoupling and breaking chains', and oppose unilateral sanctions and extreme pressure. China will promote the liberalization and facilitation of trade and investment, adhere to openness, inclusiveness, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China always believes that the common interests of China and the United States outweigh their differences and disputes, that their respective success is an opportunity rather than a challenge to each other, and that the way for major countries to get along should be dialogue and cooperation rather than a zero-sum game. China holds that China-U.S. relations should return to the track of sound and steady development as soon as possible, so as to benefit both countries and the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The biggest threat to peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait is 'Taiwan independence', which is also the biggest challenge facing China-U.S. relations. This must be resolutely opposed and such efforts must be reflected in specific policies and actions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with President Biden
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should work to stabilize the China-U.S. relationship from further deterioration, and bring it back to the track of sound and stable development at an early date. The one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiqués, the most important political foundation of the bilateral relationship, must be earnestly maintained with efforts to steer clear of disruptions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with President Biden
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides need to take on the responsibilities to the world, history and people to truly stabilize and improve China-U.S. relations in line with the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation proposed by President Xi Jinping.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily Page 3 Commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There have been some positive signs in relations between the two countries. Both sides should adhere to the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily Page 3 Commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Adhering to mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation is China's consistent policy toward the US. China has always believed that the two countries should be partners rather than rivals, and that the relationship should be characterized by mutual benefit and win-win cooperation rather than a zero-sum game.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily Page 3 Commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The root cause for recent ups and downs in the relationship is the serious deviation in the US' perception of and positioning towards China. Some people in the US hold on to a Cold War mentality and are actually encircling, containing, and suppressing China in the name of competition. This approach will only push China and the US into confrontation and conflict.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily Page 3 Commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The One-China principle and the three China-US joint communiques are the most important political foundation for bilateral relations. They must be genuinely upheld and effectively safeguarded while eliminating any interference.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: 10th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese military looks forward to working together with all parties to deepen mutual trust in security, collectively enhance security frameworks, strengthen security governance, pragmatically advance security cooperation, and effectively implement and practice GDI, GSI and GCI, and work together to build a human security community.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: 10th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to adhere to win-win cooperation and harmonious coexistence in order to promote lasting peace, respect each other's sovereignty and territorial integrity, respect each other's core interests and major concerns, and persist in resolving differences through dialogue and consultation, not impose one's will on others, put one's own interests above others, base one's own security on the insecurity of others, and deliberately provoke other countries on major and sensitive issues.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: 10th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan issue is at the very core of China's core interests; the one-China principle is a universal consensus among the international community. Any attempt to sever Taiwan from China, no matter by whom or in what form, will be resolutely rejected and deterred by the Chinese armed forces.

statements.speaker: Zhang Youxia
statements.context: 10th Beijing Xiangshan Forum (per VOA report)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to develop military relations with the United States in the spirit of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: He Lei
statements.context: 10th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any Chinese use of force around Taiwan would be legitimate and just. Once the Chinese government is forced to use force to resolve the Taiwan question, it will be a war for reunification, a just and legitimate war supported and participated in by the Chinese people, and a war to crush foreign interference.

statements.speaker: He Lei
statements.context: Interview with CGTN
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States must resolutely correct any behaviour that interferes in China's internal affairs and undermines China's core interests, especially when it comes to the Taiwan issue and the South China Sea issue.

statements.speaker: He Weidong
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese Minister of National Defence General Phan Van Giang at 10th Beijing Xiangshan Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to make joint efforts with the Vietnamese side, maintain close friendly exchanges, and push forward the cooperation between the two militaries in various fields.

statements.speaker: Zhai Jun
statements.speaker_title: China's Special Envoy for Middle East Affairs
statements.context: Visit to Jordan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply concerned about the deteriorating situation in Gaza and the serious humanitarian crisis. The international community, especially the UN Security Council, should take action and take concrete measures to promote a ceasefire and an end to hostilities as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: 24th China-France Strategic Dialogue in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As independent major countries, China and France should shoulder their own responsibilities, take the consensus between the two heads of state as fundamental guidance, and adhere to mutual respect, win-win cooperation, exchanges and mutual learning, so as to build a comprehensive strategic partnership that is stable, mutually beneficial, enterprising and dynamic.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with California Governor Gavin Newsom in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States, as the world's two largest economies, account for more than a third of the global economy and nearly a quarter of the world's population, and bilateral trade accounts for about a fifth of the global total. The interests of both sides are closely intertwined. The achievements of China-U.S. relations have not come easily and should be cherished. China's policy toward the United States is consistent: mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation. China will continue to work in this direction and hopes that the United States will work with China in the same direction.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with California Governor Gavin Newsom in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The foundation of China-U.S. relations lies among the people, the hope is in the people, the future lies in the youth, and the vitality lies in sub-national areas. He highly values and supports exchanges across various sectors and sub-national cooperation between China and the United States. China and the United States enjoy great potential for cooperation in the fields of promoting green development and addressing climate change, which should become a new highlight in the development of China-U.S. ties.
statements.topic: US-China relations, people-to-people exchanges, climate cooperation

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with California Governor Gavin Newsom in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Newsom's visit to China can be described as an ice-breaking trip to consolidate the foundation, sow hope, and open up the future. Time and facts will prove that this visit is in line with the wishes of California people, the interests of the U.S. people, and the expectations of the international community. The interests of China and the United States are closely intertwined. It is hoped that California will continue to take the lead in sub-national cooperation between China and the United States and play a constructive role in promoting the United States to view China's development and revitalization in an objective and friendly way and return to a rational and pragmatic policy toward China.
statements.topic: US-China relations, sub-national diplomacy, people-to-people exchanges

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with California Governor Gavin Newsom in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation between Shanghai and California is a good example of sub-national exchanges between China and the United States, and has huge potential for future development. Expressed hope that Newsom's visit will inject positive energy into promoting bilateral exchanges and cooperation and improving China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.speaker_title: China's Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: UN Security Council vote on Palestinian-Israeli conflict resolution
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China voted against a United Nations Security Council resolution on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, saying it was 'introduced in haste' and does not address the crucial issue of a cease-fire. The draft resolution 'does not reflect the world's strongest calls for a cease-fire and an end to the fighting'. China is not opposing the council taking actions but opposes that the draft resolution is evasive on the most urgent issue of ending the hostility and has never been able to call for an immediate cease-fire in clear and unambiguous terms. At this moment, cease-fire is not just a diplomatic term; it means the life and death of many civilians. If a council resolution is ambiguous on the question of war and peace and of life and death, it is not only irresponsible, but also extremely dangerous. It is tantamount to paving the way for large-scale military actions and giving the green light to further escalation of war.
statements.topic: US policy, Middle East conflict, UN diplomacy

statements.speaker: People's Daily (editorial/commentary attributed to Huan Yu Ping)
statements.context: Commentary on Israel-Palestine conflict
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: While certain major powers have paid lip-service to the notion that the Security Council should take the right actions, their voting positions on relevant draft resolutions casts doubt on their true purpose. In recent years, individual major powers have further strengthened the tendency to take sides in the Israeli-Palestinian conflict. This has resulted in the gradual marginalization of the Palestinian issue, and United Nations resolutions have not been effectively implemented.
statements.topic: US policy, Middle East, UN diplomacy, international justice
statements.framing: accusatory, critical of major powers (implicitly US)

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message to symposium commemorating 10th anniversary of amity, sincerity, mutual benefit and inclusiveness principle in China's neighbourhood diplomacy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China attaches great importance to neighborhood diplomacy, always prioritizes the neighborhood on its diplomatic agenda, and remains committed to promoting regional peace, stability, development and prosperity. The neighborhood is where China survives and thrives and the foundation of its development and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message to symposium on neighborhood diplomacy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States should, on the basis of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, engage in sound interactions in the Asia-Pacific and contribute positive energy to regional stability and development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to annual Gala Dinner of the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, China is willing to work with the U.S. side to advance mutually beneficial cooperation, properly manage differences, and make joint efforts to meet global challenges, contribute to each other's progress and push for common prosperity so as to deliver benefits to both countries and the whole world.

statements.speaker: State Council (via Outlook on China's Foreign Policy on Its Neighborhood in the New Era document)
statements.context: Official policy document released after State Council meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cold War mentality is resurfacing; unilateralism, protectionism and hegemonism run rampant... Some countries have intensified efforts to build regional military alliances... There are two opposite propositions and trends concerning the future of Asia. One advocates open regionalism, true multilateralism, a development-first approach, mutually beneficial cooperation, openness and inclusiveness... The other represents a relapse into the Cold War mentality and exclusive clubs, and attempts to draw lines based on values, politicize economic issues, divide the region into different security blocs, and stoke division and confrontation.

statements.speaker: State Council (via Outlook on China's Foreign Policy on Its Neighborhood in the New Era document)
statements.context: Official policy document
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China rejects the Cold War mentality, unilateralism, group politics and bloc confrontation. China attaches importance to the legitimate security concerns of all countries, upholds the principle of indivisible security, seeks to build a balanced, effective and sustainable security architecture, and follows a new path to security that features dialogue over confrontation, partnership over alliance, and win-win over zero-sum.

statements.speaker: State Council (via Outlook on China's Foreign Policy on Its Neighborhood in the New Era document)
statements.context: Official policy document on neighborhood diplomacy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will resolutely take forward the endeavor of national reunification, firmly oppose 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities in any form, and firmly safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity. The more unequivocal we are on upholding the one-China principle and the more forceful our measures are to forestall separation, the greater possibility there is to ensure peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait and uphold peace and prosperity in the region.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments at symposium on neighborhood diplomacy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The key to Asia's future lies in handling its own affairs well. The key to Asia's revitalization lies in the united efforts of regional countries. China is comprehensively promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation with Chinese-style modernization, which will surely bring lasting dividends to countries around the world, especially its Asian neighbours, provide more opportunities, and inject inexhaustible power.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments at symposium on neighborhood diplomacy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang Yi put forward four suggestions: First, adhere to the principle of extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits, and build a BRI demonstration zone. Second, persist in seeking common development and create a pioneer area for GDI. Third, persist in working together and build an experimental zone for GSI. Fourth, adhere to Asian values and build a model zone for GCI.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Palestinian Foreign Minister Riyad Al-Maliki
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China deeply sympathizes with the Palestine people's plight, especially the people in Gaza. China strongly condemns and opposes all acts that harm civilians and violate international law, and calls for an immediate ceasefire to ensure the most basic survival needs of the people in the Gaza. The United Nations Security Council should earnestly shoulder its responsibilities, and the international community must take action right away. Countries outside the region, especially major countries, should take an objective and just position and play a constructive role in de-escalating the crisis.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Brief meeting with Kyrgyz President Japarov at airport in Bishkek
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Kyrgyzstan to fully implement the important consensus reached by the two heads of state, deepen political and strategic mutual trust, create more new highlights and new benchmarks for cooperation, and enrich the China-Kyrgyzstan friendship with more connotation of the times. The Chinese side looks forward to working with other SCO members to jointly carry forward the Shanghai Spirit, and inject new impetus into regional peace, stability and development.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Bhutanese Foreign Minister Tandi Dorji in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China always respects Bhutan's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and is willing to strengthen exchanges at all levels and in all fields, expand practical cooperation on the economy, trade, culture and tourism, and accelerate the boundary demarcation process and the establishment of diplomatic relations with Bhutan to bring more benefits to the two countries and the two peoples.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Speech at the 13th National Women's Congress in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Women's federations must be guided by Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics, adhere to the Party's overall leadership, strengthen ideological and political guidance for women, and mobilize women to contribute to the new era and Chinese-style modernization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Discussion with new leadership of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's labour movement developed under Party leadership. It is necessary to uphold the Party's overall leadership over trade unions and never waver. Must rely wholeheartedly on the working class and mobilize their enthusiasm to participate in the great cause of comprehensively promoting the construction of a strong country and national rejuvenation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Discussion with new leadership of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Party's leadership must be comprehensively upheld throughout trade union work. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Discussion with new leadership of the All-China Federation of Trade Unions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Trade unions must represent and defend workers' rights and interests, conscientiously perform basic duties of rights protection services, focus on solving practical problems related to workers' vital interests, and attach great importance to safeguarding legitimate rights and interests of workers in new forms of employment.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Written message to China's neighbourhood diplomacy conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the new era context, we will give new connotation to the concept of amity, sincerity, mutual benefit and inclusiveness, promote Asian values with peace, cooperation, tolerance and integration as the core. Chinese-style modernization will bring more benefits to neighbors. China will work with regional countries to build an Asian homeland of peace, prosperity and friendly coexistence and advance construction of a community with a shared future for Asia and mankind.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Message on 45th anniversary of China-Japan Treaty of Peace and Friendship
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Japan relations have made hard-won progress that has enhanced the well-being of both peoples and made contributions to regional and global peace, stability and prosperity. China is willing to work with Japan to relive the spirit of the treaty, stay the course in steering bilateral relations, and commit to building China-Japan relations suited to the requirements of the new era.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Reception marking 45th anniversary of China-Japan Treaty of Peace and Friendship
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In face of volatile and intertwined international situation, China-Japan relations stand at key crossroads. President Xi Jinping has pointed out that the significance of China-Japan relations has not changed and will not change. A stable and mutually beneficial Sino-Japanese relationship is vital to both countries, indispensable to Asia, and has important impact on the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Palestinian-Israeli conflict is escalating continuously and is at the risk of losing control. China opposes all acts that harm civilians, and condemns any violation of international law. China believes that safeguarding one's own security should not come at the cost of harming innocent civilians, that military options lead to nowhere, and that repaying violence with violence only creates vicious cycles. Currently, the immediate priorities are to seek a ceasefire and de-escalate tensions. The fundamental way out of the Palestinian issue lies in implementing the 'two-state solution' and establishing an independent State of Palestine. China calls for convening an international peace conference as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States have recently carried out a series of high-level contacts, and bilateral relations have shown a momentum of stemming the decline and stabilization. It is hoped that the United States will work together with China to implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state in Indonesia's Bali, overcome disturbances and remove obstacles, lengthen the positive list and shorten the negative list, truly respect China's core interests and major concerns, so as to bring bilateral ties back to the track of stable development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press briefing following China-EU High-level Strategic Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Palestine is now in a critical situation. The ongoing conflict has caused heavy civilian casualties. The humanitarian situation is rapidly deteriorating. China condemns all acts that harm civilians and opposes any violation of international law. The question of Palestine is at the heart of the Middle East issue and a wound that keeps being torn open in today's world. The root cause of this question lies in the long delay in realizing the dream of an independent State of Palestine and the failure to redress the historical injustice suffered by the Palestinian people. There is no shortage of injustices in the world, but the injustice to Palestine has dragged on for over half a century. On the question of Palestine, China will continue to stand on the side of peace, on the side of justice, on the side of international law, on the side of shared aspirations of the majority of countries in the world, and on the side of human conscience.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The right to self-defense should be exercised in accordance with international humanitarian law, and should not be at the cost of innocent civilian casualties. The parties concerned should exercise restraint, cease fire immediately and seek dialogue. The basic living conditions of the people in Gaza must be guaranteed, and humanitarian access must be opened as soon as possible. The Palestinian issue has always been the core of the Middle East issue. Without a just and reasonable settlement of this issue, there will be no lasting peace in the Middle East. The only way to solve the Palestinian issue is to ensure the effective implementation of UN Security Council resolutions and the true implementation of the two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The pressing task is to cool down the situation and prevent a serious humanitarian disaster in the Gaza Strip from causing more innocent civilian casualties. The exercise of the right to self-defense should comply with international law and international humanitarian law, including ensuring the safety of civilians and detainees. Countering violence with violence would only cause more damage and bring about more serious crises. China supports Islamic countries in strengthening unity and coordination and speaking with one voice on the Palestinian issue. The fundamental reason for the development of the Palestinian-Israeli situation today is that the Palestinian people's right to statehood has been put on hold for a long time, their right to existence has not been implemented for a long time, and their right to return has been ignored for a long time. This historical injustice should end as soon as possible. China will continue to stand on the side of peace and justice, and support the just cause of the Palestinian people.

statements.speaker: Zhai Jun
statements.speaker_title: Special Envoy on Middle East Issue
statements.context: Meeting with diplomatic envoys of Arab countries in China and head of Arab League representative office
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is saddened by the increasing tension between Palestine and Israel, which has caused numerous civilian casualties. The Chinese side opposes harming civilians and condemns practices that violate international law. It is imperative to maintain calm and restraint, protect civilians, and provide necessary conditions for alleviating the humanitarian crisis. The international community should earnestly enhance the sense of urgency to promote the solution for the Palestinian question, return to the correct basis of the two-state solution, and realize the peaceful coexistence of Palestine and Israel. China will continue to provide humanitarian assistance to the Palestinian side to help alleviate the humanitarian crisis facing the Palestinian people.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press conference on Israel-Palestine conflict
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The priority now is to immediately cease fire and protect civilians. The international community needs to play an effective role, work together to cool down the situation, and provide timely humanitarian assistance to the people of Palestine. To end the cycle of conflict between Palestine and Israel, the key is to return to the two-state solution as the basis, restore peace talks, establish an independent State of Palestine, and realize the peaceful coexistence of Palestine and Israel. China will continue to stay in contact with relevant parties to work for a ceasefire and stop of the violence, help ease the humanitarian crisis, actively promote peace talks, and work with countries in the region and the rest of the international community constructively for a comprehensive, just and lasting settlement of the Palestinian question.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press conference on Arab League meeting regarding Middle East
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We take note of the Arab League's emergency foreign ministers' meeting and resolution. We support the Arab League in playing an important role on the Palestinian question. China shares a similar position with Arab states on this question. Both sides call for an early end to the violence, condemn actions against civilians and believe it is essential to avoid further escalation of the situation which will lead to humanitarian disasters. We both believe that the international community needs to play an effective role, provide humanitarian support to the Palestinian people and work for the early resumption of the peace talks. The Palestinian-Israeli conflict keeps repeating for a fundamental reason: the Middle East peace process has been off the right track, the foundation of the two-state solution has been continuously eroded and relevant UN resolutions are not followed through in good faith. China stands ready to continue communication and coordination with the Arab League and others to actively bring parties to the table and keep working to bring the peace process in the Middle East back to the right track.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply saddened by the rising tension between the Palestinians and Israel and the huge civilian casualties. China opposes acts that harm civilians and condemns violations of international law. China calls on all parties to exercise restraint, de-escalate regional tensions as soon as possible and prevent further expansion of the conflict. The top priority is to ensure the safety of civilians, and open corridors for aid so as to avoid a serious humanitarian crisis in Gaza. The Palestinian issue is the core of the Middle East issue. The crux of the matter is that justice has not been done to the Palestinian people. This conflict once again proved in an extremely tragic manner that the way to solve the Palestinian issue lies in resuming genuine peace talks as soon as possible and realizing the legitimate rights of the Palestinian nation. China calls for a more authoritative and influential international peace conference as soon as possible to push the international community to reach a broader consensus based on the 'two-state solution' and formulate a timetable and road map for it. The United Nations has the responsibility and obligation to play its due role on the Palestinian issue. China supports the Security Council in holding an emergency meeting on the Palestinian-Israeli conflict, agrees to focus on humanitarian concerns, clearly calls for practical measures to a ceasefire, an end to violence, protection of civilians, and the formation of a binding international consensus. China is willing to maintain communication, coordination and close cooperation with Brazil and relevant parties in this regard.
statements.topic: Middle East conflict, diplomacy, international law
