As the world's two largest economies, China and the United States share far more common interests than differences and need to strengthen win-win cooperation on economy and trade, science and technology, as well as meeting the climate challenge. China has always viewed and handled its relations with the United States in accordance with the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo group study session on WTO reform

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo group study session on WTO reform
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To participate in the reform of the WTO, we must firmly safeguard the authority and effectiveness of the multilateral trading system with the WTO as the core, and actively promote the restoration of the normal operation of the WTO's dispute settlement mechanism. We must firmly stand on the right side of history, adhere to the general direction of economic globalization, take a clear-cut stand for free trade and true multilateralism, oppose unilateralism and protectionism, oppose politicization, weaponization and securitisation of economic and trade issues.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo group study session on WTO reform

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo group study session on WTO reform
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Reform and opening up has been an important magic weapon for China's modernization drive to continuously achieve new achievements. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo group study session on WTO reform

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Politburo group study session on WTO reform

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with US participants in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese economy is recovering and transitioning from high-speed growth to high-quality development. China pays great attention to the growth of economic volume and even greater attention to boosting the quality and efficiency of its economic growth. China will unswervingly pursue opening up at a high level, seek win-win cooperation with other countries and provide a constant driving force for world economic recovery and growth while offering mutually beneficial cooperation opportunities for investors worldwide.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

China will never practice hegemony and expand, and independence is the defining feature of China's diplomacy.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech to United Nations General Assembly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The legitimate security concerns of all countries should be addressed, the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries respected, and differences and disputes resolved in a peaceful way through dialogue and consultation. Nuclear war must not be fought and nuclear weapons must not be used.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech to United Nations General Assembly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Ukraine, ceasing hostilities and resuming peace talks are the only way to settle the crisis.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech to United Nations General Assembly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue supporting the just Palestinian cause of restoring lawful national rights, which is at the core of the Middle East issue.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will remain a developing country and a natural member of the Global South. China is firm in upholding the legitimate rights and interests of developing countries, supports and respects their efforts to independently choose their development paths based on their national conditions.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech to United Nations General Assembly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes politicization and double standards in human rights issues, particularly the use of human rights and democracy as a political tool to interfere in other countries. Developed countries should do more to reduce emissions and provide developing countries with financing, technology, and capacity-building support.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Reply to letter from Chairman of Sino-American Aviation Heritage Foundation Jeffrey Greene and Flying Tigers veterans, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the past, our two peoples fought the Japanese fascists together, and forged a deep friendship that withstood the test of blood and fire. In the future, the two major countries shoulder even more important responsibility for world peace, stability and development. We therefore should, and we must, respect each other, coexist in peace and pursue win-win cooperation. In growing China-U.S. relations, the hope lies in the people, the foundation lies among the people, and the future lies with the youth. A sound and steady development of the relationship in the new era requires the input and support of a new generation of Flying Tigers.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken at sidelines of UNGA, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A healthy and stable China-U.S. relationship is good for the two countries and the world. China's development is an opportunity rather than a challenge, a gain rather than a risk to the United States. The two sides may well contribute to each other's progress and achieve common prosperity. China maintains consistency and stability in its policy toward the United States, all following the three principles put forward by President Xi Jinping: mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation. China hopes the United States will work with China to meet each other halfway and follow through on the important consensus reached by the two heads of state in Bali. The two sides need to take practical actions, create favorable conditions and do more to enhance understanding, mutual trust and mutually beneficial cooperation, so as to bring China-U.S. relations back on a healthy and stable track.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Nikolai Patrushev, Secretary of the Security Council of the Russian Federation, for 18th round of strategic security consultations, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Russia relations have withstood the test of the vicissitudes of the international situation and continued to develop healthily and steadily. The connotation of the strategic cooperation between the two countries has been continuously enriched, and the quality of pragmatic cooperation has been continuously improved. As permanent members of the United Nations Security Council and responsible major countries, China and Russia work closely together on the international stage to jointly defend true multilateralism, oppose various practices of power bullying, and promote the development of the global governance system in a more fair and reasonable direction. The China-Russia strategic security consultation mechanism reflects the depth of political mutual trust and the breadth of strategic coordination between China and Russia. The two sides firmly support each other on issues involving each other's core interests. We are willing to work with Russia to further release the effectiveness of the mechanism and make greater contribution to safeguarding the national security of the two countries and promoting world peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaohong
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Public Security

statements.speaker: Mao Ning

With the world entering a period of turbulent change, China is committed to joining hands with all parties to build a community with a shared future for the Global South, encouraging developing countries to adhere to the original aspiration of independence, unity and self-reliance. China has always prioritized South-South cooperation. The Chinese approach is in line with the trend of the times and meets the common expectations of a broad range of developing countries for development and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Zhao highlighted the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative, stressing that China is willing to work with the UAE to promote cooperation on the three global initiatives and inject more positive energy into a turbulent world.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on China-US relations, Page 17
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, the US has consistently emphasised 'competition' when discussing China-US relations, as if competition has become the predominant and even exclusive theme in China-US relations. The many measures taken by the US fully demonstrate that the so-called 'competition' by the United States has become synonymous with comprehensive blockading, unrestricted containment, and suppression of China.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on China-US relations, Page 17
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As two major powers, it is normal for China and the US to compete in some fields such as economy, trade, science and technology. This kind of competition should be fair and reasonable, benign and rule-based, with red lines and forbidden areas. The US uses its state machinery to suppress other countries in the name of competition, seeking its own competitive advantage at the expense of other countries' interests or even blocking their development and progress. This completely deviates from the original meaning of competition and exposes a naked zero-sum Cold War mentality.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on China-US relations, Page 17
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has absolutely no intention to engage in reasonable competition. It engages in wielding the big stick of sanctions wantonly, pushing for 'decoupling and breaking chains' and the so-called 'de-risking'; out of ideological prejudice, generalising the concept of national security, imposing arbitrary controls and censorship, and building 'small yards and high walls'; concocting false narratives of 'democracy versus authoritarianism', forming cliques to create a 'containment circle' around China, forcing other countries to choose sides, inciting confrontation and undermining peace; continuous provocations on issues involving China's political system, territorial sovereignty and other core interests.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on China-US relations, Page 17
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US uses whatever it can to make things difficult for China, but the essence of its policy is to deprive the Chinese people the right to choose their own development path, deprive the people of China of their right to pursue a better life, deprive China of its right to legitimate development, deprive China of its right to achieve national reunification, and deprive China of its right to develop normal relations with other countries.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on China-US relations, Page 17
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US treating competition as the entirety of its relations with China is fundamentally rooted in a directional issue in the US' perception of China. The US consistently portrays China as the 'most serious competitor', 'most significant long-term challenge', 'most significant geopolitical challenge', 'most significant systemic challenge', and 'the only competitor with the intent and ability to reshape the international order'. This perception is a product of mirror-imaging and viewing China through the lens of America's own history of a strong nation seeking hegemony.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on China-US relations, Page 17
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States shoulder special responsibilities for global peace, stability, prosperity and development, and the world needs overall stable Sino-US relations. The US should abandon the zero-sum games and the Cold War mentality, break free from the logic of competition and confrontation, and approach China with a sense of responsibility toward history, the people, and the world to achieve mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Communist Party of China is willing to strengthen exchanges of experience in state governance with political parties and political organisations from various countries, jointly promote modernization in which man and nature coexist harmoniously, and jointly build a community of life on earth and a clean and beautiful world.

statements.speaker: Li Ganjie
statements.context: Speech at 9th Singapore-China Forum on Leadership
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese-style modernization is socialist modernization led by the Communist Party of China, and the Party's leadership is directly related to the fundamental direction, future and destiny, and ultimate success or failure of Chinese-style modernization. Focus on strengthening the Party's political leadership, firmly support the Two Establishments and resolutely achieve the Two Safeguards to ensure that Chinese-style modernization always advances smoothly along the right track.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At the recent East Asia Summit, the US once again created trouble around the South China Sea issue in an attempt to sow discord between relevant countries and China. The US has repeatedly violated the will of regional countries and attempted to stir up trouble in the South China Sea, further exposing the true face of its so-called 'Indo-Pacific Strategy' in creating division and confrontation in the region.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has never provided evidence to show which country's ships or aircraft have encountered problems while sailing or overflying in the South China Sea. In the name of safeguarding 'freedom of navigation and overflight', US warships and aircraft are showing off their power and militarization in the South China Sea. This is the real threat to the peace and stability of the South China Sea.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called South China Sea arbitration award seriously violates international law, including the United Nations Convention on the Law of the Sea, and is illegal and invalid. China does not accept or recognize this ruling, nor does it accept any claims or actions based on it. China's stance is a legitimate measure to uphold the authority and integrity of the UNCLOS.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US itself has not joined UNCLOS, but it has repeatedly cited the UNCLOS, which exposes its hypocritical nature. With regard to the so-called South China Sea arbitration case, the US was the initiator and the behind-the-scenes manipulator, and has since repeatedly exaggerated and hyped up the relevant illegal award, which fully demonstrates its intention to politicize, weaponize, and instrumentalize international law.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to the path of peaceful development. As a party to the UNCLOS, China has been working with ASEAN countries to properly handle the South China Sea issue on the basis of mutual respect in accordance with international law, including UNCLOS, and taking into account the actual conditions in the region.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: While China and ASEAN countries are working on a Code of Conduct, the US, as an extra-regional actor, is looking to stir trouble, drive a wedge between regional countries and China, disrupt and undermine the efforts of China and ASEAN countries to maintain peace and stability in the South China Sea, and serve its strategic attempt to blockade, suppress and contain China.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US approach violates the basic norms of international relations, goes against the will of the people in the region and the trend of cooperation, and is destined to fail. The US deliberately deviated from the theme of the meeting and undermined the atmosphere of cooperation. It is a natural result that no one agreed.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US made a high-profile claim that the defence chiefs of the US and Indonesia issued a joint statement criticising China's South China Sea claims. However, the Indonesian side quickly debunked the lies of the US side, saying that the news released by the US side was inconsistent with the facts. The US engages in diplomacy based on lies and provocation, only to bring disgrace upon itself.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on international page regarding East Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has repeatedly hyped up the South China Sea issue, attempting to artificially create divisions and confrontations and coerce and induce regional countries to choose sides. The US should listen carefully to the voices of countries in the region and fully realise that any actions aimed at maintaining hegemonic interests by creating divisions and conflicts will not gain traction in the Asia-Pacific region.

article_title: Wang Huning on Opposing Taiwan 'Independence' - NPC's Supervision of Gov't Debt - He Lifeng Meets Myron Brilliant - Zhong Sheng: 'Tech Iron Curtain & Small Yard, High Wall Cannot Sustain US Hegemony'

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of China Council for the Promotion of Peaceful National Reunification
statements.context: Speech at meeting of China Council for the Promotion of Peaceful National Reunification
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Party's overall strategy for resolving the Taiwan issue in the new era must be fully, accurately and comprehensively implemented. We must persist in being brave in the struggle and skilled in the struggle, shoulder the responsibility and mission of fighting against the 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces and external interference forces, and firmly maintain confidence and determination in opposing separatism and promoting reunification.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Inter-Parliamentary Union President Duarte Pacheco in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes the IPU to play a greater role in international affairs. The NPC of China supports the IPU in exerting its influence further, in upholding and practicing true multilateralism, in adhering to the principles of extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits. China appreciates the IPU's long-standing impartial position on issues concerning China's core interests and major concerns.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Statement about Cambodia's new Prime Minister Hun Manet's upcoming visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China hopes to, through this visit, chart the course for the comprehensive strategic cooperation between the two countries in the next stage. In particular, we hope to deliver on the cooperation initiatives such as the 'industrial development corridor' and the 'fish and rice corridor' at an early date, and jointly usher in a new era of building a high-quality, high-level and high-standard China-Cambodia Community with a Shared Future.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is attempting to block China's technological advancement path through 'technological decoupling' and hinder China's development and progress. This approach overestimates its own capabilities, but underestimates China's determination to achieve scientific and technological innovation. American sanctions cannot stop China's technological progress. The 'science and technology iron curtain' and 'small yard, high wall' policy cannot sustain America's technological hegemony and those who undermine global scientific and technological cooperation and industrial and supply chains will only suffer the consequences.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, under the guise of safeguarding national security, the US government has successively introduced restrictive measures against China in order to suppress China's development in the field of science and technology. The scope of regulatory measures keeps expanding, and the degree of control is tightening. More than 1,300 Chinese enterprises, institutions, and individual have been included in various sanction lists. The real purpose of the US is to block China's technological advancement path through 'technological decoupling' and hinder China's development and progress.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not shy away from competition, nor is it afraid of competition, but it believes that competition should contribute to mutual promotion and common improvement. China resolutely opposes blockading, containment and suppression under the pretext of competition. No one can deprive the Chinese people of their legitimate right to development.

article_title: Li warns against 'Small Circles' at East Asia Summit - Xi Thought & Education - Wang Yi to Australia: See China as 'Opportunity rather than a Threat' - NPC's Legislative Agenda

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at the 18th East Asia Summit in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: East Asia has a hundred reasons to uphold cooperation and integration, and not a single reason to move towards division and confrontation. We need to give higher priority to promoting growth and channel greater wisdom and effort into cooperation for development. We must adhere to economic globalization, continue to promote the construction of the Asia-Pacific Free Trade Area, oppose protectionism and unilateralism, and maintain the stability and smooth flow of industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at the 18th East Asia Summit in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China resolutely opposes 'discarding the original and starting anew' or the formation of 'small circles' and does not want to see regional countries forced to choose sides at the expense of their own interests. There are no winners in camp confrontation; mutual and beneficial cooperation is the aspiration of the people and the overall trend.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at the 18th East Asia Summit in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is hoped that countries outside the region will fully respect the efforts made by countries in the region to negotiate the rules of the South China Sea and maintain peace and stability in the South China Sea, and play a positive and constructive role in this regard.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A sound and stable China-Australia relationship serves the fundamental interests and common aspirations of the two peoples. China is ready to work with Australia to restart and resume bilateral exchanges in various fields. China will continue to advance high-level opening-up, providing a bigger market for Australia and other countries. The two sides should properly handle divergences in the spirit of mutual respect, seeking common ground while shelving differences as well as mutual benefit and win-win results.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Australia to jointly safeguard peace and stability of the Asia-Pacific region.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with South Korean President Yoon Suk-yeol
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with South Korea to resist interference, meet each other halfway, and advance bilateral relations so as to reflect the changes of the times. The two sides should adhere to the general direction of good-neighborliness and friendship, continue to deepen exchanges and cooperation in various fields, and work together to cope with difficulties and challenges.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world should jointly resist the practice of overstretching the concept of security and politicizing economic issues. The current international landscape is marked by change and disorder, and the grimmer the situation is, the more the international community needs to unite and work together to meet the challenges.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international community should adopt the vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security, and uphold the philosophy of open and inclusive development. It is important to step up the reform of the global economic governance system and effectively increase the representation and voice of developing countries in international financial institutions.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to firmly support the UN in playing a central role in international affairs, and is ready to work with the UN to promote the building of a community with a shared future for mankind. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the vision of building a community with a shared future for mankind and the Belt and Road Initiative, proposed by President Xi Jinping. The Chinese president has successively put forward the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative, and the Global Civilization Initiative, providing Chinese solutions for global development and governance.
statements.topic: multilateralism, international cooperation, China's global initiatives

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Venezuelan Vice President Delcy Eloina Rodriguez Gomez
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Venezuela have forged an unbreakable, ironclad friendship, and China firmly supports Venezuela in safeguarding its national independence and national dignity. It is an inevitable historical trend for developing countries to stride forward into the international arena. China will continue to stand firm with other developing countries and be their reliable partner for development and prosperity.
statements.topic: bilateral relations, South-South cooperation, international development

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-Australia High-Level Dialogue seventh session in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China maintains continuity and stability in its policy towards Australia and will continue to adhere to the important position of the comprehensive strategic partnership between China and Australia. The economies of the two countries are highly complementary, the people of the two countries are friendly to each other, and there are no disputes left over from history or major conflicts of interests between the two countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-Australia High-Level Dialogue seventh session in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The twists and turns in the past few years cannot define the nature of our bilateral relations, still less can they stop the pace of China-Australia cooperation. Looking back at the past and looking forward to the future, if we look at bilateral relations with a 100-year horizon, bilateral relations can weather difficulties. It is necessary for the two sides to draw useful experience and lessons from the setbacks in bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-Australia High-Level Dialogue seventh session in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Australia should remain partners rather than rivals. Australia should recognize China's development as an opportunity rather than a threat. We need to advance China-Australia relations independently and without any influence or interference from any third party.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Press conference response to Japan's WTO submission regarding suspension of imports
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China took the emergency trade measures in accordance with Chinese laws and regulations as well as WTO rules. China has repeatedly made clear its solemn position on the issue of Japan's discharge of the Fukushima nuclear-contaminated water into the sea. China has always upheld the multilateral trading system with the WTO at its core, and has always abided by WTO rules. Japan should reflect upon its actions and immediately stop transferring the risks of nuclear contamination to the world.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Press conference regarding the third Belt and Road Initiative Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Representatives from more than 90 countries have confirmed that they will attend the Forum. Among them are official representatives such as leaders and ministers of Belt and Road partner countries, as well as people representing the business community, think tanks and civil societies who have actively supported and participated in Belt and Road cooperation. Many heads and representatives from international organizations have also confirmed their attendance.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, international cooperation

statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Letter to John Easterbrook, grandson of former American General Joseph Stilwell, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: From the Stilwell family, I felt the goodwill of the American people towards the Chinese people. General Stilwell was an old friend of the Chinese people who gave active support to China's cause of liberation and progress. China and the United States fought side by side against Japanese fascists and for world peace; looking into the future, the two countries have every reason to help each other achieve success and common prosperity. The foundation of China-U.S. relations lies in the people and the source of strength lies in the friendship between their peoples. The two peoples should strengthen exchanges, enhance understanding and expand cooperation to continuously inject new impetus into the development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with South Korean Foreign Minister Park Jin, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's policy toward South Korea has maintained continuity and stability. The development of bilateral relations has an internal driving force and inevitable logic, and should not be influenced by a third party. China and South Korea should stick to the original intention of establishing diplomatic ties, stick to the right direction of friendly cooperation, continue to enhance mutual understanding between the two peoples, guard against interference from external factors, refrain from ideological confrontations.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has signed Belt and Road cooperation documents with more than 150 countries and over 30 international organizations. By 2030, BRI transport infrastructure, if fully implemented, is expected to increase global real income by 0.7 to 2.9 percent, lifting 7.6 million people from extreme poverty and 32 million people from moderate poverty.

statements.speaker_title: Chairperson of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: NPC Standing Committee meeting on national food security
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th Party Congress, the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping at the core has attached great importance to national food security, consistently considering solving the problem of feeding over one billion people as the top priority in governance, and has forged a path of food security with Chinese characteristics

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.speaker_title: Vice Premier of the State Council
statements.context: Speech at China Council for International Cooperation on Environment and Development (CCICED)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th Party Congress, the leadership has regarded ecological civilization construction as a fundamental task for ensuring the sustainable development of the Chinese nation, and has carried out pioneering work with unprecedented determination, intensity, and results

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Meeting with British Foreign Secretary James Cleverly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the UK have established diplomatic relations at the ambassadorial level for more than half a century and achieved positive results in practical cooperation in various fields. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with British Foreign Secretary James Cleverly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always attached importance to the UK's status as a great power and its unique role, committed itself to stable and mutually beneficial China-UK relations, and always believed that China-UK cooperation has global influence. Amid the volatile international situation, China and the UK should show their responsibilities as major countries to work together to cope with global challenges and safeguard world peace and stability, and push China-UK relations forward rather than backward

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with British Foreign Secretary James Cleverly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan independence is incompatible with the stability across the Taiwan Strait, and the UK should earnestly respect China's core interests and abide by the one-China policy

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with speaker of the Arab Parliament Adel Al Asoomi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Arab countries to firmly support each other, deepen pragmatic cooperation, and enhance exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations. statements.speaker: Ren Hongyan
statements.speaker_title: Official from China's Permanent Mission to the United Nations

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current international security environment is undergoing the most profound changes since the Cold War. The international arms control, disarmament and non-proliferation system is facing unprecedented severe challenges, and the risks of nuclear arms race and nuclear conflict are constantly rising. It is necessary to firmly practice true multilateralism, safeguard international multilateral disarmament mechanisms, advocate a common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security concept, resolutely resist the Cold mentality and camp confrontation

statements.speaker: Song Tao
statements.speaker_title: Head of Taiwan Work Office of the Central Committee and Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council
statements.context: Meeting with Andrew Hsia, vice chairman of the KMT in Yuncheng, Shanxi Province
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: General Secretary Xi Jinping pointed out that the peaceful development of cross-strait relations is the correct path to maintain cross-strait peace, promote common development, and benefit compatriots on both sides of the strait. Taiwan independence separatist forces are colluding with external forces to take provocative actions of independence, harming the interests of Taiwan compatriots and undermining peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. Taiwan is faced with a major choice between peace and war, and between prosperity and recession. statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic and trade relations between China and the United States are mutually beneficial and win-win in nature. Politicizing economic and trade issues and overstretching the concept of security will not only seriously affect bilateral relations and mutual trust, but also undermine the interests of enterprises and people of the two countries, and will have a disastrous impact on the global economy.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is the largest developing country and the United States is the largest developed country. The two sides should strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation, reduce friction and confrontation, and jointly promote world economic recovery and cope with global challenges. A sound and stable China-U.S. relationship benefits both countries and the world. Mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation are the right ways for China and the United States to get along.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to strengthen dialogue and cooperation with the United States on the economy and trade. China is actively advancing its high-level opening-up and making efforts to provide a world-class, market-oriented business environment governed by a sound legal framework. The country is also working to ease market access further, treat foreign companies in the same manner as domestic firms, and safeguard and promote fair competition. China will only open its doors even wider to the outside world.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting regarding vaccine alliance, reported by People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should uphold the principles of objectivity, fairness, and professionalism and oppose politicizing and stigmatizing pandemic prevention and control and origins tracing issues.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides had candid, pragmatic and constructive discussions over implementing the important consensus reached at the Bali meeting between the two countries' heads of state, as well as economic and trade issues of common concern. The Chinese side expressed its concerns over measures taken by the United States, such as Section 301 tariffs, export controls against China and two-way investment restrictions.

statements.speaker: Hu Heping
statements.context: Meeting with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's Ministry of Culture and Tourism is willing to work with the U.S. Department of Commerce to boost people-to-people and cultural exchanges and increase mutual visits. China hopes the U.S. will further increase direct flights between the two countries, adjust its travel advice for Chinese trips as soon as possible, and make it easier for Chinese citizens to apply for U.S. visas.

statements.speaker: Hu Heping
statements.context: Meeting with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China urges the U.S. side to stop groundless interrogation and harassment of Chinese citizens and delegations visiting the United States and create better conditions for mutual tourist visits.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Culture and Tourism
statements.context: Official announcement reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States have agreed to hold the 14th China-U.S. Tourism Leadership Summit in the first half of 2024 in China to further revive and develop tourism cooperation between the two countries.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on BRICS expansion during 15th BRICS summit

It will promote multi-polarity in the world and greater democracy in international relations, contribute to making global political and economic governance more just and equitable. BRICS advocates openness, inclusiveness and win-win cooperation, not bloc confrontation. The expansion is fundamentally different from small circles or exclusive blocs.

statements.speaker: Wang Wentao
statements.context: Talks with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, official statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic and trade relations are the cornerstone of China-U.S. relations. Trade between the two countries is important for their respective economies and the global economy. China is willing to work together with the United States to create a favorable policy environment for cooperation between business sectors and promote bilateral trade and investment while upholding principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Wentao
statements.context: Talks with US Commerce Secretary Gina Raimondo, official statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Raised serious concerns about U.S. Section 301 tariffs on Chinese goods, semiconductor policies, restrictions on two-way investment, discriminatory subsidies, and sanctions on Chinese enterprises. The U.S. should match its words with actions on not seeking decoupling with China.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily editorial commentary on Camp David summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Camp David meeting between US, Japan and South Korea smeared China on Taiwan and South China Sea issues, grossly interfered in China's internal affairs, deliberately sowed discord between China and neighboring countries, and violated basic norms of international relations. statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily editorial commentary on Camp David summit

China insists on striving for peaceful reunification with the utmost sincerity but will never accept anyone interfering in China's internal affairs. The biggest threat to Taiwan's peace is separatist 'Taiwan independence' activities and external forces' connivance and support. The US, Japan and South Korea talking about peace in the Taiwan Strait without opposing 'Taiwan independence' is essentially conniving with and supporting 'Taiwan independence' forces.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily editorial commentary on Camp David summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's territorial sovereignty and maritime rights in the South China Sea have sufficient historical and legal basis. The US is a disruptor and destabilizer in the South China Sea.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily editorial commentary on Camp David summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is attempting to create a closed and exclusive 'small circle' in the Asia-Pacific, counter to strengthening unity and cooperation among regional countries. The US has not let go of hegemonic obsession and is addicted to group politics and camp confrontation.
statements.topic: US Indo-Pacific strategy, regional bloc-building, hegemony

statements.speaker: Wu Jianghao
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Vice Foreign Minister Masataka Okano, official statement via Xinhua

Japan should immediately stop its wrongdoing, communicate honestly with neighboring countries in a truly responsible manner, and adopt a scientific, safe and transparent way to dispose of nuclear-polluted water.
statements.topic: Fukushima nuclear wastewater discharge, environmental and health concerns

statements.speaker: Wu Jianghao
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Vice Foreign Minister Masataka Okano, official statement via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China lodges solemn representations about nuisance suffered by Chinese embassy and consulates in Japan. The Chinese embassy and consulates have received numerous harassing phone calls from Japan, seriously disrupting normal operations. China urges Japan to handle the matter in accordance with law and earnestly protect the safety of Chinese embassy, consulates, institutions, enterprises and citizens in Japan.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Adel Al Asoomi, Speaker of Arab Parliament, in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under strategic guidance of leaders of China and Arab countries, China-Arab relations have achieved leapfrog development. China stands ready to work with Arab side to implement outcomes of first China-Arab States Summit, carry forward spirit of China-Arab friendship featuring mutual assistance, equality, mutual benefit, inclusiveness, and mutual learning, and build China-Arab community with shared future.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: BRICS Summit speech in Johannesburg, August 24, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries oppose decoupling and supply chain disruption as well as economic coercion.
