statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: BRICS Summit speech in Johannesburg, August 24, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We do not barter away principles, succumb to external pressure, or act as vassals of others. BRICS countries invariably advocate and practice independent foreign policies.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Cuban President Miguel Diaz-Canel in Johannesburg, August 24, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to firmly support Cuba in defending national sovereignty and opposing external interference and blockade.
statements.topic: US policy toward Cuba, sovereignty, sanctions
statements.framing: supportive of Cuba against US policy

article_title: Xi's South Africa Visit - Key Deals Signed - No Endorsement of GDI, GSI & GCI in Joint Statement - Xi's Cold War Warning at BRICS Forum - Wang Yiming on China's Economic Situation

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS business forum closing ceremony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some country, obsessed with maintaining its hegemony, has gone out of its way to cripple the EMDCs. Whoever is developing fast becomes its target of containment; whoever is catching up becomes its target of obstruction. But this is futile, as blowing out others' lamp will not bring light to oneself.
statements.topic: US hegemony and containment of developing countries

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS business forum closing ceremony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What people in various countries long for is definitely not a new Cold War or a small exclusive bloc; what they want is an open, inclusive, clean and beautiful world that enjoys enduring peace, universal security and common prosperity.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS business forum closing ceremony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any attempt to keep enlarging a military alliance, expand one's own sphere of influence or squeeze other countries' buffer of security can only create security predicament and insecurity for all countries.
statements.topic: NATO expansion and US security policy

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS business forum closing ceremony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Deliberately creating division with the assertion of 'democracy versus authoritarianism' and 'liberalism versus autocracy' can only split the world and lead to clash of civilizations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at BRICS business forum closing ceremony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hegemonism is not in China's DNA; nor does China have any motivation to engage in major-power competition. China stands firmly on the right side of history.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily editorial commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Not long ago, the US House of Representatives passed a so-called Taiwan International Solidarity Act...Such an argument wantonly distorts the resolutions of the UN General Assembly, and is a despicable trick of the US to engage in public opinion fraud on the Taiwan issue.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily editorial commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: After the motion of the Central American Parliament was put forward, some American politicians tried to smear China under the guise of 'democracy' and put pressure on the Central American Parliament.

statements.speaker: Wang Yiming
statements.speaker_title: Vice Chairman, China Center for International Economic Exchanges
statements.context: Theory page article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US and the West have escalated their containment and suppression of China, the Ukraine crisis has continued to ferment, and the geopolitical landscape has undergone profound adjustments, all of which have increased the uncertainty of the external environment.

statements.speaker: Xu Dong
statements.speaker_title: Spokesperson, Foreign Affairs Committee of National People's Congress
statements.context: Official statement on Central American Parliament decision
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The just move of the Parlacen on the Taiwan-related issue has amply illustrated that upholding the one-China principle serves the greater good of international relations

article_title: Xi on 'Making BRICS Voice Stronger' - HuánYǔ Píng Commentary on BRICS - Anil Sooklal on BRICS Agenda - China & India's Interests at BRICS - State Council on Digital Economy - Li Meets USCBC Delegation

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Signed article published in South African media ahead of state visit and BRICS summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and South Africa should work together to practice true multilateralism and push for the building of a more just and equitable international order. China and South Africa should fear no hegemony and work as real partners. What the world needs is peace, not conflict; coordination, not confrontation. China and South Africa should oppose unilateral sanctions and the 'small yard, high fence' approach.
statements.framing: assertive opposition to Western approaches; constructive partnership emphasis

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Signed article published in South African media
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries should act on the BRICS spirit of openness, inclusiveness and win-win cooperation, build consensus on important issues, carry forward the tradition of independent diplomacy, and resolutely uphold international equity and justice. Urge the international community to refocus on development issues and promote a greater role by BRICS in global governance.
statements.framing: constructive; positioning BRICS as alternative governance voice

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US-China Business Council (USCBC) delegation led by Marc Casper
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with the United States in undertaking their responsibilities as major countries, jointly upholding international trade rules, and ensuring the stability of global industrial and supply chains. China and the US have economic complementarity far more than competition. The essence of the economic relationship is win-win cooperation. China-US relations and economic-trade cooperation are facing certain difficulties, which requires both sides to show sincerity, meet each other halfway, and make joint efforts. China and the US can achieve common development and work together for a better future for humanity.
statements.framing: constructive; emphasizing complementarity over competition; acknowledging difficulties but proposing cooperative solutions

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US-China Business Council delegation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will open its door even greater to the outside world. As China makes headway in high-quality development and Chinese modernization, its massive market is blessed with huge potential and opportunities for growth. China will continue expanding market access, optimizing business environment, ensuring foreign-funded enterprises receive equal treatment to domestic firms, promoting fair competition, and protecting property rights and entrepreneurs' rights and interests.
statements.topic: China's economic opening, foreign investment, business environment

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article by Huán Yǔ Píng on BRICS summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS cooperation has transcended conventional political and military alliances, establishing partnerships rather than alliances. It transcends old thinking of drawing lines based on ideology, following a new path of mutual respect and common progress. It breaks from zero-sum competition, embracing mutual benefit and win-win cooperation. The 'rules-based international order' pushed by some Western powers has become a stumbling block to world economic development and social progress.
statements.topic: BRICS, multilateralism, Western-led international order, ideology
statements.framing: assertive criticism of Western approach; promotional of BRICS alternative

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article on BRICS summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The western-led international order characterized by 'post-colonial rule, double standards and ignoring the concerns of developing countries' has not really met the common needs of emerging market countries and developing countries for peace, development and cooperation. The so-called 'rules-based international order' pushed by some Western powers has become a stumbling block to world economic development and social progress.
statements.topic: Western-led international order, double standards, developing country concerns

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Meeting with Rustam Emomali, chairman of National Assembly of Tajikistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China thanks Tajikistan for its long-standing firm support on issues concerning China's core interests and major concerns, including Taiwan, Xinjiang, Hong Kong, and human rights, and will continue to support Tajikistan in pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions.
statements.topic: China's core interests, Taiwan, Xinjiang, Hong Kong, human rights
statements.framing: defensive; emphasizing support for China's positions

article_title: SoEs & High-Quality Development - BRICS to Embark on 'New Journey' in South Africa - Peace Ark Visits Solomon Islands - Fu Zhu on US' China Policy Violating International Law

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Reply to letter from US-China Youth and Student Exchange Association and friendly personages from Washington state, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The hope and foundation of the China-US relationship lie in the people, and its future lies in the youths. Xi hopes more youths from China and the US can get to know each other, move forward together, become generational ambassadors of bilateral friendship, and continuously inject impetus into the development of bilateral ties.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to continue to work with Iran to jointly oppose external interference, resist unilateral bullying, defend the sovereignty, security and development interests of the two countries, and safeguard the common interests of developing countries and international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with Iranian Foreign Minister, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Only by resuming the full and effective implementation of the Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action can the Iranian nuclear issue be fundamentally resolved. China is ready to strengthen coordination with all parties including Iran to push the Iranian nuclear issue in a direction conducive to regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Chen Xiaodong
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on BRICS cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The BRICS cooperation mechanism is an important platform for collaboration among emerging market countries and developing nations. It has become a key force in promoting global economic growth, driving reforms in the global governance system, and maintaining international peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Chen Xiaodong
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with all parties to uphold the BRICS spirit of openness, inclusiveness, and win-win cooperation, open a new chapter of BRICS cooperation, and contribute more Chinese wisdom and strength to maintaining world stability and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Fu Hua
statements.context: Keynote speech at BRICS Media Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Proposed promoting the shared values of humanity, jointly advancing the building a more just and equitable international order, better narrating BRICS stories in the new era, and jointly promoting cultural exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations.

statements.speaker: Fu Zhu
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has been pursuing a wrong policy towards China out of a wrong perception of China. The US has been escalating its attacks on China, seeking to smear, contain and suppress it, playing up the 'China threat', increasing sanctions on China, wantonly interfering in China's internal affairs, and advocating such wrong arguments as 'economic coercion' and 'de-risking'.

statements.speaker: Fu Zhu
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has wantonly attacked China's system of governance, violated China's right to freely choose its own system. The US argues that western-style democracy and human rights are 'universal values' and tries to discredit China's political party system, democratic system and economic system. This is a replay of 'Western civilization superiority theory'.

statements.speaker: Fu Zhu
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US supports separatist forces advocating 'Taiwan independence,' 'Hong Kong independence,' 'East Turkestan independence,' 'Tibet independence,' and fabricated egregious lies such as 'genocide' and 'forced labor' in Xinjiang. Taiwan Province, Hong Kong, Xinjiang and Tibet are all parts of China, and the affairs related to them are purely China's internal affairs. The US has no right to interfere!

statements.speaker: Fu Zhu
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is trying to obstruct China's development by 'decoupling and breaking the chain', creating all kinds of cliques that exclude China, imposing tariffs on China goods, abusing export control measures, illegally sanctioning Chinese enterprises. The US has recently advocated the 'de-risking' strategy, but its essence is to rally allies to promote 'de-Sinification'.

article_title: Li Qiang Confident of Achieving Annual Goals - SPP's Implementation Xi Thought Study Campaign - Wang Yi's Diplomacy at South Asia Expo

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Second plenary meeting of the State Council
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economic operation has generally recovered and improved, laying a good foundation for achieving annual goals. Must align thinking with Party Central Committee's scientific judgments, adhere to seeking progress while maintaining stability, strengthen confidence, implement macro-control accurately, and accelerate development of new advantages in achieving high-quality growth.

statements.speaker: Supreme People's Procuratorate
statements.context: Report on Xi Thought education campaign implementation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: SPP has prioritized theoretical learning of Xi Jinping Thought, emphasizing deepening, internalizing and applying the theory with focus on enhancing political competence. Adheres to Party's absolute leadership over procuratorial work and fully implements major decisions and deployments of Party Central Committee.

statements.speaker: State Administration for Market Supervision
statements.context: Guidelines on Strengthening Intellectual Property Rights Enforcement in the New Era
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Guidelines clarify objectives and key tasks for intellectual property enforcement. Call for strengthening legal protection, establishing law enforcement mechanisms, and equally protecting intellectual property of all business entities to support innovation-driven development strategy. By 2025, will establish comprehensive IP enforcement system coordinating administrative enforcement, industry self-regulation, enterprise rights protection, and social supervision.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Opening ceremony address at seventh China-South Asia Expo in Kunming
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and South Asian countries are linked by mountains and seas with intertwined destinies. Both appreciate each other in civilization rejuvenation and walk hand-in-hand amid globalization. Conform to historical trends, accelerating development and revitalization. Respect each other equally, moving toward each other with fruitful cooperation results.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Opening ceremony address at seventh China-South Asia Expo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Actively promoted high-level interaction, strengthened strategic leadership, consolidated solidarity and cooperation, supported each other's core interests, respected development paths, handled differences properly, and worked together to tackle challenges. Trade volume between China and South Asia expanded from under $100 billion to nearly $200 billion since 2013 with 8.3% annual growth. Carried out friendly exchanges, adhered to openness and inclusiveness, built multi-level non-governmental platforms.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Opening ceremony address at seventh China-South Asia Expo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks 10th anniversary of expo, Belt and Road Initiative, and neighborhood diplomacy. China stands ready to work with South Asian countries to strengthen solidarity and coordination, foster new development drivers, build a community of development, and contribute to enduring peace, stability and prosperity in the region.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Opening ceremony address at seventh China-South Asia Expo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes South Asian countries to board the express train of China's development and share dividends of China's development. Willing to work with South Asian countries to seize historic opportunity, strengthen unity and cooperation, cultivate new development momentum, build development community, and contribute to long-term stability and prosperity of the region. Proposed four suggestions: deepen strategic mutual trust, deepen interconnection, deepen economic and trade cooperation, and deepen people-to-people exchanges.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Nepalese Vice President Ram Sahay Prasad Yadav
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Appreciated Yadav's reaffirmation of one-China principle and commitment that Nepal's territory will not be used by anti-China forces. Acknowledged Nepal's adherence to friendly relations and respect for China's core interests. Emphasized China and Nepal are friendly neighbors connected by mountains and rivers, always respected and supported each other, worked together in unity. China cherishes traditional friendship and will continue to firmly support Nepal in safeguarding sovereignty, security and development interests. Willing to work with Nepal to build generations-long development and prosperity-oriented strategic partnership. Should continue promoting trans-Himalayan three-dimensional connectivity network construction, build high quality BRI, speed up cross-border railway feasibility study, help Nepal develop and rejuvenate. Welcome Nepal to strengthen exchanges with Chinese neighboring places, welcome more characteristic products from Nepal to enter Chinese market, will encourage Chinese enterprises to invest in Nepal.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Sri Lankan Prime Minister Dinesh Gunawardena
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Sri Lanka relations have become a model for countries big and small to treat each other as equals and get along well. China cherishes traditional friendship cultivated by leaders of two countries and will always be a strategic partner Sri Lanka can rely on. Appreciates that Sri Lanka has always adhered to friendship with China and stood with China on issues involving China's core interests. Firmly supports Sri Lanka in safeguarding sovereignty, independence, and national dignity. Willing to strengthen exchanges in governance experience and cooperation in various fields to help Sri Lanka effectively cope with financial debt challenges, enhance capacity for independent development, break free from 'poverty trap' and 'underdevelopment trap', and accelerate industrialization and agricultural modernization. Believes Sri Lanka will overcome temporary difficulties, find development path suited to national conditions, achieve rebirth from adversity and revitalize prosperity. Welcome Sri Lanka to continue using this important platform and further open up Chinese market.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Lao Vice President Pany Yathotou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Laos are both socialist countries with same ideals and common strategic interests. Willing to continue understanding and trusting each other, supporting and helping each other, strengthening docking of development strategies, expanding all-round and all-field cooperation, turning high-level consensus into tangible cooperation results bringing more benefits to two peoples. China supports Laos assuming rotating presidency of ASEAN next year and playing more important role in international arena, expects Laos to make new contributions to China-ASEAN cooperation. Welcome Laos to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with Yunnan and other Chinese provinces and regions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnam's Deputy Prime Minister Tran Luu Quang
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two sides should prepare for next stage of high-level exchanges, further deepen strategic mutual trust, jointly safeguard security of political power and system, and jointly adhere to Parties' ideals and beliefs and socialist direction. China firmly supports ASEAN unity and ASEAN centrality in regional cooperation. Will work with ASEAN countries including Vietnam to uphold spirit of friendly consultation and mutually beneficial cooperation, oppose provocation and interference of external forces, and safeguard peace and stability in South China Sea and the region. Look forward to positive outcomes from East Asia Summit series of meetings under joint efforts of Vietnam and other ASEAN countries.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Comment on China's role in world economic growth
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is an important engine for world economic growth.

statements.speaker: State Council
statements.context: Guidelines on attracting foreign investment
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Despite rise of global protectionism and certain countries' strong push to 'decouple and break chains', all parties remain eager to promote open cooperation and look forward to sharing opportunities in China. China, which constantly expands high-level opening to outside world, has strong attraction.

article_title: Seeking Foreign Investment - Wang Yi on US' 'Evil Claws' in South China Sea - Warning Japan on NATO Expansion - July Data Shows Greater Weakness - NBS Suspends Youth Unemployment Data - Gwadar Attack

statements.speaker: State Council
statements.context: 24-point guideline on foreign investment published August 15, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Authorities should increase protection of rights and interests of foreign investors, including strengthening enforcement of intellectual property rights; increase fiscal support and tax incentives for foreign-invested enterprises; explore a 'convenient and secure management mechanism' for cross-border data flows

statements.speaker: Chen Chunjiang
statements.context: Press conference on August 15, 2023 following State Council guideline announcement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The government is looking for a 'new cooperation model in procurements' and Beijing will encourage and support foreigners who want to invest in 'world-leading' Chinese innovation. The government will continue to reduce the number of sectors that ban investment from foreign firms and will relax restrictions on 'strategic' investments into listed Chinese firms

statements.speaker: Yao Jun
statements.speaker_title: Head of Planning Department, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
statements.context: Press conference on August 15, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The government will continue to push for FDI in areas including 'advanced manufacturing' and 'energy conservation and environmental protection'. Beijing hopes to encourage more FDI in central-western and northeastern parts of China. In the next step, MIIT will guide foreign capital to invest in fields such as advanced manufacturing, energy conservation and environmental protection, and invest in the central, western and northeastern regions

statements.speaker: Liu Lin
statements.speaker_title: Official, State Administration for Market Regulation (SAMR)
statements.context: Press briefing on August 15, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Emphasizing the importance of 'adhering to the equal treatment of domestic and foreign-funded enterprises, and actively creating a market environment for fair competition.' In the first half of this year, 17,100 cases in the fields of trademarks and patents were investigated and dealt with, and the IPR of domestic and foreign-funded enterprises are being equally protected according to law

statements.speaker: Fu Jinling
statements.speaker_title: Director of Economic Construction Department, Ministry of Finance
statements.context: Press briefing on August 15, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Ministry of Finance attaches great importance to optimizing the foreign investment environment in the field of government procurement, strives to eliminate all kinds of unreasonable restrictions and barriers in government procurement, and ensures equal participation of domestic and foreign enterprises in government procurement activities in accordance with the law. The Ministry will continue to optimize the business environment of fair competition in government procurement, clarify specific standards of 'produce in China' in government procurement, and carry out special inspections to ensure fair participation

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Statement on August 15, 2023 regarding foreign investment promotion
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Ministry will fully mobilize foreign embassies and consulates, domestic and foreign associations, industry organizations and foreign investment promotion institutions, and make good use of various economic and trade exhibitions, pilot free trade zones, national development zones and other platforms to provide support for attracting foreign investment. Will guide local governments to explore and innovate bold foreign investment promotion activities in a more targeted manner, such as attracting investment through industry chain collaboration and business-to-business interactions

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on August 13, 2023 attack on Chinese convoy in Gwadar, Pakistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China strongly condemns this terrorist act and has asked the Pakistani authorities to bring the perpetrators to justice and take actions to keep Chinese nationals safe. China will continue to work with Pakistan to jointly guard against and counter the threats of terrorism and effectively protect the safety of Chinese personnel, institutions and projects in Pakistan. No attempt to sabotage the friendship between China and Pakistan and the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor (CPEC) will succeed

statements.speaker: Wang Wentao
statements.context: Second Meeting of the Steering Commission for Economic and Trade Cooperation between China and Angola
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the strategic leadership of the leaders of both countries, the economic and trade cooperation between China and Angola has yielded fruitful results. China is prepared to collaborate in strategizing for the upcoming phase of bilateral economic and trade cooperation, enhancing the scope of trade and investment cooperation, strengthening the achievements in infrastructure partnership, and broadening engagement across sectors such as energy, mining, manufacturing, agriculture, and fisheries

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister and Member of Political Bureau of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Diplomatic visit to Malaysia (readout from bilateral meeting with Foreign Minister Zambry Abd Kadir)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Malaysia to follow the important common understandings between the leaders of the two countries, take stock of the successful experience, deepen mutually beneficial cooperation. China supports Malaysia in pursuing a development path that suits its own national conditions and in playing a greater role in regional and international affairs. As two flagship projects of the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), the construction of the East Coast Rail Link and Two Countries, Twin Parks has been progressing smoothly. China supports and encourages more Chinese enterprises to invest and do business in Malaysia
statements.topic: bilateral relations and Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister and Member of Political Bureau of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Diplomatic visit to Malaysia (readout from bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Dato' Seri Anwar Bin Ibrahim)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Malaysia are both emerging economies and developing countries with similar development philosophies and extensive common interests. The high-quality Belt and Road cooperation has yielded fruitful results, and the construction of the East Coast Rail Link and Two Countries, Twin Parks has achieved good economic and social effects. China is ready to share with Malaysia the opportunities brought by the super-large market, expand cooperation areas, and achieve mutual benefit, win-win results, and common development
statements.topic: bilateral relations and Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister and Member of Political Bureau of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Diplomatic visit to Singapore (readout from bilateral meeting with Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current world is full of chaos; the only right way is to jointly uphold the international system with the United Nations at its core and the international order underpinned by international law. Major countries, in particular, should take the lead. China is committed to realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation by advancing Chinese modernization on all fronts. China's commitment to high-quality development, high-standard opening-up and the creation of a new development pattern will bring new opportunities to countries in the region, including Singapore. China will work with ASEAN countries to build a peaceful, safe and secure, prosperous, beautiful and amicable home for China and ASEAN and push forward the sustained and steady development of China-ASEAN comprehensive strategic partnership

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister and Member of Political Bureau of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Official statement during visits to Singapore and Malaysia regarding South China Sea
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Thanks to the joint efforts of China and ASEAN, the situation in the South China Sea has been generally stable over the years. However, the United States and some other forces wish nothing but chaos in the South China Sea and keep stirring up trouble. Recently, the United States fanned up the flames over the Ren'ai Jiao dispute, provoked discord and incited confrontation between China and the Philippines, and disrupted the peace and tranquility of the South China Sea, to serve the United States' own geopolitical strategy. China hopes that regional countries will maintain necessary vigilance against the evil claws behind the scenes. China has repeatedly expressed its willingness to properly handle existing differences with the Philippines through bilateral dialogue. China is ready to work with ASEAN countries to accelerate the negotiation on a Code of Conduct in the South China Sea
statements.topic: South China Sea and US-China relations

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Foreign Minister and Member of Political Bureau of CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Diplomatic visit to Cambodia (readout from bilateral meeting with Prime Minister Hun Sen)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The recent elections in Cambodia were 'fair, transparent and in accordance with the law.' Under the leadership of Prime Minister Hun Sen, Cambodia has gone from war to peace, from turmoil to stability, from poverty to prosperity. The noises made by some external forces are pale in the face of the people's choice. The ironclad friendship between China and Cambodia is ever-lasting and time-tested

article_title: Xi & the Double Support Policy - Tensions of US Investment Screening - Pushback on US-Taiwan Trade Agreement - No More Banquets for Quzhou Officials - France's EV Focus

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to US Executive Order on investment screening
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China strongly deplores and firmly opposes the US's single-minded rollout of restrictions on investments in China. Restricting US companies' investments in China with national security as a front is a clear act of overstretching the concept of security and politicizing business engagement. The move's real aim is to deprive China of its right to develop and selfishly pursue US supremacy at the expense of others. This is blatant economic coercion and tech bullying.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to US Executive Order on investment screening
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Biden committed to not seeking to decouple from China or halt China's economic development. We urge the US to follow through on that commitment, stop politicizing, instrumentalizing and weaponizing tech and trade issues, immediately cancel the wrong decisions, remove the restrictions on investments in China and create an enabling environment for China-US business cooperation. China will follow the developments closely and resolutely safeguard our rights and interests.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement via Xinhua on US investment restrictions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States imposing limits on its own companies investing abroad is an act of decoupling and severing industrial and supply chains under the guise of de-risking in the investment sector. The act gravely deviates from the principles of market economy and fair competition, affects normal business decisions of enterprises, undermines international economic and trade order, and seriously disrupts global industrial and supply chain security. China is seriously concerned and reserves the right to take measures.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on US-Taiwan Initiative on 21st-Century Trade First Agreement Implementation Act
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China strongly opposes official interaction of any form between China's Taiwan region and countries that have diplomatic relations with China. The US move violates the one-China principle and the three China-US joint communiqués, contravenes the US's own commitment of maintaining only unofficial relations with Taiwan, and sends a wrong message to separatist forces. We urge the US to change course immediately, revoke the so-called Act, stop pushing forward the negotiations on the so-called initiative, and stop going further down the wrong path.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to Japanese LDP official Taro Aso's visit to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Despite China's strong opposition, certain Japanese politician visited China's Taiwan region and made irresponsible remarks that sought to hype up cross-Strait tensions, stoke antagonism and confrontation, and blatantly interfere in China's internal affairs. This seriously violates the one-China principle and tramples on basic norms governing international relations. Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory and the Taiwan question is entirely China's internal affair that brooks no external interference.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to Japanese LDP official Taro Aso's visit to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan needs to draw lessons from history and act prudently. The Japanese politician kept raising the possibility of war whilst in Taiwan—an obvious attempt to stir up trouble in the Taiwan Strait. Today's China is no longer what it was when the Qing government signed the Treaty of Shimonoseki in 1895. The complete reunification of the motherland is the common aspiration of all the sons and daughters of the Chinese nation and an unstoppable historical trend. No one shall underestimate the strong resolve, will and capability of the Chinese people to defend the nation's sovereignty and territorial integrity.
statements.topic: Taiwan, Japan relations, history, military deterrence

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to Japanese LDP official Taro Aso's visit to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We seriously urge Japan to deeply reflect on its history of aggression, abide by the one-China principle and its commitments regarding the Taiwan question, and stop meddling in China's internal affairs and lending support to Taiwan independence separatist forces in any form. Taiwan independence has no future. Soliciting Japan's support and selling Taiwan away will only harm the people in Taiwan.

statements.speaker: China's UN Mission
statements.context: Working paper issued at UN on Fukushima wastewater issue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan should fully respond to concerns of China and the international community, and dispose of the nuclear contaminated water in a responsible manner in line with its obligations under international law. Japan should stop pushing through the discharge plan, fully consult with stakeholders including neighbouring countries, make sure to handle the nuclear contaminated water in a science-based, safe and transparent way, and subject itself to rigorous international oversight.

article_title: What Was Discussed at Beidaihe? - Foreign Trade Slumps - Wooing the 'Global South' - State Council Discusses Flood Situation - Jeddah Talks - South China Sea Tensions

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Statement on South China Sea tensions with the Philippines, reproduced in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has sovereignty over Nansha Qundao, including Ren'ai Jiao, backed by sufficient historical and legal evidence. The Philippines violated its commitment by attempting to send supplies to an illegally 'grounded' military vessel. China Coast Guard vessels intercepted Philippine boats in accordance with law. The Chinese military will resolutely perform its duty to uphold China's national sovereignty and maritime rights and interests.

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense
statements.context: Statement on South China Sea tensions with the Philippines, reproduced in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China expresses resolute opposition to the United States' groundless remarks on China's legitimate law enforcement actions. China urges the United States to immediately cease sowing discord among countries in the region and to respect China's territorial sovereignty over the South China Sea and its maritime rights and interests.
statements.topic: US-China relations, South China Sea, US interference

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement following discussions in Jeddah on Ukraine issue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to act in the spirit of the four principles, joint efforts in four areas and three observations proposed by President Xi Jinping, work on the basis of the document of China's Position on the Political Settlement of the Ukraine Crisis, enhance dialogue and communication with all parties, and contribute to the political settlement of the Ukraine crisis.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement in response to European Commission Executive Vice-President Valdis Dombrovskis' remarks about unbalanced China-EU trade
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's trade surplus with the EU is a natural result of different industrial structures, industrial specialization, and ways of trade. EU restrictions on export of high-tech products to China directly limited the EU's ability to expand exports to China and led to unbalanced trade. If the EU truly wants to address this, it needs to lift export control against China rather than blaming China.

article_title: NDRC on Mobilising Private Investment - Wang-Lavrov Chat - Liu Jianchao on Xi's 'Three Major Global Initiatives' - South China Sea Tensions - US-China People-to-People Ties

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to US State Department comments on South China Sea incident
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes the US State Department's statement which attacked China's legitimate and lawful actions at sea. The US has been inciting and supporting the Philippines' attempts to repair and reinforce its warship on Ren'ai Jiao. The US's attempt to make an issue of the illegal arbitration award will not affect China's firm resolve to safeguard its territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests in accordance with the law.
statements.topic: South China Sea / maritime disputes / US-China relations

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat/meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since Xi Jinping's visit to Russia in March, the strategic coordination and pragmatic cooperation between the two countries have made headway. Bilateral trade volume has reached a new high, energy cooperation has been carried out steadily, and personnel exchanges have swiftly resumed. China and Russia are trustworthy and reliable good friends and partners. The current priority for both sides is to continue implementing the important consensus reached by the two heads of state and promote the high-level development of the China-Russia comprehensive strategic partnership.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat/meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On the international and multilateral stage, China and Russia continue their close strategic cooperation, advancing the processes of global multipolarity and democratization of international relations, and upholding the fundamental norms of international relations. This is the international responsibility that China and Russia should undertake. BRICS keeps pace with the trend of the times and demonstrates abundant vitality. China is willing to work with Russia and other BRICS partners to support South Africa in hosting the upcoming BRICS Summit.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat/meeting with Russian Foreign Minister reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will uphold an independent and impartial position on any international and multilateral occasion, make objective and rational statements, actively promote peace and talks, and strive to seek a political solution to the Ukraine crisis.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Chief of the International Liaison Department of the CPC Central Committee
statements.context: Long article in People's Daily on Xi Jinping's three global initiatives
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The concept of building a community with a shared future for mankind and the Three Major Global Initiatives demonstrate that China will never follow the old path of hegemony when a country becomes strong, nor will it engage in hegemonism or power politics. China will never seek its own security at the expense of the security of others, nor will it incite division and confrontation. Instead, it will always be a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development and a defender of international order.
statements.topic: US-China relations / international relations / diplomacy / global governance

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Bill Gates (as cited in Robert Lawrence Kuhn article in People's Daily)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The foundation of China-US relations lies in the people-to-people connection.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to the Bond with Kuliang: 2023 China-U.S. People-to-People Friendship Forum (as cited in Robert Lawrence Kuhn article in People's Daily)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Amity between the people holds the key to sound relations between countries, and the people are the cornerstone of the growth of state-to-state relations.

article_title: Cai Qi hosts Tech Experts at Beidaihe - Evolution of Xi Thought - H1 Opening Up - Support for MSMEs - MPS' Measures for High-Quality Development - PBOC Meets Private Players - William Lai's US Transit

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on DPP leader William Lai's transit through US to Paraguay
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes any form of official interaction between the US and Taiwan, firmly opposes any visit by Taiwan independence separatists to the US, and firmly opposes any US connivance and support for Taiwan independence. The Taiwan question is at the core of China's core interests and a red line that cannot be crossed. China urges the US to abide by the one-China principle and the three joint communiqués, act on its leaders' commitment of not supporting Taiwan independence, and refuse to let William Lai transit the US.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on US military aid to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US provision of military aid to Taiwan seriously violates the one-China principle and the three joint communiqués. Such moves seriously undermine China's sovereignty and security interests, and harm China-US relations and peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. China strongly deplores and firmly rejects this. The Taiwan question is the very core of China's core interests and the first red line that must not be crossed in the China-US relationship. The Chinese people have determination, resolve and capability in safeguarding our sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on US blacklisting of Chinese firms
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The allegation of forced labor in Xinjiang is nothing but an enormous lie propagated by anti-China elements to smear China. The US enforcement of the Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act on the basis of such a lie is detrimental to international trade rules and global supply chain stability. The move to blacklist Chinese entities is aimed at undermining Xinjiang's prosperity and stability and containing China's development. We condemn and reject this and will take strong measures to firmly safeguard Chinese companies' lawful rights and interests.
statements.topic: trade, human rights allegations, US-China relations

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on Italy's reported withdrawal from Belt and Road Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past five years, bilateral trade increased by 42 percent. Some forces have launched malicious hype and politicized the cultural exchange and trade cooperation between China and Italy under the Belt and Road framework in a bid to disrupt cooperation and create division. This goes against the trend of history and will hurt others without benefiting oneself.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, US-related criticism

article_title: Party-building in PLA - CPEC & Pakistan Blast - Feature on Xi's High-Quality Development Agenda - Chinese & Russian Media Discuss Enhancing Int'l Influence - Zhong Sheng on Japan's Defense White Paper

statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: Inspection in Jiangsu Province (July 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has grown from 1.2 meters to 1.89 meters and must follow the path of self-reliance and self-strengthening. Only by holding the rice bowl in our own hands can we be assured about sustenance without panicking. This is of strategic importance, which is why I spare no effort to promote strengthening and extending the supply chain.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: Special seminar for senior provincial and ministerial leaders (January 2016)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic development is at a key transition point where speed is shifting, like a person who grows rapidly between ages 10-18 but growth slows after age 18.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: People's Daily feature article on high-quality development (August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: With the spread of unilateralism, protectionism, and counter-globalization trends, China's development has entered a period where strategic opportunities coexist with risks and challenges, and factors of uncertainty and unpredictability are increasing.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: People's Daily feature article on high-quality development (August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: By unblocking the domestic circulation and striving to cultivate a body that is invulnerable to all poisons and indestructible, we can face the ever-changing international dynamics with vitality and continue to thrive. No one can knock us down or bring us to a standstill.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: People's Daily feature article on high-quality development (August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The most essential feature of building a new development pattern is to achieve high-level self-reliance and self-improvement.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: Letter to Pakistani President Arif Alvi (condolence message)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes all forms of terrorism and strongly condemns the suicide bomb attack. China will continue to firmly support Pakistan in promoting its national anti-terrorism action plan and jointly safeguard peace and security in the region and the world.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily (Page 15, August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan has positioned China as an 'unprecedented and the greatest strategic challenge' and exaggerated the so-called 'China threat,' grossly interfering in China's internal affairs and smearing China's national defense policy, normal military development and legitimate military activities. Japan is trying to find excuses for its own military expansion by exaggerating the 'China threat.'
statements.topic: US-Japan relations, China's military, regional security

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily (Page 15, August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China adheres to the path of peaceful development and pursues a defensive national defense policy. It has never challenged anyone, let alone threatened anyone. China's strengthening of national defense and army building aims to safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily (Page 15, August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan has followed the wrong US policy toward China, cooperated with the US to provoke troubles on issues involving China's core interests, pushed NATO eastward into the Asia-Pacific region despite regional opposition, and placed regional countries on the dangerous frontline of great power competition and camp confrontation.
statements.topic: US-Japan-China relations, NATO expansion, regional security

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily (Page 15, August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan is Chinese territory and the Taiwan question is purely an internal affair of China which brooks no external interference. The one-China principle is an insurmountable bottom line for China-Japan relations. Japan must stop violating its promises and hollowing out the one-China principle on Taiwan.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary article in People's Daily (Page 15, August 2, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Countries that really threaten regional peace and stability and attempt to unilaterally change the status quo are external actors that frequently send warships to relevant sea areas to show off their strength for their own selfish interests.
statements.topic: US military presence, regional security, South China Sea

statements.speaker: Yan Dong
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of the Chinese People's Association for Friendship with Foreign Countries
statements.context: China-Russia Media Dialogue forum and '3rd China-Russia Youth Walk Together on the Friendship Road' media briefing (July 31, 2023)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Media exchanges are an essential part of China-Russia strategic cooperation and cultural collaboration. China-Russia media cooperation not only concerns bilateral relations but also meets the needs of regional stability, global peace, and the construction of a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Reception held to mark the 96th army day
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese military will faithfully implement the global security initiative proposed by President Xi Jinping, continue to deepen international military exchanges and cooperation, and inject more certainty and positive energy into today's troubled world.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official response statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We are deeply shocked by the attack [in Pakistan]. We mourn for the victims and extend our sympathy to their families and the people who are injured.

article_title: Xi to WTC Air Force: Deepen Preparations for Military Struggle - Xi's Sichuan Visit & Diplomatic Engagements - CPEC @10 - Wang Huning Visits Tibet - Li Xi Visits Xinjiang

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Inspection of Air Force of Western Theater Command, eve of Army Day, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Emphasized need to thoroughly implement spirit of 20th Party Congress, thought on strengthening army in new era, and military strategic policy in new era; speed up modernization of army; resolutely complete all tasks entrusted by Party and people. Called for deepening military struggle preparations, ensuring airspace security through regular air defense, promoting rapid integration of new equipment and forces into combat system, coordinating development of aviation units and ground guidance/radar/electronic countermeasures units, and grasping realistic combat training with adversarial confrontational training.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Inspection visit to Sichuan Province, July 25-27, 2023, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called Sichuan the 'strategic hinterland for China's development.' Urged the province to make more progress in sci-tech innovation, application of sci-tech achievements, building modern industrial system, rural revitalization, and consolidation of ecological shields along upper reaches of Yangtze River and Yellow River. Stated that opening up new areas of development with sci-tech innovation and forging new driving forces for development is both a general trend and urgent requirement of high-quality development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Burundian President Evariste Ndayishimiye in Chengdu, July 2023, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Stated that China-Burundi relations have withstood test of international changes and uncertainties, and the two countries are 'all-weather friends.' Affirmed China firmly supports Burundi in upholding national independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and in pursuing independent and self-reliant development path. Said the two sides need to strengthen unity and cooperation to safeguard common interests of developing countries and international fairness and justice in a world facing multiple challenges and crises.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Indonesian President Joko Widodo in Chengdu, July 2023, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Expressed willingness to maintain regular strategic communication with Indonesia, strengthen exchanges of state governance experience, initiate '2+2' dialogue mechanism for foreign and defense ministers, and build high-level strategic mutual trust. Said major achievements made in synergizing Belt and Road Initiative with Indonesia's Global Maritime Fulcrum vision. Stated China supports Indonesia's development of new capital and North Kalimantan Industrial Park, willing to expand cooperation in new energy vehicles, smart cities, and industrial digital transformation. Expressed readiness to deepen comprehensive strategic partnership with ASEAN and support Indonesia as rotating ASEAN chair.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Mauritanian President Mohamed Ould Cheikh Ghazouani in Chengdu, July 2023, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Stated that China and Mauritania should continue to be good friends and good partners in seeking development, jointly safeguarding common interests and international fairness and justice. Noted China appreciates Mauritania's consistent support on issues concerning China's core interests, and will continue supporting Mauritania in pursuing development path suited to its national circumstances and oppose external interference in Mauritania's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Guyanese President Irfaan Ali in Chengdu, July 2023, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called for China and Guyana to be good friends who trust and count on each other, share opportunities, meet challenges, and seek cooperation together. Urged building of more close-knit China-Guyana community with shared future. Said China and Guyana, both developing countries, should strengthen communication and cooperation and firmly support each other. Expressed willingness to deepen alignment between Belt and Road Initiative and Guyana's Low-carbon Development Strategy 2030. Said China supports Guyana in playing greater role in international and regional affairs and is willing to work with Guyana to practice true multilateralism and safeguard common interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Georgian Prime Minister Irakli Garibashvili in Chengdu, July 2023, reported via Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Said China and Georgia should understand and support each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and be good friends and partners based on mutual respect, mutual trust and equality. Stated China is ready to work with Georgia to jointly promote high-quality Belt and Road cooperation and welcomes Georgia to expand exports to China. Explained he had put forward Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative, and Global Civilization Initiative with aim of upholding international system with UN at its core and international order based on international law.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Visit to Tibet, July 2023, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Stated necessity to resolutely implement Party's strategies for governing Tibet in new era, deeply comprehend decisive significance of 'Two Establishments,' strengthen 'four consciousnesses and four confidences' and achieve 'two safeguards.' Called for focusing on fostering strong sense of community for Chinese nation and addressing stability, development, ecological conservation, and border area development. Emphasized safeguarding motherland unity and strengthening national unity as main focus of Tibet's work, improving people's livelihood, and establishing concept that 'lucid waters and lush mountains are invaluable assets.'

statements.speaker: Li Xi
statements.context: Visit to Xinjiang, July 2023, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Emphasized that new journey of building strong country and national rejuvenation inseparable from cohesion and unity of people of all ethnic groups. Called on discipline inspection and supervision organs to focus on overall goal of social stability and long-term peace, constantly forge sense of Chinese nation community, firmly and clearly uphold discipline against separatist activities, and strengthen supervision and inspection on implementation of policy of stabilizing Xinjiang, benefiting people and enriching people.

statements.speaker: Zhang Guoqing
statements.context: National work safety conference, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called for all-out efforts to effectively prevent and contain occurrence of major accidents. Urged learning lessons from recent accidents, accurately investigating and rectifying risks and hidden dangers, firmly establishing safe development concept, putting end to idea of making efforts afterwards, focusing on accident-prone industries and high-risk points, and resolutely curbing frequent occurrence of gas accidents.

article_title: Xi on Strengthening Military Governance - Qin Ousted as FM - Xi Wants Patriotism from HK Youth - China-Pak Defense Cooperation - Wang at BRICS Meeting: Global South Must 'Resist External Interference'

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to students of Pui Kiu Middle School in Hong Kong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Patriotism lies at the core of the spirit of the Chinese nation. People in Hong Kong maintain the noble tradition of loving both the motherland and Hong Kong, which serves as a crucial cornerstone for the stable and enduring implementation of 'one country, two systems'. Hope students will gain deep understanding of world development trends, motherland's history and culture, and grow into talents worthy of great responsibilities to contribute to construction of better Hong Kong and national rejuvenation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to Samdech Techo Hun Sen on Cambodia's electoral victory
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cambodia has achieved political stability, economic development and better living standards under Hun Sen's leadership. China will support Cambodia in pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions. China and Cambodia belong to one community with a shared future. Expressed willingness to strengthen political guidance for bilateral relations, deepen exchanges and cooperation to build a high-quality, high-level and high-standard China-Cambodia community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission
statements.context: Remarks at BRICS National Security Advisors meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries have become an important platform for emerging markets and developing countries seeking strength through unity. Emphasized need to adhere to mutual respect, UN Charter purposes and principles, respect each other's legitimate security concerns and right to choose political systems and development paths. Advocated for multilateralism, resistance to unilateralism and hegemonic actions, opposition to 'decoupling and breaking the chain' and 'double standards'. Called for unity and cooperation to deal with security challenges in spirit of win-win cooperation and opposition to zero-sum game and Cold War mentality.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Central Foreign Affairs Commission
statements.context: Remarks at BRICS National Security Advisors meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The 'Global South' countries face important mission of resisting external interference and infiltration, maintaining political and regime security. Should maintain strategic determination and self-confidence, unswervingly follow own paths, support each other on core interests and major concerns. Called to respond to voices that sow discord in BRICS unity and smear BRICS cooperation. Need to deepen South-South cooperation, lead Global South to unite and strengthen itself, jointly safeguard national security and stability.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Video link conversation with Speaker of Pakistan's National Assembly Raja Pervaiz Ashraf
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hailed Pakistan for firm support on China's core interests. China willing to strengthen strategic coordination with Pakistan and promote building of closer China-Pakistan community of shared future. Hoped two sides would deepen all-round practical cooperation, push China-Pakistan Economic Corridor to new level, strengthen friendly people-to-people exchanges, continue close coordination on international and regional issues. Praised Pakistan for leading support of Global Development Initiative and Global Security Initiative.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Air Force Chief Zaheer Ahmad Babar in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Pakistan are all-weather strategic cooperative partners and iron-clad friends. Two sides should promote close cooperation in all fields and build even closer China-Pakistan community with shared future in new era. Air forces of two countries should enhance collaborative capability through joint exercises.

statements.speaker: Wang Wentao
statements.context: Announcement with Nicaragua's Minister of Development, Industry and Trade on FTA negotiations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Nicaragua have substantively completed their free trade agreement negotiations. Two sides agreed to step up technical preparations and fulfill domestic ratification procedures to sign and implement agreement at early date.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese port investments under Belt and Road Initiative have promoted local employment, infrastructure improvement and economic development. Some people in the United States look at cooperation between Chinese and foreign ports with coloured lenses, fabricating and exaggerating 'the threat of Chinese investment in global ports', hyping that these ports 'are more likely to provide support for Chinese navy' and pose 'obvious geopolitical risks'. These unfounded accusations politicize, ideologize and securitize normal business cooperation, aiming to smear and unreasonably suppress Chinese enterprises to maintain US competitive advantage.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Critics in the US are ignoring that Chinese investments in ports are based on business logic of two-way choice and mutual benefit and win-win, instead sticking to zero-sum game mindset and speculating out of malice. Noted that Boston port in US has expanded practical cooperation with COSCO Group, retaining 9,000 original jobs and creating 400,000 total jobs, with Port Authority calling it 'a perfect example of US-China economic and trade cooperation'.

statements.speaker: Li Fei
statements.context: Statement on 7th China-South Asia Expo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Annual trade volume between China and South Asian countries has grown from under 100 billion US dollars a decade ago to nearly 200 billion dollars last year, representing average annual increase of 8.3 percent. China has become largest trading partner of Pakistan, Bangladesh and Maldives. Over 60 countries and regions have expressed intention to participate in the expo, with nearly 1,000 enterprises expected to attend.

statements.speaker: Xiao Lisheng
statements.speaker_title: Scholar from Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US federal government debt held by public accounted for 98% of US GDP in fiscal year 2023 and will rise to 107% in fiscal year 2029, exceeding historical high point. High and rising debt will slow US economic growth, push up interest payments, and pose significant risks to fiscal and economic outlook. Long-term fiscal imbalance caused by decline in economic growth is main reason for high US government debt. Risk of US government debt default will impact US domestic capital market and real economy, making global financial system more vulnerable, with emerging market countries facing capital outflows and currency depreciation.

statements.speaker: Xiao Lisheng
statements.speaker_title: Scholar from Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, US, European countries and Japan have adopted extremely loose monetary and fiscal policies, contributing significantly to persistently high global inflation and directly driving rapid growth of government debt in multiple countries. Due to special status of US treasuries in global financial system, US government debt problem has obvious negative spillover effects. If US government continues to ignore fiscal balance and borrows recklessly, debt default risk will increase significantly. International community calls on US government to take measures to control fiscal balance and debt risks and stabilize global economic and financial system.

article_title: Politburo Discusses Economic Challenges - Wang Yi Meets BRICS NSAs - Central SoEs Eye Future Industries - EU-China Climate Dialogue - Taiwan 'Reunification' 'Core Essence' of National Rejuvenation

statements.speaker: CPC Central Committee / Politburo
statements.context: Politburo meeting discussing economic work
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economy is facing new difficulties and challenges, which mainly arise from insufficient domestic demand, difficulties in the operation of some enterprises, risks and hidden dangers in key areas, as well as a grim and complex external environment.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Symposium with non-CPC personages on economic situation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The speed of China's economic recovery is in a leading position among the world's major economies, the fundamentals of long-term improvement have not changed, and the prospects for development are bright.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with South African Minister of International Relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The BRICS mechanism is the most important platform for representatives of emerging markets and major developing countries to strengthen dialogue and cooperation. China fully supports South Africa as the BRICS chair and will work to further strengthen BRICS cooperation, practice multilateralism and provide more stability to a world full of uncertainties.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Brazilian chief advisor to presidency
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Brazil, as the biggest developing countries in the Eastern and Western hemispheres, share common strategic interests. China is willing to work with Brazil to deepen strategic mutual trust, expand strategic cooperation, and strengthen alignment between the Belt and Road Initiative and Brazil's development strategies.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Iran's Secretary of Supreme National Security Council
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to support Iran in safeguarding its national sovereignty and dignity, pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions and safeguarding its national security. China opposes external interference in Iran's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Indian National Security Advisor Ajit Doval
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and India are two major forces in the process of multi-polarization. At the end of last year, President Xi Jinping and Prime Minister Modi reached an important consensus in Bali on stabilizing China-India relations. The two sides should adhere to the strategic judgement that they do not pose a threat to each other and are each other's development opportunities.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Indian National Security Advisor Ajit Doval
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Whether China and India support each other or suspect and exhaust each other will directly affect their respective development processes and the trend of the world situation. A major trend in the world today is the rise of developing countries, including China and India. China will never tread the old path of seeking hegemony. It is willing to work with developing countries, including India, to support multilateralism and democratization of international relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Security Council Secretary Nikolai Patrushev
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Russia relations have withstood the test of international changes and become more mature, resilient and vigorous. China is willing to further strengthen strategic communication with Russia, enhance strategic mutual trust, and deepen synergy. We should work together to oppose hegemonic and high-handed acts and inject new impetus into a multi-polar world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS National Security Advisors meeting on cyber security
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cyber security is an important cornerstone of national security. Cyberspace should be jointly created by all countries and jointly safeguarded by all countries. statements.speaker: Song Tao

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
