statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Gabonese Foreign Minister Hermann Immongault, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will realize national rejuvenation through Chinese modernization, bring new opportunities for developing countries, especially for African countries at the same time, and provide a reference for other countries in pursuing development paths suited to their national realities. China is willing to continue to support each other in safeguarding core interests, promote bilateral cooperation to more fields and a higher level, and jointly uphold the basic norms in international relations. China will work with Gabon and other African countries to carry forward the spirit of China-Africa friendship and cooperation to create a new chapter of China-Africa development and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Laos' Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Saleumxay Kommasith, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China calls to jointly push the China-ASEAN comprehensive strategic partnership to a new level. Wang also called for accelerating negotiations on the upgraded China-ASEAN Free Trade Area, which could inject new impetus into the building of a peaceful, safe and secure, prosperous, beautiful and amicable home between China and ASEAN.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Ban Ki-moon (Former UN Secretary-General and former ROK official), reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since China and the Republic of Korea established diplomatic ties 30 years ago, bilateral relations have gone through an extraordinary journey and achieved unprecedented results. Bilateral relations should move forward instead of stagnating or backsliding. China's policy toward the ROK remains unchanged. It is hoped that the ROK will work with China to overcome temporary difficulties, reinvigorate exchanges and cooperation, and open up broad prospects for the development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Regular press briefing, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a country committed to the rule of law. The decisions to conduct security reviews over foreign companies by competent Chinese departments are made in accordance with the laws and the facts. China welcomes the people and businesses of all countries to come to China and do business here, and we are committed to protecting their safety and lawful rights and interests in China in accordance with the law, including their freedom of entry and exit. In recent years, the US has put up hurdles and even harassed and interrogated under various excuses Chinese nationals entering the US. From time to time, Chinese students bound for the US have been refused entry and sent back. In 2021, the US refused to issue visas for at least 2,000 Chinese students majoring in science, technology, engineering or mathematics. From January to October 2022, the number of visas issued for Chinese students bound for the US dropped by 38% year-on-year. Recently, the US has prosecuted and detained Chinese nationals and people of Chinese descent in the US. The US has scapegoated China on fentanyl-related issues, resorting to 'sting operations' and extra-territorial abduction against Chinese nationals. We urge the US to stop its wrongdoing at once, stop disrupting practical cooperation between the two countries, stop arbitrary detentions and abuse of process against Chinese businesses and individuals.
statements.topic: US-China relations, security reviews, visa restrictions, law enforcement

article_title: Tech in Focus during Xi's Jiangsu Visit - Janet Yellen's Beijing Visit - New Regulation for Private Investment Funds & VCs

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation are the basic principles of state-to-state interactions. Chinese culture values peace above everything else, as opposed to hegemony and bullying. It is hoped that the U.S. side will adopt a rational and pragmatic attitude, and work with China in the same direction to push bilateral relations back onto the right track at an early date.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic interests of China and the United States are closely intertwined. Mutual benefits are the essence of China-U.S. economic relations, and strengthening cooperation is the realistic demand of and right choice for both sides. China's development is an opportunity rather than a challenge for the United States, and a gain rather than a risk.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Politicizing economic cooperation or overstretching the concept of security on such cooperation does no good for the economic development of the two countries and the whole world.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen on Saturday, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides had in-depth, candid and practical exchanges on the economic and financial situation of the two countries and the whole world as well as on working together to address common global challenges. The talks were constructive. The overstretching of national security does no good to normal economic and trade exchanges.

statements.speaker: Chinese side (unnamed)
statements.context: Meeting with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Expressed concerns over the sanctions and restrictions imposed by the United States on China.

article_title: Xi Stresses Combat Preparedness - China in 'Critical Period' of Economic Recovery - Shanghai AI Conference - China-Japan Ties at 'New Crucial Juncture' - Education & Graduate Employment

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Inspection of PLA Eastern Theater Command headquarters in Jiangsu Province
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world has entered a new period of turbulence and transformation and China's security situation is facing rising instability and uncertainty. It is necessary to keep in mind the mission and task, adhere to problem orientation, enhance planning of war and combat, strengthen the command system for joint operations, and step up training under real combat conditions to raise the forces' capabilities to fight and win.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter on 70th anniversary of 'Icebreaking Mission' in China-UK trade
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The multiple challenges in today's world are intertwined and economic globalization is facing countercurrents. Express hope that people of vision from China and Britain will carry on the pioneering spirit of openness and cooperation, work hard to break new ground for win-win cooperation, promote the building of an open world economy, and make greater contributions to promoting China-UK friendship and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Expert symposium on China's economic situation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The complex global political and economic situation has continued to influence and impact China's development. The fundamental outlook for China's long-term economic development has not changed. As long as we maintain strategic determination and enhance confidence in development, we have the conditions to promote sustained and healthy economic development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Yohei Kono, president of Japanese Association for the Promotion of International Trade
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For China-Japan relations, upholding fundamental principles means adhering to the principles set out in the four political documents between China and Japan. To break new ground is to build bilateral relations that meet the requirements of the new era based on fundamental principles, remain undisturbed by external distractions, implement the political consensus that China and Japan are cooperative partners rather than threats to each other, and jointly safeguard the hard-won peace and stability in Asia.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Yohei Kono, reported by Global Times
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There has been a series of negative movements from Japan regarding the Taiwan question in recent years. Some people even advocated that 'a Taiwan emergency is a Japanese emergency,' which is absurd and dangerous, and all sectors in Japan should be highly alert.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-Japan-ROK trilateral forum in Qingdao
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Most Americans and Europeans can't tell China, Japan and South Korea apart. No matter how blonde you dye your hair, how sharp you shape your nose, you can never become a European or American, you can never become a Westerner. We must know where our roots lie. We must prosper together, revitalize East Asia, revitalize Asia and benefit the world.

statements.speaker: Huai Jinpeng
statements.context: Press briefing on education and talent development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will allocate more resources on developing talent in areas such as international communications, organisation and law to produce more people who can serve the national agenda. Efforts must be made to guide students in loyalty to the Communist Party. Investment in advanced basic sciences and high-level applied technologies has increased as one of the key challenges China is facing is in technology.

statements.speaker: Zhang Guoqing
statements.context: Meeting on flood prevention and disaster relief at national command headquarters for emergencies
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The critical flood prevention period is approaching and extreme weather is occurring frequently. Efforts must be enhanced to strengthen cross-department collaboration, intensify monitoring and emergency warning measures in key areas, handle disaster relief work well, and ensure a safe flood season.

article_title: Xi & Han Zheng Pitch GCI - Xi's Research Story - Tian Peiyan's Deep-dive into Xi Thought - Chinese Media's Social Responsibility - China-Japan-ROK Forum - Li Shangfu Meets Russian Navy Chief

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: Letter to the third Dialogue on Exchanges and Mutual Learning among Civilizations and the first World Conference of Sinologists, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with all parties to carry forward the common values of peace, development, equity, justice, democracy and freedom, and implement the Global Civilization Initiative to let exchanges prevail over estrangement, mutual learning over clashes, and inclusiveness over cultural superiority so as to advance human civilization.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the third Dialogue on Exchanges and Mutual Learning among Civilizations and the first World Conference of Sinologists, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Civilization Initiative proposed by China reveals the law of exchanges and development among civilizations and points out new prospects for cooperation in human society. It is another vital public good that China has provided to the international community in the new era, following the Global Development Initiative and the Global Security Initiative.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the third Dialogue on Exchanges and Mutual Learning among Civilizations and the first World Conference of Sinologists, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese modernization has enriched and developed a new form of human civilization, opened up a new road for the development of civilizations, and brought new opportunities for closer mutual learning among civilizations. China is ready to work with other countries to hold up the banner of multilateralism and strengthen cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative to inject new impetus into global development and prosperity and chart a new course for modernization.
statements.topic: development, multilateralism, Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at the China-Japan-ROK International Forum for Trilateral Cooperation 2023, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past 20 years and more, China-Japan-ROK trilateral cooperation has grown from scratch to the most influential sub-regional cooperation mechanism in Asia, providing an important driving force for the modernization of the three countries and Asia. China, Japan and the ROK should grasp the trend of the time, acquire wisdom from the past, and firmly maintain the right direction of trilateral cooperation. We should respect each other and live in harmony, adhere to openness and inclusiveness to achieve mutual success, adhere to independence, unity and self-improvement.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at the China-Japan-ROK International Forum for Trilateral Cooperation 2023, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peace, prosperity and revitalization in Asia require the joint efforts of the three parties. Made a five-point proposal including strengthening mutual trust, mutual benefit, connectivity, mutual assistance, and exchanges and mutual learning. Called for collaborating to safeguard regional peace and stability, to create driving forces for economic growth, to advance regional economic integration, to meet common challenges and to foster public support.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at the China-Japan-ROK International Forum for Trilateral Cooperation 2023, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China, Japan and the ROK should eliminate interference, work together, activate the trilateral cooperation and exchange mechanism, and restart trilateral cooperation, so as to jointly revitalize Asia and benefit the world.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Meeting with Commander-in-Chief of the Russian Navy Nikolay Yevmenov in Beijing, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two heads of state have drawn up blueprints for China-Russia relations and their cooperation in various fields. He called for efforts to advance and deepen relations between the two militaries, strengthening navy communications and expanding cooperation in professional fields.
statements.topic: military cooperation, bilateral relations with Russia

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: SCO summit preview, cited in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should continue under the guidance of the 'Shanghai Spirit', work together with one heart, cooperate sincerely, and work together to build a Shanghai Cooperation Organization community of shared destiny, promote the construction of a new type of international relations, and together move toward a world of lasting peace, universal security, common prosperity, openness, inclusiveness, cleanliness, and beauty.
statements.topic: multilateral cooperation, regional security, global governance

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: SCO summit preview, cited in People's Daily article on Xi's engagement with SCO
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: From signing the 'SCO Trade Facilitation Agreement' to proposing the implementation outline for the 'Long-term Good-Neighborliness, Friendship, and Cooperation Treaty among SCO Member States' for the next five years, and from promoting the issuance of strong declarations on safeguarding international energy security, food security, addressing climate change, and maintaining the security, stability, and diversification of supply chains, President Xi Jinping has promoted the continuous enrichment of cooperation in various fields of the SCO and united all parties with a resounding call for close cooperation, confronting challenges, and moving forward hand in hand.
statements.topic: multilateral cooperation, trade, energy security, food security, climate change

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency
statements.context: Report on SCO summit preview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The SCO is not a closed and exclusive 'small circle', but an open and inclusive 'big family'.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the 11th World Peace Forum at Tsinghua University in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has put forward major initiatives including the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative, and Global Civilization Initiative to enrich the concept of building a community with a shared future for humanity and inject positive energy into world peace and development. China is ready to work with other countries to safeguard world peace and security, seek global development and prosperity, advocate exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations, and share the fruits of human development, security, and civilization.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the 11th World Peace Forum at Tsinghua University in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called for upholding independence and mutual respect, supporting all efforts to independently explore the path of democratic development, and respecting the exploration of the path of value realization by people in different countries.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the 11th World Peace Forum at Tsinghua University in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Stressed resolving conflicts through dialogue and consultation, with the international community, especially influential major countries, taking a clear stand to promote peace talks and mediation to build mutual trust, resolve disputes and promote security through dialogue.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the 11th World Peace Forum at Tsinghua University in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Urged firmly upholding and practicing multilateralism to make global governance more just and equitable.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at the 11th World Peace Forum at Tsinghua University in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called on all sides to promote inclusiveness, mutual benefit, and win-win results.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on the new Foreign Relations Law
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports the central role of the UN in international affairs, firmly advocates and practices genuine multilateralism, and firmly upholds the basic norms governing international relations based on the purposes and principles of the UN Charter. China has put forward the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative to address the deficits in peace, development, security and governance that the world is facing today, reflecting China's responsibility as the largest developing country.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on the new Foreign Relations Law
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The law takes a clear-cut stand against all forms of hegemonism and power politics, against any unilateralism, protectionism and bullying, and clearly stipulates the adoption of countermeasures and restrictive legal provisions in response to foreign interference, sanctions and sabotage. This provides a legal basis for China to exercise its legitimate rights against sanctions and interference in accordance with the law and firmly safeguard national interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on the new Foreign Relations Law
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China must persist in promoting the construction of Community of Shared Future for Mankind, promote the high-quality development of BRI, promote the implementation of GDI, GSI and GCI, and deepen and improve the all-round, multi-level, wide-ranging and three-dimensional layout of foreign work.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, global initiatives, diplomacy

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Amina Mohammed, Deputy Secretary-General of the United Nations, in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports the central role of the UN in international affairs and firmly advocates and practices genuine multilateralism. China has put forward the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative to address the deficits in peace, development, security and governance.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Barbados Prime Minister Mia Amor Mottley, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing profound global changes unseen in a century, developing countries should strengthen solidarity and cooperation, practice real multilateralism, oppose the Cold War mentality and camp confrontation, uphold the basic norms of international relations, safeguard international fairness and justice, and promote building a community with a shared future for humanity

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese Prime Minister Pham Minh Chinh, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Vietnam should jointly oppose decoupling and the severing of industrial and supply chains, and oppose politicizing economic, scientific and technological issues. A more just and reasonable international order should be promoted, and a peaceful and stable external environment for the modernization drive of the two countries should be created

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with New Zealand Prime Minister Chris Hipkins, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's current central task is to comprehensively promote the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation with Chinese-style modernization. Only an open China can become a modern China. We will continue to vigorously promote high-level opening up and better protect the rights and interests of foreign investors in accordance with the law

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with New Zealand Prime Minister Chris Hipkins, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should continue to view each other as partners rather than adversaries, opportunities rather than threats. It is necessary to jointly advocate genuine multilateralism and a free trade system and jointly address global challenges such as climate change

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos meeting in Tianjin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The rapid advance of new technologies such as digital technology and artificial intelligence is creating more favorable conditions for economic globalization. The world should not, and cannot return to a state of seclusion or isolation. We should oppose the politicization of economic issues and work together to keep global industrial and supply chains stable and smooth

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos meeting in Tianjin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The invisible barriers put up by some people in recent years are becoming widespread, and pushing the world into division and even confrontation. This is a bigger cause for concern. Different countries, ethnic groups and civilizations need to deepen mutual understanding and strengthen dialogue to bridge differences and expand common ground

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos meeting in Tianjin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Recent years have witnessed repeated rhetoric stoking ideological confrontation, hatred and prejudice, and the resulting acts of encirclement and suppression, and even regional wars and conflicts. Peace is precious and development is never easy

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Entrepreneur dialogue in Tianjin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What the world needs most today is communication and, most importantly, openness and cooperation. China is committed not only to its own development, but also to actively sharing development opportunities with other countries. China is a major country that is open, inclusive and honest

article_title: Xi Meets CYL Leadership - Li Meets Vietnamese PM - NPCSC Meeting - Wang Yi Meets NCUSCR Leadership - Zeng Jixin on China's Mideast Diplomacy - Zhong Sheng on US Prosecution of Chinese Citizens

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with NCUSCR delegation in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The root cause of difficulties in China-US relations lies in the serious deviation in the US side's perception and positioning of China. The US should respect China's legitimate right to development, abide by the one-China principle, safeguard the political foundation of China-US relations, implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state in Bali, meet China halfway, and promote stability and improvement of Sino-US relations.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called 'reducing dependence' and 'de-risking' as proposed by some countries are essentially politicizing and ideologizing economic and trade issues, which violate basic principles of free trade and non-discrimination advocated by the WTO and undermine the authority and effectiveness of the multilateral trading system. Such acts run counter to economic laws, disrupt the security and stability of global industrial and supply chains, and ultimately hinder global economic recovery.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with WTO Director-General Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to work with all parties to support multilateralism and free trade, oppose unilateralism and protectionism, enhance trade and investment liberalization and facilitation, promote world economic recovery, and better respond to global challenges.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On COVID origins-tracing, China believes in the need to respect science and facts. China remains the only country that has invited WHO expert groups more than once to conduct joint SARS-CoV-2 origins study. The US needs to stop politicizing and weaponizing origins-tracing, stop scapegoating others, respond to legitimate concerns, share data on suspected early cases, disclose Fort Detrick and US biological labs information, and offer responsible explanation.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to South Korean Foreign Minister Park Jin's remarks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China values relations with the ROK and remains committed to growing those ties. There has been no change to that basic position. We hope the ROK will work with China to bring bilateral relations back to the track of sound growth.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US Department of Justice indictment of Chinese companies and individuals for alleged fentanyl precursor production is another example of habitual blame-shifting and arbitrary detention. The root cause of the drug problem in the United States lies within its own borders. The US should stop attacking and smearing China, lift sanctions on Chinese anti-drug agencies, stop prosecuting Chinese enterprises and citizens, and release illegally arrested Chinese citizens.

statements.speaker: Zhuang Rongwen
statements.speaker_title: Director of Cyberspace Administration of China
statements.context: Opening speech at World Internet Conference Digital Civilization Nishan Dialogue in Qufu
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the guidance of the Global Civilizational Initiatives, we should seize opportunities of AI development, explore effective governance approaches, and jointly promote the exchange, mutual learning, and harmonious coexistence of human civilization in the era of artificial intelligence, and work together to build a community with a shared future in cyberspace.

article_title: Li Meets Barbados PM - Wang Xiaohong Wants Tougher Policing - Wagner 'Incident' is 'Russia’s Internal Affair' - NZ Should 'Constructively Manage Differences' - NPCSC to Review Patriotic Education Law

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Wagner group incident in Russia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This is Russia's internal affair. As Russia's friendly neighbour and comprehensive strategic partner of coordination for the new era, China supports Russia in maintaining national stability and achieving development and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Prime Minister of Barbados Mia Amor Mottley
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Barbados is a good friend and partner of China in the Caribbean region. Under new circumstances, China is willing to enhance strategic mutual trust with Barbados, deepen cooperation in various fields, build China-Barbados relations into a model of solidarity, cooperation and mutual benefit for developing countries. China is ready to work with Barbados to promote the joint construction of a high-quality Belt and Road, and enhance exchanges and cooperation in economy, trade, culture and other fields. China encourages its enterprises to invest and do business in Barbados, stands ready to import more competitive products from Barbados, and will continue to provide assistance within its capacity for Barbados' economic and social development. China understands the situation and special concerns of developing island countries in coping with climate change and other issues.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese Foreign Minister Bui Thanh Son
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China regards Vietnam as a priority in its neighborhood diplomacy and attaches great importance to the prime minister's visit. The visit will inject new impetus into work to deepen China-Vietnam comprehensive strategic cooperation. Both sides should strengthen strategic communication, accelerate the alignment of development strategies, and promote the greater development of bilateral ties.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Sri Lankan Foreign Minister Ali Sabry
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Sri Lanka have respected and supported each other since establishing diplomatic ties, setting a good example of friendly exchanges and win-win cooperation between countries of different sizes. The two sides should fully implement the important consensus reached by the leaders of both countries, enhance high-level and people-to-people exchanges, and promote the joint construction of a high-quality Belt and Road. China will continue to provide assistance to Sri Lanka's economic and social development and the improvement of people's livelihood to the best of its capacity. In the face of complex and volatile circumstances, China will work with other countries to safeguard regional and world peace, stability and prosperity and build a community with a shared future for humanity.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaolong
statements.context: Article ahead of New Zealand PM Chris Hipkins' visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the establishment of diplomatic relations in 1972, China and New Zealand have always adhered to mutual respect, equal treatment, win-win cooperation, and seeking common ground while reserving differences. The relationship between the two countries has been at the forefront of China's relationship with Western developed countries. For more than 50 years, China-New Zealand relations have maintained healthy and stable development. In 2022, the volume of goods traded between China and New Zealand reached a new high. Both sides are actively exploring cooperation in new energy, electric vehicles, sustainable agriculture, technological innovation, and other fields.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaolong
statements.context: Article ahead of New Zealand PM Chris Hipkins' visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and New Zealand seek common ground while respecting differences and properly handle their differences. While the two countries have differences in social systems, development stages, history and culture, common interests far outweigh differences. Both countries should enhance communication, deepen mutual trust, accommodate each other's core interests and major concerns, engage in dialogue and consultation on an equal footing, and constructively manage differences. Both China and New Zealand pursue an independent foreign policy, support free trade and multilateralism, and oppose unilateralism, protectionism and bullying.

article_title: Li Qiang Meets Macron & Borne & Two Establishments Enter CYL Constitution - China-Pakistan Ties

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron during official visit to France
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China, France, and Europe have their own strengths and need to further strengthen cooperation in traditional areas like nuclear energy, space and aviation, as well as emerging areas like environmental protection, digital economy, artificial intelligence and advanced manufacturing to achieve mutual benefit and win-win results. Chinese enterprises are encouraged to invest in France and French companies are welcomed to share China's development opportunities.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with French President Emmanuel Macron during official visit to France
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and France are permanent members of the UN Security Council and are responsible major countries with a common strategic perspective and view on the overall situation. China is willing to continue strengthening communication and coordination with France in international affairs, support each other's good initiatives, jointly cope with global challenges, and promote world peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with French Prime Minister Elisabeth Borne during official visit to France
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with France to uphold mutual benefits, continuously improve the business environment, expand cooperation in emerging areas, and make the pie of common interests bigger. Both sides should tap into potential for cooperation in areas such as green development, technological innovation and digital trade, help achieve their 'dual carbon' goals, and enhance the quality and efficiency of bilateral economic and trade cooperation.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with French Prime Minister Elisabeth Borne during official visit to France
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to step up cooperation with France on issues such as climate, food and debt, to support each other in international affairs and to jointly implement the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative, so as to contribute to the world's peace and security, stability and prosperity in the long run. China always regards the European Union as an important pole in a multi-polar world. Strengthening cooperation between China and Europe is a strategic choice based on their respective interests, which is not targeted at, dependent on, or subjected to third parties.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with French Prime Minister Elisabeth Borne during official visit to France
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to strengthen macro policy coordination with the EU to create conditions for their long-term and stable cooperation. China hopes the French side will continue to exert its positive influence and encourage Europe to form more objective and rational understandings and policies toward China, so as to intensify 'win-win cooperation' as the main theme between China and the EU.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with President of the European Council Charles Michel during official visit to Paris
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China hopes that the European Union will view its cooperation with China in an objective and rational way and work with China to safeguard the sound environment of the China-EU practical cooperation. This year marks the 20th anniversary of the establishment of the comprehensive strategic partnership between China and the EU. China stands ready to work with the EU to make a new China-EU summit a success and strengthen cooperation in green, economic, trade and digital fields. China is willing to make joint efforts with the EU to enhance the reliability and stability of China-EU economic and trade relations and better achieve mutual benefit and win-win results.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with President of the European Council Charles Michel during official visit to Paris
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is no conflict of fundamental interests between China and the EU. statements.speaker: Li Qiang

China will support Pakistan in accelerating its economic development and enhancing its capacity for sustainable development. statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (via Zhong Sheng commentary)

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world needs a generally stable China-U.S. relationship. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Major-country competition does not represent the trend of the times and cannot solve America's own problems or the challenges facing the world. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China always hopes to see a sound and steady China-U.S. relationship and believes that the two major countries can overcome various difficulties and find the right way to get along based on mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation. statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A choice needs to be made between dialogue and confrontation, and cooperation and conflict. History always moves forward. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Chinese readout reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Relations between China and the United States are at a low point. The root cause is U.S. misperceptions toward China, which has led to misguided China policies. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Chinese readout reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To stabilize China-U.S. relations, the most urgent task is to act on the common understandings reached between the two presidents with real actions. To ensure the steady and long-term growth of China-U.S. relations, the most critical task is to follow the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation as fundamental guidance.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Chinese readout reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Do not project onto China the assumption that a strong country is bound to seek hegemony and do not misjudge China with the beaten path of traditional Western powers. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Chinese readout reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States must stop playing up the so-called 'China threat', lift illegal unilateral sanctions against China, stop suppressing China's scientific and technological advances, and not wantonly interfere in China's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken, Chinese readout reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Safeguarding national unity has always been the core of China's core interests. It is where the future of the Chinese nation lies and the abiding historical mission of the CPC. On the Taiwan question, China has no room for compromise or concession. The United States must earnestly abide by the one-China principle set out in the three China-U.S. joint communiqués, respect China's sovereignty and territorial integrity, and unequivocally oppose 'Taiwan independence'.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Remarks on US Indo-Pacific Strategy, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called 'Indo-Pacific Strategy' is essentially about bringing major-country rivalry to and creating camp-based confrontation in the Asia-Pacific region. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Remarks on US Indo-Pacific Strategy, reported by Xinhua

Hosting this year's APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting is an important opportunity for the U.S. side to rethink and recalibrate its Asia-Pacific policy.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Remarks on US Indo-Pacific Strategy, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with the United States to explore a way for constructive interaction in the Asia-Pacific and hopes that the United States will play its role as the host of APEC and work with China to enable Asia-Pacific cooperation to return to the right direction.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China adheres to an independent foreign policy of peace and a win-win strategy of opening-up. By jointly upholding the principles of mutual respect, seeking common ground while shelving differences, exchanges and mutual learning, as well as win-win cooperation, China stands ready to work with Germany to promote the sound and steady development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides should jointly support economic globalization, oppose decoupling and severing industrial and supply chains, practice true multilateralism, safeguard regional and world peace and stability, and inject more stability, certainty and constructiveness into the world.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German businesses including Siemens, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and others, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Enterprises should be re-put in the driving seat in terms of risk prevention. Risk prevention and cooperation are not opposites. statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German businesses including Siemens, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and others, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Enterprises have the most direct and acute sense of risk and know how to avoid and respond to it. This means refraining from exaggerating the degree of dependence or even simply equating interdependence with insecurity.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German businesses including Siemens, Volkswagen, Mercedes-Benz, BMW, and others, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For some specific problems, all parties should analyze them case by case and jointly prevent and respond to them through consultation and cooperation. Seize the opportunities and make prompt actions to push for more outcomes in cooperation in emerging areas such as innovation and green and low-carbon development, making the pie of the two countries' converging interests even bigger.

statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken in Beijing

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken in Beijing

statements.speaker: Qin Gang

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Honduras to implement the important consensus reached between the two heads of state and work for steady and long-term bilateral relations. China's NPC is willing to carry out multi-level, multi-field and multi-form exchanges and cooperation with the Honduran Congress.

statements.speaker: Li Xi
statements.speaker_title: Secretary of the Central Commission for Discipline Inspection
statements.context: Meeting with visiting President of Honduras, Iris Xiomara Castro Sarmiento, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to strengthen the exchange of governance experience with Honduras, including in anti-corruption and other fields, and strengthen international cooperation on anti-corruption.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference
statements.context: Meeting with Ganesh Prasad Timilsina, Chairman of the National Assembly of Nepal, reported by Xinhua

The CPPCC National Committee is willing to work with the National Assembly of Nepal to implement important consensus reached by leaders of the two countries and contribute to building a closer community of shared future between China and Nepal.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with visiting Palestinian Foreign Minister Riyad Al-Maliki, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Abbas is the first Arab head of state to be hosted by China this year, which speaks to the special friendship between the two countries and China's support for Palestine's just cause. China has always firmly supported the Palestinian people's just cause of restoring their legitimate national rights and will continue to support peace talks between Palestine and Israel.

statements.speaker: Li Hui
statements.speaker_title: China's Special Representative for Eurasian Affairs
statements.context: Article in People's Daily following recent visit to Ukraine, Russia and other European countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Ukrainian issue is objective and fair and has won the support of most countries in the international community. All conflicts can only be resolved through negotiations; the sooner there is a ceasefire and negotiations, the sooner there is hope for peace. China has acted as a responsible major country, upholding an objective and impartial stance and actively promoting peace talks.

statements.speaker: Li Hui
statements.speaker_title: China's Special Representative for Eurasian Affairs
statements.context: Article in People's Daily following recent visit to Ukraine, Russia and other European countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During my visit, I had in-depth exchanges with Ukrainian President Zelensky, Foreign Minister Kuleba, Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov and colleagues from various European countries. All parties appreciate and positively evaluate China's efforts to restore peace and resolve the Ukrainian crisis politically, and expect China to play a greater role.

statements.speaker: Li Hui
statements.speaker_title: China's Special Representative for Eurasian Affairs
statements.context: Article in People's Daily following recent visit to Ukraine, Russia and other European countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has no selfish interests on the Ukrainian issue; it does not engage in the creation of cliques, adding fuel to the fire, or profiteering from the situation. China is willing to continue to work with the international community to stand on the side of peace, dialogue and historical correctness, and contribute to world peace and tranquillity.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to the Forum on Global Human Rights Governance, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At a time of severe challenges facing global human rights governance, China stands for safeguarding human rights with security, respecting the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries, calling on all countries to follow the path of peaceful development, and putting into action the Global Security Initiative. China advocates for promoting human rights with development through the Global Development Initiative. China stands for advancing human rights with cooperation through the Global Civilization Initiative. China has pursued a human rights development path that follows the trend of the times and suits its national conditions.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing on Nord Stream pipeline explosion
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has expressed on multiple occasions that safeguarding the security of vital infrastructure is a common concern. It is critically important to launch an objective, impartial and professional investigation into the explosions. The US has remained silent on this issue, which is surprising given its usual use of hotspot issues for self-promotion. The US owes the international community an explanation.
statements.topic: Nord Stream, infrastructure security, US policy

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing response to South Korean criticism of Chinese Ambassador
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is part of Ambassador Xing Haiming's job to engage extensively with people from various walks of life in South Korea with an aim of increasing understanding, promoting cooperation and advancing China-ROK relations. There is no point in making an issue of this. A sound and steady China-ROK relationship serves the common interests of both sides.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Honduras President Iris Xiomara Castro Sarmiento, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will unswervingly develop China-Honduras friendly relations, firmly support Honduras' economic and social development, and is willing to be a good friend and good partner with Honduras with mutual respect, equality, mutual benefit and common development. China supports Honduras' efforts to safeguard national sovereignty and independence and opposes any external interference in Honduras' internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Honduras President Iris Xiomara Castro Sarmiento, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will promote the early introduction of Honduran specialty products to the Chinese market and is willing to start negotiation process for a free trade agreement at an early date.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with Nepal's National Assembly Chairman Ganesh Prasad Timilsina in Beijing, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Nepal to deepen exchanges and cooperation in various fields and promote the building of an even closer community of shared future between China and Nepal. China firmly supports Nepal in safeguarding independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, and respects the development path chosen by the Nepali government and people.

statements.speaker: Li Shulei
statements.speaker_title: Propaganda Chief (Head of CPC Propaganda Department)
statements.context: Speech at first meeting of China-Central Asia political parties dialogue, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The CPC is willing to work with the political parties of the five Central Asian countries to implement the important consensus reached by President Xi Jinping and the heads of state of the five countries, and promote the building of a China-Central Asian community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of the International Liaison Department of the CPC
statements.context: Speech at first meeting of China-Central Asia political parties dialogue, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with political parties in Central Asian countries to deepen political mutual trust, enhance synergy between the Belt and Road Initiative and the development strategies of Central Asian countries, promote mutual cultural understanding and exchanges, and jointly safeguard regional and global peace, stability and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Wang Dongming
statements.speaker_title: Vice Chair of National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Speech at National Day reception of Russian Embassy in China on June 12, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Russia under the guidance of the consensus reached by the two heads of state to deepen political mutual trust, expand practical cooperation, tighten the emotional bond of generational friendship and make new and important contributions to the development and revitalization of the two countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs press briefing, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US statement reads like a description of the US itself. The US CHIPS and Science Act exemplifies economic coercion. The US abuses state power to suppress companies like Huawei and TikTok. The US has paralyzed WTO dispute settlement by blocking judges' appointments and refuses to comply with WTO rulings. The Inflation Reduction Act represents market-distorting illegal subsidies. The US has over 500,000 people living under modern slavery. The US is a country that tramples on market economy principles and international trade rules.

article_title: Cultivating Pragmatic Work Style - China-Honduras Ties - China-ROK Tensions - A New Era for Philosophy & Social Sciences in China

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Fact-finding trip to Inner Mongolia surveying border management and border troops development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Governing the country requires that one must secure the borders. Border defense work is a major issue in governing the country and safeguarding the country. It is related to national sovereignty and territorial integrity, the overall situation of reform, development and stability and the overall situation of foreign affairs work, and the great cause of building a strong country and the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with South African President Cyril Ramaphosa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and South Africa are both important major developing countries and the two enjoy special friendly relations like brothers. China-South Africa relations are of important strategic significance to safeguarding the common interests of developing countries and guiding China-Africa solidarity and cooperation. China is ready to work with South Africa to upgrade bilateral relations, build a high-level China-South Africa community with a shared future, jointly practice genuine multilateralism, safeguard the common interests of developing countries, and make the international order more just and equitable. China supports South Africa, as the rotating chair, in successfully hosting various BRICS cooperation activities this year.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with South African President Cyril Ramaphosa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Ukraine crisis has been consistent, which is to promote peace talks. China hopes all parties will build up favorable conditions for solving the crisis through dialogue. It is hoped that peace-loving countries worldwide which uphold justice can make a rational voice to promote peace talks.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Attendance at inauguration ceremony of Honduran embassy in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The establishment of diplomatic ties on the basis of the one-China principle has opened a new era of China-Honduras relations. The rapid development of bilateral relations has fully proved that adherence to the one-China principle is recognized by the international community, reflects the trend of the times and the aspiration of the people, and serves the fundamental interests of the two countries and two peoples.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Meeting with Narongphan Jitkaewtae, commander-in-chief of the Royal Thai Army, in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Against the backdrop of the Asia-Pacific currently facing some security challenges, China is willing to jointly maintain regional stability with Thailand and ensure lasting security in the region.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement in response to South Korean protest
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current challenges in Chinese-South Korean relations are 'not caused by China'. It is part of Ambassador Xing's job to have extensive engagement with the ROK government, political parties and people from all walks of life, exchange views on bilateral relations and issues of mutual interest and share China's position and concerns.

statements.speaker: Nong Rong
statements.context: Meeting with South Korean ambassador Chung Jae-ho in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hope South Korea will move in the same direction with China, and work together with the Chinese side to make positive efforts to promote the healthy and stable development of relations between the two countries.

statements.speaker: People's Bank of China

statements.context: Inspection visit to Hohhot, Inner Mongolia on Wednesday and Thursday
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We need to rely on high-level science and technology to be self-reliant and build a new development pattern to overcome scientific and technological difficulties. The purpose of building a large domestic cycle is to ensure the normal operation of the national economy under extreme circumstances, which is not contradictory to participating in the international economic cycle. We will unswervingly open to the outside world at a high level, open our doors to construction and work together to achieve a win-win situation.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Nicholas Lyons, Lord Mayor of the City of London
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is unswervingly expanding its high-level opening-up in various fields, including the financial industry. China is willing to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation with the British financial community and promote the sustained and healthy development of bilateral economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaohong
statements.context: Meeting with South African Police Minister Bheki Cele in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with South Africa to earnestly implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state, strengthen pragmatic cooperation in BRICS Summit security, Belt and Road security, crackdown on transnational crimes and law enforcement capacity building, promote personnel exchanges and cooperation mechanisms at all levels, and push for more development of the China-South Africa comprehensive strategic partnership.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Secretary General of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Studies Centre; Ambassador
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 9
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the new era, the significant improvement in overall national strength has laid a solid foundation for China to play a greater role in international affairs. With the world entering a new period of turbulence and change, China's diplomacy firmly stands on the right side of history and the progress of human civilisation. It maintains strong strategic composure, takes the initiative to adapt to changes, creates new prospects amid global challenges, turns crises into opportunities in world chaos, and resolutely safeguards world peace, promotes unity and cooperation, and firmly defends fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Secretary General of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Studies Centre; Ambassador
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 9
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We have strategically managed relationships with major powers, promoted coordination among major countries, deepened strategic dialogue, and continued to improve the strategic environment for China's peaceful development. We have strengthened the China-Russia comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination for a new era, advanced four major partnerships between China and the EU for peace, growth, reform and civilisation, and built China-US relations featuring mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Secretary General of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Studies Centre; Ambassador
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 9
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We advocate true multilateralism, insist that the fate of the world should be shared by all countries, that international rules should be written by all countries, that global affairs should be governed by all countries, and that the fruits of development should be shared by all countries, and oppose unilateralism, protectionism, hegemonism and power politics.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Secretary General of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Studies Centre; Ambassador
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 9
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of external blackmail, containment, blockade and extreme pressure, we must dare to struggle and be good at struggle, and rely on tenacious struggle to open up new opportunities for the development of the cause of the Party and country. We must firmly grasp the initiative of China's development and security, resolutely counter any wrong actions that infringe on China's sovereignty and interfere in China's internal affairs, take a clear-cut stand against all hegemonism and power politics, and firmly defend national sovereignty, security and development interests.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Secretary General of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Studies Centre; Ambassador
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 9
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Take the initiative to tell China's story well, make China's voice heard, promptly clarify misunderstandings and refute false remarks, and comprehensively expound China's views on development, civilization, security, human rights, ecology, international order and global governance, so as to demonstrate China's contribution to world peace and development, and further enhance the appeal of China's proposals and plans.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Secretary General of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy Studies Centre; Ambassador
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 9
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Adhere to true multilateralism, opposing the practice of building a 'small yards with high walls' and a 'parallel system' and engaging in exclusive 'small circles' and 'cliques.' Participate in groups like the WTO, BRICS, APEC and SCO, strengthening the role of emerging market countries and developing countries in global affairs.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides had candid, constructive and productive communication on improving bilateral relations and managing differences appropriately in accordance with the common understandings between the two presidents reached in Bali last November. China stated its serious position on Taiwan and other major issues of principle, adding that the two sides agreed to maintain communication.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Phone call with ICAO Secretary General Juan Carlos Salazar in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is at the heart of China's core interests, and China's position on Taiwan's participation in ICAO activities is consistent and clear: It must be handled in accordance with the one-China principle. China appreciates the ICAO's correct position on Taiwan-related issues and hopes the ICAO will continue to give China firm support.
