statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Editorial commentary on Xi Jinping's speech on Chinese civilization, Page 1
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese civilization possesses outstanding peacefulnature, fundamentally determining that China has always been a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development, and a defender of international order. China will not impose its own values and political system on others, and will persist in cooperation, refrain from confrontation, and never engage in formation of exclusive cliques or alliances based on political or ideological alignment.
statements.topic: diplomacy, China's role in world affairs

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with German Social Democratic Party delegation led by Lars Klingbeil, reported by Xinhua, Page 1
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China attaches great importance to its relations and cooperation with Germany. It is important for the two major, influential countries to stay true to their original aspiration of cooperation and strengthen dialogue and coordination to bring more stability and certainty into the world. China welcomes more German companies to come to China and will continue to expand market access, strengthen intellectual property rights protection, and foster a market-oriented, law-based and internationalized business environment.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Meeting with Wu Cheng-tien, chairman of Taiwan's New Party, reported by Xinhua, Page 1
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The policies of peaceful reunification and 'one country, two systems' are the best way to realize reunification across the Taiwan Strait. 'Taiwan independence' represents the serious crime of secession that will only bring disaster to the people of Taiwan and will lead nowhere. Efforts must uphold the one-China principle and the 1992 Consensus, give firm support to patriots in Taiwan who desire reunification, take resolute steps to oppose 'Taiwan independence' and external interference, and safeguard peace and stability in the region.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Princess Maha Chakri Sirindhorn of Thailand, Page 1
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Thailand to implement key common understandings between the leaders of the two countries, carry forward the traditional relationship of the two countries as close as one family, jointly build the Belt and Road with high quality, and expand cooperation in various fields.
statements.topic: bilateral relations, Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Li Chunlin
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Director, National Development and Reform Commission
statements.context: Press briefing on unified national market policy, Page 2
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Local governments have cleaned up, abolished, and corrected policies that hinder building a unified market and fair competition. Supporting policies have been introduced in property rights, market access, fair competition and credit. Progress has been made in key areas including full implementation of registration-based IPO system, comprehensive launch of pilot project for rural collective construction land market entry, complete abolition of used car relocation restrictions, and promotion of unified national electricity market system and carbon market.

statements.speaker: Zhu Jianqiao
statements.speaker_title: Director, Comprehensive Planning Department, State Administration for Market Regulation
statements.context: Press briefing on unified national market policy, Page 2
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Market regulatory authorities have fully implemented the fair competition review system. Since 2022, 163,700 new policy measures have been reviewed, 452,000 existing policy measures have been cleared, and 20,400 measures that violated regulations have been repealed, revised, or corrected. 78 administrative monopoly cases have been closed and improper market interventions have been corrected.

statements.speaker: Zhou Qiang
statements.context: Press briefing on unified national market policy, Page 2
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The unified national market being constructed will be a globally oriented and fully open market, providing a better environment and bigger platform for various market entities, including foreign companies. China will appropriately shorten the negative list for foreign investment to further cancel or relax restrictions on market access. It will align with high-standard international economic and trade rules to deepen reforms and steadily advance institutional opening-up. More efforts will be made to better serve foreign companies and create a world-class environment for foreign investment.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press briefing on China-Argentina Belt and Road cooperation, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The cooperation plan signed between China and Argentina is an important step for increasing strategic synergy and practical cooperation between the two countries and will deepen Belt and Road cooperation between China and Latin American and Caribbean countries. This year marks the 10th anniversary of the BRI. Latin America now has 21 countries that have joined Belt and Road cooperation with China. China has been Latin America's second largest trading partner for ten consecutive years. The Belt and Road Initiative will help strengthen China-Latin America relations and open up brighter prospects for cross-Pacific friendship and cooperation.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, bilateral relations, Latin America

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Emmanuel Bonne, diplomatic counselor to French President Macron, reported by Xinhua, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Macron's visit to China in April was a great success and both countries reached strategic consensuses. Both sides should step up implementation and jointly push forward the next important agenda. China appreciates France's independent diplomatic tradition and Europe's more active dialogue and contact with China. As two major forces in the multi-polar process, China and the EU share far more common interests than differences. The two sides should think more about cooperation and less about rivalry and work together to provide more stability for the world. China has always been an important member of the Global South and as the largest developing country is committed to providing assistance to developing countries through South-South cooperation.
statements.topic: bilateral relations with France, multilateralism, global cooperation, Global South

statements.speaker: National Development and Reform Commission
statements.context: Statement on China-Argentina Belt and Road cooperation agreement, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The agreement will deepen cooperation between China and Argentina in infrastructure, energy, economy and trade, as well as finance.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, bilateral relations

article_title: Xi on Building 'Modern Chinese Civilization' - Li Shangfu's Message at Shangri-La Dialogue - Interpreting Xi Thought for the PLA's Future Development

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC, President
statements.context: Speech at meeting on civilization, cultural inheritance and development; visits to China National Archives of Publications and Culture and Chinese Academy of History
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese civilization is highly consistent, exceptionally innovative, characterized by strong uniformity, inclusive, and peaceful in nature. These characteristics determine that China will continue to build world peace, contribute to global development, safeguard the international order, pursue exchanges and mutual learning among civilizations rather than cultural hegemony, and will not impose its own values and political system on others. China is a champion of cooperation, not confrontation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC, President
statements.context: Speech at meeting on civilization, cultural inheritance and development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The peaceful nature of Chinese civilization fundamentally determines that China will not impose its own values and political system on others. China is a champion of cooperation, not confrontation. Never will it dish out favors to acolytes and punishments to opponents.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Asia Pacific faces unprecedented security challenges. Some country has willfully interfered in other countries' internal affairs, frequently resorted to unilateral sanctions and military incursion, incited colour revolutions and proxy wars. Mutual respect should prevail over bullying and hegemony. The essence of mutual respect lies in respecting each other's strategic autonomy and the right to development.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries take a selective approach to rules and international laws. They force their own rules on others and attempt to constrain others with conventions they have not acceded to. Their so-called rules-based international order never tells you what the rules are and who made these rules. It practices exceptionalism and double standards and only serves the interests of a small number of countries.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On issues concerning the Middle East, the Korean Peninsula and Ukraine, China has played a constructive role and made great efforts to cool down situations and facilitate political reconciliation. Meanwhile, some country is expanding military bases, reinforcing military presence, intensifying arms races in the region, transferring nuclear weapon technologies to non-nuclear states—practices designed to make enemies, fuel confrontation and fish in troubled waters.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some big power continues to promote its so-called Indo-Pacific strategy. No strategy should be based on ideological grounds and aim to build exclusive military alliances against imagined threats. The true design of pushing for NATO-like military alliances in the Asia Pacific is to hold countries in the region hostage and play up conflict and confrontation. Such attempts will only plunge the region into a whirlpool of division, disputes and conflicts.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Taiwan: The root cause of tensions across the Taiwan Strait is the DPP authorities soliciting foreign support for independence, and some foreign forces attempting to contain China with Taiwan and interfering in China's internal affairs. If anyone dares to separate Taiwan from China, the Chinese military will not hesitate for a second. We will fear no opponents and resolutely safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity, regardless of any cost.

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On South China Sea: Some countries outside the region exercise their hegemony of navigation in the name of freedom of navigation. They want to muddy the waters so they can rake in profits. Regional countries should stay highly vigilant and firmly reject these acts.
statements.topic: South China Sea, US naval operations

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Speech at Shangri-La Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-US ties are of global significance. A major country should behave like one, not provoke block confrontation for self-interests. China and the US should not forget history and must draw lessons from it. Both countries will benefit from cooperation and lose from confrontation. China seeks to develop a new type of major country relationship with the United States. The US side needs to act with sincerity, match its words with deeds and take concrete actions to stabilize relations and prevent further deterioration.

statements.speaker: People's Daily editorial/commentary
statements.context: Front page commentary on Xi's speech regarding cultural construction
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th Party Congress, the Party Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core has adhered to the guiding position of Marxism in the ideological field, placed cultural construction in an important position, adhered to the standpoint of Chinese culture, inherited Chinese cultural genes, and built a new atmosphere of Chinese culture and injected new vitality into Chinese civilization by maintaining integrity and pursuing innovation.

statements.speaker: CMC Political Works Department, Theory Unit
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on military strategy and readiness
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, China's security situation is increasingly becoming more unstable and uncertain, and the possibility of chaos and war arriving at our doorstep is increasing. The more complicated the situation is, the more we must use the military in a measured and strategic manner. It is necessary to plan and guide military actions from a political perspective and in the overall interests of the country, strengthen coordination between military actions and political and diplomatic actions, and resolutely safeguard the core interests of the country.
statements.topic: military strategy, national security, US-related security concerns

article_title: Wheat Harvest Rush - Ministry of Ecology and Environment Implements Xi Thought Campaign - Klaus Schwab's Praise for Xi - Xi Thought on Diplomacy: Direction of & Successes in China's Foreign Affairs

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Ben Keswick, executive chairman of Jardine Matheson, in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China safeguards and practices true multilateralism and vigorously promotes the implementation of the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative and the Global Civilization Initiative. China is committed to the basic state policy of reform and opening up, and its market with great potential and resilience will bring stability and certainty to global economic recovery and development. China supports multinational companies including Jardine Matheson to achieve better development in China and jointly maintain the stability and smoothness of global industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official reply to US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's comments on de-risking after US-EU Trade and Technology Council ministerial meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is firmly committed to advancing high-level opening-up and providing market-oriented, law-based and internationalized business environment for companies of all countries. China pursues trade, sci-tech and investment cooperation with all countries based on mutual respect and mutual benefit. A country like this is a source of opportunities, not risks. The true risks faced by the world are such practices as stoking bloc confrontation and brewing a new Cold War, wantonly interfering in other countries' internal affairs and causing regional turmoil and chaos, politicizing trade and sci-tech issues and destabilizing global industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Theory Learning Centre of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on study of Xi Jinping's selected works
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It has been clarified that the China-US relationship must adhere to the correct direction of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Theory Learning Centre of the Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on study of Xi Jinping's selected works

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: General Secretary Xi Jinping emphasized 'two sides of Taiwan Strait are like one family'; urged implementation of Xi's important speech on Taiwan; must adhere to one-China principle and 1992 Consensus; resolutely oppose Taiwan independence separatism and interference from external forces; promote cross-strait exchanges and cooperation; Taiwanese friends should grasp development opportunities on mainland and achieve better development

statements.speaker: Li Zhenghong
statements.speaker_title: President of Association of Taiwan Investment Enterprises on the Mainland
statements.context: Speech at ATIEM sixth members' congress meeting, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan enterprise association must clearly adhere to 1992 Consensus, oppose Taiwan independence, unswervingly promote peaceful development of cross-strait relations, advance process of peaceful reunification; guide and assist Taiwanese businessmen to participate in Chinese-style modernization and national rejuvenation

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of Standing Committee of National People's Congress
statements.context: Visit to Senegal, statements reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Senegal's support for Xi's major initiatives; thanks Senegal for invaluable support on Taiwan question and human rights/Xinjiang issues; China ready to expand practical cooperation with Senegal; China follows principles of sincerity, real results, amity and good faith in cooperation with Africa; China never ties cooperation to political considerations nor makes hollow promises
statements.topic: diplomacy, Taiwan, human rights, Africa cooperation

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Tajik President Emomali Rahmon, statements reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China willing to further synergize development strategies with Tajikistan; deepen win-win cooperation; continue promoting high-quality Belt and Road cooperation; deepen cooperation in agriculture, industrial parks, infrastructure; strengthen connectivity and cultural exchanges
statements.topic: diplomacy, Belt and Road Initiative, bilateral cooperation

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: International page commentary on G7 and Japan, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan is hyping up China threat theory as it prepares to host G7 summit; Japan's provocation on Taiwan issue is gross interference in China's internal affairs and blatant challenge to post-war international order; Japan is attempting to use Taiwan issue to hold hostage G7 members; Taiwan's return to China is important part of post-war international order stipulated in Cairo Declaration and Potsdam Proclamation; Japan forgot humiliating history of Plaza Accord; Japan acts as vanguard of US hegemony in Asia-Pacific and vanguard of NATO's Asia-Pacific expansion; Japan is eager to become 'normal country' and use G7 to demonstrate 'major power ambition'; Japan should win trust of Asian neighbors through practical actions rather than empty slogans
statements.topic: Japan, Taiwan, G7, military, post-war order, NATO

article_title: Wang Huning on Enhancing China's Civilisation's Appeal - Guo Jiping on China-Central Asia Ties - G7 'Destroyer of Int'l Order' - Graduate Employment Woes - China-Japan Hotline

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: Meeting of the National Committee of the CPPCC in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Enhancing the dissemination and influence of Chinese civilisation is an important deployment made by the 20th Party Congress. China must build brands and platforms for foreign exchanges, enhance the appeal and communication of China's stories, present a credible, loveable and respectable image of China to the world, and promote exchanges and cooperation among civilisations.

statements.speaker: Li Shulei
statements.context: Meeting of the National Committee of the CPPCC in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to vigorously promote the prosperous development of Chinese culture, continuously enhance the attractiveness of Chinese culture, accelerate the construction of a strategic communication system with distinctive Chinese characteristics, and promote the Global Civilisation Initiative.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Telephone call with Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to open up its market, strengthen intellectual property protection, and welcome more Dutch high-quality products and competitive firms into the Chinese market. China hopes the Netherlands will provide an open, fair and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese firms. Both countries should practice true multilateralism and jointly oppose camp confrontation and the 'new Cold War.'

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with Singapore's Deputy Prime Minister and Minister for Finance Lawrence Wong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two countries should strengthen cooperation under the Belt and Road Initiative, expand cooperation in new areas such as the digital economy and utilization of ocean energy, and maintain the stability and smoothness of global industrial and supply chains. China and Singapore should resist politicization of economic issues.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Guo Jiping article)
statements.context: News article previewing China-Central Asia summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Irrespective of how the international situation changes or how far China develops in the future, China will always be a good neighbour, good partner, good friend, and good brother that Central Asian countries can trust and rely on.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Guo Jiping article)
statements.context: News article previewing China-Central Asia summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the five Central Asian countries stand firm in supporting each other's core interests. China firmly supports Central Asian countries in pursuing a development path that suits their own national conditions. China resolutely opposes external forces engaging in 'colour revolutions' in Central Asia and interference in other countries' internal affairs under the pretext of human rights. Central Asian countries firmly adhere to the one-China principle and resolutely oppose any form of 'Taiwan independence.'

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Telephone conversation with Japanese Defense Minister Yasukazu Hamada
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The establishment of the direct telephone hotline under the maritime and air liaison mechanism is a practical measure that will effectively enrich communication channels between the two defense authorities and help improve crisis management, which is conducive to the maintenance of regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Sierra Leonean Minister of Foreign Affairs David Francis in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Discussion of practical cooperation between China and Sierra Leone.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article on G7 meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The G7, on the instigation of the US and other individual members, has repeatedly and brutally interfered in China's internal affairs and made wild accusations against China. The US insists on containing and suppressing China as an 'imaginary enemy', and enlisting allies to encircle China is its publicly declared strategic goal. The G7 has been reduced to a hegemonic servant of the US.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article on G7 meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The G7 claims to uphold the 'international order based on the rule of law,' but openly challenges the core of the post-war international order by condoning 'Taiwan independence' secessionist activities. This is a naked challenge to the post-war international order. The G7 itself is a destroyer of the international order.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article on G7 meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has long relied on its economic power and financial hegemony to impose illegal unilateral sanctions on other countries. From 2000 to 2021, US foreign sanctions increased by 933 percent. China is a victim of US economic coercion and has always firmly opposed economic coercion by other countries. The US should be condemned for its economic bullying practices rather than the G7 enabling them.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary article on G7 meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has repeatedly generalized the concept of national security, abused export control measures, and intensified restrictions on normal economic and trade cooperation between its enterprises and China. It has influenced normal business decisions and coerced its allies to replicate these practices, seriously violating principles of market economy and fair competition and disrupting the global industrial and supply chains.

article_title: Xi Meets Eritrea’s Afwerki - Understanding Correct View on Political Achievements - Zhong Yin on Building Quality Talent Resources - Wang & Qin Meet Peter Szijjarto

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Eritrea's President Isaias Afwerki, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China views and develops bilateral relations with Eritrea from a strategic and long-term perspective. In face of the current international situation, which is full of instability and uncertainty, a sound China-Eritrea relationship serves common and long-term interests and is of great significance to regional peace and international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Eritrea's President Isaias Afwerki, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Eritrea in safeguarding its sovereignty, security and development interests, and opposes external interference in Eritrea's internal affairs and the imposition of unilateral sanctions.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Eritrea's President Isaias Afwerki, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to share experience with Eritrea on national governance, jointly oppose unilateralism and bullying, and safeguard the common interests of the two countries and other developing countries.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Eritrea's President Isaias Afwerki, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should practice closer coordination in regional and international affairs, stay committed to true multilateralism, resolutely oppose power politics and bullying, and defend the common interests of China and Eritrea and developing countries at large.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Standing Committee Member, National People's Congress
statements.context: Visit to Morocco, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China thanks Morocco for abiding by the one-China principle and providing China with valuable support on issues covering Taiwan, Xinjiang, Tibet, and human rights.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Standing Committee Member, National People's Congress
statements.context: Visit to Morocco, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi Jinping proposed the Global Development Initiative (GDI), the Global Security Initiative (GSI), and the Global Civilization Initiative (GCI), providing China's solutions to development and security problems and promoting the progress of human civilization.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development and growth is a boost for peace forces and an enhancement of global stability factors. China supports European strategic autonomy and is willing to work with Hungary and other EU countries to uphold genuine multilateralism, advance democratization in international relations, and make the global governance system more just and equitable.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to plan bilateral relations from a strategic and long-term perspective, maintain high-level exchanges with Hungary, deepen strategic mutual trust, expand friendly and mutually beneficial cooperation, increase cultural and people-to-people exchanges, firmly support each other's core interests and major concerns, and jointly address various risks and challenges.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is hoped that the European Union (EU) could establish an objective and correct perception of China and uphold a positive and practical policy towards China.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No one is more qualified than the US to be called out for economic coercion. Japan surely knows this best from its experience with the Plaza Accord of the 1980s. The US has been browbeating relevant countries into economic decoupling from China, imposing sci-tech blockade on China, and suppressing Chinese companies. This is not about fair competition, but a serious violation of market principles and WTO rules.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If G7 members truly care about economic security, they should ask the US to stop bludgeoning and curbing other countries in the name of national security, stop bullying others and coercing allies to form exclusive blocs, stop disrupting the security and stability of global industrial and supply chains, and stop dividing the world into two markets and systems, which is the world's No.1 economic threat right now.
statements.topic: trade; economic security; US foreign policy

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We urge the US, Japan and other G7 countries – all members of the club of the rich – not to harm the interests of the many for the selfish interests of the few in the world of nations. We hope they will follow the trend of our times for inclusiveness and openness and think of tangible ways to contribute to world peace, stability and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs, comment on EU's China strategy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China always views its relations with Europe from a strategic height and long-term perspective. We see Europe as a comprehensive strategic partner and follows a Europe policy featuring stability and continuity. We see the EU's perception of China — the triptych of rival, partner and competitor — as self-contradictory. The 'de-risking' rhetoric is based on a false narrative.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs, comment on EU's China strategy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Europe economic and trade cooperation enjoys a sound foundation, fruitful outcomes and enormous potential. The dependencies are mutual and our cooperation is mutually beneficial. China can be an important partner for the EU in the face of risks and challenges. We hope the European side will provide a fair and non-discriminatory business environment for Chinese companies and avoid politicizing economic and trade issues.

article_title: Ding Xuexiang on Employment Challenges - Wang Yi Meets Jake Sullivan - Pushing Back Against the 'Rules-based Order' - US 'Obstructing Mideast's Tide of Reconciliation' Song Tao Meets KMT Vice Chair

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides held candid, in-depth, substantive and constructive discussions on bilateral ties, removing obstacles in China-US relations and stabilizing the relationship from deterioration. Wang fully expounded China's solemn position on the Taiwan question. Both sides agreed to continue to make good use of this strategic communication channel.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with French Minister for Europe and Foreign Affairs Catherine Colonna
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always regarded Europe as a comprehensive strategic partner, consistently and unequivocally supported Europe in strengthening its strategic autonomy. The China-Europe relationship is not targeted at any third party, nor is it subjugated to or controlled by any third party. China stands ready to work with France and other countries to make the pie of cooperation bigger and share development opportunities.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (寰宇平 commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US so-called 'rules-based international order' is actually a cover that the United States is using when it draws up camps internationally and seeks to put pressure on other countries. The US is trying to impose its own will and standards on others, and replace generally accepted international laws with its own 'family rules and regulations' created within a small circle of allies. The essence of this is hegemonism and power politics.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (寰宇平 commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For more than 70 years, the international community has recognised that there is only one system in the world - the international system with the UN as its core; only one order - the international order based on international law; only one set of rules - the basic norms of international relations based on the UN Charter. The 'rules-based international order' that the US is referring to has nothing to do with the international order recognized by the international community. There is no such statement in the UN Charter and no such concept in UN resolutions.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (寰宇平 commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has fashioned the idea of the so-called 'rule-based international order' with the purpose of interpreting and applying international law at will and monopolising the right to define international rules and international order. Any behaviour of any country that impinges on the hegemonic interests of the US can be labelled as 'violating rules' and 'disrupting order'.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (寰宇平 commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has long been self-centred; it complies with international rules when they suit its interests and abandons them when they don't; it enters international institutions when they suit the US and exits when they don't, thereby undermining the international order in the name of maintaining international order. Its real intention is to set up a set of American-style 'family laws and regulations' apart from the existing recognized international system and international order to serve its own hegemonic interests.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (寰宇平 commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called rules-based international order is a tool used by the US to win over allies and create camp confrontation. The US is obsessed with containing and suppressing its chosen 'imaginary enemy', and all countries it defines as 'competitors' are labelled as so-called 'rule breakers' and 'order subverters' without exception.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (寰宇平 commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a 'defender of the international order.' The US narrative of labelling China as a 'challenger' of the order has not impacted the 'objective judgement of the international community.' Opposing hegemonic behaviour, transcending camp opposition, jointly safeguarding the UN Charter, and adhering to sovereign equality and non-interference in internal affairs are not only China's ideas but also the common aspirations of the overwhelming majority of members of the international community.

statements.speaker: Song Tao
statements.speaker_title: Head of Taiwan Work Office of the Central Committee and Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council
statements.context: Meeting with Sean Lien, vice chair of the KMT in Xi'an
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan is China's Taiwan. The resolution of the Taiwan issue is the Chinese people's own business, and should be decided by the Chinese people themselves. We must adhere to the '1992 Consensus', oppose 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities and external interference, maintain peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait, promote the peaceful development of cross-strait relations, advance the great cause of national reunification, and seek the well-being of compatriots on both sides of the strait.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily criticizing US Middle East policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US displeasure with Syria being admitted to the Arab League and its announcement to extend unilateral sanctions against Syria is a product of its 'hegemonic nature' and it has sought to 'provoke division and confrontation' in the Middle East in order 'to profit from it.' The US goes against the trend of history by obstructing the 'tide of reconciliation' in the Middle East.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily criticizing US Middle East policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is to blame for the humanitarian crisis in Syria. The US insists on extending illegal unilateral sanctions against Syria, which fully demonstrates that the US is not ready to remove its hegemonic hand from Syria and fully exposes how hypocritical the US' claim of safeguarding human rights is, placing its hegemony above other countries' sovereignty and human rights.
statements.topic: US sanctions policy, Syria, human rights

article_title: Xi Inspects Xiong’an New Area - The 'Correct View on Political Achievements' - Qin Gang Warns US on Taiwan - Wang Huning: 'Respect, Care & Benefit Taiwan Compatriots' - Railways FAI up 6.3%

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Daily news briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Middle East belongs to the people of the Middle East, and its affairs should be decided by the people of the Middle East independently. Syria's return to the Arab League meets the aspiration of the Arab people. The U.S. needs to respect the aspiration of the people of Middle East countries, stop coercive diplomacy, stop disrupting dialogue and reconciliation processes, and stop manufacturing tension to divide the Middle East.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Daily news briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes the U.S. statement on Taiwan's WHO participation. There is only one China, and Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory. Taiwan's participation in international organizations must be handled in accordance with the one-China principle. The U.S. statement is misguided and misleading and intends to connive with Taiwan independence forces. The Taiwan question is the most important red line between China and the United States that must not be crossed. The U.S. must adhere to the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiques. Any attempt to play the Taiwan card or use Taiwan to contain China will be rejected and will not succeed.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Visit to Germany, meeting with Chancellor Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is common ground between Chinese President Xi Jinping's strategic judgment of 'the world undergoing profound changes unseen in a century' and Chancellor Scholz's 'Zeitenwende' (historic turning point). Facing a world full of turmoil, the international community should strengthen cooperation and join hands to tackle challenges. Strengthening dialogue and cooperation between China and Germany will help inject more stability, certainty and positive energy into the world.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Visit to Germany, meeting with Chancellor Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On the Ukraine issue, China's position is to facilitate talks for peace. The conflict should be ended as quickly as possible, for any delay would only bring more misery. A political solution should be achieved through dialogue, and ways be found for long-term peace and stability in Europe.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Visit to Potsdam Conference site in Germany
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The 1945 Potsdam Conference established the post-WWII international order and is of special historical significance to China. The Potsdam Declaration included the return of Chinese territories, including Taiwan, stolen by Japan. This was achieved by 35 million Chinese soldiers and civilians with their lives and blood. Today, the United States claims to want to maintain the rules-based international order, but has forgotten the Potsdam Declaration it drafted. By supporting and condoning Taiwan independence separatist activities, the U.S. is undermining the post-war international order and damaging China's sovereignty and territorial integrity. The Chinese people will never allow this. We must remember history's warnings: the post-war international order must be maintained. International fairness and justice must be upheld. Engaging in Taiwan independence separatism, challenging international justice and order and moving against the historical trend are doomed to lead to a dead end. China's national reunification must be realized.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: 2023 Taiwan Work Conference in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to completely, accurately and comprehensively implement the Party's overall strategy for solving the Taiwan Province issue in the new era, and firmly grasp the initiative in cross-strait relations. We should adhere to the one-China principle and the 1992 Consensus and promote peaceful development of cross-strait relations. We should uphold the concept of 'one family on both sides of the strait', respect, care for and deliver benefits to Taiwan compatriots, and continue to deepen cross-strait integration and development. We should gradually resume and expand cross-strait exchanges and promote spiritual harmony between compatriots. We must resolutely oppose Taiwan independence separatist activities and interference from external forces, and resolutely defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Visit to Portugal, meetings with President and Prime Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the beginning of this year, China's economy and society have returned to normal and economic growth has picked up, creating greater cooperation opportunities between China and Portugal and other countries. China is committed to developing friendship and cooperation with other countries, promoting the building of a new type of international relations, and expanding converging interests with other countries. China-Portugal and China-Europe relations should focus on win-win cooperation. China is willing to deepen mutually beneficial cooperation with Portugal and Europe to serve respective economic development and contribute to the stability and recovery of the world economy.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Visit to Portugal, meeting with Prime Minister Antonio Costa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Portugal is an excellent window for Chinese companies to enter the European market. The close cooperation between enterprises of the two countries has yielded important results, reflecting the high level of mutually beneficial cooperation. The Chinese side encourages Chinese companies to invest in Portugal and welcomes companies from other countries, including Portugal, to invest and develop in China. On the Ukraine crisis, China's stance is to facilitate talks for peace and will continue to work with the international community to play a constructive role in the political settlement of the crisis.

article_title: Xi & Gig Economy Workers - Foreign Trade Data - Qin Gang's Germany Visit - Preview of China-Central Asia Summit - Japan-ROK Ties - Ministries Implement Xi Thought Campaign

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock in Berlin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Germany are both major countries with global influence and should strengthen dialogue and cooperation. Countries should cooperate rather than confront, and mutually respect rather than finger-point. China and Germany should jointly oppose the 'new Cold War' and 'decoupling economies or severing supply chains.'

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Press briefing following meeting with German Foreign Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan's return to China is an integral part of the post-World War II international order. Any party that sincerely hopes for peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait and is committed to maintaining international order should abide by the one-China principle and resolutely oppose all 'Taiwan independence' acts.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Press briefing following meeting with German Foreign Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not sell weapons to parties involved in the Ukraine crisis and handles the export of dual-use items prudently. Normal exchanges and cooperation between Chinese and Russian enterprises should not be affected. China resolutely opposes long-arm jurisdiction and unilateral sanctions against other countries based on one's own laws, and will take necessary actions to safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese enterprises.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Press briefing response to question about Germany's 'de-risking' policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not export its system, adheres to peaceful development, pursues mutual benefit and win-win cooperation, maintains the international order based on international law, opposes hegemony and bullying, and will never do something like destroying the Nord Stream II pipeline. China exports opportunities rather than crises, cooperation rather than confrontation, stability rather than turbulence, and insurance rather than risks.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Press briefing on Germany's 'de-risking' policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If Europe pursues 'de-risking' as a pretext for de-Sinicization, it means de-opportunizing, de-cooperating, de-stabilizing and de-developing. Both China and Germany/EU should abide by international trade rules and the spirit of contracts, remain mutually open, and refrain from politicizing normal economic, trade and investment cooperation or artificially interfering in markets.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Press briefing on global risks and 'new Cold War'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries are waging a 'new Cold War', undermining international rules, fomenting ideological confrontation, engaging in camp confrontation, 'decoupling and breaking chains', abusing the monopoly position of their currencies to impose long-arm jurisdiction and unilateral sanctions on other countries, and exporting their own inflation and financial crisis. These are the real risks that need to be taken seriously. We must firmly oppose 'decoupling and breaking chains', stay on high alert against a 'new Cold War', and work together to maintain a stable and unimpeded global industrial and supply chain.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian delegation led by Mohammad Bagher Zolghadr
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports countries in the Middle East in upholding strategic independence and taking their destiny into their own hands, and welcomes Syria's return to the Arab League. China will continue to contribute to security and stability in the Middle East and world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Liu Guozhong
statements.context: 2023 China-Pacific Island Countries Agriculture and Fisheries Ministers Meeting in Nanjing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the strategic guidance of leaders of the two sides, China and Pacific island countries have achieved fruitful results in agriculture and fishery cooperation. China stands ready to deepen practical cooperation with Pacific island countries in agriculture and fishery, enhance economic and trade cooperation, strengthen multilateral coordination, jointly boost economic development, and improve people's livelihood.

article_title: Agenda for China-Central Asia Summit - Qin Gang Meets US Ambassador - Li Shangfu Meets Pak Army Chief - Diversification in Trade Settlement & De-Dollarisation

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Sino-US relations are of great significance to both countries and the world. A series of erroneous words and deeds by the US side has undermined the positive momentum of China-US relations. The top priority is to stabilize China-US relations, avoid a downward spiral and prevent accidents. China will adhere to principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US should correct its understanding of China and return to rationality. Cannot talk about communication while continuing to suppress and contain China. The US must respect China's bottom line and red lines, stop undermining China's sovereignty and security interests. Must correctly handle the Taiwan issue, stop hollowing out the one-China principle, and stop supporting Taiwan independence separatist forces.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Must persist in handling accidental incidents in bilateral ties in a calm, professional and pragmatic manner to avoid further shocks to China-US relations. Should promote dialogue and cooperation on the basis of mutual respect and reciprocity.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone conversation with Britain's national security adviser Tim Barrow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is the only major permanent member of the UN Security Council that has not achieved complete reunification. It is a historical fact and global consensus that Taiwan is part of China. Achieving peaceful reunification is the wish of 1.4 billion Chinese people. Britain should continue to abide by the one-China principle, respect China's sovereignty and territorial integrity, and respect China's core interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone conversation with Britain's national security adviser Tim Barrow
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China attaches great importance to relations with Britain. China has noted British willingness to maintain open, constructive, stable relations and reject the idea of a new Cold War or isolating China. Hopes China and Britain can meet halfway, maintain momentum of bilateral exchanges, and properly handle differences.

statements.speaker: Shi Taifeng
statements.speaker_title: Head of United Front Works Department
statements.context: Address at 10th Conference for Friendship of Overseas Chinese Associations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Overseas Chinese possess unique advantage of linking China and international community, serve as important bridge between China and rest of world. Should promote world peace and friendship between China and other countries, global development and win-win cooperation, exchange between civilizations.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Announcement about China-Central Asia Summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi will deliver important speech at summit. Heads of state will review development of China-Central Asia relations and exchange views on mechanism building, cooperation in various fields and major international issues. Militaries should expand new exchange areas, create new cooperation highlights, and work together to safeguard security interests of both countries and the region.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Indian Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar in Goa at SCO Foreign Ministers' meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two most populous developing countries are both at a crucial stage of modernization and should learn from history and handle bilateral relations from a strategic and long-term perspective. China is willing to work with India to carry out bilateral consultation and exchange, enhance dialogue and cooperation under multilateral frameworks, and deepen coordination and collaboration on international and regional issues.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov at SCO Foreign Ministers' meeting in Goa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to join hands with Russia to implement important consensuses reached between heads of state and strengthen strategic communication. China will continue to facilitate talks for peace on Ukraine and stands ready to maintain communication and coordination with Russia to make concrete contributions to a political settlement of the crisis.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Announcement regarding Qin Gang's visit to Pakistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This will be Qin's first visit to Pakistan and an important part of the recent close and frequent interactions between the high levels of China and Pakistan. China and Pakistan are all-weather strategic cooperative partners and ironclad friends. China hopes that this visit will follow through on important common understandings between leaders, further deepen strategic communication and practical cooperation, and promote building an ever closer China-Pakistan community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Foreign Ministry press briefing regarding CIA report
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: According to the report on CIA activities, over the years, the US Central Intelligence Agency has gathered intelligence information from foreign governments, enterprises and citizens, organized and carried out transboundary covert actions, and secretly conducted 'Peaceful Evolution' and 'Color Revolution' around the world. The international community needs to stay on high alert against these moves. The US must take seriously and respond to concerns from the international community, and stop using cyber weapons to carry out espionage and cyber attacks around the world.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Foreign Ministry press briefing on drone attack at Kremlin and Ukraine crisis
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's position on the Ukraine crisis is consistent and clear. All sides need to avoid taking actions that might further escalate the situation. China will continue to work with the international community to play a constructive role for the political settlement of the Ukraine crisis.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.speaker_title: China's Permanent Representative to the United Nations

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hegemonic and bullying practices in the field of science and technology endanger the security and stability of the international production and supply chain, undermine international scientific and technological exchanges and cooperation, and interfere with world economic recovery and development, and the international community should resolutely oppose these. Individual countries have politicized and weaponized scientific and technological issues, engaged in 'decoupling and building walls' and unilateral sanctions, and unreasonably suppressed the legitimate economic and technological development of other countries.

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 17, international page

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 17, international page

statements.topic: US policy, US economy, US domestic affairs

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 17, international page

Western countries following the US in imposing sanctions on Russia have triggered backlash effects with poor economic conditions, severe inflation, and heavy burdens on populations. People worldwide are criticizing the selfish and self-serving hegemonic nature of the US.
statements.topic: US foreign policy, Ukraine, sanctions, hegemony

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 17, international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Provoking confrontation and conflict between China and the US is dangerous and misguided, while promoting win-win cooperation is the right path. China pursues an independent foreign policy of peace and maintains world peace and promotes common development. Observing international relations norms and the three Sino-US joint communiques is key to controlling contradictions and preventing confrontation.

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 17, international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan is the core of China's core interests; it is the basis of the political foundation of China-US relations; and the first red line that cannot be crossed. To get China-US relations out of the current predicament, the US must abandon zero-sum game thinking, put aside its obsession with blocking and containing China, and stop saying and doing things that undermine China-US relations.

statements.speaker: Zheng Zongwen
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily, Page 17, international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will not swallow the bitter fruit that harms its own sovereignty, security and development interests. No one should expect China to do so. The US should stop trying to achieve 'political replenishment' by selling war anxiety and digging pits for China's development.

statements.speaker: Chinese representative
statements.context: Regular meeting of the WTO's Committee on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures in Geneva on May 2

statements.speaker: Chinese representative
statements.context: Regular meeting of the WTO's Committee on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures in Geneva on May 2
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States interprets the 'free trade agreements' arbitrarily, seriously undermining global trade rules, building 'small yards and high walls' in key minerals, and disrupting global supply and industrial chains.

statements.speaker: Chinese representative
statements.context: Regular meeting of the WTO's Committee on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures in Geneva on May 2
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US policies and measures have led to a 'race to the bottom' for electric vehicle subsidies, retarding the green transition of developing members and accelerating the fragmentation of global green economy governance.

statements.speaker: Chinese representative

statements.speaker: Chinese representative
statements.context: Regular meeting of the WTO's Committee on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures in Geneva on May 2

statements.speaker: Chinese representative
statements.context: Regular meeting of the WTO's Committee on Subsidies and Countervailing Measures in Geneva on May 2

China calls on the WTO to strengthen supervision over US violations of WTO rules, and WTO members should jointly safeguard the stability and resilience of the global semiconductor supply and value chains.
statements.topic: US technology policy, semiconductors, WTO compliance, trade rules

China is ready to join hands with Myanmar to build a China-Myanmar community with a shared future and take the lead to implement the Global Development Initiative, Global Security Initiative and Global Civilization Initiative.

For a country that doesn't respect the privacy of allied leaders, it is hardly surprising it would monitor users' private data on social media. The US accuses foreign companies without hard evidence of monitoring and stealing US users' data. What Musk said proves the belief that 'the US either has done or is doing what it accuses you of.' Protecting cyber security is just a pretext the US uses to perpetuate its cyber hegemony.

China hopes all parties in Yemen will put people's interests first, make political decisions, meet each other halfway, and push for visible progress in the Yemeni political process. China calls on all parties to the conflict, especially the Houthis, to maintain calm and restraint, avoid provocative actions that undermine mutual trust and create tensions, and provide good conditions for a political solution.

statements.speaker: Huang Xilian
statements.context: Remarks to media/public
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The announcement of four additional EDCA sites has caused widespread and grave concern among Chinese people. The US intends to take advantage of the new EDCA sites to interfere in the Taiwan Strait situation to serve its geopolitical goals and advance its anti-China agenda at the expense of peace and development of the Philippines and the region. China is the last country that wishes to see conflict over the Strait because people on both sides are Chinese. But we will not renounce the use of force and reserve the option of taking all necessary measures. The Philippines is advised to unequivocally oppose 'Taiwan independence' rather than stoking the fire by offering the US access to military bases near the Taiwan Strait.
statements.topic: Taiwan, US-China relations, EDCA military bases

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Uruguay's Francisco Bustillo Bonasso, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should further consolidate political mutual trust and deepen practical cooperation, and continue to firmly support each other on issues concerning each other's core interests and major concerns, and take China-Uruguay strategic partnership to a new level.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with Boris Kollar, speaker of the Slovak National Council, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, under the Belt and Road Initiative and China-Central and Eastern Europe cooperation frameworks, China and Slovakia have scored positive cooperation outcomes in economy, trade, science and technology, tourism, culture, and interconnectivity. China is willing to work with Slovakia to carry forward, maintain, and develop their traditional friendship. China welcomes Slovak enterprises to expand markets in China and hopes Slovakia provides a fair, just, and unbiased business environment for Chinese companies. China and Slovakia should deepen people-to-people exchanges and join hands in promoting China-CEE cooperation. China respects and supports people of all countries to take development paths suited to their national conditions and is ready to deepen state governance experience exchanges with Slovakia.

statements.speaker: Xinhua (People's Daily reference to commentary)
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary in People's Daily, sixth in series on US and human rights
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US, which is keen on shouting human rights slogans and pointing fingers at other countries' human rights situations, is precisely the biggest saboteur of the international human rights cause and should be seated as the defendant in the courtroom of global human rights. The 20-year war in Afghanistan launched by the US is the main cause of the current difficult situation in Afghanistan. All parties call on the US to immediately lift unilateral sanctions against Afghanistan, immediately return overseas funds belonging to the Afghan people, and stop creating new humanitarian disasters in Afghanistan. American military 'conquest' has not brought peace to Afghanistan. The more the US opposes terrorism in Afghanistan, the more terrorist organizations have increased from single digits 20 years ago to more than 20 today. The US promised to help Afghanistan build a 'democratic and prosperous' country but left its people with nothing but instability and poverty.
statements.topic: human rights, Afghanistan, US foreign policy

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official response to G7 communique, reported by press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We once again urge the G7 to stop maligning and slandering other countries and stop inciting antagonism and confrontation. They need to reflect on their own strategic security policies, earnestly fulfill relevant international arms control obligations, and shoulder their due responsibilities for world peace and security.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.context: United Front seminar in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under Xi Jinping Thought guidance, comprehensively study and implement the spirit of the 20th Party Congress, understand Xi's important thoughts on united front work in the new era, strengthen four consciousnesses and four self-confidences, achieve the two safeguards, and give play to the United Front's role in uniting people's hearts for building a socialist modern country

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with Lao Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Saleumxay Kommasith in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Laos to make the China-Laos Railway more promising, continue to deepen people-to-people and cultural exchanges, jointly safeguard regional prosperity and stability, and push for new achievements in practical cooperation

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Lao Foreign Minister Saleumxay Kommasith in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should implement strategic consensus reached by top leaders, carry forward traditional friendship, deepen political mutual trust, and synergize development strategies. China is ready to work with Laos to uphold ASEAN centrality, uphold open regionalism, safeguard shared home, and create better environment for regional development and revitalization

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with Lao Foreign Minister Saleumxay Kommasith in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work closely with Laos to turn important consensus reached by top leaders into tangible cooperation results, and support Laos in achieving stable development, improving people's livelihood and playing more important role in international and regional arena. The two sides firmly opposed interference in regional affairs by non-regional forces under pretext of Taiwan, South China Sea, human rights, and water resources issues

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Phone conversation with Palestinian Foreign Minister Riyad Al-Maliki
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is highly concerned about recent intensification of Palestinian-Israeli conflict and escalation of tensions. China strongly condemns words and deeds that violate relevant UN resolutions, supports resumption of peace talks between Palestine and Israel as soon as possible on basis of 'two-state solution,' and is willing to play an active role. China always supports strategic autonomy of Middle Eastern countries and is willing to continue to make contributions to peace and stability in the Middle East

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Phone conversation with Israeli Foreign Minister Eli Cohen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China encourages both Israel and Palestine to show political courage and take steps to resume peace talks, and China is ready to provide convenience for this. China is concerned about current tension between Israel and Palestine, and top priority is to bring situation under control and prevent conflict from escalating or getting out of control. All parties should maintain calm and restraint, and stop excessive and provocative words and deeds. Fundamental way out is to resume peace talks and implement 'two-state solution.' Xi Jinping put forward Global Security Initiative, and key to solving Israel-Palestine issue lies in upholding vision of common security. China has no selfish interests on Israel-Palestine issue, only hopes Israel and Palestine can coexist peacefully and safeguard regional peace and stability. Saudi Arabia and Iran recently restored diplomatic relations through dialogue, setting good example. All parties should seize favorable opportunity to promote dialogue and reconciliation, implement Joint Comprehensive Plan of Action on Iranian nuclear issue, and safeguard peace and tranquility in Middle East

statements.speaker: Li Shangfu
statements.context: Visit to Russia, meeting with President Putin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This is my first overseas visit since taking over as minister of defence. I specifically chose Russia to emphasize the special character and strategic importance of our bilateral relations. China is willing to work with Russia to fully implement consensus reached by two heads of state, further strengthen strategic communication between two militaries and bolster multilateral coordination and cooperation so as to make new contributions to safeguarding global and regional security and stability

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US blames China for exporting 'fentanyl precursors' which are in fact only ordinary chemicals sold through normal trade. US is twisting truth, vilifying China's normal trade of ordinary chemicals, trumping up charges and slapping sanctions on Chinese companies and nationals. This is classic case of US bullying and coercion and flagrant defiance of international rule of law. US itself is root cause of its drug problems. With 5% of world's population, US consumes 80% of world's opioids. US still has not permanently scheduled fentanyl-related substances as class. As China and rest of world strengthen control of fentanyl-related substances, fentanyl issue in US has been deteriorating. Instead of working to reduce drug demand at home, strengthen prescription drug management and public awareness, US has resorted to grossly sanctioning other countries to mislead public and deflect blame. US indictment and sanctions against Chinese companies and citizens will add obstacles to China-US counternarcotics cooperation and hurt others as well as US itself. If US truly wants to solve drug problem, it should respect facts, reflect on itself, correct wrongdoing, and stop shifting blame. China will continue to safeguard lawful rights and interests of Chinese companies and individuals

China is willing to work with Brazil to open up a new future for bilateral relations and play a positive and important role in regional and world peace, stability, prosperity and development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is promoting high-quality development and high-level opening to the outside world, and comprehensively promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation with Chinese-style modernization. This will bring more opportunities to all countries in the world, including Brazil. The two sides should maintain regular strategic communication, strengthen exchanges of experience on national governance, and firmly support each other in pursuing development paths that suit their own national conditions.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides need to deepen cooperation and steadily advance major cooperation projects in agriculture, energy, infrastructure, space, aviation, and innovation. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China pledges firm support for Latin American and Caribbean countries to cement peace, stability, independence, solidarity and development. China will work with Brazil to ensure the continued success of the China-CELAC Forum and take cooperation between China and LAC countries to a new level. Facing global changes of a magnitude unseen in a century, China and Brazil are resolved to stand on the right side of history, practice true multilateralism, and work for a more just and equitable international governance system.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will step up strategic coordination with Brazil on global issues of mutual interest in the UN, BRICS, the G20 and other multilateral institutions, and enhance coordination on climate response.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

They appealed to more countries to play a constructive role for a political settlement of the Ukraine crisis.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the establishment of diplomatic ties, the two countries have always been committed to mutual respect, equality, seeking common ground while shelving differences, and pursuing mutual benefit. China-Germany relations have shown strong resilience and made substantial progress in the past three years, which fully demonstrates that different civilizations can coexist with each other and that dialogue, exchanges and cooperation are the mainstream and right path of China-Germany ties.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Germany are partners, not rivals. The two sides should develop their relations independently. China is committed to enhancing high-quality development and high-level opening up, which will provide a larger Chinese market to the world, bringing more development opportunities to all countries including Germany.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to promote all-round exchanges and cooperation with Germany, calling on both sides to jointly prepare for China-Germany inter-governmental consultation and high-level people-to-people dialogue, and activate more than 70 dialogue mechanisms between the two countries.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and Germany are major countries that have a bearing on the world. To meet global challenges together, both countries should uphold the concept of a community with a shared future for humanity and jointly defend multilateralism and the basic norms governing international relations based on the UN Charter. Both sides should oppose decoupling economies or severing supply chains, and Germany should provide a fair, open and non-discriminatory market environment for Chinese enterprises.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Meeting with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock regarding Ukraine crisis
