statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will follow the path of socialism with Chinese characteristics, apply a people-centered development philosophy, remain committed to deepening reform and opening up, remain firm in pursuing an independent foreign policy of peace, and remain committed to promoting the building of a human community with a shared future. China's development marks a growing force for world peace. China will never seek hegemony or expansion.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There are no strategic differences or conflicts of fundamental significance between China and the EU. China does not seek dominance or hegemony. China has never exported and will never export its system. China supports the EU's strategic autonomy and a united and prosperous Europe. The EU should gain an objective and right perception of China, rise above Cold War mentality and ideological antagonism, transcend confrontation of systems, and reject a new Cold War of whatever forms.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is important to properly manage differences between China and Europe. They should maintain communication and coordination in a constructive way. It is essential to respect each other's major concerns and core interests, especially sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity, and refrain from interfering in each other's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Europe is an important partner and beneficiary of China's rapid development. China will continue to pursue high-level opening up. China welcomes the EU's continued participation for win-win results. The two sides should strengthen macroeconomic policy coordination, seek greater complementarity in market, capital and technology, and work together to nurture new growth drivers. Joint efforts are needed to keep industrial and supply chains secure, stable and reliable, reject practices of decoupling and severing supply chains, and oppose attempts to politicize and weaponize exchanges in economy, trade, science and technology.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the EU, both advocates of upholding the international system with the United Nations at its core, can work together to follow true multilateralism, rise to challenges, and safeguard global peace and development. The two sides should lead the global response to climate change and efforts for biodiversity protection, energy and food security, and public health. China welcomes the EU's participation in Belt and Road cooperation and the Global Development Initiative.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel regarding Ukraine crisis
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A political settlement of the Ukraine crisis best serves Europe's interests and the common interests of all countries in Eurasia. Under current circumstances, it is important to prevent an escalation or expansion of the crisis, stay committed to promoting talks for peace, manage the spillovers of the crisis, and watch out for any risk of bloc confrontation. China supports the EU in stepping up mediation efforts and playing a leading role in building a balanced, effective and sustainable security architecture in Europe.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will always remain committed to its basic state policy of opening up. It will continue to foster a market-based and law-based international business environment, and treat all types of companies equally and fairly. China will steadily open its financial sector and encourage more investment from qualified foreign institutional investors, while maintaining domestic financial stability. China will strive to maintain the basic stability of the exchange rate of the renminbi and keep it at a reasonable and balanced level. China is ready to boost cooperation with the European Union on the basis of mutual respect and equality, and handle differences properly to promote sound and steady development of the China-EU comprehensive strategic partnership.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Nuclear weapons must not be used and nuclear wars must not be fought.

statements.speaker: Li Zhanshu
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with EU Council President Charles Michel
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-EU relations are now at a critical period of succession and development. China is ready to work with the EU to implement the consensus reached by leaders of the two sides, uphold mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit, achieve peaceful coexistence and common development, make new progress in the China-EU comprehensive strategic partnership and contribute more to world peace and prosperity. The NPC is ready to conduct exchanges with the European Parliament and the parliaments of EU member states in various forms, at various levels and through multiple channels to provide a legislative guarantee for China-EU practical cooperation.

statements.speaker: Sun Chunlan
statements.context: National Health Commission meeting on epidemic containment measures
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The healthcare and disease control systems of the country had stood the test of the epidemic over the past nearly three years, and effective diagnostic and treatment methods and medicines have been developed. More than 90 percent of the Chinese people have been fully vaccinated and health awareness of the public has been significantly improved. The pathogenicity of the Omicron virus is weakening. All these factors have created the conditions for tweaking the epidemic response measures.

China has not only developed itself, but also benefited the world; a stable, open and prosperous China is always an opportunity for the future development of the world. Chinese-style modernization is based on peaceful development and is different from the old Western modernization, which is capital-centered, polarised, materialistic and based on foreign expansion and plunder.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at APEC CEOs summit in Bangkok

statements.context: Speech at APEC CEOs summit in Bangkok

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China views its relations with Pakistan from a strategic and long-term perspective, and Pakistan has always been a high priority in China's neighborhood diplomacy. China is ready to work with Pakistan to elevate the level of all-round strategic cooperation and elevate their all-weather strategic cooperative partnership.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during state visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to firmly support Pakistan in safeguarding its sovereignty, territorial integrity, development interests and dignity, and in achieving unity, stability, development and prosperity.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during state visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: I am highly concerned about the safety of the Chinese people in Pakistan, and hope that the Pakistan side will provide a reliable and safe environment for Chinese institutions and personnel working on cooperation projects there.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during state visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world, our times and history are changing in ways like never before. Facing a highly uncertain world, both sides should stand on the right side of history, keep up their strong cooperation in multilateral mechanisms, and work closely on major international and regional issues so as to uphold true multilateralism, international fairness and justice and the shared interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif during state visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Make every effort to ensure the safety of Chinese personnel, institutions and projects in Pakistan. China is willing to ensure the smooth operation of flights between the two countries and ensure the healthy and orderly exchanges of bilateral personnel on the premise of doing a good job in pandemic prevention.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Foreign Minister Bilawal Bhutto Zardari during state visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Shehbaz Sharif is the first foreign head of government to visit China since the successful convening of the 20th National Congress of the Communist Party of China, which fully reflects the special friendship between the two countries and the important position Pakistan holds in China's overall diplomacy. China's development is a growing force for world peace and a strong factor for global stability. China will continue to provide assistance to Pakistan in its post-disaster reconstruction work and is ready to work with Pakistan to promote the high-quality development of the China-Pakistan Economic Corridor.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Visit to Singapore
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Development is the CPC's top priority in governing and rejuvenating the country, and China is committed to achieving high-quality development and high-level opening-up. The two countries share common ground on modernization. China welcomes Singapore's positive response to the Global Development Initiative and expects the two sides to translate the consensus into actions and inject strong impetus into regional development.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Letter to 23rd Pacific Basin Nuclear Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Nuclear power is safe, stable and efficient clean energy. The Chinese government firmly supports the active and orderly development of nuclear power and vigorously promoting technological advances and industrial development in this field on the premise of ensuring absolute safety. China is willing to work with other countries to deepen international exchanges and cooperation in nuclear power on the basis of equality and mutual benefit to facilitate the transformation of economic and social development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.context: Closing remarks at CPPCC NC standing committee meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must deeply grasp the milestone significance of 10 years of great changes in the new era, fully understand that the decisive significance of the Two Establishments provide the greatest certainty in dealing with all uncertainties on the new journey. We must resolutely safeguard General Secretary Xi Jinping's position as the core of the Central Committee and the whole party and resolutely safeguard the authority and centralised and unified leadership of the CPC Central Committee.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks at ceremony awarding Friendship Medal to Vietnamese Communist Party General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Vietnam are good neighbors and friends 'connected by mountains and rivers, as close as lips and teeth.' The two countries are like-minded comrades and partners with a shared future. The CPC is willing to work with the CPV to inherit the traditional friendship and jointly lead China-Vietnam relations to achieve greater development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Talks with Vietnamese Communist Party General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world has entered a new period of turbulence and transformation. Socialist countries face a complicated international environment and severe risks and challenges. Never allow anyone to interfere with their progress or any force to shake the institutional foundation of their development. The two sides should adhere to the direction of socialism.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Talks with Vietnamese Communist Party General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China regards ASEAN as a priority in its neighborhood diplomacy and a key region in high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. China looks forward to working with Vietnam to accelerate the building of a peaceful, safe and secure, prosperous, beautiful and amicable home together, and to promote regional economic integration in East Asia.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Talks with Vietnamese Communist Party General Secretary Nguyen Phu Trong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and other socialist countries have succeeded in following the trend of the times and exploring a modernization path in line with their own national conditions, and socialism is becoming more and more vigorous.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Blinken regarding the 20th Party Congress
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should carefully study the report of the 20th CPC National Congress if it really wants to understand China. China's domestic and foreign policies are open and transparent, and its strategic intentions are open and aboveboard.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should stop making conjectures by looking through tinted glasses and should not allow ideological biases to cloud its eyes regarding China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Bringing China-U.S. relations back to the track of stable development not only serves the common interests of China and the United States, but also meets the common expectations of the international community.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should stop containing and suppressing China and refrain from creating new obstacles for bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with US Secretary of State Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has adopted new export control regulations against China and restricted its investment in China, seriously violating free trade rules and gravely undermining China's legitimate rights and interests, and must correct those practices.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Article on study and implementation of 20th Party Congress principles in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In today's world, although many countries are striving for modernization, there are not many that have truly achieved comprehensive modernization. Some developing countries, regardless of their own national conditions, have entirely copied the Western model. No nation in human history has ever become strong and rejuvenated by relying on external forces, copying foreign models, and following in the footsteps of others.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Article on study and implementation of 20th Party Congress principles in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will persist with an independent foreign policy of peace, adhere to mutual respect and equal consultation, bridge differences through dialogue, resolve disputes through negotiation, oppose all forms of hegemonism and power politics.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Article on study and implementation of 20th Party Congress principles in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should not take the path of 'polluting first and treating later.' China will strike a balance between development and protection.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Ambassador to China Nicholas Burns
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-US relations are at a critical juncture. China and the US need to respect each other, live in peace and pursue win-win cooperation. These are fundamental principles China follows in developing relations with the United States. Neither China nor the US can change the other side. The US should stop trying to deal with China from a position of strength, and stop aiming at suppressing and containing China's development.

statements.speaker: Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Official decision on study, publicity and implementation of 20th Party Congress guiding principles
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Our development has entered a period in which strategic opportunities and risks and challenges will co-exist, and uncertainty and unpredictability will remain high. All kinds of 'black swan' and 'grey rhino' incidents could occur at any time. We must strengthen our sense of urgency, adhere to bottom-line thinking, be prepared for danger in times of peace, prepare for a rainy day, and be prepared to withstand the great test of strong winds and even turbulent storms.

statements.speaker: Central Committee of the Communist Party of China
statements.context: Official decision on study, publicity and implementation of 20th Party Congress guiding principles
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In diplomatic work, we should always adhere to the foreign policy objective of safeguarding world peace and promoting common development, devote ourselves to promoting the construction of community of shared future for mankind, firmly pursue an independent foreign policy of peace, develop friendly cooperation with other countries on the basis of the Five Principles of Peaceful Coexistence, adhere to the basic national policy of opening to the outside world, actively participate in the reform and construction of the global governance system, and carry forward the common values of all mankind.

statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the Communist Party of China / President
statements.context: Letter to the National Committee on U.S.-China Relations, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Closer communication and cooperation between China and the United States, both as major countries, will help bring greater stability and certainty to the world, and promote world peace and development. China stands ready to work with the United States to find the right way to get along with each other in the new era on the basis of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, which will benefit not only the two countries but also the whole world. Xi said he hopes those who care for and support China-U.S. relations will continue to play an active role and help bring bilateral relations back to the track of sound and steady development.

statements.context: Speech at the 20th Party Congress

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President and General Secretary of the CPC
statements.context: Speech at the 20th Party Congress
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes protectionism, the erection of 'fences and barriers,' decoupling, disruption of industrial and supply chains, unilateral sanctions and maximum pressure tactics.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President and General Secretary of the CPC
statements.context: Speech at the 20th Party Congress
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A backlash against globalization is rising; and unilateralism and protectionism are mounting. The global economic recovery is sluggish, regional conflicts and disturbances are frequent, and global issues are becoming more acute.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message to Maldivian President on 50th anniversary of diplomatic relations, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two countries have always been respecting and supporting each other, setting a model of equality and mutual benefit between countries of different sizes. In recent years, the two sides have supported and helped each other in times of difficulty, jointly addressed the pandemic, deepened Belt and Road cooperation, maintained and promoted true multilateralism.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter on establishment of Global Sustainable Transport Innovation and Knowledge Center, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Promoting the sustainable development of global transportation and global connectivity is of great significance to ensuring the stability and smooth flow of global logistics supply chains and boosting the development of the world economy. China is ready to work with other countries to make full use of this platform to promote global transportation cooperation, and contribute to advancing the Global Development Initiative, implementing the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development and building a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (via governance record article)
statements.context: Party governance record summary published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: From carrying out economic and trade consultations with a constructive attitude, to carrying out direct dialogue between China and the United States with a sense of responsibility; from decisively taking necessary countermeasures to maintaining strategic determination and doing our own thing well... General Secretary Xi Jinping has led the whole Party and the people of all ethnic groups to carry forward the spirit of not believing in evil spirits and not being afraid of ghosts, resolutely withstood extreme external pressure and containment and carried out the struggle with reason and restraint, not only defending the fundamental interests of the country and the people but also winning the respect and admiration of the international community.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States and some other countries tabled a draft decision on Xinjiang attempting to justify an unauthorized and illegal 'assessment.' Xinjiang-related issues are not human rights issues but are about counter-terrorism, deradicalization and anti-separatism.

statements.speaker: Chen Xu
statements.speaker_title: Head of Chinese Mission to UN in Geneva

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee, President
statements.context: Comments at the 'Forging Ahead in the New Era' exhibition in Beijing Exhibition Hall
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th CPC National Congress in 2012, the CPC Central Committee has united and led the whole Party, the country, and the people in solving many challenging problems, making many achievements, and overcoming many political, economic, ideological, and natural risks. Historic achievements and shifts have taken place in the cause of the Party and the country.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Member of the Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: Comments at the opening of the 'Forging Ahead in the New Era' exhibition
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The decade since the 18th CPC National Congress has been extraordinary and remarkable. The CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core has united and led the entire Party, the military, and all Chinese people in advancing transformative practices and achieving landmark accomplishments. The fundamental reason for historic achievements is the helmsmanship and leadership of General Secretary Xi Jinping and the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era.

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Member of Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: National Day reception
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th CPC National Congress, the CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping at its core has implemented the strategy of national rejuvenation within the context of global changes unseen in a century. It has solved many longstanding problems, brought about important achievements on matters concerning the future, and withstood risks and challenges at home and abroad.

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Member of Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: National Day reception
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's reunification is unstoppable. Seeking 'Taiwan independence' with foreign support will lead nowhere, while using Taiwan to contain China is doomed to fail.

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, Member of Politburo Standing Committee
statements.context: National Day reception
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Implement the principle of 'one country, two systems,' enforce the central government's overall jurisdiction in Hong Kong and Macao SARs, implement the principle of patriots administering Hong Kong and Macao, and support their integration into China's overall development.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Editorial/commentary on the socialist system with Chinese characteristics
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: How could we have made one major innovation after another despite the containment and suppression by anti-China forces in the US and the West? This is inseparable from the governance efficiency of the 'Chinese system.'

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Page 14 article on color revolutions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has engaged in ideological infiltration, supported and cultivated NGOs as its 'pawns', nurtured pro-US elites, and provided support to opposition figures to achieve its strategic objectives of establishing 'Western-style democracy.' These efforts have resulted only in turmoil and missed opportunities for these states.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Page 14 article on color revolutions in Kyrgyzstan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During Kyrgyzstan's parliamentary elections in October 2020, the US Embassy recruited 200 'observers'; during the January 2021 presidential election, the US recruited 1,500 'observers'; in April 2021, the US recruited 3,000 'observers.' These observers collected information on candidates and places, evaluating whether elections met US wishes.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Central Committee's International Liaison Department
statements.context: Call with George Papandreou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Discussed strengthening exchanges, promoting cooperation, addressing global challenges and international and regional issues of common concern.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with EU High Representative Josep Borrell at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the EU, as two major forces in a multi-polar world, should shoulder their due responsibilities, stick to the basic position of being strategic partners, and maintain sound momentum of dialogue and communication. The EU should maintain strategic autonomy and work with China to promote steady growth of bilateral relations

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with EU High Representative Josep Borrell at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should adhere to mutual benefit and win-win cooperation, reject attempts at decoupling or severing supply chains, uphold multilateralism and oppose camp confrontation

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with EU High Representative Josep Borrell at UNGA regarding Ukraine
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Ukraine situation is showing a trend of prolongation and expansion with increasingly severe negative spillover effects. The most pressing task is to bring the conflict to an end. China will neither stand by nor add fuel to the fire, but will continue to play its role in its own way. China supports the EU and major European countries to continue actively mediating and striving for peace

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Climate change dialogue at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Unilateralism, geopolitical games and green barriers should be abandoned. Developed countries should achieve carbon neutrality well ahead of schedule, make room for developing countries to develop, and restore mutual trust between North and South with concrete actions

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian FM Sergey Lavrov at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As permanent members of the UN Security Council and responsible major countries, China and Russia should play their due roles. The two sides should deepen strategic cooperation, advance high-quality practical cooperation, take active part in global governance, work together to meet global challenges, promote a fairer international order, oppose unilateralism and power politics

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian FM Sergey Lavrov at UNGA regarding Ukraine
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to hold an objective and fair stance to promote peace talks. China hopes that related parties will not give up dialogue and will strive to address security concerns through peace talks

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: High-level video dialogue with Japanese business community representatives
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Japan are important neighbors and the world's second and third-largest economies respectively. Maintaining sound and steady development of bilateral ties serves the interests of both sides, promotes well-being of both peoples, and safeguards peace, stability and development of the region and world. The two sides should strive for peaceful and friendly coexistence and push for steady and long-term development of China-Japan relations

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: High-level video dialogue with Japanese business community representatives
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is firmly committed to peaceful development and calls on the two countries to respect each other, treat each other as equals, enhance mutual trust, handle differences properly, jointly maintain a peaceful external environment and stable regional environment

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to International Day of Peace 2022 commemorative event in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At this important historical juncture, I put forward the Global Security Initiative, call on all countries to uphold the common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security concept, respect the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries, abide by the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, and take seriously the legitimate security concerns of all countries. All countries should resolve differences and disputes through dialogue and consultation, shoulder the responsibility of safeguarding peace, follow the path of peaceful development, and work together to build a community with a shared future for humanity.

statements.speaker: Wang Qishan
statements.context: Keynote speech at International Day of Peace 2022 commemorative event
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with the international community to jointly implement the Global Security Initiative. All countries need to practice mutual respect, enhance solidarity and coordination, respect others' national security, sovereignty and development interests, and refrain from interfering in others' internal affairs. We need to work together to improve global governance, firmly oppose hegemony and bullying, practice true multilateralism, safeguard world peace and stability. China will unswervingly follow the path of peaceful development and continue to be a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development and a defender of the international order.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Ministerial Meeting of the Group of Friends of the Global Development Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The group has become an important force for solidarity, coordination and common development. In June, President Xi presided over the High-level Dialogue on Global Development, announced 32 important measures taken by China to implement the GDI, and worked with leaders of other countries to put development back to the center on the international agenda. China is ready to strengthen strategic synergy with UN development agencies, and work with other countries of the Group of Friends to take seven more steps to implement the 2030 Agenda. China will continue to share development opportunities with countries around the world and achieve common progress for all mankind.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Second Middle East Security Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Security Initiative is of great significance to peace and stability in the Middle East as it clearly outlines how to achieve common security for all countries. China is ready to seize the opportunity of implementing the Global Security Initiative and work with Middle Eastern countries and the broader international community to build up the new security framework in the Middle East.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing responding to CSIS question
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We appreciate the experts' objective and fair view of the GDI. Over the past year, the GDI has encouraged the international community to take the issue of development seriously once again. The GDI has put forward a viable pathway, created a cooperation platform, and pooled development resources to accelerate the implementation of the UN 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development. In line with the GDI's spirit of open and inclusive partnership, we welcome partners including developed countries' participation in cooperation under the initiative to jointly bring global development to a new height.

statements.speaker: Chen Yuanfeng
statements.speaker_title: Deputy Director of Taiwan Affairs Office
statements.context: Press conference on Taiwan policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th Party Congress, the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has grasped the historical trend and promoted cross-strait political exchanges on the basis of adhering to the '1992 Consensus' and opposing 'Taiwan independence', and has made historic achievements. In the current environment the goal of national reunification is facing a new situation. Despite that, this is an irreversible historical process, with time, momentum and righteousness of reunification on the side of the Chinese mainland.

statements.speaker: Zhu Fenglian
statements.context: Press conference on Taiwan policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan independence is a dead end and will only put Taiwan Province compatriots in danger. The Taiwan Province issue concerns the core interests of the country and the national feelings of the Chinese people. Attempts by external forces to use the Taiwan Province issue to obstruct China's development and reunification will only end in failure. We are willing to create a broad space for peaceful reunification, but we will never leave any space for any form of Taiwan independence separatist activities. No one should underestimate the Chinese people's strong determination, firm will and strong ability to defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Ma Xiaoguang
statements.context: Press conference on Taiwan policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: After reunification, the specific implementation form of 'one country, two systems' in Taiwan Province will fully consider the actual situation in Taiwan Province, fully absorb opinions and suggestions from people from all sectors on both sides of the strait, and fully consider the interests and feelings of Taiwan Province compatriots. The peaceful reunification of the two sides of the Taiwan Straits in accordance with 'one country, two systems' will bring tangible benefits to Taiwan Province's economic and social development and Taiwan Province compatriots.

statements.speaker: You Quan
statements.context: Handing of Overseas Chinese Contribution Award
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Overseas Chinese talents should unite their patriotism, ambition to strengthen the country and their devotion to serve the country. Hopes for support in regard to key core technologies and chokepoint technologies, accurately implementing the new development concept, building a new development pattern, assisting with high-quality economic development, actively participating in the construction of BRI, helping tell Chinese stories well, promoting exchanges and mutual learning between Chinese and foreign cultures and civilisations, and making contributions to the construction of Community of Shared Future for Mankind.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Henry Kissinger at UNGA sidelines, New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's policy toward the United States has maintained continuity and stability. Xi Jinping has put forward three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation between China and the United States. These are not only the accumulation of 50 years of experience in bilateral relations, but also the basic principles that should be jointly followed in the next step of development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Henry Kissinger at UNGA sidelines, New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: U.S. President Joe Biden has made commitments that the United States does not seek a new Cold War with China; does not aim to change China's system; the revitalization of its alliance is not targeted at China; does not support 'Taiwan independence' and has no intention to seek conflict with China. However, what the United States has done is contrary to these commitments. Out of a wrong perception of China, the United States insists on viewing China as its main rival and a long-term challenge.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Henry Kissinger at UNGA sidelines, New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Kissinger once warned that China-U.S. relations are already in the 'foothills of the Cold War.' The outbreak of a 'new Cold War' between China and the United States will be a disaster not only for China and the United States, but also for the whole world. The U.S. side should return to a rational and practical China policy, return to the right track of the three China-U.S. joint communiques, and maintain the political foundation of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Henry Kissinger at UNGA sidelines, New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The top priority now is to properly manage the Taiwan question, otherwise it will have a subversive impact on China-U.S. relations. U.S. House Speaker Nancy Pelosi's visit to Taiwan, the deliberation of the 'Taiwan Policy Act of 2022' in the U.S. Senate, and remarks on supporting Taiwan's defense have all seriously challenged the three China-U.S. joint communiques and seriously undermined the political foundation of China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Henry Kissinger at UNGA sidelines, New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is China's top wish to realize peaceful reunification, which the Chinese people will do their utmost best to achieve. It must be noted that the more rampant 'Taiwan independence' is, the less likely the peaceful resolution of the Taiwan question would be. The old Chinese saying—'better lose a thousand troops than an inch of land'—best describes the Chinese people's determination and resolution. If the Anti-Secession Law is violated, China will take resolute actions in accordance with the law to safeguard the country's sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Henry Kissinger at UNGA sidelines, New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In order to maintain peace and stability in the Taiwan Straits, the United States should seriously return to the original meaning of one China, and clearly oppose and curb 'Taiwan independence'.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with representatives from National Committee on United States-China Relations, U.S.-China Business Council and United States Chamber of Commerce at UNGA sidelines
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's policy toward the United States is certain. China and the United States have different systems, which are chosen by their own people. The two countries can neither substitute nor defeat one another. The key is that the United States should return to a rational and practical China policy at an early date.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Guo Jiping
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily

The answer is no. Only the path of peaceful development can work. Therefore, China will unswervingly follow the path of peaceful development.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiping
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some Western countries have long regarded democracy as their own 'patent', and they often dictate and interfere in the internal affairs of other countries in the name of 'democracy'. Only by breaking this deliberately created 'democracy monopoly' can the vast number of developing countries find their own democratic development path.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Ambassador and President of China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Opinion article on Global Security Initiative in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is going through a 'profound and complex evolution.' Multi-polarisation, economic globalisation, social informatisation, and cultural diversification are developing in depth. At the same time, the global security situation is becoming increasingly severe. The threats of unilateralism, hegemonism, and power politics are on the rise. Some countries are sticking to the Cold War mentality, engaging in exclusive 'small groups', insisting on provoking group confrontation and deliberately creating contradictions and conflicts.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Ambassador and President of China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Opinion article on Global Security Initiative in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A few countries practice double standards and abuse unilateral sanctions and 'long-arm jurisdiction' to curb the economic and technological development of other countries, which has further aggravated the livelihood difficulties of all countries in the world, especially developing countries. GSI opposes the abuse of unilateral sanctions and 'long-arm jurisdiction', and opposes the generalisation of the concept of national security.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: Ambassador and President of China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Opinion article on Global Security Initiative in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes piecing together 'small circles' to create divisions, and advocates that Asian countries uphold the principles of mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit, and peaceful coexistence, pursue a policy of good-neighbourliness and friendship, and continue to develop and build Asia well.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments on sidelines of East Asia Summit Foreign Ministers' meeting, reported by Xinhua

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
