statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has repeatedly sold arms to Taiwan in serious violation of the one-China principle and the three China-US joint communiques to condone and assist Taiwan independence separatists. The US approach has exposed its sinister intention of arming Taiwan and containing China through Taiwan. The US should stop playing the Taiwan card and stop playing with fire on Taiwan-related issues. Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party authorities should be warned that seeking independence by force will only harm Taiwan compatriots' interests and push them into disaster.
statements.topic: Taiwan, arms sales, separatism, US-China relations

statements.speaker: Zhu Fenglian
statements.speaker_title: Spokeswoman for Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council
statements.context: Official statement on US arms sales to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has repeatedly sold arms to Taiwan in serious violation of the one-China principle and the three China-US joint communiques to condone and assist Taiwan independence separatists. The US approach has exposed its sinister intention of arming Taiwan and containing China through Taiwan. The US should stop playing the Taiwan card and stop playing with fire on Taiwan-related issues.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng column)
statements.context: Editorial analysis in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US Uyghur Forced Labor Prevention Act is not to protect human rights but to implement trade protectionism and eliminate competitors. US politicians want to compete with China in clean energy. The law is a disguised attempt to suppress Xinjiang's competitive advantage and relocate the photovoltaic industry out of China. The US is politicizing economic issues to hinder fair competition. The presumption of guilt regarding Xinjiang products and requirement for enterprises to prove innocence tramples on fair competition principles and WTO rules. The law may aggravate US inflation. The US should deeply reflect on its protectionist and hegemonic behavior, immediately stop political manipulation, and revoke all Xinjiang-related sanctions.
statements.topic: trade, Xinjiang, US policy, protectionism, competition

statements.speaker: Xia Baolong
statements.speaker_title: Director of Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office
statements.context: Comments praising Xi's July 1 speech in Hong Kong
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must resolutely clamp down on all anti-China forces that destabilize Hong Kong and Macau and leave no crack in the process. We must resolutely launch struggles against external forces in the United States and the West. External forces in the United States and the West will not be reconciled and may counter-attack at any time. Hong Kong residents should remain vigilant over destabilizing anti-China forces.
statements.topic: Hong Kong, US interference, anti-China forces

article_title: Xi's Xinjiang Visit - Wang Yi's Chat with Szijjarto - China's 'Resilient Economy' still Key to Global Growth - Dynamic Clearing ≠ Giving up on Economy

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Visit to Xinjiang University
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a unified multiethnic country. Our ethnic theories and policies are sound and effective. We should stay committed to the correct and Chinese way to address ethnic issues. China, a country with ethnic unity, is invincible and will have a bright future, and our Second Centenary Goal is bound to be achieved and so is the rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Visit to Urumqi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xinjiang should develop the core area of the Silk Road Economic Belt, incorporate its regional opening-up strategy into the overall layout of the country's westward opening up, innovate the system for an open economy, speed up the construction of major opening-up corridors.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Visit to home of Uygur resident in Urumqi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Ethnic unity is the lifeline for people of all ethnic groups in China and all ethnic groups in Xinjiang are inseparable members of the family of the Chinese nation. We should value the current stability and unity in China with all 56 ethnic groups standing together.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Visit to Museum of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese civilization is extensive and profound, has a long history stretching back to antiquity, and is composed of outstanding cultures of all its ethnic groups. We should make full and effective use of historical facts, archaeological objects, and cultural heritage on exchanges between various ethnic groups in Xinjiang, to prove that this region has been an integral part of China since ancient times.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Work report hearing in Xinjiang
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: With the overarching goal of Xinjiang work as the focus, efforts must be made to advance the fundamental, basic and long-term imperatives to ensure enduring social stability and long-term security. We must communicate Xinjiang to the world in a multi-level, comprehensive and multi-dimensional manner, do a better job in letting the world see Xinjiang with their own eyes, and tell Xinjiang's stories well.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Ukraine crisis has not only seriously impacted Europe, and its negative spillover effect has also affected the whole world. China is not a party directly related to the issue but it hasn't sat on its hands, neither will it add fuel to the flames. China will consistently and firmly promote dialogue and peace talks.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China cherishes the trust and friendship with Hungary, and appreciates the Hungarian side for always upholding justice in China-related issues, understanding China's just propositions and supporting China in safeguarding its legitimate rights and interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Hungarian Foreign Minister Peter Szijjarto
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China believes that Hungary will continue to uphold an objective and just position, and push the European Union to adopt positive and practical policies towards China.

article_title: Xi in Xinjiang - H1 Economic Data - Li: Foundation for Economic Recovery still Unstable - Beijing Armed Police' Loyalty - Wang Yi on China's Diplomacy - Speed & Precision Key to Dynamic Clearing

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There was a serious misjudgment in the United States' understanding of China, which resulted in deviation of American views on China, its interests and the nature of competition. The US' China policy has deviated from the right path. The US should not view Sino-US relations from the perspective of great power competition or manage affairs through zero-sum game thinking. The US should immediately stop interfering in China's internal affairs and harming China's interests on issues related to Taiwan, Xinjiang, Hong Kong and the maritime domain.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has taken the initiative to issue 'four lists' to the US side; three require the US to eliminate negative factors in the relationship between the two countries, and one is for exploration and promotion of mutually beneficial cooperation. This reflects China's principled and constructive approach. The two sides reached consensus on advancing joint working group discussions to resolve concerns, facilitating diplomatic and consular personnel duties, restarting cultural exchanges, and cooperating on climate change and public health.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US should eliminate 'strategic anxiety' that leads to 'inflation of threats' and abandon zero-sum game thinking. The US should stop a series of wrong practices that damage China-US relations and regional strategic stability. Both countries must effectively manage conflicts and differences, first practicing peaceful coexistence in the Asia-Pacific region and achieving positive interactions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On China-Russia relations: The distortion and smearing of normal Sino-Russian exchanges by the United States is out of thin air and has ulterior motives. China and Russia are committed to building a new type of relationship between major powers based on non-alignment, non-confrontation and non-targeting of third parties.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Australia: The root of difficulties in China-Australia relations is that the previous Australian government treated China as an 'adversary' or threat and adopted irresponsible and reckless words and deeds. China is willing to recalibrate bilateral relations in the spirit of mutual respect. Australia should correct its understanding of China, refrain from hyping up differences, not participate in containment of China, and conduct constructive exchanges with equal respect, calm and pragmatism.
statements.framing: defensive, accusatory toward prior Australian government; constructive toward new government

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Canada: China and Canada are not rivals but partners. China is not a threat but an opportunity. The improvement and development of China-Canada relations requires joint efforts, correct direction, proper management of differences, mutual respect, adherence to independence and self-reliance, and seeking win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Interview on recent foreign travels including East Asia tour, LMC meeting, and G20 meeting in Indonesia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On South Korea: Maintaining and stabilizing China-ROK relations is in the common interests of both sides; otherwise both countries will suffer. The two sides should review the original intention of establishing diplomatic relations, abide by political commitments, focus on mutually beneficial cooperation, eliminate external interference, and promote healthy and stable development of bilateral relations.
statements.topic: diplomacy, bilateral relations with South Korea

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.speaker_title: Head of the International Department of the Communist Party of China Central Committee
statements.context: Second China-Pacific Island Countries Political Leadership Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The CPC is willing to work with political parties in Pacific island countries to strengthen exchanges and mutual learning on country governance, promote pragmatic cooperation in various fields, and build a closer China-Pacific island countries community with a shared future.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily on US policy regarding Xinjiang
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called 'forced labor' in Xinjiang is a big lie woven by anti-China forces in the United States and the West. The US concocted evil laws based on lies, grossly interfered in China's internal affairs, and seriously violated international law and basic norms. The US violates human rights in the name of human rights, violates rules in the name of rules, and tramples on the rule of law under the guise of law. The fundamental purpose is to maintain American hegemony.
statements.topic: US policy on Xinjiang, human rights

article_title: Foreign Trade Data - Employment Situation 'Better' but still 'Daunting' - 'Adhere to Dynamic Clearing' - Liu Jianchao's Nepal Visit - PBOC on Liquidity & Infrastructure Spending

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.context: 14th Straits Forum in Fujian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The people on both sides of the Strait are members of the same family whose blood runs thicker than water. It is the strong backing of the motherland that has enabled Taiwan compatriots to enjoy a better life and have more opportunities for development. Called on Taiwan compatriots to firmly oppose any separatist activities seeking 'Taiwan independence' and seize happiness and dreams into their own hands. Deepening the integrated cross-Strait development is a necessary path to achieving peaceful reunification of the country.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: 14th meeting of the China-Vietnam Steering Committee for Bilateral Cooperation in Nanning
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should strengthen cooperation on climate change, green development, photovoltaic and clean energy. The two sides agreed to properly handle sensitive issues at sea and strive for more tangible outcomes in maritime cooperation.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on China's aid to Afghanistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The manner in which one manages the relationship with Afghanistan is a test of the conscience and sense of responsibility of a major country. The arrival of a Chinese plane carrying relief supplies for the Afghan people at Kabul Airport has drawn widespread attention. The United States is the initiator of the current humanitarian disaster in Afghanistan and has a greater obligation than any other country to provide assistance. However, instead of facing up to its own responsibility, the United States has forcibly frozen the $7 billion in life-saving money for the Afghan people. This banditry by the United States has made the suffering of the Afghan people worse.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Article on US engagement in Middle East)
statements.context: International page article
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has engaged in armed invasions, 'colour revolutions' and unilateral sanctions in the region. In order to maintain its hegemony, the United States, the self-proclaimed 'guardian of human rights', has committed numerous crimes in the Middle East, resulting in humanitarian disasters, causing economic and social turmoil, with hundreds of thousands of people losing their lives and millions becoming refugees. The United States has seriously violated human rights of the people in the Middle East, exposing the true face of 'American-style human rights'.

article_title: Studying 'Governance of China' - Wang Yi's ASEAN Speech - Auto Sales - He Lifeng on Xi's Economic Thought - Li on Work Safety - RMB Loans - Beijing's Consumption Support - Fu Zhenghua Trial

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: National video teleconference held by the Work Safety Committee of China's State Council
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Local governments and related authorities should coordinate development and safety, implement work safety responsibilities and measures at all levels to effectively eliminate grave safety risks. The prevention and resolution of major safety risks should be regarded as a major political responsibility ahead of the 20th Party Congress.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Asia is becoming a model for global governance. The world faces two trends: one advocates open regionalism and true multilateralism with development-first approach; the other pursues Cold War mentality and closed group politics. Asia must choose openness over isolation, cooperation over confrontation. We must never allow geopolitical conflicts and bloc confrontations to extend to Asia, nor sanctions, blockades, and humanitarian crises to occur in Asia.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Security Initiative provides a Chinese solution for bridging the global peace deficit and security dilemma. We must uphold common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security concept, maintain sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries, resolve differences peacefully through dialogue, and safeguard the bottom line of peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Asia faces growing risks to stability of regional industrial and supply chains from threats of decoupling and severing supply chains. We must continue to adhere to development orientation, share development opportunities, jointly safeguard the multilateral trading system based on the WTO, maintain free and open global market, and promote economic integration and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must continue to adhere to independence. Many countries in the region, including ASEAN members, are under pressure to take sides, and the regional strategic environment faces risk of being reshaped by political needs. We must respect each other's sovereignty and core interests, respect ASEAN's integrity, autonomy and leadership, keep the region away from geopolitical calculations and law of the jungle, avoid becoming chess pieces in great power games, and firmly hold our destiny in our own hands.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta - response to question on Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: When the one-China principle is fully recognized, there is peaceful development across the Taiwan Strait. When challenged or undermined, there is tension. The current tension is caused by Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party abandoning the 1992 Consensus and pursuing 'Taiwan independence'. The US is constantly distorting and hollowing out the one-China principle, attempting to play the 'Taiwan card' and interfering with China's development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta - response on Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The true status quo is that Taiwan is part of China and China's sovereignty and territory have never been divided. The Taiwan question is the core of China's core interests. No individual, force or country should harbor illusions of separating Taiwan from China. The one-China principle is a key cornerstone of China's diplomatic relations and integral to the post-WWII international order.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta - response on Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: All countries should fully understand the harm of 'Taiwan independence' and work with China to safeguard the one-China principle. The US has repeatedly stressed safeguarding every country's sovereignty and territorial integrity. China's sovereignty and territorial integrity on the Taiwan issue should also be respected and safeguarded, which tests the international credibility of the United States.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta - comment on meeting with US Secretary of State
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: When meeting with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken in Bali, I suggested that China and the US explore establishing rules for healthy interactions in Asia-Pacific to practice open regionalism. The core elements are supporting ASEAN's central position, maintaining existing regional cooperation framework, respecting legitimate rights and interests of both sides, and not taking hostility or containment as purpose.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta - comment on meeting with US Secretary of State
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It remains to be seen how the US side will respond. This will test whether the United States can let go of its hegemonic mentality, overcome the Cold War mentality, abandon zero-sum logic, and truly play a constructive role in peace and prosperity in the Asia-Pacific region.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to support ASEAN centrality and promote solidarity and cooperation. China firmly supports ASEAN's role in the 'driver's seat', supports ASEAN community-building, and supports the ASEAN-centered regional cooperation architecture. China will support ASEAN's efforts in building a nuclear-weapon-free zone.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to firmly pursue its open strategy for development and promote regional economic integration. China will speed up import of $150 billion of agricultural products from ASEAN and encourage more Chinese enterprises to make ASEAN their first investment destination. China is ready to launch a new round of upgrade of the China-ASEAN Free Trade Area and implement RCEP across the board.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at ASEAN Secretariat in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is determined to join the Comprehensive and Progressive Trans-Pacific Partnership and Digital Economy Partnership Agreement. China is ready to strengthen digital connectivity, explore cooperation on low-carbon, circular and green economy, and advance barrier-and discrimination-free scientific and technological innovation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Indonesian President Joko Widodo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China congratulates Indonesia on successfully hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Bali, which highlighted Indonesia's significant role as a representative of major developing countries and emerging economies and sent a positive signal of tackling global challenges in solidarity. China will fully support Indonesia in hosting the G20 summit and jointly bring Asia's role into play.

statements.speaker: Xue Bing
statements.speaker_title: Special Envoy for the Horn of Africa Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: First China-Horn of Africa Peace, Good Governance and Development Conference in Ethiopia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China wants a more important role not only in trade and investments but also in the area of peace and development. This is the first time for China to play a role in the area of security. Beijing will provide assistance in kind, in peacekeeping, cooperate in law enforcement and speed up assistance of criminal investigation lab equipment to countries in the region.

article_title: Li's Fujian Visit - China-DPRK Treaty Anniversary - Human Rights Diplomacy - Special Page on Chinese-style Modernisation - Criticising US' 'Unilateral Sanctions'

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to opening ceremony of Italian cultural exhibition in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Italy are outstanding representatives of Eastern and Western civilizations. China is willing to work with the international community to promote equality, mutual learning, dialogue, and inclusiveness among civilizations, to replace estrangement with exchange, clashes with mutual learning, superiority with coexistence, and to build a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Lead report on international page, July 11, 2022 edition
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US has instigated the protracted conflict between Russia and Ukraine, and wooed allies to continue to strengthen sanctions against Russia, causing massive adverse impact on global energy, finance, food, and industrial chains. The US' wanton suppression of other countries through unilateral sanctions has aroused dissatisfaction and criticism from many parties, with the entire international community having to pay for the bullying behaviour of the US.

article_title: Feng Zhongping on NATO & Asia-Pacific - Li: 'Recovery at Critical Point' - Wang Yi meets Jaishankar & Lavrov - Wang's 3 Concerns on Ukraine War - Boosting Auto Consumption

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Indian Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar in Bali at G20 meeting sidelines
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes the act of taking the opportunity to incite Cold War thinking, hyping up bloc confrontation, and creating a 'new Cold War.' The world values unity rather than division, and what is needed is dialogue rather than confrontation. China will continue to unswervingly stand on the right side of history and on the side of promoting peace talks.
statements.topic: US-China relations, Ukraine, US containment strategy

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Indian Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar in Bali at G20 meeting sidelines
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes the practice of double standards that undermine China's sovereignty and territorial integrity. Some countries emphasize the principle of sovereignty on the Ukraine issue, but keep challenging China's sovereignty and the one-China principle on the Taiwan question, and even deliberately create tensions in the Taiwan Strait, which is obviously a blatant double standard. China rejects any attempt to equate the Ukraine crisis with the Taiwan question, noting that China will firmly defend its core interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Indian Foreign Minister S. Jaishankar in Bali at G20 meeting sidelines
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes any act to undermine other countries' legitimate right to development. Some countries have used the Ukraine crisis as an excuse to abuse unilateral sanctions on China and other countries, which is neither justified nor legal. Such actions undermine normal state-to-state exchanges, violate the prevailing rules of international trade, and lead to further complication and escalation of the Ukraine crisis.
statements.topic: US sanctions, economic policy, international law

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov in Bali
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the realities of current international politics, will countries choose to pursue power politics and hegemony or promote the process toward a multi-polar world? Will they truly uphold international order with the United Nations at its core or follow rules made by a handful of countries according to their own standards? 'As time goes by, more and more countries will have a clearer view of this and make the right choice.'

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Symposium with leading officials of five coastal provincial regions (Fujian, Shanghai, Jiangsu, Zhejiang, Guangdong)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economic operation has been through an unusual journey since the start of this year. The foundation for recovery is still unstable and arduous efforts will be required to stabilise the economy. Development is the foundation and key to solve all problems in China. Under the guidance of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, we must fully implement the new development concept, efficiently coordinate epidemic prevention and control and economic and social development, give full play to the initiative of the central and local governments, coordinate the implementation of macro policies and deepen reforms, help market players recover and enhance their vitality, and strive to stabilise employment and prices.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Symposium with leading officials of five coastal provincial regions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economic recovery is at a critical point now. The five provinces and cities along the southeast coast account for more than one-third of the country's economic volume, nearly 40% of fiscal revenue, and nearly 80% of the local governments' net contribution to the central government, which supports the national financial resources and the central government's transfer payments to the central and western regions. It is necessary to continue to take the lead in national development and economic stability, and play a major role in safeguarding national financial resources. Efforts must be made to further unclog bottlenecks in industrial and supply chains and steer the economy back on track as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Symposium with leading officials of five coastal provincial regions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Li underlined the significance of opening-up to China's economic and social development, pledging to remain committed to expanding opening-up. China will continue to promote reform and development through opening-up, stabilize foreign trade and foreign investment, and better participate in international competition and cooperation through high-level opening-up.
statements.topic: China's trade and investment policy, opening-up

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of Institute of European Studies at Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The continuous expansion of NATO in Europe has led to the Ukraine crisis. Now, this military organisation is trying to further itself beyond the territory stipulated in its convention and provoke group confrontation in the Asia-Pacific region, which is bound to create greater risks to regional and global security.
statements.topic: NATO expansion, US military strategy, Asia-Pacific security

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of Institute of European Studies at Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO claims to be a defensive organisation, but it has repeatedly violated international law and wantonly waged war against sovereign countries. When NATO, led by the United States, launches wars abroad, it has often used the banner of 'humanitarianism', but its acts of war have led to serious humanitarian disasters in other countries.
statements.topic: US military interventions, international law, NATO actions

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of Institute of European Studies at Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO has 'suddenly' again assumed a higher profile and expressed the intention to continue its external expansion. While this seems related to the 'sudden change in the European security situation caused by the Ukraine crisis, but fundamentally, it is because the United States has intensified its demands from NATO and is more eager to use what is the world's largest military bloc in order to further its global strategy and maintain its hegemonic position.'
statements.topic: US hegemony, NATO strategy, US global containment

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of Institute of European Studies at Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, the US has identified China as a 'strategic competitor.' The current administration is more keen on wooing allies 'when containing and suppressing China' and is also keen on leveraging NATO for this purpose. Since last year, NATO has escalated its hype about 'China Challenge' and sought to exert joint pressure on China, which is indicative of the strategic intention of the United States. During the NATO summit in Madrid, the United States also sought to promote a 'convergence' of the so-called alliance mechanism established by NATO and the United States in the Asia-Pacific region, in an attempt to replicate the template to incite group confrontation in the Asia-Pacific region. This further highlights the US' strategic plot against China.
statements.topic: US containment strategy against China, NATO, US-China relations

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of Institute of European Studies at Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The crisis in Ukraine has not yet subsided, and the United States has encouraged NATO to extend its tentacles to the Asia-Pacific region. This is bound to pose a threat to regional stability and development.
statements.topic: US military strategy, Asia-Pacific security, US hegemony

article_title: Liu Jieyi on Taiwan Policy - Wang Yi in Philippines - Shenzhen's New Smart Cars Regulation - Environmental Inspections - State Council on Budget Audits

statements.speaker: Li Zhanshu
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the National People's Congress Standing Committee
statements.context: Chat with Tanzila Narbayeva, chairperson of the Senate of Uzbekistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Further enhancing political mutual trust and strengthening mutual support on issues concerning each other's core interests and major concerns is necessary for the development of China-Uzbekistan relations. Uzbekistan has consistently supported China's stand on issues related to Taiwan, Hong Kong, Xinjiang and Tibet, and China appreciates that. China will firmly support Uzbekistan in pursuing a development path suited to its national conditions and in efforts to safeguard national sovereignty, independence and territorial integrity. China is ready to work with Uzbekistan to implement the Global Security Initiative.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Visit to the Philippines and meetings with President Ferdinand Romualdez Marcos and Foreign Secretary Luis Enrique Manalo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Philippines relations are at a new starting point and China is ready to work with the Philippine side to keep the general direction of friendship and cooperation. Both sides remain committed to becoming good neighbors that help each other, good relatives that share mutual understanding and close bonds, and good partners that pursue cooperation and win-win results. China is willing to engage with the Philippines to conduct cooperation in four key areas: agriculture, infrastructure, energy, cultural and people-to-people exchanges. Cooperation between China and the Philippines far outweighs their maritime differences, and any difference between the two countries cannot define their relations, nor will it hinder their cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Philippine Foreign Secretary Luis Enrique Manalo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should always properly handle maritime issues from a strategic and overarching perspective, giving the issues a proper position in bilateral relations. The two sides should work to steadily advance joint development in the South China Sea, accelerate consultations on the Code of Conduct in the South China Sea, and expand maritime cooperation to increase mutual benefit and win-win results.

statements.speaker: Liu Jieyi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Party has comprehensively promoted innovation in the theory and practice of Taiwan work and continuously strengthened the momentum towards complete reunification of the motherland. We must deeply study and implement the new era Party's overall strategy for solving the Taiwan issue and strive to advance the process of national reunification.

statements.speaker: Liu Jieyi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No individual or force can stop the historical trend of building a strong country, national rejuvenation, and cross-strait reunification. Time, momentum, and justice when it comes to addressing the Taiwan issue have always been on the side of the forces that advocate reunification. Resolving the Taiwan issue and realizing the reunification of the motherland is an inevitable requirement for realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation in the new era.

statements.speaker: Liu Jieyi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peaceful reunification and one country, two systems is the basic policy for resolving the Taiwan issue and the best way to achieve national reunification. We are willing to strive for the prospect of peaceful reunification with the utmost sincerity and best efforts and actively explore the 'two systems' plan for Taiwan. However, we do not promise to renounce the use of force and reserve the option of taking all necessary measures, with the aim of safeguarding the prospect of peaceful reunification of the motherland and the fundamental interests of the Chinese nation.

statements.speaker: Liu Jieyi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan issue is China's internal affair, and no external interference is allowed. We will resolutely defend national sovereignty, security and development interests, and will never allow any individual, organization, or political party to separate any piece of Chinese territory from China at any time and in any form. We will resolutely crack down on Taiwan independence separatist acts and severely punish Taiwan independence diehards, according to law. We resolutely counter external forces playing the 'Taiwan card' and resolutely oppose any external interference.

statements.speaker: Liu Jianchao
statements.context: Chat with Le Hoai Trung, chief of the Communist Party of Vietnam Central Committee's Commission for External Relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Spoke highly of Vietnam's achievements in Party building, socio-economic development, and anti-corruption work. Agreed to continue realizing the common perceptions of high-ranking leaders of the two Parties and countries and work closely to contribute to promoting the implementation of bilateral cooperation plans.

article_title: Xi & Environmental Inspections - Li's Requirements from Officials - Tax Easing at RMB 2.58 tln - Yang Jiechi on 4-nation Visit - Wang Yi in Thailand - Subsistence & Development Rights - China-US Talks

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to Algerian President on 60th anniversary of Algerian War of Independence, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese government and Chinese people provided support and assistance to Algeria's independence revolution. The two countries have forged profound friendship. Political mutual trust has been strengthened continuously and bilateral practical cooperation has been fruitful. Xi highly values China-Algeria relations and stands ready to work together to push forward bilateral communication and cooperation within the Belt and Road Initiative framework.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: People's Daily article on ecological civilization construction
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We develop human rights not based on the standard proposed by the West. Regardless of the stage of development, our human rights cause must be developed in accordance with our national conditions and people's requirements. It is good to achieve the goals and levels we have set. There is no need to follow the West, and we do not need the West to judge.

statements.speaker: Liu He
statements.context: Video conversation with U.S. Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides had pragmatic and candid exchange on macroeconomic situation and global industrial and supply chain stability. Exchanges were constructive. Both sides agree it is significant to strengthen macro-policy communication and coordination between China and the United States. Jointly maintaining global industrial and supply chain stability is in the interests of both countries and the world. Chinese side expressed concern about lifting of additional tariffs on China, sanctions, and fair treatment of Chinese enterprises.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Visit to Thailand, meeting with Thai PM and Deputy PM/Foreign Minister, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Thailand have witnessed healthy and stable development of relations, which benefits from strategic guidance of leaders, traditional friendship between countries, and firm political trust. The two sides agreed to set joint construction of China-Thailand community with shared future as goal and vision. Both sides agreed to work towards early opening of China-Laos-Thailand railway. Both sides agreed to jointly safeguard cyber security. Both sides will work for positive results at APEC meeting later this year.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.context: Interview on visit to Pakistan, UAE, Zimbabwe and Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Pakistan: China and Pakistan agreed to continue to firmly support each other in safeguarding national sovereignty, security and territorial integrity. Chinese side willing to expand import of Pakistani products and smooth industrial supply chains. Both will fight against all forms of terrorism. On regional issues and development: Developing countries are unanimously opposed to hegemonism, power politics, interference in internal affairs and racial discrimination. They resist replacement of basic norms of international relations by unilaterally-defined rules by few countries.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.context: Interview on visit to Pakistan, UAE, Zimbabwe and Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding US actions: At the critical juncture of pandemic fight and global economic recovery, a few countries have clung to ideological prejudices and engaged in geopolitical machinations in the name of democracy and aid. They have suppressed countries adhering to independent development path. This is contrary to the trend of times and will of countries and people seeking peace and promoting development, and will inevitably fail.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.context: Interview on visit to Pakistan, UAE, Zimbabwe and Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Global Security Initiative: It offers a new security path featuring dialogue rather than confrontation, partnership rather than alliance, and win-win rather than zero-sum engagement. Developing countries should not be victims of international crises. China willing to work with other developing countries to promote implementation of GSI and build global security community so peace illuminates the world.

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Supreme People's Court
statements.context: Article on theory page of People's Daily on rule of law construction
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since 18th Party Congress, Xi Jinping's thought on rule of law has led rule of law construction in China. Party's leadership in comprehensively governing country by law has become increasingly stronger. Overall pattern of comprehensively governing country by law has basically taken shape. System of socialist rule of law with Chinese characteristics continuously improved. Solid progress made in building country, government and society governed by law.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Comment confirming meeting between US Secretary of State and Wang Yi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US Secretary of State Antony Blinken and Wang Yi will meet in Bali during the G20 meeting.

statements.context: Congratulatory letter to 'Global Development: Common Mission and Contributions' Think Tank & Media Forum in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As the world enters a new period of turbulence and transformation, promoting development has become a major topic facing humanity. China proposes the Global Development Initiative and stands ready to work with other countries in upholding people-centered approach, pursuing inclusiveness and benefits for all, innovation-driven development and harmony between human and nature.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments at Lancang-Mekong Cooperation Foreign Ministers' meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Work together to build a high-quality Belt and Road demonstration zone, a pilot zone for the Global Development Initiative, and an experimental zone for Global Security Initiative.

statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese Foreign Minister Bui Thanh Son
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two foreign ministers exchanged views on the South China Sea issue, agreeing to move forward the process of the Code of Conduct in the South China Sea, adhere to consensus reached between leaderships, handle differences properly and boost maritime cooperation.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of Central Committee's Office of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Visit to Mozambique, meeting with President Filipe Nyusi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Mozambique in exploring a development path suited to its national conditions and in safeguarding national security and stability. China is ready to conduct all-round exchanges with Mozambique, further deepen political mutual trust, support each other on issues concerning each other's core interests and major concerns.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Comments on BRICS agenda
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to advance the BRICS agenda this year as planned. We plan to hold about 80 meetings and other events. China looks forward to working hand in hand with fellow BRICS countries to act on outcomes and common understandings reached at the Summit, further consolidate BRICS strategic partnership, deepen practical cooperation across the board.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on NATO summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO should immediately cease its groundless accusations and provocative remarks against China, abandon the outdated Cold War mentality and zero-sum game concept, and abandon its dangerous actions of disrupting Europe and the Asia-Pacific.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on NATO summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The recently concluded NATO summit issued a so-called new 'strategic concept' document, wantonly distorting China's domestic and foreign policies, claiming China poses a challenge to NATO's interests, security and values. NATO has fabricated and disseminated China-related lies and tried to exaggerate the 'China challenge'. This is a weak effort by the United States to seek excuses to push NATO to extend its tentacles to the Asia-Pacific region.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on NATO summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has never initiated a war, invaded an inch of other countries' territory, interfered in other countries' internal affairs, exported ideology, engaged in 'long-arm jurisdiction', unilateral sanctions and economic coercion. The ever-growing China brings to the world a great opportunity for peaceful development, not a 'systemic challenge' as imagined by NATO.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on NATO summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current US administration has inherited the erroneous policies of the previous administration, continued to regard China as a 'strategic competitor', and formed cliques everywhere to contain and suppress China. Since NATO has positioned China as a 'systemic challenge', China has to pay close attention to this and coordinate its response. China will resolutely and forcefully fight back against any act that violates its legitimate interests.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on NATO summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current US administration's attempt to disrupt the Asia-Pacific region is packaged as maintaining the 'international order' and defending 'values'. This is simply the same old trick. America's attempt to encourage its allies to gang up on China is futile.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission
statements.context: Visit to Zimbabwe, meeting with President Emmerson Mnangagwa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Zimbabwe's important role in promoting China-Africa cooperation on the Belt and Road Initiative and stands ready to further strengthen all-dimensional exchanges with Zimbabwe. China is ready to provide more support for Zimbabwe's economic and social development. Instability, uncertainty and insecurity are prominent in the current international situation. China recently held the High-Level Dialogue on Global Development in the form of BRICS Plus, sending a positive signal for emerging markets and developing countries. China is ready to fully coordinate its position with Zimbabwe on multilateral affairs, jointly uphold the international system with the United Nations at its core and the international order based on international law, and make the global governance system more just and equitable.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission
statements.context: Visit to UAE
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports the UAE in safeguarding its national sovereignty and security, while resolutely opposing any interference in the Gulf country's internal affairs. China highly appreciates the UAE's support for the China-proposed Global Development Initiative and Global Security Initiative, and is willing to deepen cooperation with the UAE under the two major initiatives, aiming to make positive contributions to lasting world peace and long-term development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Visit to Cambodia, meeting with Cambodian Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Prak Sokhonn
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China fully supports the important role of Cambodia as the 2022 ASEAN Chair and is ready to work with ASEAN to: uphold ASEAN centrality to preserve strategic independence, maintain multilateralism and take hold of the leading power over regional security; uphold the orientation of win-win cooperation to fully implement the Regional Comprehensive Economic Partnership (RCEP) and launch the building of Version 3.0 China-ASEAN Free Trade Area at an early date; uphold the principle of properly handling sensitive issues to maintain the key note of mutually beneficial cooperation, oppose initiating antagonism of camps and division in this region, and resist any attempt to turn the East Asia cooperation platform into a 'wrestling ground' for major-country rivals.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Visit to Cambodia, meeting with Myanmar's Foreign Minister U Wunna Maung Lwin on sidelines of seventh Lancang-Mekong Cooperation (LMC) Foreign Ministers' Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will work together with the Myanmar side to further consolidate the four pillars of mutual political trust, mutually beneficial cooperation, people to people bonds, and personnel and cultural exchanges, so as to push for the building of the China-Myanmar community with a shared future to a new high. China supports the Myanmar people in exploring the development path that suits Myanmar's own national conditions, and supports Myanmar in safeguarding its legitimate interests and national dignity in the international arena. As Myanmar's largest neighboring country, China expects Myanmar to achieve political and social stability, improvement of people's livelihood and national development and revitalization. It is necessary to synergize the LMC with the Global Development Initiative (GDI) and the Global Security Initiative (GSI) proposed by China.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Article by Gu Xueming, President of the Institute of International Trade and Economic Cooperation of the Ministry of Commerce, on the WTO's 12th Ministerial Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a staunch participant, firm defender and important contributor to the multilateral trading system. Looking to the future, China will, as always, support all the work of the WTO, actively participate in discussions on various issues, participate in leading open plurilateral negotiations, promote the early resumption of the operation of the appellate body, and support the necessary reform of the WTO to respond to members' concerns and the needs of the times. China practices true multilateralism, and is willing to make positive contributions to the development and improvement of the multilateral trading system with the WTO as its core, and push economic globalisation towards a more open, inclusive, shared, balanced and win-win direction.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at train station upon arrival in Hong Kong, July 1, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: My heart and the central government's heart are always with the Hong Kong compatriots. Hong Kong has withstood grave tests and overcome risks and challenges, emerging stronger with great vigor. Facts have proven the great vitality of 'one country, two systems', which guarantees Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability. As long as 'one country, two systems' is upheld unswervingly, Hong Kong will have an even brighter future and make greater contributions to the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with new Philippine President Ferdinand Marcos to attend his inauguration
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Marcos and his family have made great contributions to enhancing China-Philippines friendship. The Chinese side has always given priority to the Philippines in its neighborhood diplomacy and is ready to work with the new Philippine government in carrying on their friendship, boosting mutual trust and deepening cooperation to usher in a new 'golden age' in bilateral ties.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting commemorating the 20th anniversary of the signing of the SCO Charter and 15th anniversary of SCO Treaty on Long-Term Good-Neighbourliness
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Four key points: (1) Grasp historical position and strengthen unity; strengthen sense of community of common destiny, deepen mutual political trust and resolutely oppose external interference; (2) All parties welcome to participate in global security initiative, practice common/comprehensive/cooperative/sustainable security concept, jointly respond to traditional and non-traditional security threats; (3) Adhere to path of inclusiveness, mutual benefit and win-win results, promote implementation of Global Development Initiative; (4) Uphold fairness and justice in global governance, practice true multilateralism, oppose hegemony and bullying, resolutely resist Cold War mentality and camp confrontation, promote democratization of international relations, contribute to building community with shared future for mankind.
statements.topic: multilateral diplomacy, regional security, global governance

statements.speaker: Ministry of National Defense (via Tan Kefei, Spokesperson)
statements.context: Monthly defense ministry press conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is justified to take forceful response measures against provocative acts by Australian and Canadian military aircraft and has handled situations in a safe and professional manner. Australian military aircraft entered airspace close to China's Xisha Islands for close-in reconnaissance; Canadian military aircraft increased close-in reconnaissance and made provocations in the name of implementing UN Security Council resolutions, undermining China's national security. China firmly opposes such acts and urges relevant countries to stop spreading disinformation.
statements.topic: military, US allies, aerial incidents, South China Sea

statements.speaker: People's Daily (editorial)
statements.context: Editorial on 25th anniversary of Hong Kong's handover, July 1, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th Party Congress, General Secretary Xi Jinping and the CPC Central Committee have made important expositions and major decisions on 'one country, two systems' and Hong Kong. With strong support from central government and mainland, and joint efforts of HKSAR government and Hong Kong people, Hong Kong's economy has flourished, its position as international financial/shipping/trade center consolidated, and democratic rights and freedoms of Hong Kong residents more fully guaranteed. When Hong Kong situation was grim, the Party Central Committee made important decisions to improve central government's overall governance over SAR in accordance with Constitution and Basic Law, promoted establishment of legal system for safeguarding national security, formulated National Security Law, improved electoral system, implemented 'patriots governing Hong Kong' principle, and supported improved oath system for public officials. These measures pushed Hong Kong situation from chaos to governance. Practice proves that to ensure stability and long-term implementation of 'one country, two systems', must adhere to 'patriots governing Hong Kong' principle—this is fundamental principle concerning national sovereignty, security, development interests and Hong Kong's long-term prosperity and stability.

Must uphold the multilateral trading system with the WTO at its core, eliminate trade, investment, and technological barriers, and prevent some countries' policy adjustments from having serious negative spillover effects. Criticized acts of containment, ideological confrontation, and politicizing/weaponizing economic and technological issues.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC Central Committee / President
statements.context: High-level Dialogue on Development speech
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Countries should jointly build international consensus on promoting development, jointly create an enabling international environment for development, jointly foster new drivers for global development, and jointly forge a global development partnership. The Global Development Initiative meets the concerns and needs of vast numbers of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Acting Foreign Minister of Afghan Interim Government Amir Khan Muttaqi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's policy toward Afghanistan is clear and firm and maintains stability and continuity. China always respects Afghanistan's independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity, respects the independent choices made by the Afghan people, and respects its religious beliefs and ethnic customs. China never interferes in the country's internal affairs, nor seeks self-interest or a sphere of influence in Afghanistan.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Acting Foreign Minister of Afghan Interim Government Amir Khan Muttaqi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Afghan side should take concrete measures to resolutely combat all terrorist forces including the East Turkestan Islamic Movement, and strengthen the security and protection of Chinese citizens and institutions in Afghanistan.

statements.speaker: Li Zhanshu
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Event celebrating the 90th anniversary of the establishment of the National Assembly of Thailand
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Development Initiative and the Global Security Initiative have contributed Chinese solutions to promoting sustainable world development and addressing global security governance challenges. China stands ready to work with Thailand to safeguard the international system with the United Nations at its core and international order based on international law, safeguard the common interests of developing countries, and contribute to world peace and development.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on Xi's BRICS speech regarding economic issues
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any act of containment, of inciting ideological confrontation, politicising and weaponizing economic and technological issues, will seriously weaken the efforts of the international community to meet common challenges. Some countries have politicized and marginalized the development issue, built 'a small yard with high fences', imposed maximum sanctions, and stoked division and confrontation. Such practices will impact the world economic system and only lead to a situation in which everyone loses.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Commentary)
statements.context: Commentary on High-level Dialogue on Development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries have built 'a small yard with high fences', imposed maximum sanctions, and created division and confrontation. These practices will destroy the achievements of decades of international economic cooperation. Mankind is at a critical juncture. Emerging markets and developing countries need to strengthen unity and cooperation, put development at the center of the international agenda, and build an open world economy.

statements.context: Chat with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir Abdollahian

statements.speaker: People's Daily

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at opening ceremony of BRICS Business Forum

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at opening ceremony of BRICS Business Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should reject zero-sum games and jointly oppose hegemonism and power politics. We should build a new type of international relations based on mutual respect, fairness, justice and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at opening ceremony of BRICS Business Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some important industrial and supply chains are suffering from deliberate disruptions. To politicize the global economy and turn it into one's tool or weapon, and willfully impose sanctions by using one's primary position in the international financial and monetary systems will only end up hurting one's own interests as well as those of others, and inflict suffering on everyone. It has been proved time and again that sanctions are a boomerang and a double-edged sword.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at opening ceremony of BRICS Business Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For some time, economic globalization has faced headwinds and countercurrents. Some countries attempt to decouple with others, sever supply chains and build 'a small yard with high fences.' Economic globalization is an unstoppable historical trend. Anyone who attempts to turn back the wheel of history and block others' way will only have his own path blocked.

statements.speaker: General Wei Fenghe
statements.context: 13th China-ASEAN Defense Ministers' Informal Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On the South China Sea issue, all parties involved should exclude interference, adhere to the 'dual-track approach', and make the South China Sea a sea of peace, friendship and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's friendly policy toward the ROK has not changed, and China will continue to place the ROK in an important position in its neighborhood diplomacy.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-U.S. relations are encountering more and more challenges, and the historical narrative has been artificially distorted. If the United States continues to turn back the clock of history on the Taiwan question, it will fundamentally undermine peace across the Taiwan Straits and will eventually hurt itself. China-U.S. relations cannot continue to deteriorate. We must make the right choice. We need to correct our strategic perception and abandon the Cold War mentality. We need to consolidate the political foundation and properly manage differences.
statements.topic: Taiwan, US-China relations, Cold War mentality

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at Symposium on Dr. Kissinger and China-U.S. Relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current atmosphere of China-U.S. relations is much abnormal, and the high anxiety of the U.S. side is completely unnecessary. China's overriding task is to concentrate on developing itself and meet its people's aspirations for a better life. If the United States keeps defining its relations with China in terms of major power competition and sets its policy goal as 'I-win-you-lose', it will only push China and the United States into confrontation and conflict and the world into division and turmoil.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

China deeply understands the legitimate needs and urgent aspirations of developing countries and is ready to do the utmost to help them catch up with the trend of the times and accelerate development and revitalization.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese diplomacy features non-interference in other countries' internal affairs, mutual benefit and win-win results. statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Based on the basic principle of mutual respect and toward the fundamental goal of common development, China is ready to enhance political communication, join hands in development, provide full support to fight the pandemic, take the lead in tackling climate change, strengthen people-to-people exchanges and mutual learning, and promote international solidarity and collaboration

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Combat transnational crime including cyber crime, and jointly tackle non-traditional security threats

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Visit to Solomon Islands, meeting with Prime Minister Manasseh Sogavare
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates the Solomon Islands' firm determination of safeguarding national interests and adhering to the one-China policy. China staunchly backs the Solomon Islands' efforts to safeguard national sovereignty and independence. The political decision of the Solomon Islands to establish diplomatic relations with China is in line with the development and progress of the times as well as the fundamental and long-term interests of the people of the Solomon Islands. China is ready to work with the Solomon Islands to forge 'iron-clad' ties.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Joint press conference with Solomon Islands Foreign Minister Jeremiah Manele
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The 'four upholdings' for China's engagement with Pacific island countries: upholding equal treatment, upholding mutual respect (China has never interfered in the internal affairs of Pacific island countries and neither attached political strings nor sought geographical selfish interests), upholding win-win cooperation, upholding openness and inclusiveness (the South Pacific region should serve as a stage for cooperation, not an arena for destructive competition; China's cooperation with the Pacific island countries does not target any country and should not be disrupted by any country).

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with new French Foreign Affairs Minister Catherine Colonna
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports European integration and supports France, which holds the rotating presidency of the EU, in promoting the strategic autonomy of Europe. The basic tone of the relationship between China and the European Union is friendship, and cooperation is the mainstream. The two sides are partners rather than rivals.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with French Foreign Affairs Minister Catherine Colonna on Ukraine
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The situation in Ukraine has reached a new crossroads. The most pressing issue at the moment is that relevant parties should work together to promote peace talks rather than adding fuel to the fire. China is pleased to see France play a mediating role on the Ukraine issue and will continue to play a constructive role in its own way.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The IPEF is essentially part of the US Indo-Pacific Strategy, which is an 'attempt to create a 'small circle' to contain China.' The fundamental purpose of this strategy is to serve 'America's First' and safeguard American hegemony. Its essence is to create division, incite confrontation and destroy peace, which will have a devastating impact on regional peace, stability and development.
statements.topic: US Indo-Pacific Strategy, IPEF, regional strategy

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: When the United States launched the 'Indo-Pacific Economic Framework', it explicitly stated that this was meant to ensure that the United States would win the competition in the 21st century and provide alternatives to China for regional countries. This fully shows that the framework serves to promote America's geo-strategy. The so-called 'emphasis' of America on its allies and partners is to 'decouple' regional countries from China's economy and make Asia-Pacific countries serve as pawns of American hegemony. The framework has neither tariff exemptions, market access and other arrangements, nor does it care about the development level and actual needs of countries in the region.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: When promoting its Indo-Pacific strategy, the US has explicitly said that it wants to 'shape China's strategic environment', which exposes its intent to contain China. US policy regarding the Taiwan card and the Asia-Pacific is extremely dangerous.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any insidious attempt to delay China's development and rejuvenation or to undermine China's mutually beneficial cooperation with other countries will inevitably fail.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to peace, stability and lasting prosperity in the Asia-Pacific. China has become the largest trading partner of most countries in the region and its interests are deeply integrated with those of other countries in the region. China's super-large market of over 1.4 billion people will continue to be fully open to countries in the region, and the path of mutual benefit between China and countries in the region will be even broader. Any country that tries to isolate China will end up isolating itself.
statements.topic: regional relations, China's role in Asia-Pacific

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and the United States are Asia-Pacific countries, and can have a common 'circle of friends'. The Asia-Pacific region should be a highland for peaceful development, not an arena for geopolitics. Any country attempting to turn the region towards camp confrontation through a NATO-like bloc or stoke a Cold War will stand in opposition to countries in the region, which are committed to peaceful development.
statements.topic: US-China relations, regional cooperation, Cold War

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: President of the China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Commentary/article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Changes in the international balance of power are a key factor in determining the international order. China is in the best period of development since modern times, and the world is undergoing profound changes unseen in a century. China's influence, appeal and shaping power have significantly increased, and China's relations with the outside world have entered a new era.

statements.speaker: Xu Bu
statements.speaker_title: President of the China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Commentary/article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy is an important part of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era. It is a major theoretical achievement that combines the basic principles of Marxism with the practice of major country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics. We must study and implement Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy in a more comprehensive and systematic way, continue to promote major-country diplomacy with Chinese characteristics, and strive to build a community with a shared future for mankind for world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Michelle Bachelet, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On human rights, no one can claim perfection. China is ready to conduct human rights dialogue and cooperation on the basis of equality and mutual respect. There is no such thing as a flawless utopia; countries do not need patronizing lecturers; human rights issues should not be politicized or used as a tool to apply double standards or as a pretext to interfere in internal affairs of other countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with Indonesian Foreign Minister, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Joko Widodo has reiterated that since its inception, the G20 has been an economic forum, not a political one, and China fully agrees with him on this point. The UN Security Council is the right platform for discussing political and security issues. The G20 should stick to its focus on macroeconomic policy coordination. China firmly supports Indonesia in exercising the G20 rotating presidency, removing interference to achieve goals set in the agenda and steering the G20 toward the right direction.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with Indonesian Foreign Minister, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As global governance has entered the 'Asian moment,' Indonesia, Thailand and Cambodia will host important multilateral conferences respectively, and China is preparing for the BRICS Leaders' Meeting. China fully supports and actively echoes the recent joint statement issued by the three countries, which has sent a unified voice for Asia to strengthen solidarity and jointly meet challenges. China calls on Asian countries to play an active role in peaceful and stable development of the region and the world at large in the face of the turbulent international situation.

statements.speaker: People's Daily Editorial
statements.context: Commentary piece on international page, People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As a political-military organisation with the largest military expenditure, the most powerful weapons and equipment and the most extensive military deployment around the world, NATO seeks absolute security through military bloc confrontation, creates security panic by peddling security anxiety, and constantly shapes new imaginary enemies and confronts them. This has had a serious impact on relations between major powers and the European security order. US-led NATO's adherence to the Cold War mentality and its continued promotion of expansion is the cause of the Ukraine war.
statements.topic: NATO, security, Ukraine war, US foreign policy

statements.speaker: Hong Feng (Natee Taweesrifuengfung)
statements.speaker_title: President of Siam Think Tank (external analyst, but published in People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary piece in People's Daily international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US Indo-Pacific Strategy seriously threatens ASEAN's centrality in the regional structure and will inevitably cause concern among ASEAN countries. Most countries in the region do not want to see camp confrontation again. The US Indo-Pacific strategy is not conducive to the stable development of the region and does nothing in the economic and trade fields that regional countries value.
statements.topic: US Indo-Pacific Strategy, regional relations, US policy

statements.speaker: Hong Feng (Natee Taweesrifuengfung)
statements.speaker_title: President of Siam Think Tank (external analyst, but published in People's Daily)
statements.context: Commentary piece in People's Daily international page
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US Indo-Pacific Strategy bears the shadow of Cold War confrontation. It is the product of the US' reversal of history, and it runs counter to the general trend of regional prosperity and stability. Countries in the region should be vigilant against this. Politicising and weaponizing economic issues will ultimately damage the common interests of all countries. The hard-won prospects for prosperity and stability in the Asia-Pacific region should not be ruined in order to cater to the US' Indo-Pacific strategy.
statements.topic: US Indo-Pacific Strategy, regional stability, US foreign policy

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

The two countries should explicitly uphold true multilateralism and maintain the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, international law and basic norms governing international relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
