statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On grain supply problems caused by spillover effects of the Ukraine crisis, the international community should push for an early ceasefire and a green channel for Russia and Ukraine to export grain. China is willing to maintain communication with all parties.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily (fifth in series on US human rights)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Racism in the US is a deep-rooted cancer in American society, an institutional and systemic defect reflected in every aspect of American society, leading to discrimination, hatred and violence. Some US politicians openly embrace far-right ideological trends, fueling white supremacy. The current American political system is unable to find an antidote for systemic racism but is constantly solidifying it. Without racial justice, America cannot be a truly free, democratic society.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary criticizing NATO, first in planned series
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: After the end of the Cold War, NATO, under US leadership and under the guise of safeguarding 'democracy, freedom and human rights', extended its black hand of armed provocation and military intervention to many places around the world, causing massive casualties and humanitarian disasters.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary on Japan-US relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US-Japan joint statement grossly interfered in China's internal affairs and maliciously attacked China's foreign policy. Japan and the United States wantonly discredited China's image, exposing their insidious plot to contain China and divide the region. Japan is cooperating with the US in promoting the 'Indo-Pacific strategy' of creating divisions and confrontation, openly leading the wolf into the house, seriously endangering regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary on Japan-US relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On the Taiwan issue, Japan provoking trouble will place it in opposition to more than 1.4 billion Chinese people. The real purpose of Japan-US cooperation in the region is not about 'freedom and openness' but about creating a 'small circle' for geopolitical competition and stoking camp confrontation in Asia. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UN High Commissioner for Human Rights Michelle Bachelet
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must adhere to mutual respect and not politicize human rights; adhere to fairness and impartiality without double standards; adhere to seeking truth from facts and not detach human rights from a country's realities and development stage; adhere to openness and tolerance without camp confrontation. Major countries should lead by example through practicing multilateralism, abiding by UN Charter principles, respecting international law and safeguarding international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments regarding the United Nations Economic and Social Commission for Asia and the Pacific (UNESCAP)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The peace and prosperity in the Asia-Pacific bear not only on the destiny of the region but also on the future of the world. The concept of the Asia-Pacific should not be diluted and cooperation should not be disturbed. The Asia-Pacific should unswervingly safeguard peace and stability, uphold UN Charter purposes and principles, and unequivocally reject any attempt to introduce military blocs or bloc confrontation into the region. Countries should make concerted efforts to promote economic development and achieve win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Chen Xu
statements.speaker_title: China's Permanent Representative to the United Nations Office at Geneva
statements.context: Statement on WHA rejection of Taiwan participation proposal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan-related proposal has no legal basis. UNGA Resolution 2758 and WHA Resolution 25.1 provide the legal basis for the WHO to abide by the one-China principle. Taiwan's participation in the WHA must be handled in accordance with the one-China principle and through cross-strait consultations. Since the DPP authorities obstinately adhere to the 'Taiwan independence' stance, the political foundation for Taiwan to join the WHA has ceased to exist. The proposal has no factual basis—the central government has invited experts from Taiwan to visit Wuhan and specially notified the way to obtain virus gene sequence.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing on WHA decision
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The WHA decision fully demonstrates the shared international commitment to the one-China principle—an overriding trend that cannot be challenged. The DPP authorities obstinately instigated countries to make Taiwan-related proposals disregarding the aspiration of all parties and well-being of Taiwan compatriots. Nearly 90 countries sent letters opposing Taiwan's participation in the WHA. The Chinese government always attaches great importance to health and well-being of Taiwan compatriots and has made appropriate arrangements for their participation in global health affairs under the one-China principle, providing about 400 pandemic updates and approving 47 visits by Taiwan health experts to WHO technical activities. The DPP's attempt to seek Taiwan independence by exploiting the pandemic will lead nowhere. Certain countries should stop politicizing health issues and interfering in China's internal affairs through Taiwan-related issues, or they will fail like a man lifting a rock only to drop it on his own feet.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary on WHA rejection of Taiwan proposal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The WHA episode once again proves that any attempt to 'use the pandemic to seek independence,' 'rely on the United States to seek independence,' any attempt to play the 'Taiwan card' and 'use Taiwan to control China' will never succeed. Taiwan is the most important, sensitive and core issue in Sino-US relations. The US has repeatedly stated it pursues one-China policy and does not support 'Taiwan independence,' and does not support Taiwan's participation in organizations requiring sovereign state membership. However, US actual actions on Taiwan differ significantly from statements. From passing bills seeking to 'assist Taiwan regain observer status in the WHO' to issuing statements 'strongly advocating' for Taiwan's WHO participation, the US has repeatedly played the 'Taiwan card' attempting 'use Taiwan to control China.' US words and actions seriously violate international law and basic norms of international relations, send serious wrong signals to 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces, and seriously damage China-US relations and peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

statements.speaker: Xinhua News Agency
statements.context: Report on WHA decision on Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The decision at the 75th WHA fully demonstrates that the one-China principle has become the consensus of the international community and represents the aspiration of the people and the trend of the times, which cannot be stopped. The political manipulation of Taiwan's DPP authorities through the pandemic wins no support, brings disgrace to themselves and is doomed to fail. The Chinese government allowed Taiwan region to participate as observer for eight consecutive years from 2009 to 2016. Since the DPP came into power and refused to recognize the 1992 Consensus embodying the one-China principle, the political foundation for Taiwan region's WHA participation ceased to exist. Since 2017, the Chinese government has suspended the arrangement for Taiwan's WHA participation.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: State Council weekly meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Power generation, freight volume and bank loans have all declined since April. Without a certain level of GDP growth, stable employment cannot be realized. One good thing is that we refrained from excessive money supply and mass stimulus in the past few years, and we still have policy tools in reserve.

statements.speaker: State Council
statements.context: Weekly meeting statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The downward pressure on the economy is increasing and many market entities are finding themselves in serious difficulties. Development is the foundation and key to solving all problems. It is necessary to strengthen confidence, respond decisively, comprehensively implement the new development concept, and efficiently coordinate epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development. The decisions of the Central Economic Work Conference and policies in the Government Work Report must be implemented faster and more forcefully. A host of targeted, strong and effective measures for range-based regulation will be taken to keep economic fundamentals stable.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Message of congratulations to Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A healthy and stable development of China-Australia relations is in the fundamental interests and common aspirations of both peoples, and is conducive to peace, stability, development and prosperity in the Asia-Pacific region. The Australian Labor Party made the right choice to establish diplomatic relations with China in the 1970s. This year marks the 50th anniversary of bilateral diplomatic relations. China stands ready to work together with Australia to review the past and look to the future on the basis of the principle of mutual respect and win-win benefits to promote healthy and stable development of the China-Australia comprehensive strategic partnership.

statements.context: Press meeting after talks with Pakistani Foreign Minister Bilawal Bhutto Zardari in Guangzhou

The United States plays the 'Taiwan card' and 'South China Sea card' to bring chaos to the region. The so-called 'Indo-Pacific Strategy' is, in essence, a strategy of creating division, inciting confrontation and undermining peace.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press meeting after talks with Pakistani Foreign Minister Bilawal Bhutto Zardari in Guangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On the Indo-Pacific Economic Framework: it should advocate free trade instead of pursuing protectionism; it should contribute to global economic recovery instead of undermining industrial-chain stability and creating economic decoupling, technological blockade and industrial disruption; it should promote openness and cooperation instead of creating geopolitical confrontation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech to BRICS Foreign Ministers' meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peace and development remain the unchanging theme of the times. Seeking one's own security at the expense of others' will only create new tensions and risks. BRICS countries should oppose hegemonism and power politics, reject Cold War mentality and bloc confrontation, and work together to build a global community of security for all.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to BRICS Political Parties, Think Tanks and Civil Society Organisations Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries should stay true to their original founding aspiration and work together with the majority of developing countries to rise to the challenges and create a bright future for development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments at BRICS Foreign Ministers' meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries should seek common security together, work for common development, build a firewall for human health, and advocate a global governance philosophy of extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits. All parties should strengthen strategic communication, coordination, and political mutual trust.

statements.speaker: BRICS Foreign Ministers (including China)
statements.context: Joint statement from BRICS Foreign Ministers' meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Commitment to multilateralism and upholding international law. Support for the central role of the UN. Opposition to unilateral actions and protectionist measures that run counter to WTO rules. Support for an open, transparent, fair, inclusive, non-discriminatory and rules-based multilateral trading system. Urge major developed countries to adopt responsible economic policies and manage policy spillovers to avoid severe impacts on developing countries.

statements.speaker: Song Tao
statements.context: BRICS Political Parties, Think Tanks and Civil Society Organisations Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries should become a powerful force for common development, international cooperation, global security and human progress. Countries should strengthen cooperation in fighting COVID-19, scientific and technological innovation, green and low-carbon development, and poverty reduction. They should practice genuine multilateralism, abandon Cold War mentality, promote the Global Development Initiative and Global Security Initiative, and push forward implementation of the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular Ministry of Foreign Affairs press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The appointment of the US Special Coordinator for Tibetan Issues constitutes interference in China's internal affairs. The US should honor its commitment of acknowledging Tibet as part of China and not supporting Tibetan independence. It should stop meddling in China's internal affairs and offer no support to separatist activities. China will continue to take necessary measures to resolutely safeguard its sovereignty, security and development interests.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (via Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The widening income and wealth gaps in the US demonstrate inequalities prevalent in American society. Inflation hurts the poor more than the rich. The US has the most severe gap between rich and poor among Western countries, with Gini coefficient at 0.48 in 2021, highest in nearly half a century. American democracy has been reduced to a game of 'the rich have, the rich rule, and the rich enjoy.' The long-standing disease of inequality is rooted in the failure of the American political and economic system and disorder of governance.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Seeking exclusive blocs will only lead the world to division and confrontation. statements.context: Phone call with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan, readout from Xinhua

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Director of the Central Foreign Affairs Work Commission
statements.context: Phone call with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan, readout from Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is the most important, sensitive and core question in China-U.S. relations. Recent U.S. actions and statements on the Taiwan question are quite different from stated commitments. If the U.S. side persists in playing the 'Taiwan card' and goes further down the wrong path, it will surely put the situation in serious jeopardy.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Director of the Central Foreign Affairs Work Commission
statements.context: Phone call with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan, readout from Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China urges the United States to grasp the situation, strictly honor its commitments and abide by the one-China principle and the stipulations of the three Sino-U.S. joint communiques. The Chinese side will take firm actions to safeguard its sovereignty and security interests.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Director of the Central Foreign Affairs Work Commission
statements.context: Phone call with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan, readout from Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Recently, the two sides have held some dialogues in such fields as military-to-military, climate change, health and agriculture, which are beneficial, and the momentum of dialogue should be maintained.

statements.context: Virtual meeting with Japanese Foreign Minister Yoshimasa Hayashi, readout from Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan's negative moves on Taiwan and other issues concerning China's core interests and major concerns have become prominent recently. Wang called for removing disruptive factors in bilateral relations as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Virtual meeting with Japanese Foreign Minister Yoshimasa Hayashi, readout from Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What causes concern and alarm is that even before the U.S. leader has arrived, the argument that Japan and the United States would jointly confront China has already been widely heard. Bilateral cooperation between Japan and the United States should not provoke bloc confrontation, still less should it undermine China's sovereignty, security and development interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We hope that Japan will not pull chestnuts out of the fire for others, and will avoid pitting itself against its neighbors.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facts have proved that we have firmly grasped the general trend of world development and the correct direction of history. We have the 'five strategic advantages'... Any conspiracy that attempts to obstruct and prevent China's strong development is doomed to fail, and the goal of the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation will surely be achieved.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Central Committee's Office for Foreign Affairs; Senior Diplomat
statements.context: Long article on practice of China's diplomacy in People's Daily, May 16, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries are trying to change the trend of the times by transferring contradictions and creating counter-currents. This practice of reversing the tide of history cannot shake the fundamental direction of the great changes in the world.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Central Committee's Office for Foreign Affairs; Senior Diplomat
statements.context: Long article on practice of China's diplomacy in People's Daily, May 16, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must oppose all forms of hegemonic bullying, interference in other countries' internal affairs under various pretexts, containment and suppression of other countries by expanding the remit of the concept of national security, and opposing the politicisation and weaponisation of economic and scientific issues.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The impact of the pandemic has permeated all aspects of international political economy and social life. We must resolutely fight against all words and deeds that distort, cast doubts and deny China's pandemic prevention policy.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Central Committee's Office for Foreign Affairs; Senior Diplomat

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

If any area, aspect or link is missing or weakened, it will weaken the strength of the Party and harm the cause of the Party and the country.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhongyinzhang commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary on COVID-19 control policies published on Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Improvements in Shanghai are a strong confirmation of the scientificity and effectiveness of 'dynamic clearing' and a refutation of the 'lying flat' argument. Some countries chose to let go of prevention and control out of helplessness due to inability to identify ideal strategies. However, after lifting restrictions, epidemic situations deteriorated with infection levels reaching historic highs. More than 1 million COVID-19 deaths have been reported in some countries, and more than 200,000 children became COVID orphans. To choose 'lying flat' when the global pandemic has not substantially improved is disregarding science and displaying extreme irresponsibility toward public health and life rights.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (International Page)
statements.context: News report on gun violence in the United States
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As of May 12, 15,569 people have been killed in gun violence in the United States this year. Gun violence has become a chronic disease in American society. Owing to multiple factors such as political polarization, this problem is becoming increasingly difficult to resolve. The intensifying gun violence highlights the weak governance by the US government and the hypocrisy of American democracy, which is unable to protect people's lives.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (International Page)
statements.context: Report on US intelligence sharing with Ukraine and NATO role
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Instead of promoting peace, the United States and NATO continue to fuel the situation in Ukraine, which once again highlights the destructive role that the United States and NATO are playing. US agencies have been sharing intelligence with Ukrainians and providing support for military operations, but such actions only escalate the conflict.

statements.speaker: Xu Weixinfrom
statements.speaker_title: Researcher, Research Center for Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era at the Central Party School
statements.context: Feature article in People's Daily on Party's overall leadership
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Party's leadership is comprehensive, systematic and holistic. The Party, the government, the military and the people—east, west, north and south—the Party leads everything. The Party's leadership must be reflected in all aspects of economic, political, cultural, social, and ecological progress, as well as in national defense, the armed forces, national reunification, diplomacy, and Party building.

The US government should bear considerable responsibility. The current actions of the United States are not helping end the crisis, but only continue to play up camp confrontation.

statements.context: Page 17 commentary on US foreign policy

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We hope the relevant individual can view Chinese Covid policy objectively and rationally and know the facts, instead of making irresponsible remarks.

China supports Europe in playing a positive role in promoting peace talks.

The steady and sound growth of China-EU relations serves the interests of people in China, Europe and all other countries. China urged vigilance against bloc confrontation, which poses a bigger and more persistent threat to global security and stability.

China sincerely supports the two sides of the Korean Peninsula in improving relations and promoting reconciliation and cooperation, and stands ready to advance the denuclearization of the Korean Peninsula and promote lasting peace on the peninsula.

China has embarked on a human rights development path that conforms to the trend of the times and China's national conditions, enabling unprecedented development of human rights of the Chinese people and resulting in great contributions to promoting the cause of human rights in the world.

statements.context: Interview with People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Trade ties between the United States and China are very deep and close. Many American companies are still optimistic about the Chinese market and plan to increase investment. According to a 2021 survey, 95% of member companies said their business in China achieved profitability, and over 40% said they would increase investment. US-China trade volume in 2021 increased nearly 30% to $755.6 billion. US exports to China reached $149.2 billion. American exports of goods and services to China support more than 850,000 jobs. Greater stability can bring more opportunities to businesses and people in both countries. The world needs the United States and China to settle differences properly and continue to contribute to common global development.

The CSRC will launch pragmatic measures to expand the opening of the capital market.

The chief executive election was conducted in accordance with the law and the result is in line with Hong Kong people's aspirations. statements.speaker: Luo Junjie
statements.speaker_title: Director, Bureau of Operation and Coordination Monitoring, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
statements.context: People's Daily article on Q1 2022 industrial economy performance
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with a more complex and severe external environment, various proactive and targeted policy measures have been adopted, and the resilience of industrial development has gradually emerged. The steps taken since late last year and new measures in the Government Work Report have supported the sector and positive factors supporting steady growth are accumulating.

statements.speaker: Luo Junjie
statements.speaker_title: Director, Bureau of Operation and Coordination Monitoring, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology
statements.context: People's Daily article on Q1 2022 industrial economy performance
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We have confidence and the ability to calmly respond to risks and challenges in all aspects, coordinating epidemic prevention and control with economic and social development.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Meeting with Omani Deputy Prime Minister for Defense Affairs; reported in Xinhua/People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is Oman's sole strategic partner, which fully demonstrates the uniqueness of China-Oman relations. China raised concerns about interference from certain major countries in Middle Eastern affairs that jeopardizes the region's stability and security. China appreciates Oman's positive role in promoting political settlement of regional issues and stands ready to expand friendly cooperation.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides had a frank, in-depth and constructive strategic communication. Both sides agreed that the Chinese and American armed forces should keep communication channels open, control risks and promote the construction of a crisis communication mechanism. A stable relationship between the two armies is in the common interests of both countries.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We ask the US side to truly implement President Biden's statement of 'four no intentions' - that the US does not intend to change China's system, revitalization of its alliances is not targeted at China, the US does not support Taiwan independence, and has no intention to seek conflict with China.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has taken firm and forceful countermeasures against the US military provocations, smears, threats and pressure with regard to Taiwan, maritime and air security, Ukraine and other issues.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has continued to promote the process of space militarization with a Cold War mentality, establishing a space command and developing offensive space weapons. As the country with the greatest number of satellites, the United States has long been stonewalling space arms control. Japan has also been progressive in military construction in space. The moves of the two countries have raised the risk of weaponization and arms race in outer space and negatively affected global strategic stability.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Recently, Australian officials and media have repeatedly hyped up security cooperation between China and Solomon Islands, deliberately distorting facts and creating tension, which is extremely irresponsible. China is firmly opposed to it. As two independent and sovereign countries, China and Solomon Islands carry out cooperation in maintaining social order, protecting safety, humanitarian aid and tackling natural disasters. This benefits Solomon Islands' stability and serves common interests in the South Pacific.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Certain US officials have recently made numerous erroneous remarks on Taiwan, while some US senators have visited Taiwan in an attempt to rally support for Taiwan independence separatists. This is seriously incongruous with the US commitment not to support Taiwan independence and demonstrates that the US has no credibility. China is vehemently opposed to it. The DPP authorities disregard the safety and well-being of Taiwan compatriots and attempt to divide the country in collusion with external forces - an utterly wrong calculation.

statements.speaker: Tan Kefei
statements.speaker_title: Senior Colonel, Ministry of National Defense Spokesperson
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense monthly briefing; reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In response to US officials' provocative visits to Taiwan, the Chinese PLA has recently conducted military operations in the seas and airspace around the Taiwan Strait. From now on, we will not tolerate any provocation by the DPP authorities for seeking independence or interference by external forces, and we will continue to demonstrate firm resolve to safeguard China's national sovereignty and territorial integrity through resolute actions.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing (April 28, 2022)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation between countries and regional initiatives should be conducive to promoting regional peace, stability and prosperity, rather than forming exclusive cliques. The Quad grouping is steeped in obsolete Cold War and zero-sum mentality and reeks of military confrontation. It runs counter to the trend of times and is doomed to be rejected.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing (April 28, 2022)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: G20 is the premier forum for international economic and financial cooperation. With instability in the international situation, there is urgent need for joint response. Countries should champion dialogue rather than stoke confrontation, uphold cooperation rather than create division. G20 needs to focus on its mandate, avoid politicizing and weaponizing international economic and financial cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing (April 28, 2022)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Terrorism is the common enemy of all humanity. China and Pakistan are resolved and able to cut off the evil claws of terrorists. The iron-clad friendship enjoys popular support. China will continue to support Pakistan's economic and social development. The Pakistani government has pledged to strengthen security for Chinese personnel and projects. Any attempt to undermine China-Pakistan friendship will be thwarted by the Chinese and Pakistani people.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily Commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on Chemical Weapons Convention 25th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States, as the only country with chemical weapons stockpiles, continues to delay their destruction. Some countries have used chemical weapons issues to provoke confrontation. In recent years, the OPCW has faced the most severe challenge since its establishment. Some countries like the United States have engaged in political manipulation on chemical weapons in Syria, creating splits among states and seriously impacting the Convention's authority.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily Commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on Chemical Weapons Convention 25th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is the second largest contributor to the OPCW and has made important contributions to ensuring global disarmament and security governance. China has received 593 OPCW inspections - the most for any country. China has participated constructively in solving chemical weapons issues, adhered to objective and fair positions, and made outstanding contributions to eliminating chemical weapons. China unswervingly supports international cooperation in the chemical industry and firmly safeguards legitimate rights of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily Commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on Solomon Islands security pact
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US and Australia have put pressure on the Solomon Islands government, discredited China's normal cooperation, and made naked threats. Their fallacies expose their deep-seated power mentality and hegemonic thinking. China and Solomon Islands security cooperation - on the basis of equal treatment and mutual benefit - is a realistic choice based on the country's security situation and the outcome of developing bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily Commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on Solomon Islands security pact
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Politicians in some Western countries are deliberately distorting the agreement, amounting to gross interference in island countries' internal affairs, naked bullying and coercive diplomacy, exposing their colonialist mentality and hegemonic intentions. The South Pacific island countries are independent sovereign states, not the backyard of the US and Australia. Any attempt to transplant the Monroe Doctrine to the South Pacific will be unpopular and will fail.
statements.topic: Solomon Islands, Western interference, regional sovereignty

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily Commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on Solomon Islands security pact
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US and Australia have fabricated rumors that China will build a military base in Solomon Islands - showing very sinister intentions. China's security cooperation focuses on maintaining social order, protecting lives and property, humanitarian assistance and disaster response, committed to helping strengthen security capacity building. By contrast, the AUKUS agreement is opaque and expands risk of nuclear proliferation and militarization into the South Pacific.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of National Defense
statements.context: Meeting with Turkmen President Serdar Berdimuhamedov
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports Turkmenistan's permanent neutral status, firmly supports its pursuit of a development path suited to its national conditions, and firmly opposes external interference in Turkmenistan's internal affairs. The Chinese military is willing to further expand areas of cooperation with Turkmenistan, enhance the effectiveness of cooperation and strive to elevate military-to-military relations to a higher level.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement following terror attack in Karachi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The blood of the Chinese cannot be shed in vain, and those behind this incident will surely pay the price. China expressed its strong condemnation and great indignation at the attack, as well as deep condolences to the victims and sincere sympathy to the injured and the bereaved families.

statements.speaker: Wu Jianghao
statements.context: Urgent phone call to Pakistani Ambassador to China following terror attack
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: He demanded that the Pakistani side should immediately make thorough investigation of the incident, apprehend and punish the perpetrators to the full extent of the law, and take all possible measures to ensure the safety of Chinese citizens in Pakistan and prevent such incidents from happening again.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: While adding fuel to the fire and creating obstacles for peace talks, the United States has tried to prolong the Russia-Ukraine conflict, engaged in coercive diplomacy, spread rumours about China, sought to fish in troubled waters and realise its strategic goal of containing and suppressing China in the Asia-Pacific region and around the world.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should understand that China's development and growth is an inevitable trend of history, and no force can stop it. How to get along with a China that has the courage to shoulder its responsibilities as a major power and is more confident and enterprising is a lesson that some American politicians must learn.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should understand that the era when world affairs were controlled by a few countries is gone forever. There is only one system in the world, that is, the international system with the United Nations as its core; there is only one order, that is, the international order based on international law; there is only one set of rules, that is, the basic norms of international relations based on the principles and purposes of the UN Charter.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If any country is challenging the international order and trampling on international rules, it is the United States. The examples include NATO's bombing of Yugoslavia, invasions of Iraq and Syria, ignoring Russia's security concerns and using NATO as a tool to aggravate regional tensions, and the imposition of unilateral sanctions.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has fabricated the so-called 'China threat' lies, hyped its competition with China, and advocated for a 'systemic rivalry', which are all the embodiment of its zero-sum thinking and hegemonic nature that cannot bear to witness the stable development of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Who is providing opportunities for Europe and who is threatening its security and prosperity? China has become the EU's largest trading partner since 2020. In sharp contrast to the mutually beneficial cooperation between China and Europe, the United States has tried to hold Europe hostage through the Ukrainian crisis, deliberately encouraged Europe to expand sanctions against Russia, and is preparing to sell more high-priced LNG to Europe.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Editorial commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Europe are two major forces to safeguard world peace, two major markets to promote common development, and two major civilisations to promote human progress. Europe should form a more independent, objective and rational understanding of China and promote and deepen mutually beneficial cooperation between the two sides based on the principle of strategic autonomy.

statements.speaker: Sun Lipeng
statements.speaker_title: Researcher at CICIR (China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations)
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US economy is facing the challenge of the 'three highs': high inflation, high debt and high risk of asset bubbles. Fundamentally, the problem with the US economy is that it lacks the endogenous impetus for long-term growth. Plans such as those to double exports or to bring back manufacturing enterprises to the US have not been effective.

statements.speaker: Sun Lipeng
statements.speaker_title: Researcher at CICIR (China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations)
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The abuse of sanctions by the United States and the West against Russia will not only increase the cost of cheap global financing in the United States in the long run, but will also continue to overdraw the credibility of the US dollar, which will definitely bring a long-term impact on the US' financial hegemony and economic strength.

statements.speaker: Sun Lipeng
statements.speaker_title: Researcher at CICIR (China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations)
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The negative spillover effect of American economic policy adjustment cannot be ignored. It will bring challenges to global economic and financial stability. American inflation has been exported, and the United States' current economic transformation policy is a kind of selfish recovery. Its irresponsible and self-serving policies will cast a shadow over the prospects of global economic recovery.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to international forum on 50th anniversary of artemisinin discovery, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has actively promoted the application of artemisinin around the world, saving millions of lives, especially in developing countries. China is willing to work with the international community to intensify exchanges and cooperation in public health, jointly respond to global threats and challenges, and promote joint construction of a community of human health.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to Emmanuel Macron on election victory, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and France are major countries with a tradition of staying independent. The strategic significance of sound and stable China-France relations has become more prominent as international situation undergoes profound changes. China views bilateral ties from strategic and long-term perspective and stands ready to uphold the original aspiration of diplomatic relations featuring independence, mutual understanding, foresight, and mutual benefit.
statements.framing: assertive about Chinese independence, constructive on bilateral relations

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Visit to Kazakhstan, meeting with President Tokayev, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes external forces deliberately instigating a 'color revolution' in Kazakhstan and backs the Kazakh side in taking strong measures to safeguard national security. We must be vigilant about certain major powers interfering in Central Asia to disrupt and undermine regional security.
statements.topic: regional security, opposition to Western interference
statements.framing: accusatory toward unspecified major powers (implicitly US/West)

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UN development system resident coordinator, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Development Initiative aims to call on the international community to pay more attention to development issues and accelerate implementation of UN 2030 Agenda. More than 100 countries have supported it and over 50 have joined the Group of Friends. China has accumulated rich experience in poverty alleviation, human development, and protection of women's and children's rights, and is willing to share these experiences with other countries.
statements.framing: cooperative, highlighting Chinese contributions and leadership

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing, pushing back at Australian PM Scott Morrison's remarks, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The security cooperation between China and Solomon Islands is based on equality and mutual benefits, within sovereignty, consistent with international law. Claims about a Chinese military base are pure disinformation. The US claims China's military presence will cause concerns, yet the US has nearly 800 military bases in 80 countries. If China's presence is concerning, what of US bases? Island countries are independent states, not a backyard of the US or Australia. Their attempt to revive the Monroe Doctrine will get no support.
statements.topic: US-China relations, regional security, Indo-Pacific, US military presence
statements.framing: accusatory toward US and Australia, defensive about Chinese actions, deflective

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: State Council meeting on clean governance, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China faces new increased downward pressure due to greater-than-expected changes in domestic and international situations. Economic development faces severe challenges. Urgent policy measures needed in H1 to stabilize employment, prices, supply and economic basic market. Must ensure food and energy security, stabilize industrial and supply chains, create market-oriented and law-based international business environment.
statements.topic: economic policy, US-China economic relations (implicit reference to external pressures)

statements.speaker: Yuan Peng
statements.speaker_title: Researcher, China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations (CICIR)
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily on Overall National Security Concept
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In contrast to the US and West, which have irresponsibly established cliques and added fuel to the fire, China has insisted on calling for peace and promoting talks, advocating importance of all countries' legitimate security concerns. The Global Security Concept features common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security, seeking not only China's security but peaceful coexistence of all countries. This will help solve the 'security dilemma' evident in Western international security theory by abandoning zero-sum thinking and hegemonic mentality.
statements.topic: global security, US-China relations, Russia-Ukraine conflict, international order
statements.framing: accusatory toward US/West regarding Ukraine, assertive about Chinese alternative approach

statements.speaker: Yuan Peng
statements.speaker_title: Researcher, China Institutes of Contemporary International Relations (CICIR)
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily on Overall National Security Concept
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to opposing the notion that 'a strong country is bound to seek hegemony.' China has always advocated peaceful settlement of international disputes, promoted building new type of win-win international relations and community of shared future for mankind, adhered to multilateralism and cooperation principles, worked to safeguard international system with UN at core and international order based on international law.
statements.framing: assertive, implicitly critical of US hegemonic behavior

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Boao Forum for Asia, April 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We need to work together to tackle global governance challenges. Unilateralism and excessive pursuit of self-interest are doomed to fail; so are the practices of decoupling, supply disruption and maximum pressure; so are the attempts to forge 'small circles' or to stoke conflict and confrontation along ideological lines. Instead, we need to embrace a global governance philosophy that emphasizes extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits.
statements.framing: accusatory toward unilateral approaches; constructive toward cooperation

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Boao Forum for Asia, April 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is particularly important for major countries to lead by example in honoring equality, cooperation, good faith and the rule of law, and act in a way befitting their status.
statements.framing: constructive, calls for responsible great power behavior

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Remarks to Boao Forum for Asia board of directors, April 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will vigorously promote the clean utilisation of coal, give full play to the role of market mechanism and government regulation, ensure the safety and stability of energy and power supply this year, and promote carbon peak and neutrality in a steady and orderly manner.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Remarks to Boao Forum for Asia board of directors, April 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is important to ensure orderly and smooth logistics, ensure the stability of the industrial supply chain, and minimise the impact of pandemic on economic and social development while maintaining dynamic zero-Covid policy.
statements.framing: balancing act between control and development

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Remarks to Boao Forum for Asia board of directors, April 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a law-based business environment, treating all market players equally and welcoming foreign enterprises to invest in China.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to students at Francis Holland School in the UK on climate change, April 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese primary school students start from small things, develop good habits of energy conservation and environmental protection, and learn a green and low-carbon lifestyle. You are welcome to come to China to visit the world's largest wind and solar power plants, the most extensive man-made forests and beautiful national parks. You are welcome to communicate with primary school students in China, so that the concept of green development can take root in your hearts.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial Commentary)
statements.context: Front page commentary on Xi's Boao Forum speech, April 22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi Jinping's keynote speech was far-sighted, profound in thought and rich in connotation. It has contributed Chinese wisdom and pointed out the direction of efforts for global solidarity and cooperation.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial Commentary)
statements.context: Page 2 commentary on Global Security Initiative, April 22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Security Initiative is another important international public good provided by China after the BRI and the Global Development Initiative. It is a vivid practice of the concept of the Community of Shared Future for Mankind in the field of security.
statements.framing: constructive, presents China as contributor to global good

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial Commentary)
statements.context: Page 2 commentary on Global Security Initiative, April 22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world has entered a period of turbulent change. The outbreak of the Ukraine crisis has made the already uncertain international situation more complex and turbulent. Individual countries keen to form gangs and engage in exclusive 'small circles' and 'small groups' seriously threaten global security.
statements.framing: accusatory toward exclusive blocs and great power behavior

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial Commentary)
statements.context: Page 2 commentary on Global Security Initiative, April 22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To maintain world peace and tranquillity, we must abandon the outdated Cold War mentality. In today's world, many security problems are caused by hegemonism and power politics pursued by individual countries.
statements.topic: security, great power relations, Cold War mentality

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial Commentary)
statements.context: Page 2 commentary on Global Security Initiative, April 22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: After the Ukraine crisis, China firmly advocated the maintenance of international law and the universally recognised basic norms of international relations, adhered to the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, advocated a common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security concept, and promoted the construction of a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework, providing constructive solutions for resolving the crisis and building lasting peace in Europe and Eurasia.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial Commentary)
statements.context: Page 2 commentary on Global Security Initiative, April 22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For a long time, China has actively participated in United Nations peacekeeping operations, international arms control, disarmament and non-proliferation processes, firmly pursued the nuclear strategy of self-defence, and made great efforts to promote political solutions to hot-spot issues such as the Korean nuclear issue and the Iranian nuclear issue. China is committed to promoting international anti-pandemic cooperation, actively leading the global climate governance process, launching the Global Data Security Initiative.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular MFA press briefing, April 21-22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What is disinformation? Efforts to discern disinformation should be based on objective facts, not subjective conjecture. The bellicose US, under the cover of human rights and democracy, meddles in other countries' affairs and starts conflicts and wars. It shoulders an unshirkable responsibility over the turmoil in Europe and elsewhere in the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular MFA press briefing, April 21-22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The vast majority of countries advocate resolving the Russia-Ukraine conflict through dialogue and negotiation and oppose unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction that contravene international law. As European countries pay a heavy price for the conflict, American arms dealers and oil and gas companies have made a fortune.
statements.framing: accusatory toward US sanctions and profiteering

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular MFA press briefing, April 21-22, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is pure disinformation to allege that China has acquiesced in and connived at Russia's military operation in Ukraine and that Russia has requested military equipment from China. The US should stop spreading disinformation to smear China, face up to and reflect on its due responsibility in the Russia-Ukraine conflict, and work with the international community to facilitate an early political resolution of the Ukraine crisis.
statements.framing: defensive, denies allegations of assistance to Russia

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Phone conversation with US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States should earnestly implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state. China hopes to establish sound and stable major-country relations with the United States, while China will defend its national interests and dignity. The United States should not underestimate China's determination and capability. The two militaries should enhance mutual trust, strengthen dialogue and exchanges, manage risks and crises, and carry out practical cooperation to ensure normal and stable development of bilateral military relations.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Phone conversation with US Secretary of Defense Lloyd Austin
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If the Taiwan question is not handled properly, it will have a subversive effect on China-U.S. relations. The Chinese military will resolutely safeguard national sovereignty, security and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Boao Forum for Asia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It has been proven time and again that the Cold War mentality would only wreck the global peace framework, that hegemonism and power politics would endanger world peace, and that bloc confrontation would exacerbate security challenges in the 21st century. China proposes a Global Security Initiative emphasizing common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security; respecting sovereignty and territorial integrity; abiding by UN Charter purposes and principles while rejecting Cold War mentality, unilateralism, and bloc politics; taking legitimate security concerns seriously and opposing pursuit of one's own security at others' expense; peacefully resolving disputes through dialogue while opposing double standards, unilateral sanctions and long-arm jurisdiction.
statements.topic: US policy, global security, geopolitics, multilateralism
statements.framing: accusatory toward US hegemonic practices, constructive regarding alternatives

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Boao Forum for Asia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In today's world, unilateralism and excessive pursuit of self-interest are doomed to fail; so are the practices of decoupling, supply disruption and maximum pressure; so are the attempts to forge 'small circles' or to stoke conflict and confrontation along ideological lines. We need to embrace a global governance philosophy that emphasizes extensive consultation, joint contribution and shared benefits, uphold true multilateralism, and firmly safeguard the international system with the UN at its core and the international order underpinned by international law. It is particularly important for major countries to lead by example in honoring equality, cooperation, good faith and the rule of law.
statements.topic: US policy, trade, technology, geopolitics, multilateralism

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Boao Forum for Asia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will implement the RCEP in full, seek the conclusion of high-standard FTAs with more countries and regions, and actively work for joining the CPTPP and DEPA. China will press ahead with high-quality Belt and Road cooperation. China will unswervingly follow the path of peaceful development, and always be a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development, and a defender of the international order.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Armenian Foreign Minister Ararat Mirzoyan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China believes that Armenia will continue to firmly support China's position on issues concerning China's core interests, adhere to the one-China policy and oppose any form of 'Taiwan independence.'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Georgian Foreign Minister Ilia Darchiashvili
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China speaks highly of Georgia's consistent support on China's core interests and major concerns, and appreciates Georgia's adherence to the one-China policy and its opposition to 'Taiwan independence' in any form.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Azerbaijani Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: He said he believes the Azerbaijani side will continue to support China's legitimate position on issues involving China's core interests, always follow the one-China policy, and oppose any form of 'Taiwan independence.'
