statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Central Commission for Deepening Overall Reform meeting readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi stressed efforts to fully implement a national strategy for building China's strength in cyberspace, urging broad application of digital technology in government management and services. On local fiscal system reforms, Xi noted that fiscal relations between governments should be straightened out for more rational balance between power and responsibility. On establishing criteria for auditing officials on natural-resource asset management, Xi said the system must be scientific, standardized and reasonable to encourage officials to fulfill responsibilities on ecological protection. He urged focusing on weak links in financial services for sci-tech innovation and improving financial support for innovation. To encourage scientific and technological personnel, Xi called for building an innovation ecology conducive to continuous emergence of achievements and effective application of research outcomes.

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.context: Meeting with Speaker of Legislative Assembly of Samoa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang said China will continue working with Samoa to vigorously expand cooperation in economy, trade and investment, infrastructure, agriculture, fishery, tourism and other fields under the framework of the Belt and Road Initiative, strengthen people-to-people exchanges, promote anti-epidemic cooperation, so as to enrich the China-Samoa comprehensive strategic partnership. He said the CPPCC is willing to strengthen exchanges and cooperation with the Parliament of Samoa to consolidate social and public support for the development of bilateral relations.
statements.topic: bilateral relations and Belt and Road Initiative

statements.speaker: Li Zhanshu
statements.context: Meeting with President of Mexican Senate
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The sound development of China-Mexico relations is attributable to the two sides' commitment to mutual respect and equal treatment, especially mutual support on issues concerning each other's core interests and major concerns. The one-China principle is the cornerstone of China-Mexico friendly relations, and China highly appreciates Mexico's long-standing adherence to the principle. As the two countries share broad common interests in international affairs, China and Mexico should enhance multilateral coordination and strengthen communication at international and multilateral arenas such as the UN and the G20, and defend true multilateralism. Both China and Mexico are major developing countries with important influence and great potential for cooperation, and the two sides should continue to pursue mutual benefit and deepen practical cooperation. China welcomes Mexico's active participation in the China International Import Expo and cooperation in the Belt and Road Initiative.

statements.speaker: You Quan
statements.context: Inspection visit in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: You Quan pointed out that we should always proceed from the political height of firmly defending the 'Two Establishments' and 'Two Safeguards'. He called to give full play to the role of leading groups for United Front work at all levels, study and plan with regard to major issues closely related to the overall situation of the center and those related to development and security. It is necessary to promote United Front work at the grassroots and get through to the 'last mile' of implementing the decision-making and deployment of the CPC Central Committee. You Quan emphasized that United Front work departments at all levels should attach great importance to preventing and defusing major risks, and create a good environment for the party's 20th Congress.
statements.topic: domestic political work and risk prevention

statements.speaker: Peng Huagang
statements.speaker_title: Secretary-General of State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission (SASAC)
statements.context: Press briefing on SOE performance
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peng discussed Q1 SOE performance showing net profits grew 13.7% year-on-year and revenues soared 15.4%. Going forward, he outlined focus on steady growth through 'five efficiency gains': strengthening supply, reducing costs, expanding market share, managing losses, and building synergy in industrial chains. He emphasized cooperation with SMEs, noting many central SOEs have added SMEs to supplier lists, and called on SOEs to exempt SMEs from rent in high-risk areas for up to six months. On risk prevention, he outlined 'four controls' addressing debt risks, compliance risks, financial risks, and production safety risks.
statements.topic: economic growth and state enterprise management

statements.speaker: Luo Junjie
statements.speaker_title: Spokesman for Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (MIIT)
statements.context: Press briefing on industrial performance
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In Q1, added value of industrial enterprises above designated size increased 6.5% year-on-year, manufacturing investment increased 15.6% year-on-year, and industrial export delivery value increased 14.4% year-on-year. Manufacturing proportion reached 28.9%, highest since 2016. On green and digital transformation, as of end March, 15 industrial Internet platforms had 30.72 million connected devices and over 225,000 industrial apps, with over 2,400 '5G + Industrial Internet' projects under construction. High-tech manufacturing increased 14.2% year-on-year. MIIT has cultivated 703 national public service platforms for SMEs and 392 entrepreneurial innovation demonstration bases. Going forward, three priorities are: ensuring smooth industrial supply chains through 'white list' system for key industries, coordinating with local officials on logistics and company operations, and supporting SMEs through financing.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Meeting with Mozambican Defense Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wei stressed that facing major global changes unseen in a century and the pandemic, China and Mozambique should further consolidate the special friendship of 'comrades and brothers', jointly resist hegemonism and power politics and promote win-win cooperation and common prosperity. The Chinese military is ready to maintain high-level communication with the Mozambican side, promote practical cooperation and unite in fighting the pandemic, so as to push forward the continuous development of military-to-military relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Ghanaian Foreign Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China highly appreciates Ghana's adherence to the one-China principle and believes that both sides will continue to deepen political mutual trust and jointly preserve the China-Ghana friendly cooperation. The Forum on China-Africa Cooperation is a leading mechanism for win-win cooperation between China and Africa, and China and Ghana should synergize their cooperation with the nine programs for cooperation between China and Africa. China will always be a trustworthy partner in the development and revitalization of Ghana and Africa. China congratulates Ghana on its appointment as non-permanent member of the UN Security Council from 2022 to 2023 and is glad to see Ghana play a more active role in international and regional affairs. China has set up the Group of Friends of the Global Development Initiative under the UN framework to support economic recovery of developing countries after COVID-19, and Ghana is welcome to join. China's vote in the United Nations will always belong to developing countries and African brothers, and China calls for more coordination to jointly uphold international fairness and justice, oppose hegemonism and power politics, and safeguard the overall interests of the two countries and other developing countries.
statements.topic: bilateral relations with Africa, multilateralism, one-China principle

statements.speaker: Le Yucheng
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Ambassador to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Le Yucheng said that under the guidance of President Xi Jinping and President Vladimir Putin, China and Russia maintain high-level development of the comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination for a new era and continue to deepen cooperation in various fields. In Q1 of this year, bilateral trade volume reached 38.2 billion US dollars, an increase of nearly 30 percent, fully demonstrating the great resilience and internal dynamism of bilateral cooperation. No matter how the international landscape may change, China will continue to strengthen strategic coordination with Russia for win-win cooperation, jointly safeguard the common interests of the two countries and promote the building of a new type of international relations and a community with a shared future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Ma Xiaowei
statements.context: Article in Study Times
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with the highly transmissible Omicron strain, the country should roll out the strictest, most thorough and resolute measures to coordinate comprehensive steps and cut transmission in the shortest possible time. Relaxing COVID-19 disease control measures will threaten to stretch the country's unevenly distributed medical systems too thin and hurt its large number of elderly and vulnerable people. China has entered the fourth stage of its battle against the disease. Upgraded measures are needed in the current stage, such as adding antigen tests to mass screening campaigns and expanding the capacity of quarantine facilities and makeshift hospitals.

statements.speaker: Lin Wu
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily on national security
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Lin discusses the overall national security concept, emphasizing establishing understanding of the 'overall situation' by keeping domestic and external situations in mind and taking national interests as priority. On being prepared for danger in times of peace, he notes the Theory Learning Center Group of the Provincial Party Committee followed up and studied General Secretary Xi Jinping's important exposition on national security work and the spirit of relevant meetings of the Politburo, and drove party committees at all levels to establish their ideological consciousness and action consciousness of studying and implementing the overall national security concept. The provincial party committee conscientiously implements major national security decision-making arrangements of the CPC Central Committee and formulates action measures. Many special studies have been conducted on major national security issues and grassroots research has been conducted to grasp the truth. Every quarter, risks in economic security, ideological security, social security, and safety in production are assessed and evaluated. Lin emphasizes Shanxi's function as 'moat' for capital Beijing, discussing fight against 'infiltration, subversion, terrorism, and separatism' and crackdown on 'illegal religions' and 'cults', as well as 'ideological struggle' against threats of 'infiltration and destruction by hostile forces' networks'. He discusses improving governance on pandemic management, flood and disaster relief, workplace safety, and maintaining social stability, and safeguarding economic security, ecological security, and cultural security.

article_title: Emphasising Economic Resilience - Lawmakers Must Adhere to 'Correct Political Direction' - Cui Hongjian on EU & Ukraine War - Jiangsu Party Secretary on National Security

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Message to Philippine President Rodrigo Duterte regarding typhoon damage
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to provide assistance within its capacity to the Philippines following the typhoon

statements.speaker: Cui Hongjian
statements.speaker_title: Director, Department for European Studies, China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily (Page 3)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States regarded itself as the 'victor of the Cold War' and treated Russia as a 'loser', enlisting European countries to engage in political discrimination, economic 'transformation' and security squeeze against Russia. NATO strengthened itself by accepting new members and repeatedly expanding its missions, accumulating contradictions with Russia until collapse of mutual trust.

statements.speaker: Cui Hongjian
statements.speaker_title: Director, Department for European Studies, China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily (Page 3)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Throughout the process of the Ukrainian crisis emerging and escalating, the United States was not only reluctant to assume responsibility of engaging in direct and equal dialogue with Russia on European security, but instead used NATO's military deterrence strategy against Russia, limiting space for European diplomatic mediation and eventually resulting in the Russia-Ukraine conflict.

statements.speaker: Cui Hongjian
statements.speaker_title: Director, Department for European Studies, China Institute of International Studies
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily (Page 3)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Europe should establish subject consciousness around building European security and urge the United States to assume responsibility of not promoting conflict escalation, not evading conflicts with Russia, and not undermining European security.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Comments on China's Space Station being open to foreign astronauts, reported ahead of Boao Forum for Asia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's Space Station is open to foreign astronauts

article_title: Q1 Economic Data - Adhere to Pandemic Control Policies - Ukraine War & the 'Need for Common, Comprehensive, Cooperative & Sustainable Security Concept' - Human Rights - National Security Preparedness

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Cited in People's Daily commentary on Ukraine crisis
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The root of the Ukrainian crisis lies in the long-standing regional security contradictions in Europe, and the fundamental solution is to take care of the legitimate security concerns of all parties concerned. China advocates that all countries should establish a common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security concept

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary on Ukraine crisis and NATO
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US-led NATO, with its Cold War mentality, maintains its own security at the expense of other countries' security and seeks regional security by expanding military blocs, which is the greatest threat to international security

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary on Ukraine crisis and NATO
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's constructive stance highlights its role as a major country that practices the correct security concept and persists in being a builder of world peace. China is willing to support peace talks, attach importance to the legitimate security concerns of all countries, and support the establishment of a balanced, effective and sustainable European security mechanism

statements.speaker: Xu Xianming
statements.speaker_title: Vice President, China Society for Human Rights Studies
statements.context: Article on human rights development in China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We are willing to engage in dialogue and exchanges with other countries on human rights issues on the basis of equality and mutual respect, but we are opposed to a one-size-fits-all approach or double standards on human rights issues, and any country interfering in China's internal affairs under the guise of human rights

article_title: Xi on Space Power - Flood Preparation - Resolution 2758 - National Security Education Day - Political Security = Regime & System Security - Covid: 'Persistence is Victory' - China-Vietnam FMs Talk

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese Foreign Minister Bui Thanh Son
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States tries to create regional tension and provoke confrontation by pushing the 'Indo-Pacific Strategy,' which will seriously damage the hard-won peaceful development in the region and seriously erode the regional cooperation structure centered on ASEAN. We cannot let the Cold War mentality return to the region and the tragedy of Ukraine be repeated around us.
statements.topic: US Indo-Pacific Strategy and regional geopolitics

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Vietnamese Foreign Minister Bui Thanh Son
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, the situation in the South China Sea has remained generally stable with the joint efforts of China and ASEAN countries. It is precisely some forces outside the region with ulterior motives who are anxious that the South China Sea will not be chaotic.
statements.topic: South China Sea and US involvement

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary on National Security Education Day
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 18th Party Congress, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at the core has adhered to the overall national security concept and integrated national security into all aspects of the work of the Party and the country. In response to external shocks and challenges, steps have been taken to strictly prevent and severely crack down on infiltration, sabotage, subversion, and separatist activities from hostile forces, and withstand and counterattack extreme suppression and containment from external forces.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary on National Security Education Day
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international form is experiencing profound complex changes. Economic globalisation is facing countercurrents; the game between major countries is becoming increasingly fierce; and the world has entered a new period of turbulent change. The US tries to create regional tension and provoke confrontation by pushing the 'Indo-Pacific Strategy.'
statements.topic: US regional strategy and geopolitical competition

article_title: Xi's Hainan Visit Wrap - Li on Boosting Consumption - Q1 Foreign Trade Data - China's Development Finance Work - Anti-Corruption Struggle - Zhong Sheng on US Human Rights Hypocrisy

statements.speaker: Ma Zhaoxu
statements.speaker_title: BRICS Sherpa and Vice Foreign Minister
statements.context: Second BRICS sherpas' meeting discussing Ukraine
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries reiterated their respective national positions on the Ukraine issue, pledging to support multilateralism, abide by the purposes and principles of the UN Charter, and respect the legitimate security concerns of all countries. BRICS countries expressed concern over humanitarian situation in Ukraine and support for humanitarian aid. BRICS noted particular concern about serious impact of unilateral sanctions on world economy recovery, industrial and supply chain stability, energy and food security.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary on US State Department's 2021 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is hypocritical and politicising and weaponizing the issue of human rights to further its hegemonic interests, undermining the cause of human rights development globally. In recent years, facing China's increasing comprehensive national strength, some American politicians have suffered from anxiety about China. They embrace a Cold War mentality and engage in zero-sum games. The so-called issues of 'democracy' and 'human rights' have increasingly become tools for US politicians to smear China and whitewash their hegemonic behaviour.

article_title: Li on Bonds - Zero-Covid a Test of Political Quality - Song Tao Speaks to Boris Gryzlov - China's Horn of Africa Diplomacy - 86% of Special Bond Quota Issued - Aerospace Sector & Digital Economy

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs press conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is practicing hegemony and bullying on the Ukraine issue. NATO escalated tensions to the breaking point. The US spreads disinformation to smear China and distort China's responsible position on peace talks. The US harbors the agenda to shift blame, instigate confrontation, profit from the situation and hold down China and Russia simultaneously. The US holds Cold War mentality, draws ideological lines, instigates 'color revolutions,' wages wars, engages in unilateral sanctions and economic coercion undermining global supply chains. The US applies 'rules-based order' as 'rules of the gang' to defend hegemony. The US should discard Cold War and zero-sum mentality and return to upholding international equity and justice.
statements.topic: US foreign policy, Ukraine, China-US relations, international order

article_title: Li on Enhancing 'Sense of Urgency' on the Economy - COVID Propaganda - Adhere to Dynamic Zero-Covid in Shanghai - CAC on Regulating Algorithms - China-Djibouti Ties

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: MoFA press briefing in response to NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg's accusations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China deplores and firmly rejects NATO's groundless accusations and smears. NATO is an obsolete Cold War military alliance that has engaged in bloc confrontation. China has always been a builder of world peace and contributor to global development. China will steadfastly pursue peaceful development. NATO should stop spreading disinformation, abandon confrontational ideological approaches, and stop trying to destabilize Asia and the world.

statements.speaker: Hu Bin
statements.context: Article in People's Daily about China-Djibouti cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Djibouti Belt and Road Initiative cooperation has greatly benefited the people of Djibouti, including infrastructure projects like the Addis Ababa-Djibouti Railway, Doraleh Multipurpose Port, and the Ethiopia-Djibouti cross-border water supply project benefiting 750,000 people. China has trained around 2,000 people in Djibouti in the past three years.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, bilateral cooperation, development

article_title: Xi as 'People's Leader' - Building a National Unified Market - Liang Wannian on Zero Covid Policy - Zhong Sheng: The West is United but Isolated - Central & State Organs' Inspections Begin

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US hegemony and the Ukraine war, People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States uses the Ukraine crisis to promote a binary 'friend or enemy' narrative instead of promoting peace talks. US politicians force other countries to take sides and use ideology to hold hostage other nations. This Cold War mentality of bloc confrontation runs counter to the trend of shared human destiny. US words and deeds trample on and destroy the international order.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary series on US hegemony and the Ukraine war, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US attempts to build a global 'grand coalition against Russia' through propaganda and threats. In American diplomatic lexicon, only 'America First' and 'hegemony' and 'bullying' exist, but 'equality' and 'respect' do not. The US approach of bloc confrontation promotes a 'so-called rules-based international order' that actually replaces universally accepted international rules with rules formulated by a few countries.
statements.topic: diplomacy, US foreign policy, international order, Ukraine

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Commentary series on US hegemony and the Ukraine war, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The fundamental way to solve the Ukraine crisis lies in dialogue and negotiation. Forcing countries to choose sides only interferes with crisis resolution. Many countries refuse to follow the US in taking hostile positions against Russia and believe unilateral sanctions will fail and trigger larger humanitarian crises. Even American media acknowledge that despite Western alliance cohesion, the West is experiencing 'unprecedented isolation'.

statements.speaker: Liang Wannian
statements.context: Interview in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with the Omicron variant, some countries opted for the policy of 'lying flat', allowing the virus to infect people and causing great harm. China adheres to dynamic zero-COVID. Our socialist system has strong ability to organize and mobilize, and with people's support, scientific tools, and epidemic-fighting experience, we have the capability to ensure the success of the zero-COVID strategy.

article_title: Roots of American Hegemony - Zero-Covid is the 'Best Choice' - Wang Yi's Chat with Emmanuel Bonne - Zhong Sheng on US & Human Rights - Employment Situation 'Complex & Severe' - Common Prosperity

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with French President's diplomatic counselor Emmanuel Bonne
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi had comprehensively expounded China's principled position on the Ukraine issue. China looks forward to an early ceasefire and restoration of peace, and has been making unremitting efforts to this end. All parties should work to create necessary environment for advancing peace talks, facilitating peace and negotiations instead of fanning flames. One cannot call for ceasefire while sending large quantities of advanced weapons, and one cannot claim to support dialogue while imposing unilateral sanctions and provoking escalation. The Ukraine issue has roots in Europe's security imbalance; principle of indivisible security should be adhered to and a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework should be rebuilt.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Mongolian Foreign Minister Batmunkh Battsetseg
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The more turbulent the international situation is, the more China and Mongolia should strengthen communication, enhance mutual trust and deepen cooperation. China is willing to work with Mongolia to speed up construction of the China-Russia-Mongolia Economic Corridor and promote connectivity of railway lines between China and Mongolia. The two sides agreed to continue to firmly support each other in safeguarding sovereignty, security and development interests, and avoid external interference.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Comments on Nancy Pelosi's expected visit to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China resolutely opposes all forms of official contact between the US and Taiwan. Congress is a branch of the US government and should stringently abide by the one-China policy. If Speaker Pelosi visits Taiwan, this would gravely violate the one-China principle and the stipulations of the three China-US Joint Communiqués, seriously undermine China's sovereignty and territorial integrity, severely impact the political foundation of China-US relations and send a seriously wrong signal to 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces. The US should abide by the one-China principle and the three China-US Joint Communiqués, immediately cancel Speaker Pelosi's plan to visit Taiwan, stop official contact with Taiwan, and fulfill its commitment of not supporting 'Taiwan independence' with real actions. If the US insists on having its own way, China will take firm and strong measures to resolutely safeguard its sovereignty and territorial integrity. All possible consequences that arise from this will completely be borne by the US side.

statements.speaker: Taiwan Affairs Office of the State Council
statements.context: Comments on Nancy Pelosi's expected visit to Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China would not tolerate such a visit and would 'strike back firmly' if it takes place. The visit represents 'collusion' between Taiwan independence seeking forces and American officials. We warn Taiwan's Democratic Progressive Party authority to immediately stop seeking 'Taiwan independence' by collaborating with foreign forces.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary series)
statements.context: 8th commentary in Zhong Sheng series criticising the US
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has an unshirkable responsibility for the current refugee tide in Europe. The US government declared it would welcome Ukrainian refugees 'with open arms' but ironically, compared with European countries receiving millions of refugees, from March 1-16, the United States only received seven Ukrainian refugees. According to Newsweek, at least five Ukrainian refugees entering the US have been detained. The US promised to accept 100,000 Ukrainian refugees but even if fulfilled, it will be a drop in the bucket.
statements.topic: US foreign policy, Ukraine, human rights

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary series)
statements.context: 8th commentary in Zhong Sheng series criticising the US
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US instead of being a defender of human rights has been the biggest violator of rights around the world. This includes the bombing of Yugoslavia, wars in Afghanistan and Iraq, and conflicts in Syria and Libya. The human rights issue is nothing but a tool to extend US hegemony. Humanitarian issues should not be politicised or used as an excuse to maintain hegemony. If the US really cares about the humanitarian situation in Ukraine, it should take concrete actions to ease the situation and play a constructive role in dialogue and negotiation.
statements.topic: US foreign policy, human rights, hegemony

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary series)
statements.context: 8th commentary in Zhong Sheng series criticising the US
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For maintaining hegemony, the US wields sanctions as a tool, further exacerbating humanitarian crises. The US used sanctions on Iraq that led to the death of half a million children. US sanctions on Iran prevented import of medical supplies, threatening Iranians' right to life and health. US sanctions on Syria severely impact Syrians' economic, social and cultural rights. The US economic blockade of Cuba has lasted 60 years, not relaxed even during the pandemic.
statements.topic: US foreign policy, sanctions, human rights

statements.speaker: Wei Nanzhi
statements.context: Article on international page discussing roots of American hegemony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: An alliance of interests between the American state machinery and international monopoly capital groups is the 'foundation' of American hegemony. The US' own national governance capacity has struggled to maintain this foundation. The United States is increasingly transferring internal contradictions to external crises. The US historically treated aborigines, African slaves and immigrants of colour in a cruel manner through forcing cultural transformation and various exclusive and discriminatory regulations. Externally, the US regards itself as the representative of western civilization, promotes American values as 'universal values', and creates or amplifies ethnic and ideological conflicts by launching 'colour revolutions', becoming the 'source of chaos in the world'.
statements.topic: US hegemony, foreign policy, domestic issues

statements.speaker: Wei Nanzhi
statements.context: Article on international page discussing roots of American hegemony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States pursues 'double standards' and makes profits by creating and leveraging various regional conflicts. The anti-communist thinking established through 'Red Scare' and 'McCarthyism' remains extremely strong. The US ruling clique has divided American public opinions, used identity politics to disintegrate class political discourse, cracked down upon or corrupted trade unions, and prevented the American people from forming a joint force. The Federal Reserve System, while performing central bank duties, is a private central bank where 'money power' legitimately controls the right to issue American currency. US government major policies depend on support from international monopoly capital groups.
statements.topic: US domestic politics, governance, economic system

statements.speaker: Wei Nanzhi
statements.context: Article on international page discussing roots of American hegemony
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is natural tension between political power and capital power in the United States. The system design emphasises separation of powers, federalism, and a two-party system, but international monopoly capital groups that dominate the economy have developed into a global production system. With monopoly capital's global power expansion, American domestic and foreign affairs have become tools for monopoly consortiums to make profits. Both parties are unable to carry out internal structural reforms and can only shift the crisis by shaping a common external enemy, pursuing foreign policy based on 'American interests first', which has fundamentally damaged the trustworthiness of the United States.

article_title: State Council on Employment & Price Stability - Wang Yi Speaks to Israeli & Canadian FMs - Liu Zongyi on Afghanistan - Shanghai COVID Outbreak - Zhong Sheng: America's Cold War Mentality

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Canadian Foreign Minister, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The essence of the Meng Wanzhou case lies in US suppression of Chinese high-tech enterprises by coercion, a shameful behavior. No country should act as a facilitator of such unilateral bullying.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Wednesday MoFA press conference, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US arms sales to Taiwan seriously violate the one-China principle and three China-US joint communiques, seriously undermine China's sovereignty and security interests, and severely harm China-US relations and peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. China will take firm and forceful measures to resolutely safeguard its sovereignty and security interests.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng series commentary)
statements.context: Published commentary on Ukraine war (7th in series)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: America's deep-rooted Cold War mentality is the root cause of the Ukrainian crisis. The US has repeatedly spread false information, smearing China and distorting China's responsible position of promoting peace talks. The US repeatedly claims it does not seek a 'new Cold War' but always takes opportunity to suppress and contain China and Russia, regards them as major strategic competitors.
statements.topic: US policy, Cold War mentality, Ukraine, US-China relations

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: MoFA press briefing on Bucha killings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The relevant circumstances and specific causes of the incident must be verified and ascertained. Humanitarian issues shouldn't be politicized. Before the full picture is clear, all sides should exercise restraint and avoid unfounded accusations.
statements.topic: Ukraine, US-led Western accusations against Russia

article_title: Qingming Festival - Shanghai COVID-19 Outbreak - Wang Yi Speaks to Ukrainian and Hungarian FMs - Media Coverage of Bucha Killings

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with Hungarian Minister of Foreign Affairs and Trade Peter Szijjarto, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world finds itself in a new period of turbulence and changes, making it particularly valuable and important for countries to stay independent. China and Hungary should deepen cooperation, consolidate the political foundation, enhance their capacity to jointly resist risks and challenges, and safeguard each other's sovereignty, security and development interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba, reported by Xinhua in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is China's historical and cultural tradition and consistent foreign policy to safeguard peace and oppose war. On Ukraine, China does not seek geopolitical interests, will not watch from a safe distance, or add fuel to the fire. China wants peace in Ukraine, welcomes peace talks between Russia and Ukraine, and believes talks should continue until ceasefire and eventual peace are achieved. The principle of indivisible security should be adhered to, and a balanced, effective and sustainable European security architecture should be built upon dialogue on equal footing. Based on its objective and impartial position, China is willing to play a constructive role.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Chat with Panamanian Foreign Minister Erika Mouynes on Monday in Tunxi, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since China and Panama officially established diplomatic relations five years ago based on the affirmation of the one-China principle, bilateral ties have ushered in a new chapter. China is willing to take the fifth anniversary of diplomatic relations as an opportunity to facilitate political mutual trust, pragmatic cooperation, people-to-people exchanges and multilateral coordination, to foster more propellers of China-Panama friendly ties.

article_title: Li on Stable Growth - 'No Policy that Adversely Affects Market Expectations will be Introduced' - Wang Meets Lavrov & Qureshi - Zhong Sheng on US & NATO's Cold War Mentality - Zero-Covid Policy

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press conference on China-EU summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the EU are two major forces for world peace, two major markets for common development and two major civilizations for humanity's progress. The two sides should strengthen strategic communication, enhance mutual trust, build consensus and conduct dialogue and cooperation on the basis of mutual respect, mutual benefit and win-win results. On Ukraine, the international community should say and do more conducive to dialogue and negotiation instead of setting up obstacles.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Press conference Q&A on Ukraine negotiations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China noted positive signals from Russia-Ukraine negotiations. Dialogue and negotiation is the only right way to resolve the Ukraine crisis. The international community should speak and act in a way conducive to dialogue and negotiation, and support Russia and Ukraine in keeping talks going. It is important to prevent adding fuel to the fire and heightening tensions, which will only impede diplomatic settlement.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: How ironic it is for the US to say 'big countries cannot bully small countries'. If the US can reflect on what it did to Cuba and Panama in 1960s, Grenada in 1980s, the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia in 1990s, Afghanistan and Iraq at the start of this century, and Syria and Libya afterwards, it would find that these are textbook examples of big countries bullying small countries. Why hasn't the US said a word about these facts? The US should wear label of the big bullying the small well. If the US is sincere about easing the situation in Ukraine, then it should stand on the side of peace and justice as most countries do in the world.
statements.topic: US policy, international order, human rights, geopolitics

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Telephone conversation with Spanish Foreign Minister José Manuel Albares, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China doesn't want to be affected by western sanctions on Russia.

article_title: 20th Party Congress Progress in Central & State Organs - China's 5 Roads & 5 Strategic Advantages - Economic Data - Wang-Hoekstra Call - COVID - Zhong Sheng: US Bio-military Activities in Ukraine

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The position of the Chinese side on the Ukraine issue has been consistent and open, noting that 'the four musts' highlighted by Chinese President Xi Jinping are China's clearest and the most authoritative attitude, and that all measures taken by China will be based on the 'four musts'. China, as a peace-loving country, has always been committed to peaceful settlement of disputes through political means, and is ready to work with the Netherlands and other countries of the European Union to play a constructive role in resolving the Ukrainian crisis.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is hope for a cease-fire and a peaceful future can be opened up if the talks can be maintained. China will continue making efforts in its own way to promote peace talks.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Escalating sanctions imposed by the United States and Europe against Russia have compounded the difficulties facing a struggling global economic recovery and inflicted undue damage on the people's livelihood of various countries. All parties should do more to promote peace talks, not the opposite.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has already put forward a six-point proposal on easing the humanitarian situation in Ukraine and taken concrete actions, with the first batch of emergency humanitarian aid having arrived and been distributed.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Behind the Ukraine crisis lies the issue of Europe's security. European countries should sit down with Russia for an in-depth and comprehensive dialogue to discuss ways to set up a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On China's Taiwan question, the Chinese foreign minister said he hopes that such words about respecting sovereignty and territorial integrity would also be matched with deeds, and double standards should not be applied.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: MFA press briefing on March 11, responding to UN Human Rights Council discussion of torture
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In 2021, over 1,124 Americans died of police violence. Most victims were killed by police in circumstances involving non-violent crimes or even without criminal behavior. Black people are 3.5 times more likely than White people to be killed by police brutality. There are frequent media revelations about torture, abuse and violence in various detention facilities in the US including private prisons. The Guantanamo Bay prison is infamous for systemic abuse and torture. The CIA has set up black sites in many countries where so-called 'terrorist suspects' were secretly held in arbitrary detention and confessions were extorted by torture. The US 'floating prisons' aboard 17 navy ships and network of black sites in countries like Lithuania exemplify how the US prison system wantonly tramples on rule of law and human rights.
statements.topic: US human rights, police violence, detention, torture

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: MFA press briefing on March 11
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is in no position to claim itself a beacon or defender of human rights, still less to make wanton remarks about other countries' human rights conditions under false pretenses. China calls on the Human Rights Council and the Special Rapporteur on torture to pay closer attention to the US' violation of human rights and urge it to adopt concrete measures to resolve relevant issues.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Russia has successively exposed bio-military cooperation projects implemented by the United States in Ukraine, lifting the veil off the 'bio-military empire' of the United States. According to data released by the United States itself, the US Department of Defense has carried out biological cooperation projects in more than 30 countries around the world. The United States controls hundreds of biological laboratories under the name of 'cooperation to reduce biosafety risks' and 'strengthening global public health'. American bio-military activities in Ukraine are just the tip of the iceberg.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In 2001, the international community reached an agreement on the establishment of the verification mechanism of the Biological Weapons Convention, but the United States suddenly and unilaterally withdrew from the negotiations on the grounds that 'verification harms the security and economic interests of the United States'. Since then, the United States has been exclusively opposed to the establishment of a verification mechanism.
statements.topic: US policy, Biological Weapons Convention, multilateral agreements

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States stubbornly believes that only it can decide whether it has complied with the Biological Weapons Convention. The United States not only does not allow the international community to investigate, but also does not allow any country to ask questions of it. Whoever asks a question will be accused of 'spreading false information'. This is typical robber logic and hegemonic behaviour.
statements.topic: US unilateralism, international law, Biological Weapons Convention

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States said that there were 26 laboratories and other cooperative facilities in Ukraine in November, and on March 11th changed to say there were 46. If the United States' intention is really to safeguard biological safety and strengthen public health, there is no reason why the international community should not support it. But if the United States is taking the opportunity to seize other countries' biological resources or even research to develop biological weapons, it is another matter altogether. The United States should give an account to the international community and make a comprehensive clarification on bio-military activities in Ukraine and around the world in a responsible manner.

article_title: State Council Discusses Key Tasks - Xi & Two Sessions - Yang-Sullivan Meeting - Zhong Sheng: US, the 'Initiator' - 始作俑者 - of Ukraine Crisis - MoFA on Arms Sales & US' Taiwan Policy

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Press conference during Two Sessions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We aim to achieve about 5.5 percent growth this year to ensure the steady performance of the Chinese economy at a high level. To achieve this goal is not easy, and needs the support of a series of macro policies. Government spending this year will rise by no less than 2 trillion yuan, mostly for tax and fee reductions. China is still faced with challenges such as climate change, income gap, and debt that need forceful response. China's modernization is a long process requiring addressing issues through development.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission, Politburo Member
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan in Rome
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current U.S. administration has pledged to adhere to the one-China policy and not to support 'Taiwan independence', but its actions are obviously inconsistent with its statements. The Chinese side expresses grave concern over and firm opposition to recent wrong words and deeds of the U.S. side on Taiwan-related issues. Any attempts to condone and support 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces, or play the 'Taiwan card' and use the Taiwan question to contain China will be futile. China urges the U.S. to recognize the high sensitivity of the Taiwan question, abide by the one-China principle, the three Sino-U.S. joint communiques and the commitments made by the U.S. side, and stop going further down the dangerous path.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission, Politburo Member
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan in Rome
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Yang expounded on China's solemn position on issues related to Xinjiang, Tibet and Hong Kong, pointing out that these issues concern China's core interests and are China's internal affairs that allow no foreign interference. Any attempt to use these issues to suppress China will fail.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission, Politburo Member
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan in Rome
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side does not want to see the situation in Ukraine as it has developed. China always stands for respecting the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries, and abiding by the purposes and principles of the UN Charter. China is committed to promoting peace talks. It is important to straighten out the historical context of the Ukraine issue, get to the bottom of the problem's origin, and respond to the legitimate concerns of all parties. The Chinese side resolutely opposes any words and deeds that spread false information, or distort and discredit China's position.

statements.speaker: Yang Jiechi
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Office of the Foreign Affairs Commission, Politburo Member
statements.context: Meeting with US National Security Advisor Jake Sullivan in Rome
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To preserve peace in Europe and around the world, encourage relevant parties to conduct equal-footed dialogue, and set up a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework based on the principle of indivisible security.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on FDI statistics
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Foreign Direct Investment was at 243.7 billion yuan in the first two months of 2022, a year-on-year increase of 37.9% (or $37.86 billion, up 45.2% year-on-year). FDI into high-tech sector increased by 73.8% year-on-year.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Spanish Minister of Foreign Affairs Jose Manuel Albares
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some forces have been constantly smearing China's objective and just position on the Ukraine issue and creating disinformation. The Chinese side will continue to play a constructive role in the peaceful settlement of the Ukrainian crisis on multilateral occasions. The Ukraine crisis is the result of the accumulation and intensification of security frictions in Europe over the years. The Chinese side encourages Russia and Ukraine to achieve a ceasefire through peace talks, and expressed hope that Europe and Russia will launch dialogue and negotiations on an equal basis, and find reasonable solutions to their security concerns, so as to set up a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Indonesian Foreign Minister Retno Marsudi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to play a constructive role in easing tensions, promoting peace talks and preventing humanitarian crises in accordance with the 'four musts' put forth by Chinese President Xi Jinping. To achieve long-term stability in Europe, the European Union, NATO and Russia need to engage in dialogue on an equal footing, and establish a balanced, effective and sustainable security framework.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.speaker_title: Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: UN Security Council briefing by OSCE chairperson-in-office
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The 'wanton use of sanctions' will not help solve the conflict in Ukraine but only create new problems. The current status in Ukraine is an outcome of the interplay of complex historical and present factors. Escalating sanctions have already seriously affected and will continue to affect global finance, energy, food, transportation, supply chains and other fields, hampering the already fragile world economy amid the pandemic. We once again call for greater diplomatic efforts by the international community to de-escalate tensions and immediately bring the Ukrainian issue back to the track of political settlement.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.speaker_title: Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: UN Security Council briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The principle of indivisible security carries special significance under the current circumstances and should not only be upheld, but more importantly, be implemented. The final settlement of the crisis in Ukraine requires taking seriously and respecting the legitimate security concerns of all states, and forming a balanced, effective and sustainable European security mechanism. The Cold War mentality based on bloc confrontation should be rejected entirely. The path of dialogue and cooperation should become wider rather than narrower.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side firmly opposes US arms sales to China's Taiwan region, which severely violates the one-China principle and the three China-US joint communiques, especially the August 17 Communique, interferes in China's internal affairs, and harms China-US relations as well as peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait. The US should earnestly abide by the one-China principle and the three China-US joint communiques and stop arms sales to and military ties with Taiwan.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is only one China in the world. Taiwan is an inalienable part of the Chinese territory. The US' move grossly interferes in China's internal affairs, pursues political manipulation with the map of the Taiwan region, and attempts to create the false impression of 'two Chinas' and 'one China, one Taiwan'. Playing the 'Taiwan card' is like playing with fire. It will not only push Taiwan to a precarious situation, but also bring unbearable consequences for the US. The US should stop hollowing out the one-China principle and stop condoning or abetting 'Taiwan independence' moves.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular press briefing at Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of documents, pictures, materials and other evidence found by Russia in Ukraine, the US could not convince others by simply dismissing the concerns as 'disinformation'. The US always claims to be 'open and transparent'. If the concerns are 'disinformation', why doesn't the US release detailed materials to prove its innocence? What did the US spend the $200 million on? What kind of research has the US conducted on which pathogens? What is it trying to hide when the US Embassy in Ukraine deleted all relevant documents on its website? Why does the US insist on being the only country in the world to oppose the establishment of a multilateral verification mechanism though it claims to abide by the Biological Weapons Convention?

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US should reflect on its role in the Ukrainian crisis, stop lying, deceiving and confusing the public, earnestly shoulder its due responsibilities, take practical actions to ease the situation and solve problems, and do something conducive to peace. Some US officials and media have fabricated and disseminated false information to smear China in the context of the Ukraine war. Their tactics remind people of the disgraceful history of the US lying and repeatedly waging war through rumors.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not want to see the situation in Ukraine as it has developed. As a permanent member of the UN Security Council, China has always made judgments and expressed opinions independently based on the merits of the matter in an objective and fair manner. To defuse the current crisis, it is necessary to uphold the purposes and principles of the UN Charter and respect and safeguard the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries. We must uphold the principle of indivisibility of security and accommodate the legitimate security concerns of parties concerned. We must resolve disputes peacefully through dialogue and negotiation. We must build a balanced, effective and sustainable European security mechanism. China's position is aboveboard, and China's position is positive and constructive.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To solve the Ukrainian crisis, it is imperative to promote peace talks, and not add fuel to the fire. China always stands on the side of peaceful cooperation, fairness and justice, supports any efforts that are conducive to easing the situation and political settlement, and opposes any actions that are not conducive to promoting diplomatic settlement and leading to an escalation of the situation. China has always maintained close communication with all parties, and has done some work to persuade and promote talks.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not support the use of sanctions to resolve the Ukrainian issue; and opposes unilateral sanctions that have no basis in international law. Sanctions have never been an effective way to solve problems. They will only bring serious difficulties to the economy and the livelihood of the people in the countries concerned, and further aggravate division and confrontation. Sanctions will not only cause a 'no-win' or 'multiple losses' economic outcome, but will also interfere with the process of political settlement.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As the initiator of the Ukrainian crisis, the United States should reflect on its role in the Ukrainian crisis, stop lying, deceiving and confusing people, earnestly shoulder its due responsibilities, take practical actions to ease the situation and solve problems, and do something conducive to peace.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement/press briefing regarding Yang Jiechi's upcoming meeting with Jake Sullivan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The key issue of this meeting is to implement the important consensus reached by the Chinese and US heads of state in their virtual summit in November last year. The two sides will exchange views on China-US relations and international and regional issues of common concern.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with political advisors from agriculture and welfare sectors at CPPCC session; comments reproduced in People's Daily editorial
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international situation is continuing to undergo profound and complicated changes, with once-in-a-century changes intertwined with the once-in-a-century pandemic, economic globalisation facing counter-currents, major power contests becoming increasingly fierce, and the world entering a new period of turbulent change. Despite these challenges, China has multiple strategic advantages: strong Party leadership, socialist system with Chinese characteristics (demonstrated through poverty alleviation and COVID-19 control), solid foundation for sustained development with strong economic resilience, stable social environment, and spiritual strength of self-confidence. The contrast between 'the governance of China' and 'chaos in the West' is even more apparent.
statements.topic: China's strategic position amid geopolitical competition

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.context: Speech at closing of CPPCC session, March 10-11, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: CPPCC members must constantly enhance political judgement, political understanding and political execution, consciously maintain consistency with the CPC Central Committee with Xi Jinping as the core, and earnestly shoulder the political responsibility of implementing the decision-making arrangements of the CPC Central Committee.

statements.speaker: Wu Qian
statements.speaker_title: Spokesman for PLA and PAP delegation at NPC
statements.context: Press briefing at NPC, March 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is groundless for some external forces to hype up the so-called 'invisible military spending'. China's defense spending remains relatively low compared to major military powers such as the US in terms of percentage in GDP, percentage in national fiscal expenditure, and per capita defense expenditure. The increase in China's national defense spending is necessary to cope with complex security challenges and to fulfill its duties as a major country.
statements.topic: Defense budget and military spending transparency

statements.speaker: Wu Qian
statements.speaker_title: Spokesman for PLA and PAP delegation at NPC
statements.context: Press briefing at NPC, March 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is but one China in the world and Taiwan is an inalienable part of Chinese territory. The Chinese people on both sides of the Taiwan Strait are brothers and sisters. China consistently upholds the guideline of 'peaceful reunification' and 'one country, two systems', and is willing to make utmost efforts with greatest sincerity to strive for peaceful reunification, but will never tolerate secession from the nation by 'Taiwan independence' forces. The exercises and training by the PLA are targeted at 'Taiwan independence' secessionist activities and external interference, not at Taiwan compatriots. The DPP has refused to acknowledge the 1992 Consensus, quickened steps towards 'Taiwan independence', and colluded with external forces. The Taiwan question is purely China's internal affair that brooks no external interference. Washington and Tokyo's political ploy to contain China by playing the Taiwan card will be nothing but a pipe dream. The more aggressive they are on the Taiwan question, the firmer and tougher we will be in safeguarding national sovereignty and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone calls with French Foreign Minister Jean-Yves Le Drian and Italian Foreign Minister Luigi Di Maio, March 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China would like to see an early ceasefire and cessation of fighting in Ukraine, which is also the common aspiration of the international community. China hopes that the international community will continue to encourage and support Russia-Ukraine negotiations and create necessary environment and conditions for these negotiations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Italian Foreign Minister Luigi Di Maio, March 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Ukraine crisis is closely related to European security and stability. China is not a party involved, but as a permanent member of the UN Security Council and a responsible major country, we will continue to make efforts to ease tensions and seek peace in our own way. Behind the Ukraine crisis lies the issue of European security. European countries should conduct in-depth and comprehensive discussions with Russia on the basis of agreements reached so far in accordance with the principle of the indivisibility of security to form a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with French Foreign Minister Jean-Yves Le Drian, March 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always opposed long-arm jurisdiction and unilateral sanctions that have no basis in international law. In the case of weak global economic recovery, unlimited sanctions will undermine the stability of international industrial and supply chains, aggravate the food and energy crisis, and hurt people's livelihoods in all countries.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular press briefing, March 8, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports and encourages all diplomatic efforts conducive to peacefully resolving the Ukraine crisis. We are prepared to continue playing a constructive role to facilitate dialogue for peace and work alongside the international community when needed to carry out necessary mediation.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular press briefing, March 8, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes all diplomatic efforts to peacefully resolve the Ukraine crisis, including the trilateral foreign ministers' meeting of Turkey, Russia and Ukraine. We note that this is the highest-level meeting between the two sides since the conflict broke out. We hope relevant parties can meet each other halfway in the principle of mutual respect, sit down for serious negotiations and make positive efforts for a peaceful settlement of the crisis.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: UNHRC discussion on human rights cooperation, March 7, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has adhered to people first and life first, responded vigorously to the epidemic, and attached great importance to the protection of the rights of vulnerable groups during the epidemic. China is willing to strengthen unity and cooperation with all parties, share beneficial experiences and good practices, strengthen technical cooperation and capacity building, and protect vulnerable groups.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Editorial on conclusion of CPPCC session, March 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The contrast between 'the governance of China' and 'chaos in the West' is even more apparent. We should grasp the favourable conditions, firmly develop confidence, carry forward the spirit of historical initiative, unswervingly do our own thing, and stride forward.

article_title: Xi Discusses Ukraine with Macron & Scholz - NPCSC & SPC Work Reports - Wang Yi Speaks to Borrell, Szijjarto & Qureshi

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The combined impact of major global changes and the pandemic has brought multiple global challenges that need to be addressed through global cooperation. China and the EU share common understanding on promoting peace, seeking development and advancing cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current situation in Ukraine is worrisome. China maintains that the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries must be respected, the purposes and principles of the UN Charter must be fully observed, the legitimate security concerns of all countries must be taken seriously, and all efforts conducive to peaceful settlement must be supported.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The pressing task is to prevent the tense situation from escalating or running out of control. We need to jointly support peace talks between Russia and Ukraine and encourage the two sides to keep the momentum of negotiations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We need to work together to reduce the negative impact of the crisis. Relevant sanctions will affect global finance, energy, transportation and stability of supply chains, and dampen the global economy. This is in the interest of no one.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with French President Emmanuel Macron and German Chancellor Olaf Scholz
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We need to actively advocate a vision of common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security. China supports France and Germany in promoting a balanced, effective and sustainable European security framework. China will be pleased to see equal-footed dialogue among the EU, Russia, the United States and NATO.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with EU High Representative Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is deeply grieved over the evolution of the situation in Ukraine. Sanctions will not solve problems, and escalating sanctions will only further complicate and aggravate the situation. The top priority now is to avoid a humanitarian crisis.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with EU High Representative Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has publicly put forth a six-point initiative on preventing a humanitarian crisis in Ukraine, aimed at fostering synergy among the international community to avoid further worsening of the humanitarian situation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with EU High Representative Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should encourage Russia and Ukraine to hold peace talks. The Chinese side has advocated dialogue from the very beginning. China hopes that the international community will support Russia and Ukraine in conducting serious negotiations until they agree on introducing a ceasefire, ending the war, and making peace.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with EU High Representative Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to continuously play a constructive role within its capacity in easing the situation. China also hopes that the EU will enter into comprehensive and serious dialogue on European security issues with Russia and form a balanced, effective and sustainable European security mechanism according to the principle of indivisible security.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with EU High Representative Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the current circumstance, China and the EU, as two major forces in the world, should work together to make good preparations for the China-EU leaders' meeting, so as to send a positive signal to the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Hungarian Foreign Affairs and Trade Minister Peter Szijjarto
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For China, the situation in Ukraine is regrettable. China hopes that the European Union can uphold the spirit of strategic autonomy and play a more proactive role in resolving the current Ukrainian crisis and building a European security mechanism.

article_title: Xi @ PLA & PAP Meeting - Two Sessions Discussions - NPC's Financial & Economic Affairs Committee's Meeting - Wang Yi's Press Engagement on Foreign Policy

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Ukraine: China has adopted an objective and impartial attitude. To resolve the crisis, must uphold UN Charter purposes and principles, respect sovereignty and territorial integrity, adhere to indivisible security principle, settle disputes through peaceful dialogue and negotiation, and establish balanced, effective and sustainable European security architecture

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Ukraine: China has made efforts to facilitate dialogue for peace. Xi Jinping spoke to Putin expressing desire for Russia-Ukraine peace talks. China prepared to continue playing constructive role in mediation and work with international community when needed

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Proposed six-point humanitarian initiative on Ukraine: ensure humanitarian operations follow neutrality and impartiality principles, attend to displaced persons, protect civilians, provide safe humanitarian aid access, ensure safety of foreign nationals, and support UN's coordinating role

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Cold War risks: Some major country trying to hold onto hegemony has resurrected Cold War mentality and stoked bloc confrontation. China firmly believes right way forward lies in greater solidarity and cooperation under multilateralism to build community with shared future for mankind

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On China-Russia relations: The relationship is valued for its independence, based on non-alliance, non-confrontation and non-targeting of third parties. China and Russia jointly oppose Cold War mindset and stand for greater democracy in international relations and UN Charter purposes and principles

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On US-China relations: While US leaders stated no intention for new Cold War or system change, these are verbal assurances not yet in practice. Reality is US engages in intense zero-sum competition, provokes China on core interests, and pieces together blocs to suppress China. These actions undermine bilateral relations and disrupt international peace and stability

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On US-China relations: Major-country competition should not be order of day and zero-sum game not right choice. China and US must work out right way forward together. Should replace competitive-collaborative-adversarial trichotomy with mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, return US China policy to right track guided by reason and pragmatism

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On China-Europe relations: Some forces unhappy with steady growth of China-Europe relations, fabricate 'China threat' narrative, play up competition, call China 'systemic rival', and impose sanctions. Both China and Europe must be on high alert against these developments. China-Europe cooperation deeply rooted with great resilience and potential, cannot be reversed by any force

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Press engagement on Chinese foreign policy

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's modernization is a modernization of peaceful development. Some old capitalist countries followed the path of violently plundering colonies, which is modernization at the expense of the backwardness of other countries. China's modernization emphasises mutual benefit and win-win cooperation with other countries in the world, promotes the construction of a community of shared future for mankind, and strives to contribute to the peace and development of mankind.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Belt and Road Initiative forum, 2017, quoted in People's Daily March 4, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will enhance friendship and cooperation with all countries involved in the Belt and Road Initiative on the basis of the Five Principles of Peaceful Co-existence. We are ready to share practices of development with other countries, but we have no intention to interfere in other countries' internal affairs, export our own social system and model of development, or impose our own will on others. In pursuing the Belt and Road Initiative, we will not resort to outdated geopolitical maneuvering. What we hope to achieve is a new model of win-win cooperation.
