statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at Party School, quoted in People's Daily March 4, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To promote the construction of Community of Shared Future for Mankind is not to replace a system with another system, or to replace a civilization with another civilization, but to form the greatest common denominator of building a beautiful world by sharing interests, rights and responsibilities among countries with different social systems, different ideologies, different historical cultures and different levels of development.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing response to Bloomberg question, March 3, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's basic position on the Ukraine issue is consistent and clear. We always advocate respect for the sovereignty and territorial integrity of all countries, and peaceful resolution of international disputes based on the purposes and principles of the UN Charter. The top priority right now is to ease the situation on the ground as much as possible, and prevent the conflicts from escalating or even getting out of control. Any action by the UN and the relevant parties should give priority to regional peace and stability and the universal security of all parties.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing response to Bloomberg question on UN vote, March 3, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The draft resolution submitted to this emergency special session for vote has not undergone full consultations within the whole membership. Nor did it take into full consideration the history and complexity of the current crisis. It did not highlight the importance of the principle of indivisible security, or the urgency of promoting political settlement and stepping up diplomatic efforts. These are not in line with China's consistent position. Therefore, China had to abstain in the voting.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: Regular press briefing response to Global Times question, March 3, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The report by the New York Times is pure fake news. Such practice of diverting attention and blameshifting is despicable. The ins and outs of the developments of the Ukraine issue are very clear. The crux of the issue is known to all... International media lately mentioned many times that George Kennan, former US ambassador to the Soviet Union, suggested to the US government in the 1990s that expanding NATO up to Russia's borders would be the most fateful error of American policy. Regrettably, the US government turned a deaf ear to this... Those who created the problem should be the ones to undo it. We hope the culprits of the crisis can reflect upon their roles in the Ukraine crisis.
statements.topic: Ukraine, US-NATO expansion, responsibility for conflict
statements.framing: accusatory toward US/NATO, defensive regarding China

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin

China is ready to continue its constructive role in this regard.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (editorial/institutional statement)

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary on China-US relations

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)
statements.context: Editorial commentary on China-US relations

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Zhong Sheng commentary)

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Event at Jinjiang Hotel commemorating 50th anniversary of Shanghai Communique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Last year Chinese President Xi Jinping and US President Joe Biden reached agreement on several aspects of bilateral relations via calls and video meetings. Shanghai is a key player and witness in the development of China-US relations and a bridge for the two countries to deepen mutual cooperation in all areas. A healthy and stable development of China-US relations is the best choice for both sides and the common wish of both peoples. Shanghai will play a more active role in promoting friendly exchanges and pragmatic cooperation between China and the US, upholding the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Event at Jinjiang Hotel commemorating 50th anniversary of Shanghai Communique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must uphold the one-China principle and consolidate the political foundation of China-US relations. The Shanghai Communique and joint communiques explicitly state US acknowledgment of the one-China principle. The US later enacted the Taiwan Relations Act and created the 'Six Assurances' to Taiwan, which were unilaterally concocted and conflict with US commitments in the three joint communiques, violating the one-China principle and are illegal and void. China-US relations must be built on common understandings between both countries in the three joint communiques, not on US domestic laws or unilateral policies. The US should return to the original and true meaning of the one-China principle, honor its political commitments to China, stop draining the one-China principle of its essence and hollowing it out, stop encouraging Taiwan independence moves, stop using the Taiwan question to contain China, and stop interfering in China's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Event at Jinjiang Hotel commemorating 50th anniversary of Shanghai Communique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must respect each other and ensure the right direction for China-US relations. Cooperation represents the mainstream of China-US relations. To define the relationship as competition is oversimplification. Even in competition, there should be boundaries and widely recognized international rules based on fairness. Competition should be about who does a better job running the country and who contributes more to the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Event at Jinjiang Hotel commemorating 50th anniversary of Shanghai Communique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must pursue win-win cooperation and promote the development and prosperity of both countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Event at Jinjiang Hotel commemorating 50th anniversary of Shanghai Communique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must shoulder responsibilities as major countries and provide the world with more public goods. China is open to US participation in the Belt and Road Initiative and the Global Development Initiative. We are ready to consider coordinating with the Build Back Better World initiative of the United States to provide more quality public goods for the world. China and the United States jointly stated in the Shanghai Communique that 'neither should seek hegemony in the Asia-Pacific region'. This statement remains relevant today. China has not, does not and will not seek any hegemony, and neither should the United States. The Asia-Pacific region should become a demonstration field of building mutual trust and cooperation, not a backyard for pursuing sphere of influence or a wrestling ground for confrontation. The United States should stop initiating bloc confrontation and developing small exclusive circles in the region, and work with China and other regional countries to build a big Asia-Pacific family featuring openness, inclusiveness, innovation-driven growth, greater connectivity, and mutually beneficial cooperation.
statements.topic: US-China relations, Asia-Pacific, international cooperation, hegemony

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: 49th session of the United Nations Human Rights Council
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China believes that all parties should act as true practitioners of human rights, staunch guardians of people's interests, positive contributors to common development, and firm defenders of equity and justice. Respecting and protecting human rights is the unremitting pursuit of the Communist Party of China. China will continue to steadfastly pursue a human rights development path that meets the trend of the times and suits its national conditions. We will continue to uphold a human rights philosophy that puts people front and center, develop the whole-process people's democracy, promote common prosperity for all, and safeguard the human rights of the Chinese people at a higher level.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: 49th session of the United Nations Human Rights Council
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang refuted false information about the affairs of China's Xinjiang and Hong Kong, saying they had been hyped up with ulterior motives. China is ready to engage in human rights exchanges and cooperation with all countries on the basis of equality and mutual respect. We do not accept self-styled 'lecturers' on human rights and reject stoking bloc confrontation in the name of human rights.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not approve of solving problems by sanctions, and even more strongly opposes unilateral sanctions not based on international law. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with German Foreign Minister Annalena Baerbock, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As a permanent member of the UN Security Council, China has prevented the Security Council from citing expressions that involve authorization of use of force and sanctions when discussing draft resolutions on the Ukrainian issue. China will continue to play a constructive role in seeking and realizing peace.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Statement on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary, reported by CGTN
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. should abide by the political commitments it has made to China and assume its international obligations. It should stop condoning or supporting 'Taiwan independence' and stop attempts of 'using Taiwan to contain China,' so as to maintain peace and stability of the Taiwan Straits and safeguard overall China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Statement on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary, reported by CGTN
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Cooperation should be the mainstream of China-U.S. relations, and to define them as competitive is just a part of the whole. Competition should have boundaries based on fair and recognized international rules.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Statement on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary, reported by CGTN
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should return to a rational and pragmatic policy toward China and work with China to implement the consensus reached by the two heads of state so as to bring bilateral relations back on the right track. 'Since the door of China-U.S. relations has been opened, it shall not be closed again.' 'Since the world has come out of the Cold War, the iron curtain shall not be lowered again.'

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Revisiting the spirit of the Shanghai Communique and keeping in mind the important consensus that China and the United States are willing to uphold the principles of mutual respect, equal treatment and seeking common ground while reserving differences is of great practical significance for promoting all circles in the United States to correctly view Sino-US relations and return Sino-US relations to a pragmatic and rational development track.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past 50 years, China-US relations have grown steadily despite ups and downs, and both countries have reaped huge benefits from cooperation. In recent years, some in the US have attempted to reconstruct the historical narrative and hype up the so-called 'failure of engagement with China' in order to suppress and contain China. Such rhetoric is full of Cold War mentality and negates the history and achievements of China-US relations.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The fundamental reason why China-US relations are in trouble today is that some people in the US are unable to adapt to the reality of China's rapid development and have a serious misunderstanding of China. They regard China as a major strategic competitor or even an imaginary enemy. To put China-US relations back on track, the US side needs to show political wisdom and courage, view China and its development in a correct way, and get rid of the Cold War zero-sum mentality of suppressing and containing China.
statements.topic: US-China relations, US policy toward China

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some people in the US have deliberately highlighted ideological differences between China and the US with the intention of provoking confrontation. This ignores the basic reality that the common interests of China and the United States far outweigh their differences. The differences between China and the United States should be managed effectively through candid communication to prevent strategic miscalculation and avoid conflict and confrontation.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary published in People's Daily on Shanghai Communique 50th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US is trying to distort and hollow out the One-China principle for the purpose of 'suppressing China through Taiwan.' This creates serious risks for stability across the Taiwan Strait and for China-US relations. China's complete reunification is an irresistible historical trend. The US should stop all moves that challenge the One-China principle and undermine peace and stability across the Taiwan Straits, and refrain from sending wrong signals to 'Taiwan independence' forces.

statements.speaker: Hua Chunying
statements.context: Press briefing response to CCTV question about US criticism

statements.speaker: Hua Chunying

statements.speaker: Hua Chunying

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official readout of Wang Yi-Sergei Lavrov meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides agreed to carry forward the Olympic spirit, reject the politicisation of sports and expressed support for the success of the Beijing Winter Olympics

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official readout of Wang Yi-Sergei Lavrov meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Russian side briefed the Chinese side on the latest developments in the relations between Russia and the United States and NATO, and stressed the principle of indivisible security; the Chinese side expressed its understanding and support

article_title: Xi & the Winter Games - Denisov on Putin's Visit

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.speaker_title: Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: Statement at UN Security Council on Russia-Ukraine issue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What is urgently needed now is quiet diplomacy, not megaphone diplomacy. The US did not accept such a constructive proposal. China once again calls on all parties concerned to remain calm, not to do anything to aggravate tensions or hype up the crisis.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.speaker_title: Permanent Representative to the United Nations
statements.context: Statement at UN Security Council on Russia-Ukraine issue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The expansion of NATO is a problem difficult to circumvent in handling the current tension. NATO is the product of the Cold War, and NATO expansion epitomizes bloc politics. The security of one country should not be achieved at the expense of the security of other countries. All parties should completely abandon the Cold War mentality.

statements.speaker: Zhang Hanhui
statements.context: Statement to Xinhua English
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Russia relations are at their best time in history, and the planning and strategic guidance of the two presidents plays a pivotal role in advancing the relations.

article_title: People's Leader Xi - Spring Festival Banquet - Taiwan VP's US Transit

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of the CPC, President
statements.context: Central Committee's Spring Festival banquet speech, January 31, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China maintained its leading position in the world in terms of both economic development and COVID-19 control. Major achievements include celebration of CPC centenary, adoption of third historical resolution, victory in fight against poverty, attainment of first centenary goal of building moderately prosperous society, and start of new journey to fully build modern socialist China. Comprehensive plans made for carbon peaking and carbon neutrality goals. Order in Hong Kong restored, more efforts made to combat separatist forces and facilitate reunification. China's major-country diplomacy advanced.
statements.topic: domestic policy, economic development, Hong Kong, separatism, diplomacy

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official comment on Taiwan's vice president's transit through the US, January 31, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China rejects all forms of official interactions between the US and Taiwan and has lodged solemn representation with the US side over Lai Ching-te's virtual meetings with US lawmakers during his transit through the US. China urges the US to abide by the one-China principle and stipulations in three China-US joint communiqués, immediately stop erroneous acts of official exchanges with Taiwan, avoid sending wrong signals to Taiwan independence separatist forces, and refrain from further undermining China-US relations and peace and stability across Taiwan Strait.

article_title: Xi's Shanxi Visit - Wang-Blinken Call - Zhang Anmin on Xi Thought, Two Establishments & Strategic Thinking

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The top priority for China and the United States at present is to truly implement the important consensus reached by Chinese President Xi Jinping and U.S. President Joe Biden during their video meeting in November last year

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There has been no substantive change in the tone of the U.S. policy towards China and Biden's pledges have not been fully delivered. The U.S. side is still making erroneous words and deeds related to China, which have dealt a new blow to bilateral relations

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Competition between major countries is not the theme of a post-pandemic world that will encounter new situations and challenges, nor will it address the problems facing the United States and countries worldwide

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Pressure will only make the Chinese people more united, and confrontation will not stop China from becoming stronger

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, the top priority for the U.S. side is to stop interfering in the Beijing Winter Olympics, stop playing with fire by playing the Taiwan card, and stop forming all kinds of small cliques aimed at working against and containing China

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on WTO ruling regarding tariff rights
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The ruling is of great significance in rectifying U.S. countervailing duties on imported Chinese goods, protecting the legitimate trade interests of Chinese companies and safeguarding multilateral trading systems

statements.speaker: Gao Feng
statements.context: Statement on WTO ruling regarding tariff rights
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The WTO ruling again proved that the United States had for some time been breaching WTO rules, abusing trade remedy measures and refusing to fulfil its international obligations, which is detrimental to a fair and just international trading environment

article_title: Xi's Spring Festival Journeys - High-Quality Talent for PLA - Party's Principal Responsibility System in Schools - Aid to Tonga - Guidelines for Anchors & Broadcasters

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to China Media Forum; New Year speech at end of 2021; Long commemorative piece in People's Daily tracing Xi's Spring Festival visits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi hailed the 'ice-breaking trip' made by British entrepreneurs in the 1950s, saying it broke the ice in the West's trade with China. He wants more visionary people and business representatives in both countries to uphold the 'icebreaker' spirit.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Prime Minister Mark Rutte
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly upholds its opening-up policy and is committed to creating a market-oriented, law-based and international business environment for all Chinese and foreign enterprises. China is willing to deepen cooperation with the Netherlands in climate change, science and technology, and modern agriculture. China and the EU share broad common interests and should adhere to dialogue and cooperation, respect each other, treat each other as equals, properly handle disputes and differences, and work for sound and steady development of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Conversation with Saudi Arabia's Deputy Defense Minister Khalid bin Salman
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Saudi Arabia have been deepening their political mutual trust and expanding cooperation in various fields. The two are good friends and partners that trust each other, share mutual benefits, and develop together. The two militaries should maintain strategic communication and strengthen solidarity in the fight against the COVID-19 pandemic.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Communication with Tonga's Foreign Minister Fekitamoeloa Katoa 'Utoikamanu regarding disaster relief
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As a good friend and partner of Tonga, China is willing to stand firmly with the Tongan people at this difficult moment. China has allocated disaster relief supplies and equipment including drinking water, food, generators, water pumps, first aid kits, prefab houses and tractors. Relief supplies will be delivered by Chinese military aircraft and Chinese warships. The Chinese government is very concerned about Chinese citizens and institutions in Tonga and hopes the Tongan government will guarantee their safety.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Comments after China took over the rotating Presidency of the Conference on Disarmament
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is experiencing major changes and pandemic impacts unseen in a century, and the international arms control, disarmament and non-proliferation system stands at a critical crossroads. The international community needs to vigorously advocate peace, development, equity, justice, democracy and freedom. Nations should commit to common, comprehensive, cooperative and sustainable security at the global level, resolutely uphold the authority and sanctity of the United Nations, advance reform of the global security governance system and international arms control processes, and jointly build a community with a shared future for mankind that enjoys lasting peace and universal security.

article_title: China-Central Asian States Summit - Politburo Study Session on Carbon Peak & Neutrality - Anti-Corruption Campaign

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at China-Central Asian States summit meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will always remain a good neighbor, a good partner, a good friend, and a good brother for Central Asian states. China firmly opposes attempts by external forces to foment color revolutions in Central Asia, firmly opposes interference in other countries' internal affairs under the pretext of human rights, and firmly opposes any force that tries to disrupt the tranquil life of the people.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Statement on China-Central Asian summit joint statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: All sides will continue to resolutely support others' choice of development paths and governance models, oppose any form of double standards and interference in others' internal affairs under any pretexts, and support further strengthening the 'China plus Central Asia' cooperation mechanism.

article_title: Politburo Meeting - China-Israel Innovation Cooperation - Energy Conservation & Emission Reduction - BRI in South Asia - GDI's Group of Friends - Li Jiheng: Two Establishments & Xi as People's Leader

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Response from Ministry of Foreign Affairs on Xi's meeting with Central Asian leaders, People's Daily Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The summit is of great significance for all sides to take stock of the achievements and experience of China-Central Asia relations, and seek coordination and make plans for future bilateral cooperation across the board at a new historical starting point. China and the five Central Asian countries will adopt and release a leaders' joint statement on the 30th anniversary of the establishment of diplomatic relations.

statements.speaker: International Liaison Department
statements.context: Meeting on the Belt and Road Initiative between China and Southeast and South Asian countries, People's Daily Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The CPC is ready to work with political parties of other countries in the region to play a leading role in ensuring that Belt and Road cooperation always adheres to high standards, is sustainable and delivers benefits to the people.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Statement on the Launch Meeting of the Group of Friends of Global Development Initiative at UN headquarters, People's Daily Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The grand launch of the Group of Friends eloquently proves that the Global Development Initiative put forward by China is widely supported by all parties. Going forward, China will continue to hold various activities under the framework of the Group of Friends to accelerate the implementation of the 2030 Agenda, further build international consensus and chart the course for practical cooperation.

article_title: Xi-Trump Meeting: Outcomes & Narrative - Breakdown of Li Qiang and Wang Huning's Takeaways from Fourth Plenum

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under our joint guidance, China-U.S. relations have remained stable on the whole. China and the United States should be partners and friends. This is what history has taught us and what reality needs. Given our different national conditions, we do not always see eye to eye with each other and it is normal for the two leading economies of the world to have frictions now and then.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of winds, waves and challenges, we should stay the right course, navigate through the complex landscape, and ensure the steady sailing forward of the giant ship of China-U.S. relations. I am ready to continue working with you to build a solid foundation for China-U.S. relations and create a sound atmosphere for the development of both countries.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is a good momentum in China's economic development. In the first three quarters of this year, China's economy increased by 5.2 percent, and import and export trade in goods with the rest of the world expanded by 4 percent. This is not an easy accomplishment given the domestic and external difficulties. The Chinese economy is like a vast ocean, big, resilient and promising. We have the confidence and capability to navigate all kinds of risks and challenges.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At its fourth plenary session, the 20th CPC Central Committee deliberated over and adopted the recommendations for the economic and social development plan over the next five years. Over the past seven decades and more, we have been working from generation to generation on the same blueprint to make it a reality. We have no intention to challenge or supplant anyone. Our focus has always been on managing China's own affairs well, improving ourselves, and sharing development opportunities with all countries across the world.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will further deepen reform across the board, expand opening up, and promote higher-quality economic growth while achieving an appropriate increase in economic output, and advance well-rounded human development and common prosperity for all. This will also expand the space for cooperation between China and the United States.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two teams had an in-depth exchange of views on important economic and trade issues, and reached consensus on solving various issues. They should work out and finalize the follow-up steps as soon as possible, and ensure that the common understandings are effectively upheld and implemented, to inject confidence into the two countries as well as the global economy through solid deliverables.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-U.S. economic and trade relations have experienced ups and downs recently, and this has also given the two sides some insights. The business relationship should continue to serve as the anchor and driving force for China-U.S. relations, not a stumbling block or a point of friction. The two sides should think big and recognize the long-term benefit of cooperation, and must not fall into a vicious cycle of mutual retaliation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two teams can continue their talks in the spirit of equality, mutual respect and mutual benefit, and continuously shorten the list of problems and lengthen the list of cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Dialogue is better than confrontation. China and the U.S. should maintain communication through various channels and at various levels to enhance mutual understanding.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is good potential for the two countries to work together on combating illegal immigration and telecom fraud, anti-money laundering, artificial intelligence, and responding to infectious diseases. The competent departments should strengthen dialogue and exchanges and carry out mutually beneficial cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the U.S. should also engage in positive interactions on regional and international platforms. The world today is confronted with many tough problems. China and the United States can jointly shoulder our responsibility as major countries, and work together to accomplish more great and concrete things for the good of our two countries and the whole world.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily narrative account
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A few days ago, our two countries' economic and trade teams held a new round of consultations in Kuala Lumpur, reaching basic consensus on addressing each side's major current concerns, and providing the necessary conditions for today's meeting. China and the US have different national conditions, and some differences are inevitable. As the world's two largest economies, friction is normal from time to time.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily narrative account
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of storms and challenges, the heads of state of our two countries, as helmsmen, should grasp the direction and steer the overall situation, ensuring the smooth progress of the China-US relationship.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily narrative account
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development and revitalization are not contradictory to President Trump's goal of 'Making America Great Again.' China and the United States can absolutely achieve mutual success and common prosperity. For the two countries to be partners and friends, this is the lesson of history and the need of reality.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily narrative account
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past seven decades and more, we have been working from generation to generation on the same blueprint to make it a reality. We have no intention to challenge or supplant anyone. Our focus has always been on managing China's own affairs well, improving ourselves, and sharing development opportunities with all countries across the world. And that is an important secret to our success.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily narrative account
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Trade and economic relations should continue to be the ballast and engine of China-US relations, not a stumbling block or point of conflict. Both sides should consider the bigger picture, focusing on the long-term benefits of cooperation, rather than falling into a vicious cycle of mutual retaliation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Trump in Busan; People's Daily narrative account
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US can jointly demonstrate their responsibility as major powers and work together to accomplish more major, practical, and beneficial things for both countries and the world.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. side will cancel the 10-percent so-called 'fentanyl tariffs' and suspend, for an additional year, the 24-percent reciprocal tariffs levied on Chinese goods. China will make corresponding adjustments to its countermeasures against the aforementioned U.S. tariffs.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides have agreed to continue extending certain tariff exclusion measures. The United States will suspend for one year the implementation of a new rule announced on Sept. 29 that expands its 'entity-list' export restrictions. China will suspend the implementation of relevant export control measures announced on Oct. 9 for one year.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. side will suspend the implementation of measures under its Section 301 investigation targeting China's maritime, logistics and shipbuilding industries for one year. In response, China will correspondingly suspend the implementation of its countermeasures against the U.S. side for one year once the U.S. suspension takes effect.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In addition, the two sides also reached consensus on issues including anti-drug cooperation on fentanyl, expanding agricultural product trade, and the handling of individual cases involving relevant enterprises.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides further confirmed the outcomes of the Madrid economic and trade talks. The U.S. side made positive commitments in areas such as investment, and China will properly resolve issues related to TikTok with the U.S. side.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The China-U.S. economic and trade talks in Kuala Lumpur have yielded positive results, demonstrating that by upholding the spirit of equality, respect and mutual benefit, and through dialogue and cooperation, the two sides can find solutions to problems.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Noting that the outcomes are hard won, China looks forward to working with the U.S. side to jointly ensure the implementation of the outcomes, and inject more certainty and stability into bilateral economic and trade cooperation as well as the world's economy.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on trade agreement outcomes; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side is willing to work with the U.S. side to jointly uphold and implement the important consensus the two heads of state reached at the meeting on Thursday in Busan, during which they had in-depth discussions on issues including China-U.S. economic and trade relations and agreed to strengthen cooperation in economic, trade and other fields.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international community paid close attention to this meeting, believing that it sent a positive signal to the world, provided new guidance and impetus for the stable development of China-US relations, and added valuable certainty to a turbulent and transforming world.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Head-of-state diplomacy is the 'compass' and the 'guiding star' of China–US relations, playing an irreplaceable role in providing strategic guidance for the development of bilateral relations. President Xi Jinping and President Donald Trump have long engaged with each other and shown mutual respect, becoming the most valuable strategic asset in China–US relations.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the beginning of this year, President Xi Jinping and President Trump have spoken three times, maintaining close contact. Whenever China-US relations encounter storms and challenges, it is precisely through such direct communication at the highest level that both sides can transcend differences and frictions in specific areas, build consensus from a strategic and overall perspective, prevent misjudgments, steer the ship of China-US relations in the right direction, and promote steady progress.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Only if both sides without bending or cutting corners implement the important consensus reached by the two countries' heads of state, continue to negotiate on the principles of equality, respect, and mutual benefit, both sides can continuously narrow the list of problems and lengthen the list of cooperation, allowing economic and trade relations to continue serving as the ballast stone and propeller of China–US relations.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's further comprehensive deepening of reforms and expansion of opening up, focusing on promoting effective qualitative improvement and reasonable quantitative growth of the economy, will open up broader space for Sino-US cooperation.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current international situation is intertwined with turbulence and transformation; the world is once again at a critical crossroads. As two major powers with global influence, China and the United States bear special responsibilities. The two countries' positive interaction on the regional and world stage is the key to responding to the endless stream of global challenges.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two countries have good prospects for cooperation in areas such as combating illegal immigration and telecommunications fraud, money laundering, artificial intelligence, and responding to infectious diseases. China-US cooperation can accomplish many significant, practical, and beneficial things for both countries and the world.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Next year, China will host the APEC summit, and the US will host the G20 summit. Both sides have agreed to support each other and strive for positive outcomes at both summits, contributing to promoting global economic growth and improving global economic governance.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A stable, healthy, and sustainable China-US relationship is in the long-term interests of both countries and is also the common expectation of the international community. The Busan meeting between the two heads of state once again proves that the common interests between China and the United States far outweigh their differences, and cooperation is the only correct choice for both sides.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Historical lessons, contemporary needs, and the call of the future all point to one conclusion: the vast earth is large enough to accommodate two major powers, China and the United States, and the two countries can be partners and friends.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary article; People's Daily page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China hopes that both sides can work together to implement the consensus reached at the meeting between the two heads of state with concrete actions, strengthen dialogue and communication, properly manage differences, expand mutually beneficial cooperation, lay a more solid foundation for China-US relations, benefit the people of both countries, and better benefit the world.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Article on the Fourth Plenum and 15th Five-Year Plan; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world today is experiencing intensified turmoil and transformation. Unilateralism and protectionism are severely impacting international rules and order, while a new round of technological revolution and industrial transformation is accelerating, reshaping the competitive and cooperative relationships between nations.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Article on the Fourth Plenum and 15th Five-Year Plan; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During the 15th FYP period, the global political and economic landscape will continue to undergo great adjustments, great divergences, and great restructuring, with an increase in uncertainty and unpredictability. However, the general trend of world multipolarization and economic globalisation is irreversible.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Article on the Fourth Plenum and 15th Five-Year Plan; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must look toward the world, actively identify changes, respond to changes, seek changes, and gain the strategic initiative amid fierce international competition. Facing the profound and complex changes in the international situation, we must have a forward-looking grasp of the new circumstances and new trends that affect our country's development, shape a new pattern of our country's relations with the world, and create an external environment favorable to us.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Article on the Fourth Plenum and 15th Five-Year Plan; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must expand high-level opening up to the outside world, actively expand independent opening up, improve the quality and level of trade and investment cooperation, open up diversified and stable overseas markets, jointly build BRI with high quality, enhance our country's competitiveness in the global industrial division of labour, and strengthen our discourse power in the international circulation.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Article on the Fourth Plenum and 15th Five-Year Plan; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must focus on our domestic situation, concentrate our efforts on managing our own affairs well, and use the certainty of high-quality development to cope with various uncertainties. Facing potentially turbulent or even stormy international situations, as long as domestic development remains healthy and stable, we will have greater confidence in withstanding shocks and meeting tests.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Senior Politburo Standing Committee member, theoretical writer
statements.context: Article on the spirit of the Fourth Plenum; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the profound and complex changes in the international situation, the distinctive characteristic of the 15th FYP period is that relations between major powers will influence the international situation, and the evolution of the international situation will profoundly affect domestic development. We must consciously plan and promote national development within a global context.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Senior Politburo Standing Committee member, theoretical writer
statements.context: Article on the spirit of the Fourth Plenum; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must expand international cooperation space and address external risks through increased openness, maximise benefits and minimise harm, seize the initiative, and ensure the steady and long-term progress of Chinese-style modernisation.

statements.speaker: Wang Huning
statements.speaker_title: Senior Politburo Standing Committee member, theoretical writer
statements.context: Article on the spirit of the Fourth Plenum; People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The more other countries engage in building 'small yards with high fences' and 'decoupling and breaking chains', the more we must unswervingly persist in high-level opening up to the outside world.

article_title: Wang Yi Seeks to Build East Asian Bulwark Amid US Tariff Pressure

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory message to GCI Ministerial Meeting, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work together with all countries, upholding a view of civilisation that values equality, mutual learning, dialogue, and inclusiveness, practicing the Global Civilisation Initiative, promoting the building of a global network for dialogue and cooperation among civilisations

statements.speaker: Cai Qi
statements.context: Speech at GCI Ministerial Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Arguments such as 'civilisational estrangement', 'clash of civilisations', and 'civilisational superiority' continue to resurface from time to time like dregs floating to the surface. There is still a long way to go to safeguard the diversity of civilisations and promote world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian President Sisi, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to strengthen cooperation with Egypt in the fields of economy, trade, finance, manufacturing, new energy, science and technology, and people-to-people exchanges under the BRI framework. The international situation is increasingly turbulent with more chaos and disorder. China is willing to maintain close communication with Egypt, promote an early ceasefire in Gaza, alleviate the humanitarian crisis, and prevent the spillover and escalation of the conflict.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Meeting with former US Treasury Secretary Henry Paulson, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Strengthening cooperation between China and the United States based on the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation is conducive to sound, sustained development of China-U.S. relations. China represents a major factor of certainty in today's turbulent world. The United States should view China's development objectively, respect China's core interests and major concerns, foster stable and mutually beneficial economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.context: Meeting with Deputy Speaker of South Korea's National Assembly Lee Hack-young, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to maintain close exchanges with the ROK to enhance mutual understanding and trust, deepen mutually beneficial cooperation, expand people-to-people and cultural exchanges, and promote the healthy and stable development of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary on the 64th anniversary of the China-DPRK Treaty of Friendship, Cooperation and Mutual Assistance
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is the firm position of the Chinese Party and government to maintain, consolidate and develop China-DPRK relations. China is willing to work with the DPRK to follow the important consensus reached by the top leaders of the two parties and the two countries, strengthen strategic communication, deepen mutually beneficial cooperation, and promote people-to-people exchanges.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-ASEAN foreign ministers' meeting, reported by People's Daily

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the strategic guidance of the two presidents, China-U.S. relations started to stabilize. On the other hand, there are still significant negative factors in the bilateral relationship. The United States continues pushing forward the strategy of containing China and keeps adopting erroneous words and actions that interfere in China's internal affairs, smear China's image and undermine China's interests. China resolutely opposes such moves and has taken strong countermeasures.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side always views and handles its relations with the United States in accordance with the three fundamental principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation. Regarding China-U.S. relations in 2024, the Chinese side will follow three overarching principles: peace must be valued, stability must be prioritized, and credibility must be upheld.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Whether China and the United States are rivals or partners is a fundamental issue, on which there must not be any catastrophic mistake. China always believes that major-country competition is neither the prevailing trend of the current times nor the solution to the problems facing China, the United States and the world. The two big countries of China and the United States should not cut off their ties or turn their backs on each other, still less slide into conflict or confrontation.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China urges the U.S. side to honor President Biden's above commitments with concrete actions and work with the Chinese side to turn the San Francisco vision into reality, rather than continue to contain and suppress China in the name of competition.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China remains open to dialogue and communication. The U.S. side must realize that it cannot seek communication just for the sake of communication; it must not say one thing but do the opposite; and it should be under no illusion that it can deal with China from a so-called 'position of strength.'

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called U.S. alliance system is a product of the Cold War and reflects the outdated Cold War mentality and zero-sum game where one side thrives at the expense of others. The United States is obsessed with bringing its allies into small circles against China. The move runs counter to the trend of the times. It will find no support and will lead nowhere.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Disagreements should not be allowed to dominate China-U.S. relations, and the relationship should be put under whole-process management. In particular, the United States must not cross China's red lines on Taiwan, democracy and human rights, paths and systems, and the right to development.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is the first red line that must not be crossed in China-U.S. relations. Taiwan is part of China. The Taiwan question is China's internal affair. Peace across the Taiwan Straits and 'Taiwan independence' are as irreconcilable as fire and water. The biggest threat to peace and stability across the Taiwan Straits is the 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities and external encouragement and support for them; China is not going to sit on its hands.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side firmly opposes the recent erroneous words and actions of the U.S. side on the Taiwan question and urges the U.S. side to abide by the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiques, honor President Biden's commitments with concrete actions, oppose 'Taiwan independence,' stop arming Taiwan, stop interfering in China's internal affairs and support China's peaceful reunification.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. has been ramping up efforts to curtail China's economic, trade and technological development, with new measures being rolled out in such forms as export control, investment screening and unilateral sanctions. This gravely undermines the interests of China. Such moves are not de-risking but instead creating risks.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called 'overcapacity' is a misleading narrative hyped up by the U.S. side packaged in economic concepts. The real intention is to kneecap China's industrial development and put the U.S. in a more advantageous position in market competition. It's another example of outright economic coercion and bullying.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes U.S. attempts to meddle in the South China Sea and sow discord between China and ASEAN. China has indisputable sovereignty over the South China Sea Islands and their adjacent waters. China's territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests must not be violated, and China's determination to safeguard its lawful rights remains unwavering.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. is not a party to the South China Sea issue. It should not interfere, still less stir up trouble.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There are now more direct flights linking the two countries, close exchanges between business communities and between provinces and states, active engagements between young Chinese and Americans and frequent cultural and sports interactions. Cooperation on giant panda conservation is well underway. This has demonstrated that China and the U.S. share extensive common interests and can both benefit from cooperation.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It also proves that the hope of the China-U.S. relationship lies in the people, its foundation is in our societies, its future depends on the youth, and its vitality comes from exchanges at sub-national levels.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On Fentanyl, this is 'not a problem in China, nor is it caused by China.'

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should not use human rights as an excuse to interfere in China's internal affairs. Human rights are not the monopoly of any country.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to urge the U.S. side to stop poisoning the atmosphere in the two societies, stop obstructing friendly exchanges between the two peoples, rectify its wrong practices, conduct thorough investigations into relevant cases and make things right for the victims.

statements.speaker: Senior Official from Department of North American and Oceanian Affairs of the Foreign Ministry
statements.context: Media briefing ahead of US Secretary of State Antony Blinken's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to develop relations with the United States based on the three principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation, and at the same time will continue to resolutely defend national sovereignty, security, and development interests.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Opinion piece in People's Daily on Section 301 investigation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This kind of unilateralism and protectionism by the United States will not only damage the economic and trade relations between China and the United States, but also undermine the stability and development of the global economy.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference in response to reports of US sanctions

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference in response to reports of US sanctions

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference in response to reports of US sanctions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US needs to know that to fan the flames or to smear others and shift the blame is no way to solve the Ukraine issue. statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Year after year, the US creates so-called human rights reports that are filled with political lies and ideological biases on China. We strongly reject this. The Chinese people have the best say on the human rights situation in China.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China made history by eliminating absolute poverty. We practice whole-process people's democracy and provide the world's largest education system, social security system and medical care system in China. The Chinese people's sense of gain, happiness and security keeps getting stronger. We have found a path toward better human rights that reflects the trend of the times and fits our national realities.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A Harvard University survey conducted over a period of more than 10 years straight shows that the Chinese government's satisfaction rate among the people stayed above 90 percent.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In this so-called Human Rights Reports, the US criticized the human rights situation of nearly 200 countries and regions and yet said nothing about the US itself. This is just another case of double standard. The hegemonic, domineering and bullying nature of the US and its selfishness and hypocrisy are on clear display.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It should face up to and reflect on its intervention operations in other countries and human rights catastrophes resulting from the US provision of weapons and fanning the flames in regional conflicts.

statements.speaker: Wang Wenbin
statements.context: MoFA press conference responding to State Department 2023 Country Reports on Human Rights Practices
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US, turning a blind eye to over 110,000 civilian casualties in Gaza, vetoed the UN Security Council's efforts for an immediate ceasefire in Gaza four times in a roll. That alone says enough about how little human rights actually mean to the US and how it tramples on them.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

Should promote SCO to better play role of 'anchor of stability' amid once-in-a-century changes

article_title: Politburo Discusses NPC Report - Xi's Take on Deliberative Democracy - Xi's Message to Trainee Officials - PLA's Implementation of Xi Thought Education Campaign - US-China Auto Frictions

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Commentary)

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Faced with complex situations, arduous tasks, and severe risks and challenges, in order to achieve the strategic goals set at the 20th Party Congress, it is urgently necessary to continuously deepen the study and implementation of Xi Jinping Thought on Socialism with Chinese Characteristics for a New Era, using theoretical arming to promote the unity of the Party and development of the cause.

statements.speaker: People's Liberation Army

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

article_title: The Israel-Hamas War: China’s Interests & Crisis Diplomacy

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement issued a day after October 7 attack
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Expressed 'concern' over escalation of tensions and violence between Palestine and Israel. Called on relevant parties to remain calm, exercise restraint and immediately end hostilities to protect civilians and avoid further deterioration while reiterating importance of two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement following prodding by US Congressional delegation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Beijing was 'saddened by the civilian casualties caused by the conflict'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Discussion with Brazilian Chief Advisor Celso Luiz Nunes Amorim on October 12
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China opposes acts that harm civilians and condemns violations of international law. China calls on all parties to exercise restraint, de-escalate regional tensions as soon as possible and prevent further expansion of conflict. Top priority is to ensure safety of civilians and open corridors for aid to avoid humanitarian crisis in Gaza. The crux of the matter is that justice has not been done to the Palestinian people.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with Saudi Arabian Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan Al Saud on October 14
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Israel's actions have gone beyond the scope of self-defence and should cease collective punishment of Gaza's people. All parties should not escalate and should return to negotiating table. China is communicating intensively with all parties to promote ceasefire. Top priority is ensuring civilian safety and opening humanitarian relief channels. The historical injustice against Palestine has lasted over half a century and cannot continue.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Turkish Foreign Minister Hakan Fidan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The right to self-defense should be exercised in accordance with international humanitarian law and should not be at the cost of innocent civilian casualties.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir-Abdollahian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Islamic countries in strengthening unity and coordination and speaking with one voice on the Palestinian issue, urging the international community to act against harm done to civilians by any party.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Discussion with US Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The situation is at the risk of losing control.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Discussion with EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Outlined four immediate priorities: (1) stop the fighting as soon as possible and prevent it from spreading; (2) observe international humanitarian law and ensure civilian safety with open humanitarian passage; (3) relevant countries should stay calm and exercise restraint; (4) the UN should play its due role in resolving Palestine question.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Statement to EU foreign policy chief Josep Borrell
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The root cause lies in the long delay in realizing an independent Palestinian state and failure to redress historical injustice. Israel has the right to statehood, so does Palestine. The Israelis have obtained safeguards for survival, but who will care about the survival of Palestinians? The Jewish nation is no longer homeless, but when will the Palestinian nation return home? The injustice to Palestine has dragged on over half a century. The answer is the two-state solution and an independent State of Palestine for peaceful coexistence.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks to visiting Egyptian Prime Minister Mostafa Madbouly
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to strengthen coordination with Egypt and other Arab countries to work for a comprehensive, just and enduring solution to the Palestinian question at an early date. The top priority is to stop fighting as soon as possible, prevent conflict from spreading or getting out of control and causing severe humanitarian crisis. The fundamental way out is to implement the two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Conversation with Israel's Foreign Minister Eli Cohen on October 23
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Stressed importance of two-state solution. China is deeply worried about continued escalation and exacerbation of conflict. All countries have the right to self-defense, but it is important to observe international humanitarian law and protect civilians.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with Palestinian Foreign Minister Riyad al-Maliki
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China strongly condemns and opposes all acts that harm civilians and violate international law, and calls for immediate ceasefire to ensure most basic survival needs of Gaza's people. Gaza needs efforts to end fighting and promote peace, rather than geopolitical calculations. China calls for a more authoritative, broad-based and effective international peace conference as soon as possible to realize early resumption of peace talks between Palestine and Israel, with specific timetable and roadmap.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.context: UN Security Council statement on October 25
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US resolution was 'seriously out of balance', 'failed to mention the root causes of the current crisis in Gaza' and 'if adopted, would completely end the possibility of a long term two-State solution'.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Authoritative commentary on October 27
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Acts of killing innocent lives must be unanimously opposed and condemned by international community. Military operations should not go beyond self-defence, let alone impose collective punishment. Protection of civilians in armed conflicts is a red line in international humanitarian law. Indiscriminate use of force is unacceptable. Certain major powers pay 'lip-service' to notion that Security Council should take right actions on the issue.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Blinken and US NSA Jake Sullivan in late October in Washington
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called for major countries to 'remain calm, be objective, and uphold justice', 'prevent a humanitarian catastrophe on a larger scale' and movement towards two-state solution through 'provision of more effective international guarantees'.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.context: Statement on China's UN Security Council presidency in early November
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The top priority for China's presidency is to tackle Israel-Palestine conflict through working towards calling for ceasefire, ensuring protection of civilians, and preventing further deterioration of tensions and humanitarian catastrophe.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with Omani Foreign Minister Sayyid Badr Albusaidi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No responsible country with a conscience can allow such tragedy to continue. China will strengthen coordination with all parties, especially Arab countries.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on Israeli bombing of refugee camps in Gaza, coinciding with China's UNSC presidency
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China condemned the bombings and as UNSC chair supports Arab states' important proposal on ceasefire and maintenance of peace, emphasizing importance of 'a more authoritative international peace conference' to resume talks for two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Zhang Jun
statements.context: Emergency Meeting on Palestinian-Israeli Situation on November 10
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Enough is enough.' Security Council must do away with obstruction and interference and take immediate, responsible, meaningful action to uphold justice and maintain peace. Ceasefire cannot be delayed—it is only hope for Gaza's survival. All parties, especially major power with unique influence, should put aside geopolitical considerations and double standards and focus on ceasefire. Israel should curb intensifying settler violence in West Bank to avoid concurrent hotspots and conflict spread. Protection of civilians cannot be delayed. Condemn all violence and attacks against civilians. Express grave concern and strong opposition to violations of international humanitarian law in Gaza. Demand end to collective punishment of civilians.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on UN Security Council Resolution 2712 (2023) adopted November 15, 2023
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Described the resolution as being based on the 'minimum consensus' at the Security Council and 'an initial step towards a ceasefire.'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with joint delegation of foreign ministers from Arab and Islamic countries in late November
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is a good friend and brother of Arab and Islamic countries. China has always firmly upheld the legitimate rights and interests of Arab and Islamic countries and firmly supported the just cause of the Palestinian people to restore their legitimate national rights and interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Remarks to delegation of Arab and Islamic foreign ministers
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's proposal: (1) Ceasefire is 'top priority'; (2) Israel should stop collective punishment of Gaza's people; (3) Any solution should not deviate from two-state solution and should be conducive to regional peace and stability; (4) UN Security Council should heed Arab and Islamic countries' calls and take responsible actions to de-escalate. China, as rotating presidency, will strengthen coordination with Arab and Islamic countries to build consensus and push for meaningful Security Council actions on Gaza; (5) China calls for early convening of international peace conference with greater scale, scope and effectiveness, with timetable and roadmap.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Remarks at extraordinary BRICS leaders summit on Gaza conflict on November 21
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Echoed points about ceasefire priority, two-state solution, and international peace conference. Warned that international community must act with practical measures to prevent conflict from spilling over and endangering stability in Middle East as a whole.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

Israel should stop its collective punishment of the people in Gaza and open humanitarian corridors as soon as possible to prevent a wider humanitarian disaster.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Arab and Islamic foreign ministers delegation, Foreign Ministry readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Any arrangement concerning the future and destiny of Palestine must be based on the consent of the Palestinian people and accommodate the legitimate concerns of regional countries. statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Arab and Islamic foreign ministers delegation, Foreign Ministry readout
