statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Arab and Islamic foreign ministers delegation, Foreign Ministry readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The way out is to implement the two-state solution and establish an independent Palestinian state. statements.speaker: Han Zheng

statements.speaker: Han Zheng

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As the rotating presidency of the Security Council this month, China will continue to work with Arab and Islamic countries to promote the full implementation of the relevant resolutions of the General Assembly and the Security Council and make unremitting efforts to realize a ceasefire, ease the humanitarian situation, and return to the two-state solution.

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: 10th meeting of China-Russia Investment Cooperation Committee, chaired jointly with Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Andrei Belousov
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides should enhance the planning and guidance for bilateral investment cooperation; jointly push for new progress in cooperation in key areas; jointly open up new prospects for sub-national cooperation and promote regional complementarity; and jointly open up a new vision for long-term cooperation.

statements.speaker: Shen Yiqin
statements.context: Meeting with Sri Lankan President Ranil Wickremesinghe in Beijing, reported by Xinhua

statements.speaker: Wang Xiaohong
statements.context: Meeting with Zambia's Minister of Home Affairs and Internal Security Jack Mwiimbu

statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties, published in People's Daily

China is consistently committed to having a stable, healthy and sustainable relationship with the United States, and China has interests that must be safeguarded, principles that must be upheld, and red lines that must not be crossed. statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States are two major countries with extensive common interests and shoulder important responsibilities for world and regional peace, stability, and prosperity. It is unrealistic for one side to change the other, and conflict and confrontation will have unbearable consequences for both sides.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, Sino-US relations have encountered serious difficulties. The root cause of this stems from serious cognitive errors among certain people in the US in terms of their views of China and Sino-US relations. Some people in the US harbour a Cold War and zero-sum game mentality and insist on positioning China as the most important competitor and the most significant geopolitical challenge.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wrong understanding will inevitably lead to wrong policies, wrong actions, and wrong outcomes. If China and the US want to find the right way to get along, they must first jointly establish the correct understanding. With a correct understanding, the foundation for mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation can be laid.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties, quoting Xi Jinping
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development follows its own logic and laws, and it is comprehensively promoting the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation through Chinese-style modernization. China does not follow the old path of colonisation and plunder, does not pursue the crooked path of a strong country seeking hegemony, and neither does it engage in exporting ideology. China has no plans to surpass or unseat the United States, and the US should not scheme to suppress and contain China.
statements.topic: US-China relations, China's development, foreign policy

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties, quoting Xi Jinping
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's policy towards the United States is consistent and committed to building a stable, healthy and sustainable Sino-US relationship. Instead, we will be glad to see a confident, open, ever-growing and prosperous United States.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties, quoting Xi Jinping
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Likewise, the United States should not bet against China, or interfere in China's internal affairs. It should instead welcome a peaceful, stable and prosperous China.
statements.topic: US-China relations, US policy toward China

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, some people in the US have seriously misjudged and deliberately distorted China's strategic intentions driven by their internal strategic anxieties. statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Zhong Sheng commentary series on US-China ties
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development is driven by innovation. article_title: Xi's US Visit Coverage - New Era Calls For 'Stronger, Better & Bigger' SoEs - Xi's Speech at APEC CEOs Summit

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco

statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco

statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is wrong to view China, which is committed to peaceful development, as a threat and play a zero-sum game against it. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States should not bet against China or interfere in China's internal affairs. It should welcome a peaceful, stable and prosperous China. There is plenty of room for our cooperation in high-quality development and economic revitalization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China sympathizes deeply with the American people, especially the young, for sufferings from Fentanyl. statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Welcome Dinner by Friendly Organizations in the United States, San Francisco
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Whatever stage of development it may reach, China will never pursue hegemony or expansion, and will never impose its will on others. China will remain committed to dialogue and oppose confrontation, and build partnerships instead of alliances.

statements.context: Meeting with President Biden, San Francisco

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both countries should adhere to correct direction of bilateral relations and grasp world development trends; as top two developing countries and eternal neighbors, common interests outweigh differences; both should support each other's success rather than mutual suspicion; focus on respective development and people's livelihood; should find mutually acceptable solution to border issue; China concerned about recent restrictive measures against Chinese enterprises and hopes India provides fair, transparent, non-discriminatory business environment

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with EU's Josep Borrell in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No fundamental conflict of interest between China and EU; both advocate multilateralism and world multipolarity; EU should clarify strategic partnership positioning and not waver; China committed to open economy and sharing mega market; China supports EU strategic independence; ready to leverage complementary advantages including Belt and Road and Global Gateway; should jointly safeguard globalization and free trade while opposing protectionism and unilateral bullying; called on guarding against politicization of economic issues and use of 'de-risking' as term for 'decoupling'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with South Korea's Park Jin in Jakarta
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's good-neighborly policy toward South Korea is consistent and stable, not targeted at third party and should not be influenced by third party; recent difficulties and challenges in China-South Korea relations not in fundamental interests of two peoples; ready to work in spirit of mutual respect and 'harmony in diversity' to strengthen communication, rebuild trust, and advance strategic partnership; should leverage geographical proximity and cultural connectivity; Taiwan is at core of China's core interests and bears on political foundation of bilateral relations; hopes South Korea abides by one-China principle and handles prudently

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Remarks during Jakarta visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Warned against three negative trends: accelerated penetration of 'Indo-Pacific strategy' impacting ASEAN centrality; NATO attempt to involve in region, introduce Cold War mentality and camp confrontation; major extra-regional powers intervening in regional affairs under pretext of South China Sea issue

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: East Asia Summit remarks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Support ASEAN centrality as natural result of historical evolution and greatest common ground; unreasonable for NATO to get involved in East Asia; regional peace depends on common development of all countries, not on few countries' pursuit of absolute security; China ready to explore cooperation with others centered on Global Security Initiative; reiterates willingness to lead in signing Protocol to Southeast Asia Nuclear-Weapon-Free Zone

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: East Asia Summit remarks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Called for joint safeguarding of right direction of economic globalization; commitment to open, free, fair, inclusive rules-based multilateral trading system; opposition to protectionism and 'decoupling and severing supply chain'; promotion of Asia-Pacific Free Trade Area and healthy competition and win-win cooperation

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: East Asia Summit remarks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China willing to work with regional countries to implement Treaty of Amity and Cooperation, uphold peaceful coexistence, mutual respect and mutually beneficial cooperation, and practice true multilateralism to put Asia-Pacific cooperation back on right track

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: East Asia Summit remarks on Taiwan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Criticized 'foreign interference' in Taiwan issue; refuted erroneous argument that China unilaterally changed status quo in Taiwan Strait; Taiwan independence incompatible with peace in Taiwan Strait and is biggest destructive factor; to truly safeguard peace must resolutely oppose Taiwan independence; willing to make greatest efforts with utmost sincerity to strive for peaceful reunification but determination and resolve to defend sovereignty and territorial integrity remain unwavering

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: East Asia Summit remarks on South China Sea
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: South China Sea one of safest and most open waters for navigation; does not accept practice of navigation hegemony in name of freedom of navigation; hopes countries outside region respect efforts by China and ASEAN and play positive role in maintaining stability instead of opposite; should not send advanced warships and aircraft to show military might; should not provoke and exploit differences among regional countries for geopolitical interests; should not make judgments without proper understanding; China and ASEAN do not need instructors and have confidence and wisdom to handle South China Sea; South China Sea arbitration was political manipulation deviating from UNCLOS; China did not participate and will never accept it; warned against countries reversing history and hyping 'old tricks'
statements.topic: South China Sea, regional security, law of the sea

statements.speaker: Zhang Jian
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of China Institute of International Studies (CICIR)
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO summit baselessly exaggerated 'systemic challenge' posed by China; NATO involvement in Asia-Pacific increased unprecedentedly through military and political interactions with Australia and Japan, and promotion of intelligence exchanges, military exercises, joint research; NATO invited Australia and Japan to participate in NATO summits for two consecutive years and attempted to set up first liaison office in Asia in Japan, demonstrating NATO trying to accelerate eastward advance into Asia-Pacific

statements.speaker: Zhang Jian
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of China Institute of International Studies (CICIR)
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO has long been tool of US serving its strategic goal of maintaining global hegemony; US spared no effort to contain and suppress China and asked allies to take sides; under US leadership, NATO frequently hypes 'China threat'; provided timeline showing NATO's increasing focus on China as threat from 2019 onwards

statements.speaker: Zhang Jian
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of China Institute of International Studies (CICIR)
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US aware that unilateralist and hegemonic 'America First' policies not well-received and allies have widespread doubt and dissatisfaction; to bind allies to divisive agenda of containing China, US swimming against tide of history, actively creating tensions globally, and constantly provoking conflicts; US attempted to link Ukraine crisis with Asia-Pacific affairs, threatening European countries to 'decouple' from China and pressuring them to participate in 'Indo-Pacific strategy'; by introducing NATO into Asia-Pacific, US intends to utilize European resources and capabilities while integrating ally system in Asia-Pacific, aiming to further instigate disputes and hinder China's development
statements.topic: US policy, NATO, Asia-Pacific strategy, Europe

statements.speaker: Zhang Jian
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of China Institute of International Studies (CICIR)
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Made four points against NATO eastward expansion: NATO limited by geographical scope and cross-domain expansion lacks clear justification; European countries have limited patience with US and US push for NATO eastward expansion into Asia-Pacific reduced US investment in European security; Asia-Pacific countries especially Southeast Asian highly vigilant about NATOization of region and aspire for prosperity not disruption; even US close allies in Asia-Pacific have doubts about US due to track record of backtracking on strategic issues and risk of fully aligning with US
statements.topic: NATO expansion, US alliance system, regional security

statements.speaker: Zhang Jian
statements.speaker_title: Vice President of China Institute of International Studies (CICIR)
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO blamed for Ukraine war and has become source of risk for Europe, Asia-Pacific and whole world

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of European Institute of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO summit fueled fire on Ukraine issue and hyped up 'China threat'; NATO not fundamental solution to Europe's security problems; Ukraine crisis proved serious defects in post-Cold War European security pattern led by NATO; construction of European security architecture cannot bypass Russia; US did not reflect but pushed further NATO expansion in Europe; if NATO continues east expansion, it will further provoke Russia and make situation more complex; NATO cannot solve fundamental problems facing European security and Europe will become less secure if NATO continues expanding in Europe

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of European Institute of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Europe's dependence on US and NATO for defense not conducive to achieving strategic autonomy goal; dependence on US and NATO comes at price of loss of strategic autonomy; EU striving to transform into 'geopolitical power' and strengthen strategic autonomy; core of this is strengthening EU ability to act in defense domain and not being influenced by other big countries in foreign policy; unless European countries free themselves from dependence on US and NATO for security and defense, difficult for them to play independent international role
statements.topic: European strategic autonomy, NATO, US relations

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of European Institute of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO's eastward expansion into Asia-Pacific does not serve European interests; US push for NATO eastward expansion serves misguided strategy against China; European countries have significantly different views on China compared to US; Europeans regard China as important economic and trade partner and believe China's continued development cannot be stopped; US push for NATO advance eastward will inevitably lead to security tensions in Asia-Pacific and not help develop mutually beneficial cooperation between China and EU; not situation European countries want to see
statements.topic: NATO expansion, China-EU relations, US policy

statements.speaker: Feng Zhongping
statements.speaker_title: Director of European Institute of Chinese Academy of Social Sciences
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Europe faces two real risks in security and defense: first, unreliable American security protection for Europe and NATO serving only American hegemonic interests; Europe should realize this reality and make continuous efforts towards strengthening strategic autonomy
statements.topic: European security, US relations, strategic autonomy

statements.speaker: Li Jian
statements.context: Article published in People's Daily previewing Algerian President's visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two countries are major developing countries and important emerging markets with significant influence; Algeria first Arab country to establish comprehensive strategic partnership with China; two countries signed BRI cooperation agreement and Algeria joined Friends of Global Development Initiative as first member; two countries have similar positions in international affairs with Algeria advocating multi-polarization and opposing unilateralism; two sides maintain close communication and coordination in international and regional affairs and play important role in safeguarding legitimate rights of developing countries and world peace and stability
statements.topic: bilateral relations, development cooperation, international affairs

statements.speaker: Hou Jianguo
statements.speaker_title: President of Chinese Academy of Sciences
statements.context: Theory page article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Science and technology have never had such profound impact on country's future and destiny as today; self-reliance in science and technology is foundation of national prosperity and key to security; facing complex and fierce international competition, must adhere to problem orientation, focus on cutting-edge science and technology and key technologies in strategic areas bearing on overall situation and long-term, take initiative and make proactive moves to seize commanding heights of science and technology and effectively safeguard national development and security

statements.speaker: Hou Jianguo
statements.speaker_title: President of Chinese Academy of Sciences
statements.context: Theory page article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Major breakthroughs in commanding heights can drive innovation in related fields; new round of scientific and technological revolution and industrial transformation accelerating with pioneering discoveries and subversive innovations constantly emerging; only by seizing high grounds of new round of tech revolution and industrial transformation can tightly grasp historic opportunity, accelerate construction of strong country in science and technology, and achieve leap in technological strength and international competitiveness

statements.speaker: Hou Jianguo
statements.speaker_title: President of Chinese Academy of Sciences
statements.context: Theory page article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Must maintain self-reliance and self-strengthening in science and technology while participating in high-level international scientific and technological competition and cooperation; need to keep initiative in scientific and technological innovation firmly in own hands while deeply integrating into global innovation network and joining international scientific and technological community to scale scientific and technological peaks and jointly solve major problems facing mankind

article_title: Wang Yi at Munich Security Conference - China-US Ties - Zhao Peng's Dual Circulation Deep Dive

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Although the pandemic is under control, the world is not safer. Mutual trust between major countries is increasingly lacking, geopolitical rifts are widening, unilateralism is rampant, the Cold War mentality is making a comeback, and new types of security threats are emerging one after another.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Power politics and hegemonic behaviour are a recipe for global instability and cause the greatest damage to global peace. Wanton interference in the internal affairs of other countries, no matter what reasons are fabricated, is a disregard and betrayal of the basic norms of international relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Violating the one-China principle on the Taiwan issue and creating 'one China, one Taiwan' or 'two Chinas', however framed, is a serious violation of China's territorial integrity and a real threat to peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China adopts a responsible attitude towards international disputes and plays a constructive role based on the merits of the matter itself.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Response to question at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Ukraine crisis is not what we want to see. Like all other parties, China is concerned about the possibility of the conflict being escalated and protracted. China is not a party to the Ukraine Crisis, but we have not sat idly by or added fuel to the fire, and we firmly oppose any move to exploit the crisis.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Response to question at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the second day of the conflict's breakout, President Xi Jinping had initiated to seek a political settlement of the dispute through dialogue. Russia and Ukraine did hold quite a number of rounds of negotiations and made important progress. The framework for a peace deal had been already put on the table. But regrettably the peace talk stopped and all is back to square one. Some people do not want peace talks to succeed or fighting to stop.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Provoking ideological confrontation and weaving exclusive circles undermines international solidarity and hinders international cooperation. Exaggerating security threats and deliberately creating tension has weakened strategic mutual trust and increased the risk of miscalculation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world should not go down the wrong path of protectionism and decoupling. We must resolutely resist attempts to politicise, weaponise and ideologise trade and scientific cooperation. Only when people of all countries live a good life can security be firm and lasting.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peaceful development is a strategic choice made by China. We are fully aware that in order to develop, we require a peaceful and tranquil international environment, peaceful coexistence with other countries and win-win cooperation with the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference on US balloon incident
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Unfortunately, the U.S. ignored the basic facts and brazenly sent a fighter jet to shoot down the non-threatening airship with a missile. Such an unthinkable and hysterical action is, without doubt, excessive use of force, and clearly violates common practice and relevant international law.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference on US-China relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The underlying reason why the unexpected incident has caused such a stir in bilateral relations is the United States' wrong perception and strategic misjudgment of China. The U.S. sees China as the gravest geopolitical challenge and strategic competitor in its China policy, and it is using all means possible to block and suppress China with such an erroneous view of China.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Speech at Munich Security Conference on US-China economic competition
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has never been afraid of competition despite all the U.S. talking about competing with China, but the competition should be fair and rules-based. The United States' CHIPS and Science Act is unilateral and self-serving, using state power to suppress Chinese companies, violates the rules of the World Trade Organization and seriously disrupts the stability of the global industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Secretary of State Blinken (Chinese readout)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If the US side continues to fuss over, dramatise and escalate the unintended and isolated incident, it should not expect the Chinese side to flinch. The US side should be prepared to bear all consequences arising from an escalation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Secretary of State Blinken (Chinese readout)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The China-Russia comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination is built on the basis of non-alliance, non-confrontation and non-targeting of third countries, which is within the sovereign right of any two independent states. We do not accept the US's finger-pointing or even coercion targeting China-Russia relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Secretary of State Blinken (Chinese readout)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US, as a major country, has every reason to work for a political settlement of the crisis instead of fanning the flames or profiting from it.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Secretary of State Blinken (Chinese readout)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US should honour its political commitments and one must firmly oppose 'Taiwan independence' and uphold the one-China principle.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Ukrainian Foreign Minister Dmytro Kuleba
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is not willing to see a protracted and expanded Ukraine crisis and stands ready to work with the international community to prevent the situation from worsening and keep fighting for peace.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Britain's James Cleverly at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There are no geopolitical conflicts between China and Britain, and the two economies complement each other with great potential to exploit. Both countries are permanent members of the UN Security Council, shouldering the common responsibility of maintaining world peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Britain's James Cleverly at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should remove all kinds of obstructions, stick to the right direction and promote the healthy development of bilateral relations. The British side should view China's development objectively and fairly.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with EU's Josep Borrell at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the EU are partners, not rivals, and their consensus far outweighs their differences. Both sides should remain committed to the partnership, respect each other's core interests, cherish the fruits of cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with EU's Josep Borrell at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has successfully pulled through a pandemic and is ready to fully restart exchanges with Europe and the rest of the world. The essence of China-EU economic and trade relations is complementary and mutually beneficial. Both sides should maintain openness and cooperation, resist decoupling, and work together to maintain the stability of the global production and supply chain.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with EU's Josep Borrell at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang expressed the hope that the EU and its members abide by the one-China principle and maintain the political foundation of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Foreign Minister Yoshimasa Hayashi at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks the 45th anniversary of the signing of the China-Japan Treaty of Peace and Friendship. The Japanese side should take this opportunity to sum up experience and lessons, remove internal and external disturbance, and work with China in the same direction to ensure steady progress of China-Japan relations on the right track.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Japanese Foreign Minister Yoshimasa Hayashi at Munich Security Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Unilateralism and decoupling serve no one's interests. The Japanese side should clearly understand the situation and make an independent choice.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Openness and pragmatism are the essential aspects of China-Netherlands relations. While some countries are pursuing unilateralism and protectionism and desiring decoupling and severing supply chains, China hopes that the Netherlands will uphold the principle of independence and its tradition of open cooperation, remove distractions, maintain the sound momentum of bilateral cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.speaker_title: State Councilor and Minister of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Meeting with Dutch Deputy Prime Minister and Minister of Foreign Affairs Wopke Hoekstra
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is promoting high-level opening up, which will open new prospects and opportunities for its cooperation with the Netherlands. The Netherlands is a gateway to China-Europe cooperation and China appreciates that the Netherlands regards China as an important partner of Europe. China and Europe are partners, not rivals.

statements.speaker: Zhao Peng
statements.speaker_title: Official, Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the 2008 global financial crisis, there has been a resurgence of the trend of anti-globalisation in the world. Unilateralism and protectionism have been on the rise, and economic globalisation has encountered adverse trends. Some countries are seeking to undermine the existing international economic order for their own selfish interests. They are attempting to use their strong position to decouple China from the global market and industrial system and build a 'globalisation without China'. Such a move goes against the direction of historical progress and the objective laws of economic development and is impossible to achieve.

statements.speaker: Zhao Peng
statements.speaker_title: Official, Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should firmly safeguard our legitimate rights and interests in foreign trade and economic cooperation, oppose all forms of protectionism, unilateralism and bullying, actively use internationally accepted economic and trade rules and dispute settlement mechanisms, and safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese business entities.

statements.speaker: Zhao Peng
statements.speaker_title: Official, Office of the Central Financial and Economic Affairs Commission
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must oppose the establishment of camps and exclusive circles targeting specific countries, and promote multilateral mechanisms such as the World Trade Organization and APEC to play a better role.

article_title: Understanding China's Economic Development Trend - Xi's New Qiushi Article - Zhong Yin Commentary on COVID Policy Shift - 45 Advanced Mfg Clusters - ICFA's Karnataka Chapter & CCP Influence

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at COP15 meeting on biological diversity
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We need to build global consensus on biodiversity protection, jointly work for the conclusion of the Post-2020 Global Biodiversity Framework, push forward the global process of biodiversity protection, promote green development through biodiversity protection, and uphold a fair and equitable global order on biodiversity protection while firmly supporting the UN-centered international system

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: COP15 speech on biological diversity
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will respond to the Action Plan for the UN Decade on Ecosystem Restoration and launch key projects on biodiversity protection and restoration, providing support to developing countries through the Belt and Road Initiative International Green Development Coalition and the Kunming Biodiversity Fund

statements.speaker: Liu He
statements.context: Fifth EU-China CEO and Former Senior Officials' Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side is willing to expand its cooperation with the EU in the fields of economy and trade, green development, digital development, finance and technology, and jointly safeguard the multilateral trading regime with the World Trade Organization at its core

statements.speaker: Liu He
statements.context: Fifth EU-China CEO and Former Senior Officials' Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has great confidence that the economy will turn for the better as a whole in the next year. Both sides have the wisdom to push forward the China-EU investment agreement, a result hard won through seven years of negotiations

statements.speaker: Liu He
statements.context: Fifth EU-China CEO and Former Senior Officials' Dialogue
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's urbanization is still on a relatively fast track for a period of time in the future, which means enough demand to underpin the stable growth of the property sector

article_title: Protests & COVID Policy - 10 Years of the 'China Dream' - New Party Secretaries for Shaanxi & Liaoning - Wang Yi Meets Igor Morgulov

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with new Russian ambassador Igor Morgulov, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both China and Russia are committed to promoting a multipolar world and do not believe in unipolar hegemony. Both countries are committed to upholding the international system with the United Nations at its core and the international order based on international law, and reject power politics. No matter how the international situation may evolve, China and Russia will advance strategic mutual trust and practical cooperation and jointly uphold international fairness and justice.
statements.framing: assertive and constructive - rejecting unipolarity while affirming commitment to international law

article_title: 20th Congress Election - Delegates 'Must Understand & Implement Xi's Thought' - Wang Yi's UNGA Speech - Ren Lixuan on Xi's Leadership & China's Modernisation - US & Georgia's 'Rose Revolution'

statements.speaker: Xinhua
statements.context: Report on election of 20th Party Congress delegates
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the strong leadership of the CPC Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core, the election of delegates to the 20th Party Congress has been successfully completed.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page editorial on 20th Party Congress
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The upcoming 20th Party Congress is a meeting of great significance being held at a critical moment when the whole Party and the people of all ethnic groups are embarking on a new journey to build a comprehensively socialist modern country and marching towards the second centennial goal.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peace is crucial for our future and it underpins common security of all countries. Turbulence and war can only open Pandora's box, and he who instigates a proxy war can easily burn his own hands. Pursuing one's own absolute security can only undermine global strategic stability.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Protectionism can only boomerang and decoupling and supply chain disruption will hurt both those who practice them and others. We should stay true to openness and inclusiveness and tear down fences and barriers that hinder the free flow of factors of production.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No country is above others, and no country should abuse its power to bully other sovereign countries. We should promote and practice true multilateralism, promote equality of all countries in terms of rights, rules and opportunities.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports all efforts conducive to the peaceful resolution of the Ukraine crisis. The pressing priority is to restore peace through negotiation. To achieve a fundamental solution, it is important to address the legitimate security concerns of all parties concerned and build a balanced, effective and sustainable security architecture.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speech at UNGA
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to endeavor to achieve peaceful reunification with the greatest sincerity and greatest efforts. To realize this goal, we must combat 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities with the firmest resolve and take the most forceful steps to repulse interference by external groups.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is at the heart of China's core interests, and is of paramount importance to the Chinese people. US actions had run counter to its commitments on the issue. These all have sent a truly wrong and dangerous signal.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Peaceful resolution cannot coexist with Taiwan independence. The more rampant Taiwan independence separatist activities are, the less likely peaceful resolution is. To truly maintain peace across the Taiwan Strait, the United States must unequivocally oppose and curb any Taiwan independence activities.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. Secretary of State Antony Blinken
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. side will adjust its perception of China, reflect on and change its China policy featuring containment and suppression, and the U.S. side will not attempt to deal with the Chinese people from a position of strength, try to suppress China's development, or wantonly engage in unilateral hegemony. The U.S. side should create a favorable environment for the two sides to resume normal exchanges, and steer China-U.S. relations back on the track of sound and steady development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In terms of peace and security, China has the best record among major countries. Expansion is not in the genes of China. We have never invaded other countries or conducted a proxy war. China has no interest in seeking spheres of influence, exporting its ideology, interfering in other countries' internal affairs or participating in military blocs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with NATO Secretary General Jens Stoltenberg
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: NATO could understand the current international situation in an objective and calm manner, not simply drawing a line based on 'political correctness'. China hopes NATO could see China in a reasonable and correct way.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS countries should firmly resist decoupling, severing supply chains and creating barriers in science and technology, and work towards building an open world economy, so as to achieve stronger, greener, and healthier global development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS Foreign Ministers' Meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Multilateralism is hit hard by power politics and unilateral hegemony, and various forms of pseudo-multilateralism are even more bewildering. BRICS countries should take the lead in upholding the international system with the United Nations at its core.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Ren Lixuan commentary on path of socialism with Chinese characteristics

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on Global Security Initiative

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article on Global Security Initiative

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang

We are capable of meeting the main targets and tasks for this year and ensuring steady and sustained economic growth.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: 1+6 meeting reported in Xinhua

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

statements.speaker: Party Committee of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries have been keen on insinuating China with the so-called 'rules-based order' and playing up the 'China threat' theory. China is firmly opposed to this. What the world accepts is the international system with the UN at its core based on international law, not a so-called 'order' unilaterally defined by one or few countries. The US wants an order where it wantonly smears, coerces and interferes in other countries without paying any price—an order of US hegemony and bullying. This runs counter to the trend of the times and will never succeed.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Second High-level Environment and Climate Dialogue with EU (Frans Timmermans, executive vice president of the European Commission)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China announced it will step up support for other developing countries' green and low-carbon energy development and will not build new coal-fired power projects abroad. It is necessary to enhance understanding and mutual trust, strengthen policy communication and coordination, and deepen practical cooperation. The two sides should practice multilateralism, help implement the Paris Agreement and inject confidence into global climate cooperation.

statements.speaker: Wei Fenghe
statements.context: Meeting with Malaysian Defense Minister
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The global economy is struggling to recover and the international order is undergoing profound change. China is willing to work with Malaysia to oppose hegemonism and power politics, strengthen communication and properly address differences on the South China Sea issue, and jointly uphold peace and stability in the Asia-Pacific region.
statements.topic: military, regional security, US policy (implicit reference to hegemonism)

statements.speaker: Wang Chen
statements.context: Meeting with parliaments of five Central Asian countries (first collective exchange between China's NPC and parliaments of Kazakhstan, Kyrgyzstan, Tajikistan, Turkmenistan, and Uzbekistan)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We respect each other's independence, sovereignty, and development path, firmly support each other on core interests and concerns, and work jointly to combat the 'three forces' and transnational organized crime. We are jointly building a pilot zone for Belt and Road Initiative construction. We will maintain forward momentum of exchanges between legislative bodies to build a community with a shared future between China and Central Asia. We oppose efforts to politicize and stigmatize the origin of the Covid-19 virus.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Xuānyán article)
statements.context: Editorial in People's Daily, September 28, 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China faces severe and complicated domestic and international situations. In this era, opportunities and challenges coexist. Only a strong leadership core can scientifically judge the situation, dare to act decisively, and seize fleeting opportunities, avoid risks, nurture opportunities in crisis, and open new opportunities in changing situations. The Party must have a leadership core with extraordinary strategic determination and revolutionary will that dares to struggle and win, to maintain calmness in times of peace, gather invincible will and strength, and overcome all difficulties and obstacles.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Xuānyán article)
statements.context: Editorial in People's Daily, September 28, 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We will resolutely fight against all forms of unilateralism, trade protectionism and bullying, take effective measures to respond to and counter them, and resolutely safeguard national dignity and interests through struggle and cooperation.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Xi Thought Q&A Series - Question 100)
statements.context: Q&A series in People's Daily, September 28, 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development faces both rare historical opportunities and a series of major risks and challenges. With rapid and profound changes in the world, the international environment has become more complex and severe. All risks and challenges that jeopardize the leadership of the CPC and China's socialist system, sovereignty, security and development interests, core interests and major principles, and the fundamental interests of the Chinese people must be fought resolutely, unswervingly and unflinchingly. On major issues of principle, China must never yield.
statements.topic: US-China relations, international challenges, national security

article_title: Meng Return Commentary - Xi on 1992 Consensus - Inspection of Financial Institutions - Xi & Liu on Wuzhen Conference - Xuānyán Article - Xi Thought: Why Xi Deserves to be the 'Core' & Two Safeguards

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary, September 26, 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The case against Meng Wanzhou was a political witch hunt aimed at suppressing Chinese high-tech companies and targeting Chinese citizens. China will never accept any form of political coercion or abuse of justice, and will never allow Chinese citizens to become victims of political persecution by other countries.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Front page commentary, September 26, 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The essence of the Meng Wanzhou episode is that the US is trying to obstruct and interrupt China's development process. China must unswervingly follow its own path, manage its own affairs, achieve self-reliance and self-improvement in high-level science and technology.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to Eric Chu, KMT chairman
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi emphasised the common political foundation of upholding the 1992 Consensus and opposing Taiwan independence. The two parties should adhere to this foundation, uphold national interests, maintain peace across the Taiwan Strait and achieve national reunification.

statements.speaker: Wang Yang
statements.context: Commemorative meeting marking 40th anniversary of All-China Federation of Taiwan Compatriots, Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Current cross-Strait relations present both opportunities and challenges. People on both sides should proceed from the fundamental interests of the Chinese nation, pursuing and defending national reunification and resolutely opposing any separatist activities seeking Taiwan independence. China must and will be reunited; reunification is a historic trend. The initiative to solve the Taiwan question has always been in the hands of the mainland.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Niger's Foreign Minister Hassoumi Massoudou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The collective revitalization of developing countries is the most distinctive feature of our times. Any attempt to suppress the development of developing countries by whatever despicable methods is doomed to failure. Development is the master key to addressing all problems. China is willing to share its governance experience with Niger and other developing countries.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Xuanyan (declaration) piece, September 27, 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The greatest significance of China's peaceful development to the world lies not only in the prosperity of one fifth of the world's population, but also in the new Chinese-style modernization path and new forms of human civilization that China has created, providing Chinese wisdom and solutions for mankind to build a better society.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Xi Thought Q&A piece, Page 5
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi personally led China's response to economic and trade frictions with the United States, effectively safeguarding China's sovereignty, dignity and core interests, and demonstrating the leadership and fighting skills of a leader of a great party and great country.

article_title: San Nong Focus - Wang Yi on Afghanistan - Qin Gang on Ideological Confrontation - P5 FMs Meet - Xi Thought: Party is Mìng Mén, But Xi's Rule Unlike Mao's & Constituents of Party Leadership System

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: High-level meeting commemorating 20th anniversary of Durban Declaration and Programme of Action
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Relevant countries must have the courage to face up to the disgraceful history of slave trade and colonialism, take measures to eliminate the suffering caused by these acts, and have responsibility to lead in resisting all forms of racism. China calls on all countries to uphold zero tolerance for racism and establish sound legal frameworks to combat it.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: G20 meeting on Afghanistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Afghanistan's foreign exchange reserves are national assets that should belong to and be used by the Afghan people and cannot be used as a bargaining chip for political pressure. Unilateral sanctions or restrictions on Afghanistan should be lifted. Countries responsible for the current situation in Afghanistan should reflect on their actions and do more to alleviate difficulties. The United States and NATO countries should assume primary responsibility for resolving the immigration problem in Afghanistan.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with P5 permanent UNSC members and UN Secretary General
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The P5 should become a positive force for peace and solve problems instead of creating them. They should perform duties of maintaining world peace, deal with hotspot issues through upholding the UN Charter and mediation while refraining from coercive measures and avoiding arbitrary use of force. The US should give up Cold War mentality, ideological bias, and tendency for bloc confrontation.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: Event held by The Carter Center and The George H.W. Bush Foundation for US-China Relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has a distinct governance process and democratic system. Whether a system is democratic depends on whether it represents the overall interests of the people and whether the people are satisfied. China's people-centered philosophy aligns with Lincoln's 'of the people, by the people, for the people.' China's whole-process democracy can be understood as 'from the people, to the people, with the people, for the people.' Our two countries should not and cannot change each other. Instead, we should break ideological barriers, discard zero-sum mentality, respect other countries, and accommodate each other without losing our own distinctions, so as to get along in peace.

statements.speaker: Qin Gang
statements.context: High-Level Meeting of Bloomberg New Economy Forum
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US need to show broad vision, shoulder great responsibilities and bring their relations back to the right track of stable development. The Chinese people never believe in the 'Thucydides trap.' China will pursue national renaissance and peaceful development, and calls upon the US to stay committed to peaceful development, abandon wrong thinking, and find a way of getting along based on mutual respect and win-win cooperation. The two countries can advance coordination on climate change, COVID-19 response and economic recovery. China will continue to expand opening-up and promote technology and trade cooperation with the US. The US side needs to create conditions instead of barriers for cooperation.

statements.speaker: Ning Jizhe
statements.context: Statement on China-Pakistan Economic Corridor
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: CPEC has brought Pakistan direct investment totaling $25.4 billion over the past eight years. Focus going ahead will be to improve utilization rate of existing infrastructure and enhance bilateral cooperation in technology, agriculture, and other sectors.
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, economic cooperation

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: People's Daily report on Xi's UNGA speech
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Xi's Global Development Initiative is 'an important declaration of China's efforts to revitalize the global partnership for development of the United Nations.' We welcome all countries to join the global development initiative, deepen the complementarity of their development strategies, advance cooperation in key areas, and open up a brighter future for global development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: UNGA speech (reported by Wang Yi in People's Daily)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will not build overseas coal power projects and will greatly support developing countries' green and low-carbon energy development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: UNGA speech (reported in People's Daily)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, some countries under the pretext of returning to multilateralism claim to uphold a 'rules-based international order.' In fact, they are imposing their own will and standards on others and replacing universally accepted international laws with rules formulated by a few countries.

statements.speaker: Li Keqiang
statements.context: State Council weekly meeting on 14th Five-Year Plan for New Infrastructure Development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Advancing new infrastructure development will help mobilize effective investment, sustain growth, readjust the structure and enhance people's wellbeing.

statements.speaker: State Council
statements.context: Weekly meeting adopting 14th Five-Year Plan for New Infrastructure Development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will take an active part in the formulation of relevant international rules and standards.

statements.speaker: Li Zhanshu
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with Luxembourg's President of the Chamber of Deputies Fernand Etgen
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will work with Luxembourg to uphold mutual respect and consolidate mutual political trust, and advance important political agenda through consultation, explore ways to deepen practical cooperation, strengthen coordination in international affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Speaking to UAE Foreign Minister Sheikh Abdullah bin Zayed Al Nahyan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly supports the UAE to safeguard sovereignty, security and stability, and supports the UAE to independently explore a development path in line with its national conditions. China appreciates the valuable and firm support given by the UAE on issues involving China's core interests and is willing to work with the UAE to uphold the basic norms of international relations such as non-interference in internal affairs, and jointly defend international equity and justice.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Xi Thought Q&A series (47th piece) in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Belt and Road Initiative 'conforms to the historical trend of economic globalization, the requirements of the times of the reform of the global governance system, and the strong desire of people of all countries to live a better life. It is a right choice for the future.'

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Xi Thought Q&A series (47th piece) in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Belt and Road Initiative 'aims to promote policy coordination, infrastructure connectivity, unimpeded trade, financial integration and closer people-to-people ties. Its core purpose is to promote infrastructure development and connectivity, strengthen coordination of economic policies and synergy of development strategies, promote coordinated and interconnected development, and achieve common prosperity.'

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Xi Thought Q&A series (47th piece) in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Belt and Road Initiative 'has brought tangible benefits to all participants and has been recognized and welcomed by more and more countries and regions. However, there are some discordant voices in the international community, some have falsely called it the 'Chinese version of the Marshall Plan', and some have smeared it as 'neo-colonialism'... The Belt and Road Initiative is an economic cooperation initiative, not a geopolitical or military alliance. It does not target or exclude anyone. It is an open and inclusive process, not a closed-door clique or a 'China club'. It is a sunlit pathway for China to share opportunities and seek common development with the rest of the world. It is not a trap. It does not demarcate by ideology or engage in zero-sum games.'
statements.topic: Belt and Road Initiative, international perception

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Statement on special envoys' visit to Kabul
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China follows a policy of non-interference in Afghanistan's internal affairs and has always played a constructive role in the political settlement of the Afghan issue. Afghanistan should reach open and inclusive political arrangements, implement moderate and prudent domestic and foreign policies, make a clean break with all kinds of terrorist organizations and live on friendly terms with neighboring countries. The US and its allies bear the primary responsibility for Afghanistan's economic and social reconstruction and should provide much-needed economic, livelihood and humanitarian assistance.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Response to media reports about Sino-US dialogue (People's Daily question)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The 'two lists' and 'three bottom lines' are about fundamental and substantive issues in China-US relations, which we expect serious treatment and earnest response from the US. However, we have not seen substantive response so far.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Response to media reports about Sino-US dialogue (People's Daily question)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We oppose: First, plotting gimmickry before and after talks to provoke and smear China, and using megaphone diplomacy and sanctions threats to gain 'position of strength' through extreme pressure. The Chinese people don't buy such condescending and bossy moves. Second, interfering in China's internal affairs and undermining China's interests while expecting China to render help on US issues. This approach won't work. Instead of reflecting on its own bullying rhetoric and actions, the US turned to accuse China and falsely criticize China's legitimate moves to safeguard sovereignty, security and development interests as being 'tough'. The US is trying to blame the innocent party for what itself is guilty of.

article_title: Xi's UNGA Speech - Supervising the Supervisors - Marxist Colleges - Xi Thought: Hegemony & Major Power Diplomacy - Why US' Trade-Tech War Isn't Working

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at UN General Assembly (UNGA)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world has entered a period of new turbulence and transformation. Falls on each responsible statesman to answer questions of our times and make historical choice with confidence, courage and sense of mission.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at UN General Assembly (UNGA)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will provide 2 billion doses of vaccines to the world by end of year; donate $100 million to COVAX and 100 million vaccine doses to developing countries. China will continue to support and engage in global science-based origins tracing, and stands firmly opposed to political maneuvering in whatever form.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at UN General Assembly (UNGA)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will step up support for other developing countries in developing green and low-carbon energy, and will not build new coal-fired power projects abroad.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at UN General Assembly (UNGA)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We need to pursue dialogue and inclusiveness over confrontation and exclusion. Need to build new type of international relations based on mutual respect, equity, justice and win-win cooperation. China has never and will never invade or bully others, or seek hegemony. China is always a builder of world peace, contributor to global development, defender of international order and provider of public goods.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at UN General Assembly (UNGA)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is only one international system - the international system with the UN at its core. There is only one international order - the international order underpinned by international law. There is only one set of rules - the basic norms governing international relations underpinned by the purposes and principles of the UN Charter.

statements.speaker: Chen Xu
statements.speaker_title: Permanent Representative of China to the United Nations Office at Geneva
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's status and influence in the United Nations and international community are on the rise. China has actively participated in UN peacekeeping operations, promoted political settlement of regional hotspot issues, and made outstanding contributions to maintaining international peace and security. China has earnestly fulfilled its commitments upon accession to the WTO, continuously improved its level of opening-up and injected Chinese impetus into economic globalization and world economic growth.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: National strength leading to hegemony is not a historical law. Chinese people do not accept the logic that national strength is bound to lead to hegemony.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China needs peace, just as people need air, just as everything needs sunshine to grow. Must have peaceful international environment to realize second century goals and Chinese dream of national rejuvenation. China's path of peaceful development is not an expedient measure or diplomatic rhetoric, but a conclusion drawn from objective judgment of history, reality and future.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Today's world is multipolar. International balance of power developing in direction conducive to maintaining world peace. Impossible for any country to dominate world as was previously the case. Old path of colonialism and hegemonism cannot be taken; only path of peaceful development can work. Cannot have body enter 21st century while mind lives in past - in old era of colonial expansion, in old frame of Cold War mentality and zero-sum games. No country has right to dominate international affairs, dictate destiny of other countries or monopolize development advantages, still less should go its own way and engage in bullying and hegemony.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will firmly pursue independent foreign policy of peace, respect right of people of all countries to independently choose development paths, uphold international fairness and justice, and oppose imposing own will on others, interfering in other countries' internal affairs, and bullying the weak. China's development poses no threat to any country, nor will pursue own development at expense of other countries' interests. At same time, China will never give up legitimate rights and interests, and no one should harbour illusions that China will swallow bitter fruit that harms its own interests.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-Russia comprehensive strategic partnership of coordination for new era is mature, stable and solid. It is relationship between major countries with highest level of mutual trust, coordination and strategic value. Need to firmly support each other in upholding core interests, deepen cooperation across the board, actively participate in global governance, and safeguard world peace, security and stability.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: US-China relationship is one of most important bilateral relationships in world. China-US can gain much by working together. In recent years, some American politicians have publicly declared they view China as main strategic competitor, and have adopted series of wrong words and actions that have interfered in China's internal affairs, harmed China's interests and seriously damaged Sino-US relations, resulting in rare, severe and complicated situation. China's policy toward US is consistent and clear. Committed to developing relationship of non-conflict, non-confrontation, mutual respect and win-win cooperation with US, and will firmly defend interests of national sovereignty, security and development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and EU should be two major forces for global peace and stability, two major markets for global development and prosperity, and two civilizations for multilateralism and improved global governance. Should jointly build China-EU peace, growth, reform, and civilization partnerships, enhancing China-EU comprehensive strategic partnership's global impact.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always placed neighborhood at top of diplomatic agenda and taken as mission to promote peace, stability and development in neighborhood. China welcomes neighboring countries to hitch a ride on express train of China's economic development so everyone can live good life together.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Quoted in Xi Thought series article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: International affairs should be handled through dialogue and consultation and future of world should be in hands of all countries. This is essence of multilateralism. China has actively advocated and practiced multilateralism and unswervingly upheld international system with UN at core and international order based on international law.
