statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Congratulatory letter to International Summit on BeiDou Navigation Satellite System Applications
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to principles of openness and integration, coordination and cooperation, compatibility and complementarity, and benefit sharing in building the BDS.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to China Quality Conference in Hangzhou
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to improving quality, raising quality standards, strengthening overall quality management. China is willing to work with other countries around the world to strengthen international cooperation in quality, jointly promote quality transformation and innovation, enhance quality infrastructure connectivity, and contribute to promoting global economic development and creating a better future for mankind.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Letter to Mexican President Andres Manuel Lopez Obrador on 200th anniversary of Mexican War of Independence
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two countries are developing countries with broad common interests that have stood together and supported each other amid unprecedented changes taking place in the world. Wants to deepen political mutual trust and boost mutually beneficial cooperation.

statements.speaker: Li Zhanshu
statements.context: Speaking to Bahrain's parliament speaker Fawzia bint Abdulla Zainal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should continue to strengthen political support for each other, deepen anti-pandemic cooperation, advance high-quality pragmatic cooperation across fields, and strengthen people-to-people exchanges. Called for enhancing synergy between China-proposed Belt and Road Initiative and Bahrain's Economic Vision 2030, expanding cooperation in economy, trade, energy, infrastructure, 5G, and e-commerce. China appreciates Bahrain's long-term support on issues concerning China's core interests such as Taiwan, Xinjiang, Hong Kong and human rights.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Speech at 2021 World New Energy Vehicle Congress
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: New energy vehicle consumption has become the major direction of global auto industry transformation. Called for domestic EV makers to make breakthroughs in core technologies while aiming for scalable industrial efficiency. Need to actively integrate into global industrial and value chains and promote networked, intelligent and electric technologies integrated with emerging industries. Also discussed promoting consumption of new energy vehicles in public and private sectors.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official data release on FDI into China from January to August 2021
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: FDI into China stood at 758.05 billion yuan ($113.78 billion), a year-on-year increase of 22.3%. Service sector accounted for 599.33 billion yuan. FDI in high-tech industry increased by 30.2% year-on-year. Investments from Belt and Road countries expanded 37.6%, and investment from ASEAN rose 36.8%.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Comments prior to SCO summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: SCO members have transcended differences in social systems, histories and cultures and successfully found a new type of cooperation and development path. The SCO shoulders more important responsibilities in defending regional security and stability and promoting development. At the upcoming summit, President Xi Jinping will take stock of successful SCO experiences with leaders of other countries, have in-depth exchanges on SCO cooperation and major international and regional issues, approve key cooperation documents and charter the course for SCO's development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Tajik President Emomali Rahmon in Dushanbe
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Discussed maintaining regional peace and stability and strengthening communication and coordination on multiple issues including Afghanistan situation. Promised pandemic-related support to Tajikistan. Termed the two countries 'ironclad partners.'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov in Dushanbe
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Russia's opposition to politicization of COVID-19 origins-tracing and human rights issues, and is willing to deepen strategic coordination with Russia to promote cooperation among the international community in tackling virus origins. Called on Russia to communicate and coordinate with China within SCO framework to jointly maintain peace and prosperity in Asia-Pacific and respond to global challenges.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian Foreign Minister Hossein Amir Abdollahian in Dushanbe
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Iran in opposing hegemony and safeguarding its sovereignty, dignity, legitimate rights and interests. Wants to work on BRI and energy, backs Iran's SCO membership bid and pledged COVID-19-related support. Said China will work to ensure JCPOA talks move in the right direction and reach consensus at early date.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with officials from China, Iran, Russia and Pakistan on Afghanistan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Countries in the region expect the new Afghan government to be inclusive, anti-terrorist, and friendly to neighbours. Afghanistan is in a critical stage of transitioning from chaos to governance. While the war was over, the issue of Afghanistan was not resolved. Power politics, military intervention and so-called 'democratic transformation' are the root causes of the current situation in Afghanistan. Blamed the US for its hasty withdrawal. Made five-point proposal including: US must fulfill its obligations and take the primary responsibility for reconstruction of Afghanistan; Afghanistan should establish a broad and inclusive political structure and implement moderate and stable domestic and foreign policies; Taliban should fulfill commitments to prevent terrorist forces from using Afghan territory to harm neighbouring countries; all parties should form a joint force to aid Afghanistan; integrate into regional economic cooperation and connectivity networks over time.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Indian Foreign Minister S Jaishankar in Dushanbe
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Beijing has always handled the border issue with a positive attitude and the border situation was moving towards relaxation on the whole. The two sides should consolidate the achievements of disengagement of front-line troops and strictly abide by agreements and consensus reached, preventing any border-related incidents from recurring. Wants the two sides to adhere to the strategic consensus that they do not pose a threat to each other but rather provide opportunities for each other.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Editorial/Feature on Page 3)
statements.context: Feature piece previewing SCO meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China as a founding member of the SCO has always adhered to the Shanghai Spirit. Chinese initiatives have evolved within the group and China's trade has expanded with SCO members. Pandemic led to deeper cooperation.

statements.speaker: Chen Xu
statements.context: Speaking on behalf of 40-50 countries at UNHRC regarding human rights
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Spoke on behalf of over 40 countries on human rights issues

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Xi Thought Q&A Series)
statements.context: 45th piece in Xi Thought Q&A series on Page 5
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Issues related to Hong Kong and Macao are China's internal affairs. The will of the Chinese government and people to safeguard China's sovereignty, security and development interests is as firm as a rock. China will never allow any external force to interfere in the affairs of Hong Kong and Macao. The central government's overall governing power over HK and Macao is a constitutional power. The high degree of autonomy is neither complete autonomy nor decentralization, but the right to manage local affairs granted by the central government. The central government has the power to supervise the exercise of the high degree of autonomy and to correct violations of one country, two systems and the Basic Law in accordance with the law.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Xi Thought Q&A Series)
statements.context: 45th piece in Xi Thought Q&A series on Page 5
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a community with a shared future for mankind is an important part of Xi Jinping Thought on Diplomacy and an important ideological and theoretical contribution of contemporary China to the world. The concept means: the destiny of every nation and country is closely linked; upholding dialogue and consultation and building a world of lasting peace; developing universal security through joint contribution and shared benefits; pursuing win-win cooperation and building a world of common prosperity; building an open and inclusive world through exchanges and mutual learning; building a clean and beautiful world with green and low-carbon development.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Xi Thought Q&A Series)
statements.context: 45th piece in Xi Thought Q&A series on Page 5
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Today, unilateralism, protectionism and bullying are on the rise. The pandemic has accelerated the adjustment of the international structure. Peace, development, cooperation and win-win outcomes have become the trend of the times. The world cannot return to isolation, still less can it be deliberately divided. An integrated world is out there, and whoever rejects it, the world will reject them. Only by following the trend of history and promoting the building of a community with a shared future for mankind can countries achieve common development and prosperity.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (Commentary Pages 17-18)

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Certain major powers regard international law as an obstacle to realizing national interests, often 'using it when it suits them and discarding it when it does not', and readily 'withdrawing from treaties' or 'exiting organizations', seriously damaging the authority of international rule of law and multilateral mechanisms.
statements.topic: diplomacy, international order, rule of law

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Huan Yu Ping) published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Over the past year or more, hegemonic countries have more recklessly impacted global peace and development, and a number of middle powers are facing the bitter situation of their own interests being directly harmed.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Huan Yu Ping) published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The prominent challenge facing the world today is that hegemonic actions seriously threaten the international order. This impacts all countries—middle powers, and even more so smaller and weaker states.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Huan Yu Ping) published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Resolutely oppose hegemonism and power politics... For middle powers to truly play a greater positive role in international affairs, they must unite a broader international community, adhere to handling international affairs through joint consultation, form the broadest common ground for upholding multilateralism, and issue a common voice in maintaining the international order.

article_title: Breakdown of China-Mozambique Joint Statement - Zhong Sheng: Japan Tearing Off the Disguise of a ‘Peaceful Nation’ - BNP Delegation Visits China

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Daniel Chapo of Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the changing and turbulent international landscape, the two sides should continue to strengthen coordination, solidarity and collaboration in the U.N. and other institutions, and jointly advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization, and safeguard international fairness and justice. China and Africa, together with other Global South countries, represent a just force in this turbulent and transforming world.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Daniel Chapo of Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will roll out zero-tariff measures across the board to all the 53 African countries having diplomatic relations with China, and further expand access of African products to the Chinese market. This demonstrates China's major-power responsibility and firm determination to expand high-level opening-up to the outside world, against the backdrop of rising global unilateralism and protectionism.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with President Daniel Chapo of Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is ready to work with Africa to navigate challenging times and jointly promote peace and seek common development. China will assist regional countries in achieving faster development and build a demonstration zone for an all-weather China–Africa community with a shared future in the new era.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with President Daniel Chapo of Mozambique
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Amidst the current volatile and complex international landscape, China and Africa, as good brothers and good partners, should unite and collaborate even more closely, actively implement the four major global initiatives, uphold fairness and justice, and safeguard their shared interests.

statements.speaker: Joint China-Mozambique Statement
statements.context: Joint statement issued during Xi Jinping's meeting with President Daniel Chapo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides unanimously decided to continue firmly supporting each other on issues concerning their respective core interests and major concerns, and to resolutely oppose external oppression and interference.

statements.speaker: Joint China-Mozambique Statement
statements.context: Joint statement issued during Xi Jinping's meeting with President Daniel Chapo
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides are committed to strengthening cooperation in the field of peace and security, firmly oppose unilateralism, protectionism, illegal unilateral sanctions, 'decoupling and breaking chains', technological blockades, and other hegemonic practices.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Saleumxay Kommasith, special envoy of Lao LPRP General Secretary and President Thongloun Sisoulith
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At this new historical starting point, China and Laos should follow the policy of long-term stability, forward thinking, good neighborliness and comprehensive cooperation, deepen strategic alignment, expand practical cooperation, jointly address common challenges, and advance the building of a China-Laos community with a shared future toward high standards, high quality and high levels.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with Bangladesh Nationalist Party delegation led by Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China congratulates Bangladesh on the smooth and successful conclusion of its general election, stands ready to work with Bangladesh, guided by the important consensus reached by the leaders of the two countries, to carry forward the traditional friendship, deepen political mutual trust, strengthen cooperation in areas such as jointly building the Belt and Road Initiative, and advance the China-Bangladesh comprehensive strategic cooperative partnership.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (via Guo Jiakun, spokesperson)
statements.context: Regular press briefing, response to question about Japan's revised defense equipment export limits
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is gravely concerned about Japan's revision of defense equipment export limits. Japan's recent dangerous moves in the military and security fields defy its self-proclaimed 'dedication to peace' and adherence to the 'exclusively defense-oriented' policy. Japan is restarting its 'war machine' and 'exporting wars.' Japan's quickened remilitarization is already a reality and comes with actual roadmap and steps being taken. The international community, including China, will remain highly vigilant and firmly resist Japan's reckless moves of neo-militarism.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (via Guo Jiakun, spokesperson)
statements.context: Regular press briefing, response to question about Japanese Prime Minister's Yasukuni Shrine offering
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China firmly opposes and strongly condemns Japan's latest negative moves related to the Yasukuni war shrine. The Yasukuni Shrine is a spiritual tool and symbol of Japanese militarists responsible for the war of aggression and is in fact a shrine for war criminals. Japan's negative moves related to the Yasukuni war shrine is in nature an attempt to evade war responsibilities, an affront to justice, a provocation against Japan's war victims, and a challenge to the outcome of WWII victory. With massive increase in military budget, the deployment of intermediate-range offensive missiles, relaxed restrictions on weapon export, proposed revision of its pacifist Constitution and the idea of abandoning the three non-nuclear principles, how can Japan profess itself as a 'peace-loving country?'

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily criticizing Japanese Prime Minister's Yasukuni Shrine offering
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current Japanese leader's insistence on offering ritual items to such a place that summons the spirit of militarism reflects the strategic intent of Japan's right wing to further break through the constraints of the postwar international order and domestic law. Japan is tearing off the disguise of a 'peaceful nation' one step at a time, and once again becoming a threat to regional peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Xi Jinping's call with Saudi Arabia's Mohammed bin Salman regarding Middle East peace
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China stands ready to share with regional countries the opportunities through Chinese modernization. China proposes four principles: stay committed to the principle of peaceful co-existence; stay committed to the principle of national sovereignty; stay committed to the principle of international rule of law and firmly uphold the international system with the UN at its core; and stay committed to a balanced approach to development and security. As a Chinese solution to end the conflict and realize peace, the proposition has received growing recognition and support from regional countries and the international community.

The Strait of Hormuz should maintain normal passage serving common interests. China supports regional countries building a common home of good-neighborliness, development, security and cooperation, holding their future in their own hands.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: State Council group study session on energy development
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, the international situation is undergoing profound changes, and China's total energy consumption is continuing to grow; given this, we must maintain a sense of vigilance, adhere to bottom-line thinking, and continuously strengthen the resilience of the energy system and its security assurance capabilities.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary published April 21, 2026
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Philippines wants both to pull China in as an 'emergency support' economically, while at the same time stirring trouble on issues that concern China's core interests. The Philippine side has engaged in successive petty provocations regarding the South China Sea issue, including unilaterally renaming maritime features, forcibly intruding into Chinese training zones, illegally harassing Chinese fishing vessels. Moreover, the Philippines has colluded with other nations to destabilise regional security, recently holding large-scale joint military exercises with the United States and Japan—the first time in over 80 years since WWII that Japanese combat personnel have set foot on Philippine soil.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary published April 21, 2026
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Philippine politicians are betting on extra-regional allies who seem to fear nothing more than a tranquil South China Sea in security matters, while relying on cooperation with China in economic matters. If the Philippine side truly hopes to improve relations with China, it should recalibrate the overall positioning of China-Philippines relations at the strategic level and cease all provocative and disruptive actions. China hopes the Philippine side will move in the same direction as China, taking concrete actions to create necessary conditions and atmosphere for stabilizing and improving bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with Myron Brilliant, senior advisor to Albright Stonebridge Group, reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's economy got off to a good start in the first quarter this year with relatively solid growth, demonstrating the strong resilience and stability of the Chinese economy. It is hoped that Albright Stonebridge Group would continue to play an active role in promoting stable, healthy and sustainable development of China-U.S. economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Zheng Shanjie
statements.speaker_title: Chair, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC)
statements.context: Article in People's Daily on enhancing economic security capacity
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Continue to expand China–Russia oil and gas cooperation.

statements.speaker: Zheng Shanjie

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Anyone who believes that Beijing perceives US policy under Donald Trump as accommodative and potentially moving towards a G2 is mistaken. The Chinese leadership is clear; it needs more firepower to compete with American economic coercion.

Both sides should strengthen multilateral coordination, firmly uphold and practice multilateralism, jointly revitalize the authority and vitality of the UN, closely coordinate and cooperate within frameworks such as the Shanghai Cooperation Organization and BRICS, and promote the development of the international order in a more just and reasonable direction.

statements.framing: assertive defense of multilateralism and international law against implied Western unilateralism

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

China has firm resolve in advancing Chinese modernization and the broad-mindedness to share development opportunities with the world through high-standard opening up. China will inject confidence and momentum into global economic growth through its own development.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez, People's Daily report

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.framing: accusatory toward unilateralism and hegemony; assertive on China-Russia coordination

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov, People's Daily readout

The two sides should strengthen cooperation within multilateral frameworks such as the United Nations; jointly safeguard the momentum of unity of the BRICS countries, and defend the legitimate rights and interests of the Global South; continue to maintain strategic coordination on major international and regional issues, join hands in practicing multilateralism and international righteousness, and jointly advance the process of world multipolarization.
statements.framing: assertive coordination against Western-led order; positioning as defenders of Global South

statements.speaker: Wang Yi

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides exchanged in-depth views on international and regional issues of common concern, such as the US-Iran conflict, the situation in the Asia-Pacific region, and the Ukraine crisis.

article_title: Li Meets UAE's Sheikh Khaled - New Malicious Entity List added to Economic Warfare Toolkit - Strengthening Party Control over Industry Associations - Lavrov to Visit Beijing - Wang Yi-Ishaq Dar Call

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Sheikh Khaled bin Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan, crown prince of Abu Dhabi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the outbreak of the Iran conflict, the Chinese side has maintained close communication with all relevant parties and has been actively committed to promoting peace and ending the war. China stands ready to continue playing a constructive role and contributing to the restoration of peace and stability in the Gulf region.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with Pakistan's Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current ceasefire situation is extremely fragile and the regional situation is at a critical juncture. The urgent priority is to make every effort to avoid a resumption of hostilities and to maintain the hard-won momentum of the ceasefire. The international community should continue to intensify efforts to persuade peace and promote talks, and clearly oppose any actions that undermine the ceasefire or escalate confrontation.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Khaldoon Khalifa Al Mubarak, special envoy of the president of the UAE to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China fully understands the legitimate security concerns of Gulf Arab states and supports the UAE in safeguarding its national sovereignty, security, and legitimate rights and interests. A blockade of the Strait of Hormuz does not conform to the common interests of the international community and achieving a comprehensive and lasting ceasefire through political and diplomatic means is the fundamental way to resolve the issue. China has been committed to promoting ceasefire and ending hostilities, and is willing to work with the international community, including the UAE, to help restore peace and tranquility to the Middle East as soon as possible.

statements.speaker: Foreign Ministry Spokesperson Guo Jiakun
statements.context: Regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia are comprehensive strategic partners of coordination for a new era. In recent years, the two countries have steadily deepened their permanent good-neighborly friendship, expanded comprehensive strategic coordination, adhered to mutually beneficial cooperation, and maintained close communication and coordination in international and regional affairs. The two sides have made important contributions to promoting an equitable and orderly multipolar world, reforming and improving global governance, and safeguarding international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: State Council (through Regulations on Countering Improper Extraterritorial Application of Foreign Laws)
statements.context: Publication of new regulations effective upon publication
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The People's Republic of China adheres to an independent foreign policy of peace, opposes hegemonism and power politics, and opposes any country interfering in China's internal affairs under any pretext or in any manner. Where a foreign state, in violation of international law and the basic norms governing international relations, adopts improper extraterritorial measures that endanger China's sovereignty, security, or development interests, or harm the lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens or organizations, the Chinese government has the right to take corresponding measures.

statements.speaker: State Council (through Regulations on Countering Improper Extraterritorial Application of Foreign Laws)
statements.context: Publication of new regulations effective upon publication
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In accordance with the laws of the People's Republic of China, treaties concluded or acceded to by the People's Republic of China, or on the basis of reciprocity, the Chinese government has the right to exercise extraterritorial jurisdiction over acts that have an appropriate connection with China, so as to safeguard national sovereignty, security, and development interests and protect the lawful rights and interests of Chinese citizens and organizations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with South African President at FOCAC summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, the world is experiencing accelerated changes unseen in a century, and humanity is facing unprecedented challenges.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Eritrea share similar views on many major international and regional issues, and China is willing to maintain coordination and cooperation with Eritrea to better safeguard the legitimate rights and interests of developing countries and work towards a more just and reasonable international order.

statements.speaker: China-South Africa Joint Statement

statements.speaker: China-South Africa Joint Statement

article_title: China & France Must Build 'Right Perception of Each Other - Agenda for Xi's Serbia Visit - Zhong Caiwen Series on Overcapacity

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Serbian media prior to visit to Serbia; remarks during visit to France
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and France belong to Eastern and Western civilizations with different values and social systems, but both value exchanges and mutual learning between civilizations. The two sides should coexist in harmony without seeking uniformity, and make new contributions to world peace and development through dialogue and cooperation. China is willing to strengthen people-to-people and cultural exchanges with France and Europe, continuously deepen economic and trade cooperation, build the right perception of each other, and solidify and carry forward the stories of friendship between the Chinese people and the people of France and Europe.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Serbian media prior to visit to Serbia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Whatever changes in the international landscape, China and Serbia remain true friends and good partners. Our ironclad friendship is ever-growing, setting a model for state-to-state and people-to-people interactions.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Serbian media; remarks during visit to Serbia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China respects and supports the development path that the Serbian people have chosen of their own will. We support Serbia's efforts to uphold its sovereignty and territorial integrity, and oppose any attempt by any forces to interfere in Serbia's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Serbian media; remarks during visit to Serbia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing a fluid and turbulent world, we should step up coordination and cooperation in the United Nations and other international organizations, and advocate an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization. We should practice true multilateralism, and endeavor to maintain world peace and stability and safeguard international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article published in Serbian media; remarks during visit to Serbia
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Twenty-five years ago today, NATO flagrantly bombed the Chinese embassy in Yugoslavia, killing three Chinese journalists. This we should never forget. The Chinese people cherish peace, but we will never allow such tragic history to repeat itself.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Zhong Caiwen series) published May 8, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The recent so-called 'overcapacity' argument in China's new energy sector ignores the benefits that Chinese products bring to global consumers and how they promote global industrial upgrading. Asking China to reduce production capacity is a case of ulterior motives—those raising concerns are not worried about production capacity, but their own market share.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Zhong Caiwen series) published May 8, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Several studies have shown that Chinese goods have significantly lowered the prices of American consumer goods, and American consumers are the biggest beneficiaries of Sino-US trade.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Zhong Caiwen series) published May 8, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's production capacity benefits from the joint efforts of efficient markets and effective government. Throughout history, the success of developed countries is inseparable from the role of the market and the guidance and support of government's industrial policies. Japan, Germany, and South Korea achieved rapid economic development after World War II, largely relying on government policy support for leading industries. The United States has a long history of using industrial policies on a large scale. The CHIPS and Science Act alone plans to allocate more than $52 billion in subsidies.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Zhong Caiwen series) published May 8, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A large part of China's production capacity comes from multinational companies. Many of these are American companies. For example, Apple's position as the world's second most profitable and highest valued company is greatly attributed to the hardworking Chinese labour force and efficient 'Apple supply chain' companies. Recently, Apple announced plans to expand its R&D labs in China to support manufacturing. Similarly, half of the 1.845 million new energy vehicles produced by Tesla last year were manufactured in its Shanghai factory.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Zhong Caiwen series) published May 8, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China does not try to find reasons to criticise, suppress and contain other countries just because they are leading in artificial intelligence, commercial space and low-orbit satellites. Instead, it sincerely learns from and draws lessons from others, contributing to the progress of human technology through mutual learning and exchanges. Likewise, developed countries should also maintain an open and fair attitude in areas such as new energy where China is leading in technology, taking into account the cause of improving the well-being of all mankind.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary article (Zhong Caiwen series) published May 8, 2024
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's industrial policies do not violate market laws. They do not engage in 'beggar-thy-neighbour' practices by excluding competition from other countries, nor does it 'pull up seedlings to help them grow' through blind development of industries.

article_title: Li Signals Support for Private Enterprises & Platform Economy - 'Double Support' Work - China-Angola Ties - Pushing RMB Use For Trade - India-China & the Global South

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The changes in the China-US interaction model have brought more people to realize that China's growth and strengthening is the broad trend of history, and that any attempt to contain or suppress China cannot possibly succeed.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiping (People's Daily article)
statements.context: People's Daily article on US-China relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan issue is the most important and most sensitive core issue in China-US relations and concerns the political foundation of China-US relations. Taiwan is China's territory; the Chinese side must safeguard national sovereignty and territorial integrity and will never allow Taiwan to split off.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiping (People's Daily article)
statements.context: People's Daily article on US-China relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The trade and tariff wars launched by the US have disrupted normal economic and trade cooperation and have not only failed to solve the US trade deficit in goods or its problems of industrial competitiveness, but have caused American businesses and consumers to pay a heavy price.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiping (People's Daily article)
statements.context: People's Daily article on US-China relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with the US to advance an equal and orderly multipolar world, abide by universally recognised international rules, and improve the global governance system on the principle of extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiping (People's Daily article)
statements.context: People's Daily article on US-China relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world economy cannot bear having its top two economies fall into 'decoupling and breaking chains.' The two sides should be partners and friends, allow economic and trade cooperation to continue serving as the ballast of China-US relations.

statements.speaker: Zhang Siyuan (People's Daily article)
statements.context: People's Daily article on Trump's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan issue is the core of China's core interests, the foundation of the political foundation of China-US relations, and the first red line that cannot be crossed in China-US relations. The US side should immediately stop arms sales to Taiwan and properly handle the Taiwan issue.

statements.speaker: Zhang Siyuan (People's Daily article)
statements.context: People's Daily article on Trump's visit to China
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US side should abide by the One-China principle and the three China-US joint communiqués, immediately stop arms sales to Taiwan, and properly handle the Taiwan issue.

article_title: New Framework for Old Frictions as Xi Meets Trump in Beijing

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with President Trump, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Can China and the United States overcome the Thucydides Trap and create a new paradigm of major-country relations? Can we meet global challenges together and provide greater stability for the world? I stand ready to work together with President Trump to set the course and steer the giant ship of China-U.S. relations, so as to make 2026 a historic, landmark year that opens up a new chapter in China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with President Trump, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is committed to a steady, sound and sustainable development of China-U.S. relations. I have agreed with President Trump on a new vision of building a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability. This will provide strategic guidance for China-U.S. relations over the next three years and beyond.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with President Trump, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Constructive strategic stability means positive stability with cooperation as the mainstay, healthy stability with competition within proper limits, constant stability with manageable differences, and lasting stability with expectable peace.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with President Trump, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-U.S. economic and trade ties are mutually beneficial and win-win in nature. Where disagreements and frictions exist, equal-footed consultation is the only right choice. China will only open its door wider. U.S. businesses are deeply involved in China's reform and opening up. China welcomes more mutually beneficial cooperation from the U.S.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with President Trump, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should implement the important common understandings we have reached, and make better use of communication channels in the political and diplomatic and military-to-military fields. The two countries should expand exchanges and cooperation in areas such as the economy and trade, health, agriculture, tourism, people-to-people ties and law enforcement.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with President Trump, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is the most important issue in China-U.S. relations. If it is handled properly, the bilateral relationship will enjoy overall stability. Otherwise, the two countries will have clashes and even conflicts, putting the entire relationship in great jeopardy. 'Taiwan independence' and cross-Strait peace are as irreconcilable as fire and water. Safeguarding peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait is the biggest common denominator between China and the U.S. The U.S. side must exercise extra caution in handling the Taiwan question.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Evening banquet remarks, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Achieving the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and making America great again can go hand in hand. We can help each other succeed and advance the well-being of the whole world.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Evening banquet remarks, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 55 years ago, 'Ping-Pong diplomacy' was carried out between our two countries. The door that had remained frozen for over 20 years was opened. From then on, China and the United States have written many chapters of friendship through mutual opening up to each other and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Evening banquet remarks, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In this new era, President Trump and I have had multiple meetings and phone calls and kept China-U.S. relations generally stable. We both believe that the China-U.S. relationship is the most important bilateral relationship in the world. We must make it work, and never mess it up. Both China and the United States stand to gain from cooperation and lose from confrontation. Our two countries should be partners rather than rivals.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Evening banquet remarks, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Looking back at the course of China-U.S. relations, whether or not we could have mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation is the key to whether the relationship can advance steadily. China-U.S. relations concern the well-being of the over 1.7 billion people of both countries, and affect the interests of the over eight billion people of the world. Both sides should rise up to this historic responsibility and steer the giant ship of China-U.S. relations forward steadily and in the right direction.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on Iran and Middle East situation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: There is no point in continuing this conflict which should not have happened in the first place. To find an early way to resolve the situation is in the interest of not only the U.S. and Iran, but also regional countries and the rest of the world. China always believes that dialogue and negotiation is the right way forward, and the use of force is a dead end. Now that the door of dialogue has been opened, it should not be shut again.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with visiting US business delegation, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Against the background of increasing unstable and uncertain factors in the current international situation, China and the United States maintaining candid and smooth dialogue and communication, and actively safeguarding stable and healthy bilateral relations, not only has major significance for the two countries, but will also inject certainty and positive energy into the cause of global peace and development. The Chinese side is willing to work together with the US side to properly implement the important consensus of the two heads of state, strive for more positive outcomes, achieve each other and jointly promote prosperity.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with visiting US business delegation, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In today's world where transformation and turmoil are intertwined, stability appears even more precious and requires everyone to safeguard it together. A stable and predictable China-US economic and trade relationship conforms to the interests of the two countries and the world.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with visiting US business delegation, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-US economic and trade cooperation is enormous in scale, and market and industrial links are broad; strengthening cooperation between the two sides can not only promote mutual benefit and win-win outcomes, but is also beneficial to global economic growth. As the world's two largest economies, China and the United States should move toward each other, take the lead in promoting openness and cooperation, properly handle and manage differences, safeguard the economic and trade relationship between the two countries, and act as a force for global stability and constructiveness.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with visiting US business delegation, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A stable and open policy environment is a long-term and unchanging commitment of the Chinese government. We will persist in expanding high-level opening up, as always do a good job serving foreign-funded enterprises, continuously improve and perfect various policies and raise administrative efficiency, fully listen to opinions and appeals, actively help resolve worries and difficulties, and allow enterprises to plan for the future with peace of mind and focus on their own development.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with visiting US business delegation, published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The stable, healthy, and sustainable development of China-US relations requires joint efforts from all sectors across both countries. It is hoped that more US-funded enterprises would continue to deepen their engagement within the Chinese market, thereby forging even stronger bonds of mutually beneficial cooperation between China and the United States, and at the same time continue acting as bridges for communication and dialogue between the two countries, promoting all sectors of the United States to view China's development more objectively and rationally, and promoting mutual trust and friendship between China and the United States.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Regular press briefing (MoFA press conference, November 10, 2022)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: A certain country has repeatedly abused its state power to politicize tech and trade issues and use them as a tool and weapon to blockade and suppress China by pushing for decoupling and disrupting industrial and supply chains. This not only seriously undermines international trade rules, but will fragment the global market, and sabotage the security and stability of global industrial and supply chains. Those who perpetrate such self-serving coercive acts are essentially seeking to advance their anti-China agenda at the expense of the well-being of all humanity.

statements.speaker: Zhao Lijian
statements.context: Regular press briefing, November 10, 2022
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The participation of US semiconductor companies at the CIIE reflects their confidence in China's growth potential and their resolve to embrace the Chinese market, proving that China's commitment to high-quality growth and high-standard opening up is in keeping with the trend of our times. We will continue to work with the international community to jointly oppose economic coercion and sci-tech bullying, and keep the institutions, rules and foundation of the world economy stable and the global industrial and supply chains safe and secure.

article_title: The Deal Beijing Offered Trump: Constructive Strategic Stability

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the United States have reached a new starting point. President Xi raised important questions: Can China and the United States overcome the Thucydides Trap and create a new paradigm of major-country relations? Can we meet global challenges together and provide greater stability for the world?

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two presidents agreed to build 'a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability.' This is positive stability where cooperation is the mainstay; healthy stability where competition is kept within proper limits; constant stability where differences are manageable; lasting stability where peace is expectable and conflicts and wars are not acceptable.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability is not a slogan. It should be a goal both sides uphold and entail concerted actions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is China's internal affair. Realizing complete reunification is an aspiration shared by all sons and daughters of the Chinese nation and the unwavering, historic mission of the Communist Party of China. We hope that the U.S. side will strictly abide by the one-China principle and the three China-U.S. joint communiqués.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Taiwan question is the most important issue between China and the U.S., one that affects the entire relationship. If it is handled properly, the overall relationship will be stable. Otherwise, the two countries will have clashes and even conflicts, and the entire relationship will be in great jeopardy. 'Taiwan independence' and cross-Strait peace are as irreconcilable as fire and water.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Our impression coming out of the summit is that the U.S. side understands China's position, takes China's concerns seriously, and, like the rest of the international community, does not agree with or accept Taiwan's moving toward independence.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Briefing following Trump-Xi summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Where disagreements and frictions exist on economic ties, equal-footed consultation is the only right approach. The two economic and trade teams produced generally balanced and positive outcomes, including continuing to implement all consensus reached in prior consultations, establishing a Trade Council and Investment Council, addressing concerns regarding market access for agricultural products, and expanding two-way trade within the framework of reciprocal tariff reduction.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on economic consultations outcomes
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides will continue to properly implement the outcomes of earlier consultations, and have formed a positive consensus regarding relevant tariff arrangements. The two sides have agreed to establish a Trade Council and an Investment Council to discuss each side's respective concerns in the trade and investment fields.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on economic consultations outcomes
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides will resolve, or substantively advance the resolution of, some non-tariff barriers and market access issues on agricultural products. The United States will actively work to address long-standing Chinese concerns including automatic detention measures targeting Chinese dairy and aquatic products. China will actively advance solutions to US concerns regarding beef facility registration and poultry exports.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official statement on economic consultations outcomes
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The positive outcomes achieved in the China-US economic and trade consultations show that the two sides, by upholding the spirit of mutual respect, equality, and mutual benefit, and by carrying out dialogue and cooperation, are able to find ways to resolve problems.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Constructive strategic stability' should be positive stability with cooperation as the main feature. When China and the United States cooperate, both benefit; when they fight, both are harmed. The two countries should become partners rather than rivals.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Constructive strategic stability' should be benign stability of competition with proper limits. Competition is not a zero-sum 'boxing match' but a 'track-and-field competition' of mutual encouragement and joint improvement. Realizing the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and Make America Great Again can run in parallel without conflict.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Constructive strategic stability' should be a normal stability in which differences are controllable. So long as both sides adhere to mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and win-win cooperation, they can completely transcend differences and find the correct way for two major countries to get along.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Constructive strategic stability' should be enduring stability in which peace can be expected. The Taiwan question is the most important issue in China–US relations. If it is handled well, bilateral relations can maintain overall stability. 'Taiwan independence' and peace in the Taiwan Strait are as incompatible as fire and water. Safeguarding peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait is the greatest common denominator between China and the United States.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Commentary in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The US side must handle the Taiwan issue with the utmost caution. The US side should abide by the One China principle and the three China–US joint communiqués, in order to build a solid foundation for the steady and long-term development of China–US relations.

statements.speaker: Diao Daming
statements.speaker_title: Professor, School of International Studies, Renmin University of China; Chair, Department of Diplomacy
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a constructive relationship of strategic stability between China and the US is a profound summary of the lessons and experiences of China–US interactions over the past period and a clear judgment on the historical position in which current China–US relations are situated. Strategic competition does not accord with the broad trend of history or the theme of the times, nor can it define the overall picture of China–US relations.

statements.speaker: Diao Daming
statements.speaker_title: Professor, School of International Studies, Renmin University of China; Chair, Department of Diplomacy
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To take strategic competition with China as the starting point of policy is both a misreading of China's development and a misjudgment of the China-US relationship; it fundamentally cannot resolve China's and the US's respective problems or the problems of the bilateral relationship, and still less can it deal with global challenges.

statements.speaker: Diao Daming
statements.speaker_title: Professor, School of International Studies, Renmin University of China; Chair, Department of Diplomacy
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Constructive strategic stability' should be positive stability with cooperation as the main feature; benign stability with competition kept within proper limits; normal stability in which differences are controllable; and enduring stability in which peace can be expected. These 'four stabilities' further clarify the correct way for China and the US to get along in different fields.

statements.speaker: Diao Daming
statements.speaker_title: Professor, School of International Studies, Renmin University of China; Chair, Department of Diplomacy
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a constructive relationship of strategic stability between China and the US requires both sides to move toward each other and put things into action. Both China and the United States already have a clear understanding and have established the new positioning of a constructive relationship of strategic stability between China and the US.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During the Cold War, US–Soviet strategic stability meant that even amid extreme confrontation, the two sides were still able to form and maintain a basic set of mechanisms to avoid nuclear war and crises running out of control. For China–US relations, the classic US–Soviet nuclear stability framework clearly cannot be directly applied, because there are significant differences between China and the United States in nuclear forces scale, strategic culture, security environment, and economic interdependence.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China–US strategic stability not only involves nuclear deterrence and arms control, but also involves political mutual trust, strategic perceptions, crisis management and control, the boundaries of economics, trade, and technology, and respect for each other's core interests.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The proposal of the concept of a constructive relationship of strategic stability between China and the US advances traditional strategic stability from the domain of military security into the overall framework of major-country relations. It emphasizes stability, but does not take freezing contradictions as its objective; it acknowledges competition, but requires that competition must be limited; it faces differences, but requires that differences must be controllable; it pursues peace, but is not merely passively avoiding conflict.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The sixth stage is the 'constructive relationship of strategic stability' amid the background of strategic competition. Since 2017, the US has defined China as a strategic competitor. This framework neither avoids competition nor fantasises about returning to the past. Rather, it attempts, under conditions in which competition has become normalised, to establish a framework for major-country relations that is more manageable, more predictable, and more sustainable.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The innovation of the 'relationship of constructive strategic stability' lies in extending strategic stability from the traditional fields of military security and nuclear deterrence to the overall structure of China–US relations, encompassing politics, economics, technology, security, and global governance.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Constructive strategic stability emphasizes the core connotation of 'constructive.' Traditional strategic stability often carried a negative coloration, but constructive strategic stability requires stability itself to possess positive connotations. 'Positive stability with cooperation as the main feature' signifies that US-China relations cannot remain at the low-level equilibrium of merely 'avoiding war.' 'Benign stability with competition within proper limits' signifies that competition must have boundaries, rules, and bottom lines. 'Normal stability in which differences are controllable' signifies that differences can be effectively managed through communication mechanisms. 'Enduring stability in which peace can be expected' points to the ultimate objective of stability toward long-term peace.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a 'relationship of constructive strategic stability between China and the US' links stability with 'moving toward each other.' The US cannot verbally emphasize stability on the one hand while on the other hand sending wrong signals on issues such as Taiwan, broadening the concept of national security on technology issues, applying unilateral pressure on economic and trade issues, and engaging in bloc confrontation on international issues. Stability must be reflected through actions, fulfilled through policies, and guaranteed through concrete mechanisms.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The new positioning of building a 'relationship of constructive strategic stability between China and the US' provides strategic guidance for the next three years and beyond, provides a political framework for halting the decline and stabilizing China–US relations, provides a principled foundation for restoring predictability to economic, trade, and technological cooperation, and provides a signal of stability for the international community in judging the direction of China–US relations.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan is the core of China's core interests. Any attempt to instrumentalise, internationalise, or prolong the Taiwan question will touch China's bottom line and will also directly impact the stable foundation of China–US relations.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Taiwan independence' and peace in the Taiwan Strait are as incompatible as fire and water. The greatest threat to peace in the Taiwan Strait is not China's insistence on the position of unification, but rather the mutual collusion between 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities and interference by external forces. If the US side, on the one hand, claims to maintain peace in the Taiwan Strait, while on the other hand continuing arms sales to Taiwan, elevating official exchanges, and indulging 'Taiwan independence' forces, this will create serious strategic instability.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Safeguarding peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait does not mean maintaining the divided status quo, still less creating room for 'Taiwan independence' activities, but rather firmly safeguarding the One-China Principle and the political foundation established by the three China–US joint communiqués.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Properly handling the Taiwan question is the prerequisite for overall China–US stability. If the Taiwan question spins out of control, all cooperation will be impacted. The Taiwan question is not an ordinary issue within China–US relations, but rather a foundational issue determining whether the base of bilateral relations is stable.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Safeguarding peace and stability in the Taiwan Strait is the greatest common denominator between China and the United States. If the United States truly hopes for peace and does not want conflict with China, then it should, through concrete actions, abide by the One-China principle and the three China–US joint communiqués, and stop sending wrong signals to 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces.

statements.speaker: Shen Yi
statements.context: Interview on Guancha
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under the framework of the 'constructive strategic stability', the Taiwan question should be understood as a bottom-line issue of stability. If this bottom line is repeatedly tested, so-called strategic stability will lack a foundation. If the US side can handle the Taiwan question with the utmost caution, then China–US relations will have the conditions to expand cooperation in other fields and form a more constructive pattern of interaction.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During the Cold War, the United States and the Soviet Union maintained strategic stability by frightening the other side and making the other side not dare to act. This was a kind of negative stability. Now we speak of 'constructive strategic stability.' President Xi profoundly explained its core essence from four dimensions: positive stability with cooperation as the main feature, benign stability with competition within proper limits, normal stability in which differences are controllable, and enduring stability in which peace can be expected.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: With cooperation as the main feature, China and the US can continuously strengthen the resilience of China–US relations through exchanges and cooperation and enlarge the pie of common interests between themselves. With competition within proper limits, there is no zero-sum game in which one side loses and the other wins. With controllable differences, relations cannot fluctuate up and down like a roller coaster. With peace being expected, conflict, confrontation, and even war must not occur.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If over the next three years we can realise a relationship of constructive strategic stability between China and the US, then for China, it extends our period of strategic stability and wins time and space for our development.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For China–US relations, it would explore a new paradigm of peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation between a rising great power and an established great power or superpower.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To Make America Great Again, without China, without cooperating well with China, America cannot become great. The US needs to improve its economy and people's livelihood through a mutually beneficial and win-win approach and can rely on China's strength to realise stability in international affairs.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States is gradually shifting from a China policy that focused mainly on competition and suppression during Trump's first term and the first year of his second term, toward a China policy that places greater emphasis on the stability of China-U.S. relations, on cooperation in China-US relations, and on the management and control of differences.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: If the new vision and new positioning of a relationship of constructive strategic stability between China and the US takes root, and both sides, taking this as their guideline, pragmatically handle China-US affairs, reversing the major-power competitive or even major-power confrontational relationship between China and the US of the past few years, then when we look back at this visit several years later, it may well be a phased turning point in China-US relations.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Halting US arms sales to Taiwan and unequivocally opposing 'Taiwan independence' are specific demands China has made of the US.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It can be anticipated that, over the coming period of time, China-US economic and trade relations will halt their decline and stabilise, and may even gradually enter a period of growth.

statements.speaker: Wu Xinbo
statements.speaker_title: Dean, Institute of International Studies; Director, Center for American Studies, Fudan University
statements.context: Interview
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Going forward, we do not need to worry too much about the US playing the tariff card against us because US courts have already ruled, and the tariff card no longer possesses legal legitimacy. Judging from last year's China-US trade war, it did not achieve Trump's expected results. Moreover, last year our overall exports still achieved the highest growth in history. So the utility of the US tariff card is limited.

article_title: China Outlines Nine Priorities of Global Governance Reform - New Plan for Urban Renewal

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Reply to letter from Chinese and American students in 'A Shared Voyage: China-US Youth Friendship Program' reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Young people from both countries have reached out to each other, deepened mutual understanding, forged profound friendships. Young people represent the future and hope of China-U.S. relations and of the world. Called on more Chinese and U.S. youth to become 'envoys of friendship' bridging the Pacific.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. strategic and business communities in New York while chairing UN Security Council high-level meeting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-U.S. relations transcend the bilateral scope and affect world peace and the future of humanity. Achieving the sound, steady and sustainable development of China-U.S. relations is the common expectation of the international community and the mission that China and the U.S. should fulfill. The direction of China-U.S. relations is of crucial importance to reinvigorating the UN and the Security Council.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. strategic and business communities in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese and U.S. presidents held a historic meeting in Beijing where they had candid, in-depth, constructive and strategic communication. The two sides agreed to define a constructive relationship of strategic stability as the new positioning of China-U.S. relations and to work in the direction of cooperation as the mainstay, competition within proper limits, manageable differences, and expectable peace.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Statement via Wang Yi's readout from presidential meeting in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation and making America great again can go hand in hand and reinforce each other, bringing benefits to the world.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. strategic and business communities in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Taiwan independence' and cross-Strait peace and stability are as irreconcilable as fire and water. Only by upholding the one-China principle and the spirit of the three China-U.S. Joint Communiqués can peace across the Taiwan Strait be safeguarded and conflict and confrontation avoided.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with U.S. strategic and business communities in New York
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To ensure a sound China-U.S. relationship, the two sides need to meet each other halfway, effectively manage differences, lengthen the list of cooperation and shorten the list of problems. China is ready to work with the U.S. to implement the important common understandings reached by the two presidents and bring a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability into reality at an early date.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Address to Group of Friends of Global Governance at UN headquarters
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding reform and improvement of global governance, proposed nine directions: promoting UN reform; enhancing Security Council authority and capacity; promoting modernisation of peacekeeping; building consensus on accelerating development; correcting direction of international human rights governance; deepening economic and financial system reform; establishing rules for AI governance; strengthening governance in cyberspace and outer space; promoting civilisational exchanges.

statements.speaker: Group of Friends of Global Governance (joint communique)
statements.context: Joint communique issued at Group of Friends of Global Governance meeting at UN headquarters
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Members welcomed China's Global Governance Initiative and affirmed the importance of strengthening the UN's central role. Called for safeguarding UN authority and emphasised that the UN's role can only be strengthened, not weakened, and that unilateral actions or politicized and selective means must not be adopted. Called on international community to address impacts caused by unilateral coercive measures, which are not in conformity with UN Charter and international law.

article_title: Gao Fei on Building a China-US Relationship of Constructive Strategic Stability - Unpacking China's Vision for World Order

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current dialogue process between China and the US is a product of Beijing having successfully resisted and pushed back against American pressure. Chinese strength and capabilities have got the US to realise that 'containing and suppressing China does not work.'

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: After multiple rounds of intense contest, the US side has gradually recognised that containing and suppressing China does not work, and that dialogue and consultation are the correct choice.

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Competition has never constituted the entirety of China-US relations; areas of cooperation far outweigh their differences. When China and the US cooperate, both benefit, and when they fight, both are harmed; mutual benefit and win-win, rather than zero-sum games, is the essence of bilateral relations.

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Building a 'China-US relationship of constructive strategic stability' conforms to the trend of the times and accords with the widespread expectations of countries around the world. The two sides agreed to establish a Trade Council and an Investment Council, resolve each other's concerns regarding market access for agricultural products, promote the expansion of two-way trade under a framework of reciprocal tariff reductions.

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US should manage the boundaries of competition, safeguard the bottom line of cooperation, and keep channels of exchange open, in accordance with the great historical trend and the broad expectations of the international community.

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Constructive strategic stability' should be positive stability centered on cooperation, benign stability with competition within proper limits, normalised stability in which differences are controllable, and durable stability in which peace can be anticipated. China and the US should avoid the world sliding toward the danger of a 'new Cold War'.

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The structural contradictions between China and the US will not be resolved overnight, and many difficult problems facing the world still await solution; both sides must grasp the overall situation with strategic resolve, properly handle differences with a constructive attitude, and jointly devise the future with innovative wisdom.

statements.speaker: Gao Fei
statements.speaker_title: Head of China Foreign Affairs University
statements.context: Article in People's Daily
