statements.quote_or_paraphrase: So long as China and the US uphold the principles of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence, and cooperation for mutual win-win outcomes, they can transcend the historical cage of the 'Thucydides Trap' and open up the broad road for a new type of major-country relationship.

article_title: Breakdown of China-Serbia & China-Pakistan Joint Statements

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Pakistan should jointly oppose unilateralism and the Cold War mentality, and promote an equal and orderly multipolar world and an economic globalization that is universally beneficial and inclusive.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In a changing and turbulent world, China and Serbia need to practice true multilateralism, and make unremitting efforts to promote an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with Serbian President Aleksandar Vučić
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing a new wave of technological revolution and industrial transformation, the two sides need to expand cooperation in emerging areas such as artificial intelligence, digital economy, green energy and advanced manufacturing.

statements.speaker: China and Serbia (joint statement)
statements.context: Joint statement on advancing implementation of four global initiatives
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides practice true multilateralism, oppose hegemonism and power politics, uphold international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: China and Serbia (joint statement)
statements.context: Joint statement on four global initiatives
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides will deepen mutually beneficial cooperation in AI development, strengthen coordination and alignment in AI development strategies, governance rules, and technical standards, and turn AI into an international public good benefiting humanity. Serbia supports the establishment of and is willing to join the World AI Cooperation Organization.

statements.speaker: China and Serbia (joint statement)
statements.context: Joint statement - Serbia's position on South China Sea
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Serbia supports China's efforts to maintain peace and stability in the South China Sea and agrees that territorial and maritime disputes in the South China Sea should be peacefully resolved by directly concerned parties through friendly consultations and negotiations in accordance with relevant bilateral agreements and the Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan Chief of Army Staff Syed Asim Munir
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regardless of how the international and regional situation changes, China–Pakistan friendship has always remained rock-solid and unbreakable.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Singapore Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Singapore differ in size, but both are stabilizing factors in the world. In the face of an international situation marked by intertwined turbulence and transformation, both China and Singapore firmly uphold multilateralism, adhere to free trade, and advocate for an international system centered on the United Nations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Singapore Foreign Minister Vivian Balakrishnan
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Safeguarding the security of global industrial and supply chains and ensuring unimpeded maritime navigation are common aspirations of all countries and are in the shared interests of the international community, and China is willing to continue making efforts in this regard.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Pakistan PM Shehbaz Sharif
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work with Pakistan to further advance CPEC's construction, continue to focus on major connectivity projects between the two countries, and strengthen cooperation in areas such as industry, mining, agriculture, people's livelihood, and finance. China is willing to import more high-quality products from Pakistan and work with Pakistan to actively upgrade the bilateral FTA.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Serbia - statement on international situation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, the international situation continues to undergo complex changes. China is willing to strengthen coordination and cooperation with Serbia on platforms such as the United Nations, practice true multilateralism, promote the implementation of the four major global initiatives, and build a more just and reasonable global governance system.

statements.speaker: China and Pakistan (joint statement)
statements.context: China-Pakistan joint statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Pakistan firmly supports China's just stance on issues concerning Xinjiang, Xizang, Hong Kong and the South China Sea. China reiterated its unwavering support for Pakistan in defending its national sovereignty, independence, and territorial integrity.

statements.speaker: China and Pakistan (joint statement)
statements.context: China-Pakistan joint statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Pakistan supports China's initiative of establishing the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization, believing that this represents a concrete step toward promoting the development of artificial intelligence for good and for all.

statements.speaker: China and Pakistan (joint statement)
statements.context: China-Pakistan joint statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides called on the international community to enhance counter-terrorism cooperation, and reaffirmed their firm opposition to applying double standards on counter-terrorism or to politicizing and instrumentalize counter-terrorism.

article_title: Xi & Putin Outline Shared Vision for Multipolarity

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Bilateral talks with Putin in Beijing, readout of restricted and expanded format meetings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Under current international situation, as permanent members of UN Security Council and major world powers, China and Russia should focus on long-term strategic objectives, use higher-quality comprehensive strategic coordination to support each other's development, and promote construction of more just and reasonable global governance system.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Press address following Xi-Putin talks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Today's world is far from peaceful; unilateralism and hegemonism pose grave dangers, and the world faces risk of regressing to law of the jungle. As permanent UN Security Council members, China and Russia must firmly fulfill mission as responsible major countries, defend UN authority and international fairness and justice, oppose all unilateral bullying acts and acts turning wheel of history backwards, especially oppose all provocative acts negating World War II outcomes and that 'reverse verdicts on' and 'summon back souls of' fascism and militarism.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Press address following Xi-Putin talks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Russia have consistently abided by principles of 'non-alliance, non-confrontation, and not targeting any third party' established by Treaty of Good-Neighbourliness and Friendly Cooperation, have upheld treating each other as equals, mutual respect, honouring trust and upholding righteousness, and win-win cooperation, and have made important contributions to safeguarding international fairness and justice and advancing building of new type of international relations, becoming key constant amid once-in-a-century changes in world.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Press address following Xi-Putin talks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides should deepen multilateral coordination, further closely coordinate and cooperate on multilateral platforms such as United Nations, Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, BRICS, and APEC, unwaveringly safeguard post-war international order and authority of international law, unite Global South, and lead correct direction of reform of global governance system.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The practice of certain countries wantonly manipulating international affairs, imposing their own interests on entire world with colonial-era mindset, and restricting development of other sovereign states has met complete failure.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: On the other hand, international situation is becoming more complex. Unilateral coercion, hegemonism, bloc confrontation, and countercurrents of neocolonialism are surging. International law and basic norms governing international relations are continuously being trampled upon. Many global governance institutions finding it increasingly difficult to coordinate actions among states and mediate international disputes.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The use of unilateral means to solve common problems, as well as any form of hegemonism and coercive policy, is unacceptable.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: One country's security cannot come at expense of another's. Block confrontation and 'zero-sum games' should be resisted. Military alliance expansion, hybrid warfare, and proxy wars should be opposed, and building of balanced, effective, and sustainable new type of global and regional security architecture should be advocated.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Sovereign states must not be forced to abandon neutrality.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: No country or group of countries should control international affairs, dominate fate of other countries, or monopolize development advantages. Rules formulated by small number of countries cannot replace universally accepted international legal norms. Major powers should genuinely undertake special responsibilities and missions, strengthen self-restraint, and refrain from abusing their power.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides firmly oppose using human rights as pretext to interfere in internal affairs of other countries, as well as politicization and instrumentalization of human rights issues.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit, arms control section
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides oppose various provocative acts and hostile behaviour by certain nuclear-weapons states directed at other nuclear-weapons states; such acts damage fundamental interests of these states in security domain and cause increase in strategic risks. Certain nuclear-weapon states are obsessed with supremacy of force and seek absolute military-security superiority, deploying military strategic infrastructure and other strategic offensive and defensive weapons close to frontiers of other nuclear-weapon states, and recklessly expanding military alliances in violation of principle of equal and indivisible security.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit, arms control section
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides point out that actions of pushing NATO to enter Asia-Pacific region, as well as creating 'Asia-Pacific version' of NATO based on mechanisms such as AUKUS alliance, do not accord with task of consolidating regional peace and security. The two sides oppose attempts to wreck ASEAN-centred regional cooperation architecture by actively forging bloc alliances in Asia-Pacific region.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit, section on US military policy
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides believe that United States' 'Golden Dome' plan aims to establish unconstrained global, multi-layered, and multi-domain missile defense system capable of countering threats from all missiles, including those of any 'peer competitor', at every stage from pre-launch preparation to flight. This significantly undermines strategic stability and completely negates inseparability of interrelationship between strategic offensive weapons and strategic defensive weapons. It substantially increases risk of conflict in outer space, promotes weaponization of outer space and its transformation into venue for armed confrontation.
statements.topic: nuclear weapons, military, US military strategy

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit, section on regional security concerns
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides emphasise that at present, Japan is accelerating its 'remilitarisation', seriously threatening regional peace and stability, and international community and regional countries are highly vigilant about this.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit, section on international military conduct
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides point out that brazenly launching military strikes against other countries, using negotiations as pretext while actually preparing for such actions, assassinating leaders of sovereign states, destabilising their domestic political environments, inciting regime change, and forcibly abducting and putting head of state on trial, seriously violate purposes and principles of UN Charter and seriously undermine foundations of international order formed after Second World War. The two sides firmly oppose and strongly condemn such actions, and point out that main cause of present instability on Eurasian continent is destructive external interference.

statements.speaker: Joint Declaration on Formation of Multipolar World and New Type of International Relations
statements.context: Official joint declaration issued following Xi-Putin summit, section on US military strikes
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides unanimously hold that military strikes by United States and Israel against Iran violate international law and basic norms of international relations, and seriously undermine stability of situation in Middle East.
statements.topic: military intervention, Middle East, US conduct

statements.speaker: Joint Statement on Further Strengthening Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement issued following Xi-Putin summit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides are willing to coordinate in properly carrying out information support work for large-scale international events, promote reporting on bilateral relationship development of two countries, jointly respond to unfriendly actions by third parties that negatively affect media cooperation between two countries, resist interference in internal affairs in information sphere and dissemination of false information that undermines cooperation between two countries.

statements.speaker: Joint Statement on Further Strengthening Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement issued following Xi-Putin summit, section on international relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international relations section is critical of 'unilateral, coercive, punitive, or discriminatory protectionist measures' taken by states.

statements.speaker: Joint Statement on Further Strengthening Comprehensive Partnership and Strategic Cooperation
statements.context: Official joint statement issued following Xi-Putin summit, section on maritime concerns
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides are concerned about certain countries, transnational organisations, and their allies unilaterally obstructing international shipping, and believe that this poses threat to integrity of entire international supply chain and to maritime trade. The two sides hold that cooperation on maritime infrastructure such as ports should follow market principles and commercial principles, avoid pan-securitisation and pan-politicisation.

article_title: Xi's Thought Now Priority for New Party Recruits - Li Focuses on AI & Intelligent Robots - Ding Stresses Strengthening Computing Power - China Awards Foreign Envoys with Outstanding Diplomat Medal

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory. The Government of the People's Republic of China is the sole legal government representing the whole of China. China firmly opposes any official exchanges between countries having diplomatic ties with China and the Taiwan region, and firmly opposes any attempts to offer platforms for 'Taiwan independence' separatist activities.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We have noted President Trump's remarks. Taiwan is an inalienable part of China's territory. It is never a country, not in the past, and never in the future. 'Taiwan independence' and cross-Strait peace are as irreconcilable as fire and water. To seek 'Taiwan independence' by soliciting external support is a dead end.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's firm opposition to U.S. arms sales to China's Taiwan region is consistent and clear.

statements.speaker: Guo Jiakun
statements.context: Ministry of Foreign Affairs regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Lai Ching-te's latest act is just self-defeating, which once again lays bare his separatist stance and intent to advance 'Taiwan independence.' There is but one China in the world. Taiwan is never a country, not in the past, and never in the future. By colluding with external forces to seek independence and attempting to make the Taiwan question an international issue, the Lai Ching-te authorities are the biggest destroyer of the status quo and the biggest source of disruption to peace and stability across the Taiwan Strait.

statements.speaker: Zhao Leji
statements.speaker_title: Chairman of the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress
statements.context: Meeting with Georgian Parliament Speaker Shalva Papuashvili
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will, as always, support Georgia in following a development path independently chosen by its people and in line with its national conditions, and oppose external forces' interference in Georgia's internal affairs.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Seychelles Foreign Minister Barry Faure
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China highly appreciates Seychelles, together with governments of many friendly countries, for lawfully and openly revoking the outbound flight permits for Lai Ching-te, a representative figure of the 'Taiwan independence' separatist forces. It is believed that more and more countries will, like Seychelles, stand on the right side of international justice and history.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with AMD CEO Lisa Su in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese and US heads of state held an important meeting in Beijing last week, reaching a series of significant consensuses. Under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, the economic and trade teams of both countries have reached outcomes that are generally balanced and positive, which will inject more certainty and stability into the next phase of China-US economic and trade cooperation as well as the global economy.

article_title: What Happened When Xi Met Trump in Zhongnanhai?

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Feature article on Trump-Xi meeting in Zhongnanhai; attributed statements and paraphrased positions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's door of opening-up will only open wider and wider. American enterprises are deeply participating in China's reform and opening-up, and China welcomes the United States to strengthen mutually beneficial cooperation with China.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Feature article on Trump-Xi meeting; discussion of China-US relations framework
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The new positioning of China-US relations as a 'relationship of constructive strategic stability' draws wisdom from history, with an eye to transcending the 'Thucydides Trap' and pioneering a new paradigm of major-power relations.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (editorial/commentary)
statements.context: Feature article on Trump-Xi meeting and changing China-US relations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Two attitudes are competing: one is 'decoupling and breaking chains' and 'small yard, high fence'; the other is openness and cooperation, mutual benefit and win-win outcomes. Which is superior and which inferior is obvious at a glance...China cannot be crushed or defeated.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (editorial/commentary)
statements.context: Feature article discussing economic and trade changes during Trump-Xi visit
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During the trade war years, China achieved victory in poverty alleviation, developed domestically-produced large AI models, advanced on the road of technological innovation as the world's second-largest economy, and led in green transition with new energy vehicles—today more voices in the United States believe that shutting Chinese green products out will only cause America to miss this wave of global development.

statements.speaker: People's Daily (editorial/commentary)
statements.context: Feature article on Trump-Xi meeting outcomes
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In an international situation interwoven with transformation and turbulence, 'going to China' continues to witness an upsurge, and 'cooperating with China' has become an ever broader international consensus and action because a major country that persists in following the great trends, shouldering great responsibilities, and walking the great way naturally possesses powerful magnetic attraction.

article_title: Breakdown & Analysis of China's New Outbound Investment Regulations

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A explaining rationale for new outbound investment regulations
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As geopolitical risks rise and international competition intensifies, there is an urgent need for high-level specialised legislation. The model of relying primarily on departmental rules to implement outbound-investment administration no longer meets practical needs.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A on outbound investment administration
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Regulations clarify that the State shall improve the outbound investment security review system and conduct security reviews of outbound investments that affect or may affect national security.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A on responses to foreign discriminatory measures
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, the discriminatory measures of certain foreign governments and organisations against Chinese investors and their outbound investments have severely harmed the legitimate rights and interests of our citizens and organisations and infringed upon our overseas interests.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A on countermeasures against foreign discrimination
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding trade-related investment barriers or other obstacles imposed by foreign countries, the competent commerce department may conduct an investigation, and based on results, relevant departments may take measures such as adjusting country-specific investment policy or prohibiting/restricting import and export of relevant goods or technologies.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A on countermeasures against foreign discrimination
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding discriminatory prohibitions, restrictions, or other similar measures adopted by foreign countries or international organisations in matters such as investment and operation, the Chinese government has the right to take corresponding measures and may impose countermeasures on organisations and individuals that directly or indirectly participate in the formulation, decision-making, and implementation of such measures, in accordance with the Anti-Foreign-Sanctions Law.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A on countermeasures against foreign entities
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Regarding foreign organisations and individuals that endanger China's national sovereignty, security, and development interests; that violate normal market-transaction principles to interrupt transactions; or that adopt discriminatory measures, the relevant departments of the State Council may take measures including prohibiting or restricting their investment within the territory of China, their entry, and relevant transactions and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Justice, National Development and Reform Commission (NDRC), Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official Q&A on China's approach to economic globalisation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic globalisation has encountered counter-currents, with unilateralism, protectionism, and isolationism on the rise. China firmly safeguards a rules-based, transparent, non-discriminatory, open, and inclusive multilateral trading system and opposes unilateralism and protectionism.

article_title: Zhong Sheng: US Must Remove Barriers to AI Cooperation - Li Lecheng on China's Approach to Developing Future Industries

statements.speaker: Xie Feng
statements.speaker_title: Ambassador of China to the United States
statements.context: Remarks at Embassy of China event hosting 'Night of Pickleball & Premiere of China Trip Documentary'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China-US relations stand at a new historical starting point. Now it is up to us to follow the direction set by our two presidents. Let's work together toward a relationship with cooperation as the mainstay, competition within proper limits, manageable differences and expectable peace. That way, we could advance the stable, sound and sustainable development of China-US relations, and explore the right way for China and the United States to get along in this new era.

statements.speaker: Xie Feng
statements.speaker_title: Ambassador of China to the United States
statements.context: Remarks at Embassy of China event hosting 'Night of Pickleball & Premiere of China Trip Documentary'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: President Xi Jinping recently replied to a letter from Chinese and U.S. students, where President Xi pointed out that initiative to invite 50,000 young Americans to China for exchange and study over five years has reached its goal two and a half years ahead of schedule. This is a powerful example of young people from our two countries reaching out to one another across the Pacific — a youthful promise for the future of China-U.S. relations.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-US AI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Recently, the heads of state of China and the US held constructive exchanges on the issue of AI, and agreed to launch an AI inter-governmental dialogue. At present, China-US relations have generally maintained stability, with the establishment of the new positioning of a 'a relationship of constructive strategic stability between China and the US'. As two AI great powers, China and the US working together to promote AI development and governance is both a concrete embodiment of implementing the consensus reached by the two heads of state and will also push AI to better serve the progress of human civilisation and the common welfare of the international community.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-US AI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and the US have previously co-sponsored each other's resolutions on AI at the UN General Assembly, and the two countries maintain regular Track II communication and dialogue; this fully demonstrates that the two sides are capable of conducting positive interaction in this important field. China stands ready to strengthen communication and coordination with the international community, including the US, to promote the formation of a globally consensus-based AI governance framework and standards.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-US AI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, there remain some practical obstacles to China-US cooperation in the AI field. Certain people on the US side view AI through a zero-sum game mentality, politicising, instrumentalising, and weaponising AI technology, and have introduced protective measures such as investment restrictions, chip export controls, and cloud-computing service controls, artificially erecting barriers to cooperation. Such practices of 'decoupling and breaking chains' and 'small yards with high fences' violate the objective laws of scientific and technological development, harm the legitimate rights and interests of enterprises in both countries, and are unfavourable to the coordinated development of the global AI industry.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-US AI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of suppression and containment, China firmly safeguards its own right to development, and remains committed to making AI an inclusive engine for global development.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-US AI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Competition between China and the United States in the field of AI is natural, but it should be healthy competition, and the two sides should also demonstrate the responsibility of major powers through cooperation. Market practice has fully proven that China-US cooperation on AI has enormous potential and can achieve mutual benefit and win-win outcomes.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-US AI cooperation
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world does not wish to see an 'AI Iron Curtain' or 'AI enclosures'. Ensuring that AI is for good and benefits all humanity is the greatest common interest shared by China and the United States in the field of AI. It is hoped that the US will move toward China, strengthen dialogue, manage competition, and carry out cooperation, so that AI can become a new frontier of China-US cooperation and a new ladder for human progress.

statements.speaker: Li Lecheng
statements.speaker_title: Minister of Industry and Information Technology
statements.context: Article on theory page discussing future industries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Major developed countries have successively elevated the cultivation of future industries to the level of national strategy. The US has incorporated future industries into its legal framework, while the EU has clarified key deployment directions, attempting to lock in advantages during the formation of new technological systems. Facing important historical opportunities and severe external challenges, we must seize the initiative and gain the upper hand.

statements.speaker: Li Lecheng
statements.speaker_title: Minister of Industry and Information Technology
statements.context: Article on theory page discussing future industries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Strategic competition among the world's major economies surrounding future industries is becoming increasingly intense. Through measures such as increasing R&D investment to break through frontier technology barriers, optimizing visa policies and introducing incentive programs to attract top talent worldwide, and actively embedding one's own technological pathways into international standards systems, countries are driving escalating competition in technological innovation, talent acquisition, and leadership over standards.

article_title: Xi's 6-Point Agenda for China's Science & Technology Advancement

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at joint national science and technology award conference, general assemblies of Chinese Academy of Sciences and Chinese Academy of Engineering, and 11th national congress of China Association for Science and Technology
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must accelerate the advance of high-level scientific and technological self-reliance and self-strengthening, march firmly toward the goal of building China into a science and technology power by 2035, and solidly support and lead Chinese-style modernisation with scientific and technological innovation. Scientific and technological strength and innovation capacity are increasingly becoming the core competitiveness of nations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at joint national science and technology award conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Focusing on frontier fields such as AI, quantum technology, and life sciences; key fields such as integrated circuits and advanced manufacturing; and strategic domains such as the deep sea, deep space, and deep earth, we must make integrated arrangements for major engineering programs and major projects, while coordinating the advancement of original innovation and research on key core technologies.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at joint national science and technology award conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must strengthen the independent, self-reliant guarantee of basic supporting conditions such as high-end scientific instruments, scientific data, and scientific journals.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at joint national science and technology award conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must seize the window of opportunity in global talent flows and actively recruit outstanding young talent and teams from overseas.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at joint national science and technology award conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Frontier technologies such as AI are accelerating in their iteration and application, and the 'double-edged sword' effect is becoming increasingly apparent. We must coordinate development and security as a whole, closely track the development trends of new technologies and new applications, strengthen the building of the science and technology governance system and governance capacity, and ensure that science and technology move upward and toward the good, remain safe and controllable.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: President of the People's Republic of China
statements.context: Speech at joint national science and technology award conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must participate deeply in global science and technology governance, broadly publicize China's propositions and China's solutions, and enhance our discourse power and influence in the making of international rules.

statements.speaker: Cai Qi
statements.speaker_title: Senior Party Official (member of Politburo Standing Committee)
statements.context: Address at second plenary session of 11th national congress of China Association for Science and Technology
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing a complex and turbulent development environment, China needs the leading strategic support of science and technology more than at any time in the past, needs to bring fully into play the role of talent as the first resource more than at any time in the past, and needs to strengthen innovation as the first driving force more than at any time in the past.

statements.speaker: Cai Qi
statements.speaker_title: Senior Party Official (member of Politburo Standing Committee)
statements.context: Address at second plenary session of 11th national congress of China Association for Science and Technology
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Focus on strategically contested fields that must be fought for and on the weak links of industrial chains and supply chains, strengthen cross-field and cross-disciplinary coordination, and fight well the battle of storming key core technologies.

statements.speaker: Cai Qi
statements.speaker_title: Senior Party Official (member of Politburo Standing Committee)
statements.context: Address at second plenary session of 11th national congress of China Association for Science and Technology
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Coordinate development and security as a whole, maintain strategic clarity, establish bottom-line thinking, strengthen risk consciousness, carry forward the spirit of struggle, actively foster a fair and just environment for development, and resolutely safeguard national interests and science and technology security.

statements.speaker: Cai Qi
statements.speaker_title: Senior Party Official (member of Politburo Standing Committee)
statements.context: Address at second plenary session of 11th national congress of China Association for Science and Technology
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Deepen international exchanges in science, technology, and the humanities, proactively integrate into global innovation networks, widely publicize China's scientific and technological achievements, promote platforms for openness and cooperation, actively participate in the development of international scientific and technological organizations, and contribute Chinese proposals and Chinese wisdom to global governance in science and technology, using the power of science and technology to help build a community with a shared future for mankind.

article_title: Flood Situation Grave & Complex - Outcomes of Wang's Visit to Nordic Countries - Zhong Sheng's Take on China-EU Trade & Investment Dialogue

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Official readout from visit to Nordic countries (Denmark, Sweden, Finland, Norway)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Europe are partners, not rivals, and cooperation is the fundamental character and keynote of the relationship. Both sides support strengthened all-round China-EU dialogue at all levels.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Official readout from visit to Nordic countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Economic and trade cooperation is the ballast of bilateral relations; deepening cooperation is not optional but essential. Both sides firmly support free trade and economic globalization, and oppose unilateral actions and 'decoupling and breaking supply chains.'

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Official readout from visit to Nordic countries
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side reaffirmed that China never deliberately pursues a trade surplus, and expressed the hope that the EU will remain open, avoid restrictive legislative measures, relax exports of high-value products to China, and promote an upward rebalancing of China-EU trade.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation mechanism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: For some time now, protectionist currents have been rising within the EU. Certain politicians have persistently hyped false narratives such as 'China-EU trade imbalance', 'overcapacity', and 'unfair competition', concocted erroneous narratives like 'China Shock 2.0', and rolled out one restrictive trade measure after another, erecting obstacles to normal China-EU economic and trade cooperation.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation mechanism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At root, the European side suffers both from cognitive bias regarding the China-EU economic relationship and from an exposed sense of helplessness about its own structural contradictions. The EU deliberately evades the fact of its services trade surplus with China of US$48.3 billion in 2025.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation mechanism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Using protectionist barriers to avoid competition is like drinking poison to quench thirst; it will only allow structural problems to fester beyond remedy, ultimately harming the welfare of European consumers and Europe's long-term development potential.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation mechanism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is not the source of the problems the EU faces, but a partner in solving them. All along, China has been willing to resolve differences through dialogue with the utmost sincerity, while also resolutely defending its own legitimate industrial and trade rights and interests.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng (People's Daily commentary)
statements.context: People's Daily commentary on China-EU Trade and Investment Consultation mechanism
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As two major global forces and two major markets, the stability of China-EU economic and trade relations carries global significance. At present, unilateralism and protectionism continue to batter the international economic and trade order, and WTO reform is at a critical juncture.

article_title: Cai Cuihong on the Nature & Harms of America's Digital Hegemony

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Digital hegemony refers to a small number of countries, principally the United States as the first-mover in digital technology, relying on comprehensive advantages in key technologies, platform ecosystems, data resources, and institutional rules to transform digital capabilities into a systemic force for dominating the global order. American digital technology outwardly proclaims freedom, openness, and innovation, but in essence serves to maintain technological monopoly, seize economic benefits, consolidate dominance over rule-making, and expand strategic influence.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States suppresses global competitors through dual technological and legal controls, designating competitors like Huawei as national security threats, controlling exports of advanced chips to China, and pushing allies to restrict exports of advanced equipment. It also brings normal commercial trade under unilateral American licensing and review frameworks, and extends sanctions to third-party entities through legislation and enforcement mechanisms.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States manipulates the distribution of global digital economy gains through platform ecosystem monopoly, controlling key links such as app stores, search engines, social media, cloud services, and AI interfaces. Digital gains that ought to be shared globally are largely retained within the American platform system, with high value-added gains concentrated in American digital capital.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Through digital communication operations, the United States dominates overseas public opinion by posing as local users, impersonating civil society organizations, and manufacturing expressions of public opinion. It leverages coordinated operations across multiple platforms and networks of accounts to influence information spread in particular regions and groups, transforming digital communication capabilities into instruments for shaping public perceptions and intervening in other countries' public opinion.
statements.topic: information warfare, public opinion, influence operations

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States strengthens geo-security intervention through commercial digital capabilities. The Starlink commercial satellite system has undertaken functions of front-line communications, intelligence transmission, and combat support in regional conflicts, becoming a vehicle for overseas military intervention. Google and Amazon provide cloud computing and AI technical support to the Israeli government and security departments through Project Nimbus, with services involving military and security use scenarios.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: American digital hegemony erodes other countries' digital sovereignty by using open markets, free flows, and security reviews as pretexts to exert pressure on countries, making it difficult for them to make decisions aligned with their own interests regarding digital market opening, data flow arrangements, platform regulatory approaches, and support for domestic industries. Once American platforms and digital facilities are deeply embedded in other countries' economic and social operations, they influence key links such as data storage and system updates, thereby weakening these countries' actual capacity for control and governance.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: American digital hegemony widens the digital development divide through three mechanisms: first, pathways for technological catch-up are artificially obstructed through export controls, investment reviews, supply chain restrictions, and standards barriers, continuously delaying technological catch-up by late-developing countries and magnifying their existing disadvantages. Second, the mechanism through which digital revenues flow back is continuously distorted, with commercial returns flowing toward American platforms while developing countries struggle to convert their data resources and market scale into domestic development dividends. Third, channels for moving up the value chain are continuously compressed, confining developing countries to low value-added positions.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: American digital hegemony aggravates international security trust deficit through securitization of technological cooperation, institutionalizing security concerns through rules, and dividing digital relations into rival blocs. Chips, software, cloud services, data centers, communication systems, and AI models are endowed by the United States with strategic significance, causing normal technological exchanges and commercial dealings to be regarded as potential risks. Cross-border cooperation is increasingly subject to American security reviews and market-access restrictions.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: American digital hegemony distorts global digital governance by tilting the governance process toward the interests of a small number of developed countries. Issues such as AI safety and cross-border data enforcement are accorded priority, while developing countries' demands for participation in rule-making and capacity building struggle to enter the agenda. On key issues such as data flows, AI governance, and digital infrastructure, developing countries lack sufficient discursive power and occupy primarily the position of rule-takers.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: American digital hegemony has shaped Western values and narrative modes into the default standard in digital space. Non-Western countries' expressions of their own history, culture, and development paths often struggle to obtain opportunities for presentation equal to those afforded to Western narratives. The visibility, reach, and reception of non-Western content on global platforms is easily influenced by American platform rules, algorithmic rankings, and labeling mechanisms. Non-Western countries' governance experience and demands for digital sovereignty are often interpreted within Western discourse frameworks and even distorted and stigmatized.

statements.speaker: Cai Cuihong
statements.speaker_title: Professor at the Center for American Studies at Fudan University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi (CPC flagship journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The essence of American digital hegemony is to practice monopoly in the name of so-called freedom, and to seek the gains of global domination through technological superiority. The international community should be highly vigilant against its expansionist conduct. Breaking down digital hegemony requires defending digital sovereignty, promoting universal benefit and inclusiveness, adhering to open cooperation and opposing pan-securitization of digital issues, improving global governance, and advocating mutual learning among civilizations.

article_title: Takeaways from Xi's Speech at Party's 105th Anniversary - What does Xi want from County Secretaries? Wang Meets Saudi FM & UNSG Contenders - Politburo Warns of 'Extreme Weather' Challenges

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at ceremony marking 105th anniversary of CPC founding
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Party has stood on the right side of history and on the side of human civilization and progress, and through unceasing self-strengthening struggle has profoundly changed the trajectory and dynamics of the world. Today, the Party is leading people in advancing Chinese-style modernization, creating a new form of human civilization and broadening the path for developing countries to achieve modernization. Socialist China is widely recognized as a builder of world peace, a contributor to global development, and a defender of the international order.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at ceremony marking 105th anniversary of CPC founding
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development is now at a period in which strategic opportunities coexist with risks and challenges, and in which uncertain and unpredictable factors are increasing; we need to be prepared at all times to withstand major tests of high winds and rough waves, and even perilous storms. The whole Party must strengthen awareness of potential dangers, adhere to bottom-line thinking, carry forward the spirit of struggle, and enhance its ability to struggle; better coordinate the two overall situations of domestic and international affairs.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Speech at ceremony marking 105th anniversary of CPC founding
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We must conform to the aspirations of the people and the trend of the times, hold high the banner of peace, development, cooperation, and win-win outcomes, promote the common values of all humanity, advance the building of a new type of international relations, and push forward the implementation of the Global Development Initiative, the Global Security Initiative, the Global Civilization Initiative, and the Global Governance Initiative, injecting more positive energy into world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UN Secretary-General candidates Macky Sall and Maria Fernanda Espinosa
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is an indispensable major force on the international stage. China has always been a steadfast supporter of the cause of the United Nations and of multilateralism. The four global initiatives proposed by President Xi Jinping are intended to honour China's commitment to safeguarding multilateralism through concrete actions, promote the UN's better adaptation to the needs of the times, and enable it to continue developing and growing stronger through reform and change.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Saudi Foreign Minister Faisal bin Farhan Al-Saud
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes the opening of negotiations between the United States and Iran. The facts have proven time and again that one cannot obtain peace and tranquility by trading blows with fists; only by upholding morality and justice can lasting peace and stability be preserved. The current ceasefire situation remains fragile, but talking is always better than continuing to fight, and dialogue is always better than confrontation.

article_title: China-Bangladesh Ties Upgraded - More PLA Generals Sacked - 3rd Round of Goods Trade-in Bonds Issued - Ding Visits Xinjiang - Audit Finds Diversion of Rural Revitalisation Funds

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman; official readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China supports Bangladesh in upholding national independence, sovereignty and territorial integrity and rejecting foreign interference. China will work with Bangladesh to increase exchanges of governance experience, enhance ties at all levels, deepen strategic communication, strengthen political mutual trust, and continue to support each other on issues concerning core interests and major concerns.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Bangladesh PM Tarique Rahman; official readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China adheres to the policy of fostering an amicable, secure and prosperous neighborhood and will continue to provide neighboring countries with new opportunities and fresh dynamism. China will strengthen communication and coordination with Bangladesh within multilateral frameworks including the U.N. to jointly promote an equal and orderly multipolar world and a universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Cambodian People's Party President Hun Sen; official readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international and regional situation is currently undergoing complex and profound changes. China and Cambodia should join hands to demonstrate a sense of responsibility amid the changing landscape and to hold to the right path amid the turbulence, injecting greater stability into regional peace and development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Cambodian People's Party President Hun Sen; official readout
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Cambodia's steadfast adherence to the One-China principle and its support for the major concepts and initiatives proposed by China. China is willing to strengthen coordination and cooperation with Cambodia to better safeguard the fundamental state of good-neighbourly friendship in the region.

statements.speaker: Jia Guide
statements.speaker_title: China's Permanent Representative to the UN Office at Geneva and Other International Organizations in Switzerland
statements.context: Joint statement on behalf of 20 countries at the UNHRC
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The statement sought to expose and condemn the hegemonic practice of unilateral tariff under the pretext of 'forced labour'. The arbitrary imposition of tariff under the guise of so-called anti-forced labour measures will only infringe upon the right to development and the right to decent work. We urge relevant countries to respect facts, refrain from politicizing trade issues and weaponizing human rights, uphold the international economic and trading order.

article_title: Xi's Shandong Visit - Li's 'China Opportunity 2.0' Pitch in Dalian - Wang-Dar Call on US-Iran Talks - Breakdown of New Measures for Industrial Chain & Supply Chain Security Investigation Work

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos in Dalian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China remains committed to opening up further. We have extended zero-tariff policies to 63 countries, stayed as the world's second-largest import market for 17 years running, and recorded an import growth of 20.5 percent in the first five months of this year, significantly higher than export growth. For China, integrated development with the world has never been an expediency, but a strategic decision.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos in Dalian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's innovation has been nurtured in an enabling environment...Chinese enterprises have endured operational pressures brought about by prolonged and costly R&D commitments. Some incurred heavy losses at certain stages, and others faced unfair external suppression. Yet none of them ever wavered in their commitment.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos in Dalian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's industrial competitiveness has not been created through subsidies; rather, it stems from the combined advantages of its complete industrial system, ultra-large-scale market, and sound innovation ecosystem. China's industrial subsidies strictly comply with WTO rules; they are fair and broadly beneficial, and China treats domestic and foreign-invested enterprises equally.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos in Dalian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: What these combined dividends generate for the world are greater opportunities and potential of development...Today, China's large open-source AI models have been downloaded by over 10 billion times globally in cumulative terms...These are proof enough that what China's technologies and products in emerging areas bring to the world are not shocks or threats, but opportunities and empowerment.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Speech at Summer Davos in Dalian
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Second, never before has innovation been so deeply interconnected, yet the barriers to collaboration are increasing. Collective efforts that cross disciplines and national borders have become the mainstream and necessity of innovation. Yet technological walls, barriers and blockades are also growing more pervasive.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Engagement with business executives at Summer Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In recent years, the international community has increasingly recognized that there are no winners in trade wars and tariff wars, and that more and more countries are more actively advancing economic and trade exchanges, returning to the right path of mutual benefit and win-win cooperation. No matter how the external environment changes, China will always follow the great historical trend of openness and cooperation.

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Engagement with business executives at Summer Davos
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The high-quality products exported by China constitute an important contribution to the world economy...We have never deliberately pursued a trade surplus. China has always shared its domestic market with the world and is willing to import more high-quality products from all countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with Pakistan's Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The peace process has only just begun, and there is still a long, even tortuous and arduous, road ahead. But the Chinese side will, as always, support Pakistan and like-minded countries in continuing to play a constructive role...We should harness technology for good and be more effective in advancing collective governance...Advanced technologies should serve as tools that benefit people across countries, rather than sources of chaos that undermine peace and stability.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Call with Pakistan's Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Middle East, including the Gulf region, should no longer serve as an arena for great power competition or a victim of geopolitics, and regional countries should uphold genuine strategic autonomy and firmly keep their future in their own hands.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Publication of Measures for Industrial Chain and Supply Chain Security Investigation Work
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Where a foreign state, region, or international organization, in violation of international law and the basic norms governing international relations, adopts discriminatory prohibitive measures, restrictive measures, or other similar measures against our country in the area of industrial chains and supply chains, or carries out or assists in carrying out acts that harm the security of our country's industrial chains and supply chains, the Ministry of Commerce may conduct an industrial chain and supply chain security investigation.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Publication of Measures for Industrial Chain and Supply Chain Security Investigation Work
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Based on investigation results, the Ministry of Commerce may, together with relevant departments, adopt measures against states, regions, and international organizations that implement or assist in implementing acts harming the security of China's industrial chains and supply chains, including prohibiting or restricting import and export of goods or technology, levying special fees, placing organizations and individuals on countermeasure lists under the Anti-Foreign Sanctions Law, and other necessary measures.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Announcement on export control violations of strategic mineral dual-use items
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Further optimizing the handling of reports on violations concerning strategic mineral dual-use items and enhancing law enforcement capabilities is a fundamental requirement for improving the country's export control system, as well as a normal measure to safeguard national security and interests. Giving play to the supervisory role of tip-offs regarding export control violations is a common international practice.

article_title: Li Focuses on Shipbuilding & Nuclear Power in Dalian - Ding's Message on Securing Industrial & Supply Chains - New Plan to Attract Foreign Investment

statements.speaker: Ding Xuexiang
statements.context: Remarks at the 4th China International Supply Chain Expo in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current world situation is complex and volatile, and the risk of fragmentation of industrial and supply chains is increasing. China effectively brings into play its advantages such as a complete industrial system and a super-large-scale market, strives to keep the arteries of the world economy unobstructed, and firmly safeguards the stable and smooth functioning of global industrial and supply chains. Four proposals: (1) Strengthen mutual trust - prevent the politicization, weaponization, and over-securitization of economic and trade issues, work hard to eliminate the interference of non-economic factors; (2) Strengthen trade connectivity - maintain true multilateralism, uphold the multilateral trading system with the WTO at its core, oppose practicing protectionism in the name of green and low-carbon development; (3) Strengthen integrated development - work in concert to promote deep integration of innovation chain with industrial and supply chains; (4) Strengthen resource sharing - maintain open connectivity and smooth operation of global energy markets, promote mutually beneficial cooperation and peaceful use of critical minerals.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official announcement on export controls
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has decided to add 10 American entities to the export control list in accordance with the nation's export control law and regulations on export control of dual-use items. The measure was taken following the wrongful act of the U.S. government to add more Chinese firms to a so-called company list linked to Chinese military. Export operators are prohibited from exporting dual-use items to the 10 entities, which include Aveox Inc., Red Cat Holdings Inc., Teal Drones Inc., IMSAR, Jaia Robotics Inc., Ball Aerospace & Technologies Corp., Oshkosh Defense, L3Harris Maritime Services Inc., MP Materials Corp., and USA Rare Earth Inc. Organizations and individuals from any country or region are prohibited from transferring or providing dual-use items originating in China to these entities.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce
statements.context: Official announcement on government procurement restrictions
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has announced a notice prohibiting the purchase of products manufactured by 46 designated U.S. companies in government procurement. Procurement entities participating in government purchasing activities are barred from buying products made by the listed U.S. firms, including Lockheed Martin Corporation and Raytheon Missiles & Defense.

article_title: Yin Yanlin Explains What China Means by 'Investing in People' - Ding Chun Diagnoses Europe's Malaise

statements.speaker: Ding Chun
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Center for European Studies and Professor of the Institute of World Economics, Fudan University; Vice President of the Chinese Association for European Studies
statements.context: Article in Qiushi (party theoretical journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Recent US tariff increases on key industries such as automobiles, steel, and aluminum have significantly affected European exports, corporate profits, and economic growth. If tariff threats materialize, output losses in the German automobile industry will reach €15 billion in the short term and could be as high as €30 billion in the long term.

statements.speaker: Ding Chun
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Center for European Studies and Professor of the Institute of World Economics, Fudan University; Vice President of the Chinese Association for European Studies
statements.context: Article in Qiushi (party theoretical journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The external actor that seems to have any adverse impact on Europe's economic prospects is the United States. European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said in April that since the start of this US-Israel-Iran conflict, the EU's spending on imported fossil fuels has already increased by €22 billion.

statements.speaker: Ding Chun
statements.speaker_title: Director of the Center for European Studies and Professor of the Institute of World Economics, Fudan University; Vice President of the Chinese Association for European Studies
statements.context: Article in Qiushi (party theoretical journal)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: When confronted with pressure from US tariff increases, member states have found it difficult to formulate a unified approach regarding negotiating positions and the strength of countermeasures because of differences in industrial structure and trade dependence. As a result, the EU's bargaining power as a whole has been weakened.

statements.speaker: Vice President Han Zheng
