Facts have proven that force and power politics cannot solve problems, and that dialogue and negotiation are the correct choice. As a comprehensive strategic partner, China has always supported Iran's reasonable and legitimate propositions, supported Iran in safeguarding its own sovereignty and security. China stands ready to strengthen communication and coordination with Iran and, while consolidating and deepening China-Iran relations, to continue making contributions to safeguarding and promoting regional peace and stability.

article_title: State Council Discusses Functional Zoning Strategy - What is Xi Jinping Thought on Party Building? - Zhong Sheng Warning on Japan's Military-Industrial Complex - Nepal FM's Meets Wang Yi

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes the U.S. and Iran reaching agreement on the text of the memorandum of understanding for the first stage of negotiations and commends Pakistan's mediation efforts. We hope the document will be signed according to the agreed timetable and all relevant parties will stay committed to peaceful solutions and resolve issues through dialogue and negotiation. China stands ready to join the international community in playing an active role in restoring peace and tranquility to the Middle East and Gulf region at an early date.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We have noted that the text of the memorandum of understanding for the first stage of negotiations between Iran and the United States includes the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz. We hope the Strait will become safe again for free passage at an early date. China stands ready to maintain communication with regional countries and the international community on relevant issues.

statements.speaker: Lin Jian
statements.context: Regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the outbreak of the conflict, China has been working tirelessly for the end of fighting and for peace. President Xi Jinping made four propositions on safeguarding and promoting peace and stability in the Middle East, which embody China's consistent position and active efforts to promote peace, end hostilities, and advocate resolving disputes through dialogue. As a Chinese solution to end the conflict and realize peace, the propositions have played an important role in building global consensus and received broad recognition from regional countries and the international community. Guided by the spirit of the propositions and upholding fairness and justice, China, as a responsible major country, will continue to make our contribution to enabling lasting peace in the Middle East.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Meeting with US Representative Lou Correa in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The presidents of China and the United States agreed on a new vision of building a constructive bilateral relationship of strategic stability, providing strategic guidance for the next phase of China-U.S. relations. China is ready to work with the United States to fully and accurately implement the important common understandings reached by the two heads of state, strengthen dialogue and expand cooperation on the basis of mutual respect, peaceful coexistence and win-win cooperation, and strive to promote the healthy, stable, and sustainable development of bilateral economic and trade relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Reception for 25th anniversary of Shanghai Cooperation Organization
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is necessary to improve global governance. Practice true multilateralism, uphold the principle of extensive consultation, joint contribution, and shared benefits, safeguard the authority and role of the United Nations, and advocate an equal and ordered multipolar world and universally beneficial and inclusive economic globalization.

article_title: State Council Meeting on Budget Management, Tech, Education & Environment - What Protections do New Regulations offer Gig Workers? China Sanctions Philippine Defense Secretary

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on sanctions against Philippine Defense Secretary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Gilberto Teodoro Jr. repeatedly made irresponsible remarks on China, which undermines China's legitimate interests and sabotages China-Philippines relations. China has decided to prohibit him and his family from entering Chinese mainland, Hong Kong and Macao, and not allow organizations and individuals in China to engage in any transaction, cooperation or other activities with him.

article_title: Wang Xuedian: GCI Pursuing Pluralistic Co-existence in a World of Multiple Modernities

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article quoting Xi's statements on the Global Civilization Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should jointly advocate strengthening international people-to-people exchanges and cooperation, explore the building of a global civilizational dialogue and cooperation network, enrich the content of exchanges, expand channels of cooperation, promote mutual understanding and affinity among the peoples of all countries, and jointly advance the development and progress of human civilization.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article quoting Xi on the Global Civilization Initiative's purpose
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The purpose of putting forward the Global Civilization Initiative is to promote mutual understanding and affinity among the peoples of all countries, and to promote mutual tolerance and mutual learning among all civilizations.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Article quoting Xi on civilizational exchange and mutual learning
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Civilizational exchange and mutual learning is the inexhaustible driving force for advancing human civilizational progress and world peace and development.

statements.speaker: Wang Xuedian
statements.speaker_title: Dean of the Advanced Institute of Confucian Studies, Shandong University
statements.context: Academic article on the Global Civilization Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The 'end of history' theory was a product of Western-centrism. The 'clash of civilizations' theory is a false proposition; conflicts are not caused by different civilizations themselves but are largely geopolitical bloc conflicts that Western great powers have ideologized to maintain their interests.

statements.speaker: Wang Xuedian
statements.speaker_title: Dean of the Advanced Institute of Confucian Studies, Shandong University
statements.context: Academic article on the Global Civilization Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the Industrial Revolution, modern Western civilization, relying on its advantages in productive forces, achieved global expansion and imposed its own development model and value standards upon the world, causing the global governance system to be deeply imprinted with 'Western-centrism'. This exposed the hegemonic logic of treating civilization's temporal attribute in an absolutized manner and using it to suppress or negate the spatial attributes of other civilizations.
statements.topic: Western dominance, development models, global governance

statements.speaker: Wang Xuedian
statements.speaker_title: Dean of the Advanced Institute of Confucian Studies, Shandong University
statements.context: Academic article on the Global Civilization Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Global Civilization Initiative resolutely opposes using the temporal attribute as a pretext to negate or suppress civilization's spatial attribute, and advocates that all countries must advance modernization on the basis of inheriting their own civilizational characteristics and holding firm to their cultural subjectivity.
statements.topic: civilizational diversity, global governance, Western dominance

statements.speaker: Wang Xuedian
statements.speaker_title: Dean of the Advanced Institute of Confucian Studies, Shandong University
statements.context: Academic article on the Global Civilization Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Global governance transformation should break the monopoly of great powers and drive the full absorption of the governance wisdom and practical experience of non-Western civilizations in the formulation of international rules and the setting of global agendas, making rule formulation more representative and balanced.
statements.topic: global governance, Western dominance, international rules

article_title: Xi's North Korea Visit - Three Gorges New Waterway Project - Wang Yi on Dialogue among Civilizations

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Visit to Pyongyang, remarks reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facing the profound changes unseen in a century that are accelerating across the world, the two sides should take a broad and long-term view and seize opportunities in the prevailing trend of human history. China and the DPRK should strengthen strategic coordination and cooperation, resolutely defend their respective sovereignty, security, and development interests, and jointly safeguard regional peace and development.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Visit to Pyongyang, remarks reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: I have put forward the concept of building a community with a shared future for mankind and the four major global initiatives, hoping to promote the development of global governance in a more just and reasonable direction, which has received broad support and positive responses from the international community including the DPRK side.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Remarks at event marking International Day for Dialogue among Civilizations, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Human civilization development currently faces unprecedented challenges, divisions and confrontation are intensifying, turbulence and conflict are recurring, international rule of law is being eroded, and trust deficits are deepening. We must transcend narrow theories of 'civilizational superiority' and 'clash of civilizations'. China persists in high-level opening up and is willing to strengthen civilizational dialogue with all countries, deepen exchanges of experience in state governance, jointly crack the difficult problems of the era, and work together to broaden the path of world modernization.
statements.framing: accusatory of Western approaches; constructive alternative positioning

article_title: Wu Zhicheng & Dong Zuozhuang on Impact of Current Conflicts on Evolution of World Order

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Hegemonic states using force to defend vested interests is an important root cause of frequent international conflict. The United States' share of global GDP has fallen from about 40% in 1960 to about 25% in 2023. This has intensified the United States' strategic anxiety over global power, international status, and national security. To prevent the erosion of its hegemonic position, the United States has increasingly relied on its military superiority to threaten and coerce other countries and launch military strikes.

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Deflecting domestic contradictions through foreign military adventurism is an important driver of frequent international conflict. Mounting domestic debt in the United States has aggravated pressures on people's livelihoods; political polarization has caused unending vicious partisan strife; and the public has come to harbour serious doubts about systems such as the country's party politics. This has led the US government to deliberately manufacture and amplify the threat posed by existing adversarial targets, while some politicians seek to reap political capital and public support by provoking international conflicts.
statements.topic: US domestic crisis and external conflict

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States, as one of the permanent members of the UN Security Council, ought to take the lead in upholding the UN-centered international security architecture; yet in recent years, it has gradually degenerated into a wrecker of international rules and a manufacturer of international conflict. When multilateral mechanisms accord with its strategic interests, the United States holds high the banner of international rules and collective security; but once mechanisms such as the UN Security Council constrain its room for action, it chooses to bypass authorization, resort to unilateral use of force, impose sanctions indiscriminately, exercise 'long-arm jurisdiction', and even use its veto power and alliance system to obstruct multilateral mechanisms from functioning.
statements.topic: US violation of international law and UN authority

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: International conflicts in recent years show that automated weapons, remote operation, and AI-assisted decision-making are turning the killing process of conflict into something gamified or data-driven, transforming the use of force from a 'last resort' into a 'tool of first choice' and making it easier for decision-makers to launch conflicts rashly. The development of new technologies has also altered the cost-benefit structure of international conflict, leading some countries to believe that, by virtue of their advantage in high and new technologies, they can achieve a 'quick in, quick out' through unilateral suppression and rapid surprise strikes.

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The widespread application of AI, big data, and algorithmic systems has accelerated the speed of conflict decision-making and conflict evolution, while also narrowing the window for crisis management. Some stages that previously relied on human participation are gradually being replaced by intelligent warfare systems. For example, on the first day of the US-Israel-Iran conflict, the US military used the Project Maven intelligent system to strike more than 1,000 targets, achieving an efficiency 10 times greater than that of traditional strike operations.
statements.topic: US AI-driven military operations and crisis escalation

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some countries are exploiting localized conflicts to undermine international rules, erode strategic mutual trust, and promote bloc confrontation, thereby continuously weakening the foundations of stability in the international order. If allowed to continue unchecked, this will have incalculably serious consequences for the existing international system.

statements.speaker: Wu Zhicheng and Dong Zuozhuang
statements.speaker_title: Scholars affiliated with Institute of International Strategic Studies, Central Party School and Zhou Enlai School of Government, Nankai University
statements.context: Article published in Qiushi journal
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The increasing frequency of international conflicts has already demonstrated that hegemonic actions which bypass the UN framework and disregard the Security Council's lawful authorization seriously undermine strategic mutual trust among states, intensify regional instability, and widen the global security deficit.
statements.topic: US unilateralism and violation of UN authority

article_title: Xi Pushes AI Agenda with Establishment of WAICO - Wang Meets Pak FM - SAMR's Luo Wen on Tackling 'Involution-style' Competition

statements.context: Keynote speech at 2026 World AI Conference in Shanghai

We should ensure that AI is an important driver for shared prosperity and common security. We should join hands to build a just and equitable system for global AI governance. AI should be a trusted tool for humanity. We should jointly oppose overstretching the national security concept in the field of AI, or placing one's own security over that of others.
statements.framing: constructive, critical of Western security approaches

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Keynote speech at 2026 World AI Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: To further support global AI development and to advance global AI capacity building, China will provide developing countries with 5,000 opportunities in AI training and seminar programmes in the next five years. China will develop international AI application cooperation centres with ASEAN, the League of Arab States, the African Union, the Community of Latin American and Caribbean States, the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, and BRICS. We will enable 30 countries to use the AI-powered meteorological warning system.
statements.topic: AI development, Global South cooperation, technology transfer
statements.framing: constructive, positioning China as supporter of developing nations

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Keynote speech at 2026 World AI Conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should adhere to the principle of openness and win-win, and boost innovation-driven development...We should encourage open source, openness, collaboration, and sharing. We should jointly oppose overstretching the national security concept in the field of AI, or placing one's own security over that of others.

statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As a responsible major country, China, together with like-minded partners, has promoted the establishment of the WAICO with the aim of building international consensus, advancing practical cooperation, strengthening capacity building, and ensuring that all countries, especially those of the Global South, benefit equally from the wave of intelligent technologies, while preventing the emergence of a global AI divide.
statements.topic: AI governance, technology, Global South cooperation
statements.framing: constructive, positioning China as responsible actor addressing global inequality

statements.speaker: Chinese Ambassador Wang Xiaolong
statements.context: Statement in response to New Zealand signing joint statement on South China Sea arbitration award
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has never chosen to hurt the interests of New Zealand in the past. Nor is it our intention to do so in the future. However, it takes two to tango. No one should underestimate our resolve and capability to defend our legitimate rights and interests. We urge the New Zealand side to cease immediately violating China's interests and return to the path of promoting bilateral relationship development on the basis of mutual respect and mutual benefit, and resolving disputes through constructive dialogues, with a view to avoiding further damage to the relationship.

statements.speaker: Han Zheng
statements.context: Meeting with former New Zealand Prime Minister John Key in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates Mr. Key's significant contributions to China-New Zealand relations. The comprehensive strategic partnership has entered its second decade with broader prospects. China is willing to work with New Zealand to implement important consensus reached by leaders, expand and deepen exchanges and cooperation in various fields, and promote continuous development of bilateral relations. China's development provides positive energy and certainty to the world, and China will continue efforts in promoting peace, stability, development and prosperity in the Pacific region.

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: Commentary by Huan Yu Ping (Page 3)
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Criticism of joint statement by the US and its partners on the South China Sea arbitration award. The piece criticises the US and its partners for talking about peaceful resolution while practicing 'gunboat diplomacy'; practicing unilateralism and engaging in bullying; talking about 'upholding the rule of law' while engaging in the practice of 'double standards.'

article_title: Li Meets Experts & Entrepreneurs on Economy - 15th FYP on Consumption - Overseas Chinese Must Keep in Mind 'Roots', 'Soul', & 'Dream' - Zhong Sheng on SCS Award Controversy

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The so-called 'South China Sea arbitration case' was fundamentally a piece of political manipulation driven by geopolitical self-interest, aimed at disrupting the situation in the South China Sea at the expense of regional peace, stability, and the well-being of its peoples.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The South China Sea is not a 'hunting ground' for extra-regional countries, and still less should it become an 'arena' for great-power rivalry. The United States, Japan, Australia, and other countries, as well as the European Union, are not parties to South China Sea disputes and should in principle maintain an objective and neutral stance on South China Sea sovereignty issues. Instead, driven by geopolitical self-interest, they have repeatedly endorsed and lent support to the illegal and invalid so-called 'award'.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: These extra-regional countries are cobbling together exclusionary small cliques in the South China Sea, engaging in confrontation under the guise of 'cooperation', flexing military muscle in the name of 'freedom', and sowing regional disorder in the name of 'order'. They deliberately inflame regional tensions, encourage and condone the Philippines' provocative rights-infringing actions, and seek to drive wedges between countries in the region.

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some extra-regional countries have a track record of troublemaking. The various major international crises they have fomented in the Middle East, Europe, and elsewhere have yet to subside, with turmoil and division still unfolding. Now these same countries are seeking to repeat their playbook and redirect the flames of conflict toward the South China Sea, with their intent to destabilize China and sow chaos is unmistakable. The United States has to this day not ratified the UNCLOS, yet it habitually appoints itself as 'judge', arbitrarily condemning and crudely interfering in other countries' legitimate and lawful maritime activities, exposing both its hegemonic logic and its hypocrisy.
statements.topic: South China Sea, US foreign policy

statements.speaker: Zhong Sheng
statements.context: Opinion article in People's Daily, Page 3
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: During WWII, Japan committed grave crimes in China, including the illegal occupation of China's South China Sea islands and reefs, inflicting profound suffering upon China and the Chinese people. Rather than engage in honest self-reflection, Japan now seeks to intervene in the South China Sea again under the banner of being a so-called 'stakeholder', a move that can only remind the world of Japan's history of external aggression and expansion and heighten vigilance toward its alleged ambitions for 'remilitarization'.

article_title: China-Namibia Ties Focus on Minerals Cooperation - Sparring Over SCS Arbitration Anniversary

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on South China Sea Arbitration Award 10th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has sovereignty over the South China Sea Islands and historic rights in the South China Sea. The U.S. and other external countries have been persistently reinforcing military presence in the South China Sea, throwing their weight around and fanning the flames. These acts of militarization and coercion constitute the primary challenge to the current situation. The so-called 'award' is nothing but a worthless piece of paper that is illegal, null and void, and has no binding force.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official statement on South China Sea Arbitration Award 10th anniversary
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China urges the relevant countries to earnestly respect China's territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests in the South China Sea, stop stirring up trouble over the South China Sea issue, and cease undermining peace and stability in the South China Sea.

statements.speaker: Department of Asian Affairs, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
statements.context: Official summons to Japanese Embassy chief minister; reported by Xinhua
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan bears historical responsibilities on the South China Sea issue and has never reckoned with them, thus it is in no position to pass judgment. Japan's egregious words and deeds challenge the postwar international order and the international rule of law. By applying double standards and stirring up troubles, Japan undermines peace and stability in the South China Sea. China will resolutely and forcefully counter Japan's provocation and firmly safeguard its territorial sovereignty and maritime rights and interests.
statements.topic: South China Sea; Japan's alignment with US-led position

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with Namibian President; People's Daily reporting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Chinese modernization has broken the myth that 'modernization equals Westernization'. It represents a new vision distinct from the Western model of modernization and demonstrates to the world that human civilization continues to evolve and that history has not come to an end.
statements.topic: modernization; implicit contrast with Western/US model

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with DPRK Premier Pak Thae Song; People's Daily reporting
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The current international landscape is fraught with changes and turbulence. Both China and the DPRK should maintain firm strategic resolve, enhance strategic confidence, and strengthen strategic coordination, resolutely defend our respective sovereignty, security and development interests, and create a favorable external environment for both countries to achieve further progress.
statements.topic: diplomacy; strategic coordination against external pressures

statements.speaker: People's Daily
statements.context: News article in May 3, 2021 edition
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Some developed countries have artificially created an 'immune gap' by hoarding vaccines and imposing export controls... The international community has generally called for jointly resisting 'vaccine nationalism'

article_title: Li Meets with Visiting Leaders in Dalian - Wang Yi's BRICS Engagements in Delhi - Make Biomedicine 'Emerging Pillar Industry'; Foster Brain-computer Interface Tech as Future Industry

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Iranian Deputy Secretary of Supreme National Security Council Qadir Nizamipour at BRICS NSA meetings in Delhi
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China welcomes follow-up consultations between Iran and the United States based on the MoU signed between the two countries. The core provisions calling for cessation of hostilities, refraining from use or threat of force, mutual respect for sovereignty and non-interference in internal affairs embody equality and align with UN Charter. Effectively maintaining and implementing the MoU will help consolidate the ceasefire and bring peace to the Middle East.
statements.topic: diplomacy, Middle East conflict, Iran-US relations

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UAE's Ali Mohammed Hammed Al Shamsi at BRICS NSA meetings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the outbreak of the US-Israel-Iran war, China and UAE have maintained close communication. The war should never have happened and ought to be ended as soon as possible. Three key priorities: (1) persist in permanent and comprehensive ceasefire and implement the MoU; (2) restore normal navigation through Strait of Hormuz; (3) rebuild mutual trust among regional countries and explore new regional security architecture. The Middle East should not become an arena for major-power rivalry or victim of geopolitics.
statements.topic: diplomacy, Middle East conflict, regional security
statements.framing: constructive, opposes great-power competition in the region

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Egyptian official Youssef Alaa El-Deen at BRICS NSA meetings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has always maintained that regional hotspots and divergences should be resolved through dialogue and negotiation, and opposed the use or threat of force. The MoU signed between US and Iran, which commits both sides to respect sovereignty, refrain from military operations and avoid interfering in internal affairs, sends a positive signal and should be jointly upheld. Now that the door to peace has been opened, it must not be closed again.
statements.topic: diplomacy, Middle East conflict, international law
statements.framing: constructive, emphasizes international rules and peaceful resolution

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Separate readout on lessons from West Asia war at BRICS meetings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Four key lessons: (1) Importance of safeguarding international rules—any resolution should be premised on compliance with international rules; the law of the jungle may prevail temporarily but is not sustainable. (2) Importance of respecting national sovereignty—territorial integrity must not be violated, internal affairs must not be interfered in. (3) Importance of new security concept—countries increasingly form a community with shared destiny; seeking absolute security at expense of others' security will backfire. (4) Importance of grasping new forms of warfare—information and cyber warfare increasingly manifested.
statements.framing: defensive of international order, implicitly critical of US-led interventionism

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS NSA meeting remarks on counter-terrorism and cybersecurity
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The world is witnessing a new wave of international terrorist activities; root cause lies in unilateralist actions that have intensified conflicts. BRICS countries should address both symptoms and root causes, strengthen counter-terrorism cooperation, deepen intelligence sharing and operational coordination. On cybersecurity: emerging technologies like AI are reshaping cyberspace; BRICS should jointly uphold international rules for cyberspace, oppose artificial creation of division and confrontation, promote UN Convention against Cybercrime, and participate in International Alliance to Combat Telecom and Online Fraud.
statements.framing: accusatory toward unilateralism; defensive of international order

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Broader BRICS meeting statement
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: BRICS cooperation has increasingly become a backbone force for safeguarding peace, promoting development, and upholding justice. Four key priorities: (1) Uphold international order through BRICS responsibility—hold high banner of multilateralism, firmly safeguard UN Charter purposes and principles, clearly oppose unilateralism and protectionism. (2) Resolve security dilemmas through BRICS consensus—advocate common, comprehensive, cooperative, sustainable security concept, firmly promote political solutions to hotspot issues. (3) Respond to global challenges through BRICS action—resolutely combat all forms of terrorism, clearly oppose militarization of outer space. (4) Improve governance of emerging domains—closely guard against AI risks, regulate AI development direction, support advancing global cyberspace and digital governance through UN as main channel.
statements.framing: assertive opposition to unilateralism and US-led order; constructs alternative multilateral framework

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: BRICS meeting closing remarks
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will assume BRICS rotating chairmanship next year and is willing to work with BRICS partners to actively implement the four global initiatives proposed by President Xi Jinping: promoting prosperity through development, maintaining stability through security, increasing mutual trust through civilization, and pursuing justice through governance.
statements.topic: multilateralism, global governance, China's international role
statements.framing: assertive positioning of China as alternative leader

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Russian Security Council Secretary Sergei Shoigu at BRICS NSA meetings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China is willing to work together with Russia to implement important consensus reached by two heads of state, continuously strengthen all-round China-Russia strategic coordination, promote accelerated development and rejuvenation of both countries, and make contributions to cause of peace and development for humanity. BRICS is important platform for international community to practice multilateralism, safeguard fairness and justice, and promote peace and security. China and Russia should strengthen coordination and cooperation, promote continuous strengthening and expansion of BRICS mechanism, and truly make it the foremost formation of the Global South.
statements.framing: cooperative, emphasizes strategic coordination against unilateral order

statements.speaker: Sergei Shoigu
statements.context: Meeting with Wang Yi at BRICS NSA meetings
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In face of profound changes unseen in a century, Russia and China should deepen mutual trust, carry out close cooperation, jointly resist various forms of interference and infiltration by external forces in security field, and oppose Japan's attempts at 'remilitarization'. Russia stands ready to work with China to continually enhance strategic coordination within multilateral mechanisms such as BRICS, and to jointly safeguard peace and stability of region and world.
statements.framing: accusatory toward external interference; cooperative on China-Russia alignment

article_title: Xi Meets Min Aung Hlaing - US-Iran MoU 'Far from an End Point, but a New Starting Point' - NDRC's Vision for China's Service Sector Development - Why New Officials Must Settle Old Accounts

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting readout with Myanmar's President Min Aung Hlaing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In the face of the fluid and turbulent international landscape, China and Myanmar need to stay strategically clear-headed and focused, and enhance solidarity and coordination

statements.speaker: Li Qiang
statements.context: Meeting with Myanmar's President Min Aung Hlaing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present the international situation is complex and turbulent. China and Myanmar should strengthen close coordination and cooperation within multilateral frameworks such as the United Nations, the Lancang-Mekong Cooperation, and the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation, safeguard the common interests of developing countries, and promote the building of a more just and reasonable global governance system

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with UN Secretary-General candidate Rebeca Grynspan in Beijing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has consistently been a supporter and builder of the UN cause. As a responsible major country and a permanent member of the UN Security Council, China will participate in the selection of the next UN secretary-general in a constructive manner. China stands ready to work with all parties to safeguard, revitalize and strengthen the United Nations

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Pakistan's Foreign Minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the outbreak of the war, China has engaged with all parties and actively promoted a ceasefire and peace talks. From the very beginning, China has firmly supported Pakistan and emphasized to all parties that Pakistan is a trustworthy mediator. China has also engaged separately with Iran and the United States in its own way

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Phone call with Pakistan's Foreign Minister Mohammad Ishaq Dar
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The international community should further support the Iran-US talks, and multilateral institutions, including the United Nations Security Council, should also play a greater role. China has consistently advocated that regional countries should take their future and destiny into their own hands

article_title: Focus on Basic Education - Wang Huning Visits Tibet - Cai Qi Meets Heads of Party Schools - What Was Wang Yi's Message in Manila? - Lan Fo'an Discusses Policies to Expand Demand

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: This year marks a pivotal moment for China-U.S. relations. The two heads of state successfully held a historic meeting in Beijing, establishing the positioning of building a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability. Our responsibility is to follow the course set by the two heads of state, eliminate interference, overcome obstacles, and ensure that the consensus reached by the leaders is translated into consensus and action across the entire governments and in all fields. Through strategic stability between China and the U.S., we should promote world peace and tranquility.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang Yi elaborated China's solemn position regarding a series of recent negative words and actions by the U.S. side, calling on the U.S. to respect China's core interests, abide by the One-China principle, effectively manage contradictions and differences, address China's legitimate concerns, and turn this year of opportunity in China–U.S. relations into reality.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Philippine Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Facts have proven that allowing external forces to meddle in regional affairs and deliberately hyping up maritime disputes will only reduce the Philippines to a pawn manipulated by others. Any attempt at provocation backed by external countries will ultimately leave the Philippines bearing the bitter consequences of its own making.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Philippine Foreign Affairs Secretary Ma. Theresa Lazaro in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Philippines abandoned bilateral negotiation mechanisms, assembled an ad hoc 'arbitral tribunal' urged by extraterritorial forces, and manufactured and hyped up the so-called award, which is illegal and void. China has never accepted, participated, or recognized this 'award' from the very outset.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-ASEAN foreign ministers meeting in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: First, safeguard the regional environment for peace and development. Taking the 50th anniversary of the Treaty of Amity and Cooperation in Southeast Asia as an opportunity, both sides should carry forward the Asian values of peace, cooperation, openness, and inclusiveness; firmly oppose unreasonable interference by external forces; resist the creation of exclusive 'small circles'; reject the incitement of bloc confrontation; and never allow militarism to make a comeback.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: China-ASEAN foreign ministers meeting in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Wang Yi elaborated China's principled position on the South China Sea. The South China Sea is our common home. China and ASEAN countries have the wisdom and capability to continue handling South China Sea issues properly, ensuring that peace, stability, cooperation, and friendship remain the dominant narrative of the South China Sea. Regional countries should strictly abide by the Declaration on the Conduct of Parties in the South China Sea (DOC) while resisting attempts by external powers to fan the flames and opposing efforts by certain countries to stir up trouble over maritime issues. The leading role in safeguarding peace and stability in the South China Sea must be firmly kept in the hands of regional countries themselves.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Malaysian Foreign Minister Mohamad Hasan in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The early conclusion of consultations on the Code of Conduct in the South China Sea (COC) would help safeguard peace and stability in the region, keep the region's future in the hands of regional countries, and deny external actors any opportunity to meddle or cause disruption.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Canadian Foreign Minister in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Since the beginning of this year, China-Canada relations have continued to improve, with increasingly close exchanges at all levels and fruitful cooperation across various fields. Bilateral trade volume grew by 16 percent year-on-year in the first half of the year, with Canadian exports to China increasing by 23.3 percent. Canadian agricultural products such as canola and beef have returned to the Chinese market, and Chinese electric vehicles have entered the Canadian market. China is ready to work with Canada to implement the important common understandings reached by the leaders of the two countries, properly handle differences and sensitive issues, and continuously enrich the substance of the China-Canada new Strategic Partnership.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Papua New Guinea's Foreign Affairs Minister Justin Tkatchenko in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China appreciates PNG for closing the Taipei economic office, adding that the decision is another key measure by the PNG government to implement the one-China principle, and will further consolidate the political foundation of the relationship between China and PNG. It also provides a model for other countries to handle issues related to Taiwan institutions.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Meeting with Papua New Guinea's Foreign Affairs Minister Justin Tkatchenko in Manila
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's development of relations with Pacific island countries does not involve geopolitical games or seek a so-called sphere of influence. These countries have the right to independently choose their development partners and should not be interfered with by third parties.

article_title: 5th Plenum - Politburo Meets on Economy - How PLA has Evolved Under Xi - China Expresses 'Serious Concern' with US Economic Measures - China's Nukes 'Essential'; Japan's Nuke Ambitions a 'Red Line'

statements.speaker: Politburo/Party Central Committee
statements.context: Mid-year Politburo meeting readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As profound changes have taken place in the external environment, China's domestic circumstances, and the Party's own conditions, comprehensive and strict Party self-governance is also facing many new situations and new problems.

statements.speaker: Politburo/Party Central Committee
statements.context: Mid-year Politburo meeting readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The meeting held that, since the beginning of this year, the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping at its core has...effectively responding to various external shocks and internal difficulties. Our country's economy has exhibited a development trend in which growth momentum is shifting toward the new and the economic structure is shifting toward the better.

statements.speaker: Politburo/Party Central Committee
statements.context: Mid-year Politburo meeting readout published in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Expand the space for mutually beneficial international economic and trade cooperation, vigorously develop trade in services, and promote the balanced development of trade. Improve the system for the management of outbound investment and the comprehensive overseas service system, and actively attract and utilize foreign investment.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Symposium with non-CPC personages on economic work, July 24, 2026
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In carrying out economic work in the second half of the year, adhere to deepening reform and opening up, accelerate the transformation of old and new growth drivers, effectively implement a more proactive fiscal policy and a moderately accommodative monetary policy...increase efforts to expand domestic demand and optimize supply.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Symposium with non-CPC personages on economic work, July 24, 2026
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: At present, our country's economic performance also faces some difficulties and challenges...In the second half of the year, we must enhance the effectiveness of macro policy, focusing on...expanding high-standard opening up.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US tariffs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The Chinese side expressed serious concern over the recent economic and trade restrictions imposed by the United States on China. The US move was 'a typical act of unilateralism and protectionism, which China firmly opposes.' China has consistently opposed forced labor and has established a comprehensive labor law and regulatory framework. By contrast, the United States has yet to ratify the Forced Labour Convention, 1930, and has long manipulated the 'forced labor' issue.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US tariffs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: In China-U.S. economic and trade consultations, the United States made a clear commitment that any replacement additional tariffs on Chinese goods would not exceed 20 percent. Currently, the replacement additional tariffs imposed by the United States on Chinese goods stand at 12.5 percent. The United States should correct its wrong practices and fully remove the relevant unilateral tariff measures.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US tariffs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China will continue to closely monitor and conduct a full assessment of subsequent U.S. moves, and reserves the right to take all necessary measures. China is willing to continue dialogue and consultations with the United States on the basis of mutual respect, equality and mutual benefit.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US AI investigation threats
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China has slammed the US plan to investigate and threat to sanction Chinese artificial intelligence (AI) firms, stressing that such moves lack factual basis and legal justification. China has consistently opposed the US politicizing and weaponizing science, technology and trade issues, as well as smearing Chinese companies and imposing sanctions under various groundless pretexts.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US AI investigation threats
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The MOFCOM spokesperson further criticized the US side, which was disregarding facts such as the close release timelines of Chinese and US cutting-edge AI models and the progress made by some Chinese models, saying that it has groundlessly accused Chinese companies of relying on 'distillation' or 'stealing US intellectual property,' while threatening sanctions. These practices lack factual basis and legal justification, apply double standards in practice, and are typical acts of AI hegemony.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US FCC Covered List decision
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. side should immediately revoke these measures and end its erroneous practices. The FCC has, despite China's repeated representations and restrained approach, continued to introduce and escalate restrictive measures, seriously harming China's legitimate trade interests, undermining the stability of China-U.S. economic and trade relations, and disrupting the stability of global industrial and supply chains.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Commerce (MOFCOM)
statements.context: Spokesperson statement on US FCC Covered List decision
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The United States has overstretched the concept of national security and used administrative measures to interfere in normal commercial transactions and trade activities. The pursuit of 'decoupling and supply chain disruption' constitutes a typical case of market distortion and unilateral bullying. If the United States insists on moving ahead, China will take resolute countermeasures to safeguard its legitimate rights and interests.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Call with USTR Jamieson Greer and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, readout from People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides held candid, in-depth and constructive exchanges on implementing the important consensus reached between the two heads of state at their meeting in Beijing, and on maintaining stable economic and trade relations, expanding practical cooperation, and properly addressing each other's concerns. The Chinese side expressed serious concern over the recent economic and trade restrictions imposed by the United States on China.

statements.speaker: He Lifeng
statements.context: Call with USTR Jamieson Greer and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent, readout from People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Both sides agreed that under the strategic guidance of the two heads of state, they would further leverage the role of the China-U.S. economic and trade consultation mechanism to enhance communication, build mutual trust and dispel doubts, expand cooperation, promote the stable and positive development of China-U.S. economic and trade relations, and contribute to building a constructive China-U.S. relationship of strategic stability.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: MFA regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's nuclear policy maintains a high degree of stability, continuity and predictability. We advocate the complete prohibition and thorough destruction of nuclear weapons, follow a policy of no-first-use of nuclear weapons, and unconditionally commit not to use or threaten to use nuclear weapons against non-nuclear-weapon states or nuclear-weapon-free zones. China follows a nuclear strategy of self-defense, keeping its nuclear capabilities at the minimum level required for safeguarding national security, and does not engage in any form of nuclear arms race.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: MFA regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's nuclear strength is an essential force for deterring nuclear warfare and safeguarding world peace and security as well as global strategic stability.

statements.speaker: Jiang Bin
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense press conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Described recent remarks by the Japanese defense minister as 'extremely provocative and dangerous,' saying they had once again exposed Japan's pretense and lies to the international community. 'I wonder whether the Japanese side is using these remarks to test the tolerance of public opinion and pave the way for its ill attempts challenging the bottom line of international justice.'

statements.speaker: Jiang Bin
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense press conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan is internationally recognized as a nuclear-threshold state and has stockpiled approximately 44.4 metric tons of separated plutonium and long maintained the capability for a rapid nuclear breakout. Japan's attempt to breach the three non-nuclear principles seriously violates its obligations under international law as stipulated in the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons, severely undermines the international nuclear non-proliferation regime, and poses a grave threat to the outcomes of the victory of World War II and the post-war international order.

statements.speaker: Jiang Bin
statements.context: Ministry of National Defense press conference
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: 'Japan's nuclear ambition is a red line that should never be crossed. Otherwise, if the Pandora's box is opened, the consequences would be catastrophic,' calling on the international community and people in Japan to remain highly vigilant and resolutely contain such a tendency.

statements.speaker: Mao Ning
statements.context: MFA regular press briefing
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Japan's abandoned chemical weapons mark one of the gravest crimes that Japanese militarists committed during the war of aggression against China. The complete destruction of the ACWs is Japan's unshirkable historical, political and legal responsibility. Japan should have completed the destruction process by 2007. However, the Japanese side has demonstrated insufficient sincerity and inadequate input in fulfilling its obligations, and the implementation of the destruction plan has already missed its deadline four times.

article_title: Xi's Message on Overseas Chinese Affairs Work - Shi Taifeng: Political Party building is Foremost for Party & State - China-Slovakia Ties - GDI Turns 5 - China Position on 'Excess Capacity Issue'

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.speaker_title: General Secretary of CPC, President, Chairman of CMC
statements.context: Instructions to national conference on overseas Chinese affairs
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Overseas Chinese affairs work has made positive contributions to promoting the country's economic and social development, preserving and promoting Chinese culture, and enhancing exchanges and cooperation between China and other countries. On the new journey, we must better rally the hearts and strength of overseas Chinese and guide them to uphold fine traditions, deepen their feelings for family and country, give play to their unique advantages, and actively serve the great cause of national reunification, promoting the united struggle of Chinese sons and daughters at home and abroad.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Meeting with Slovakia's President Peter Pellegrini
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: As transformations unseen in a century are accelerating across the world, the relations between China and Europe are facing both new, important opportunities and many challenges. The key to turning challenges into opportunities lies in conducting equal consultation and seeking commonality while resolving differences. China always sees the EU as a partner, and develops relations with the EU with sincerity and goodwill. It is hoped that Slovakia would play a constructive role in encouraging the EU to focus on consensus and properly handle disagreements with China, and in promoting the sound and steady development of China-EU relations.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Remarks at meeting commemorating five years of Global Development Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should uphold the international system centered around the U.N. and the international order based on international law, and make every effort to foster a generally stable international environment and favorable conditions for global development cooperation. China will continue to support the U.N. in its pursuit of reform, revitalization, and a stronger development pillar, so as to advance the interests of developing countries.

statements.speaker: Wang Yi
statements.context: Remarks at meeting commemorating five years of Global Development Initiative
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: We should champion openness and cooperation in a strong push to eliminate the digital and AI divides between North and South. Two weeks ago, China, together with 28 other countries, initiated the World Artificial Intelligence Cooperation Organization (WAICO). This is a major move taken by China to answer the call of the Global South for promoting AI development and governance. China is ready to deepen collaboration on innovation with all parties to help the Global South effectively seize new opportunities and tackle new challenges.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (through official document)
statements.context: Official position paper 'China's Position on the So-called Excess Capacity Issue'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: Certain countries and economies have rising concerns about their industrial competitiveness and market positions, politicizing economic and trade issues by hyping the so-called 'excess capacity' problem in China, accusing Chinese production capacity of disrupting global markets, and using this as a pretext to escalate restrictive measures against China, thereby intensifying protectionism. Engaging in protectionism only disrupts the global economic and trade order, undermines the security and stability of global industrial and supply chains, hampers the healthy and orderly development of industrial cooperation, and poses long-term risks to world economic growth.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (through official document)
statements.context: Official position paper 'China's Position on the So-called Excess Capacity Issue'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China's modernization of industrial development represents not 'China Shock 2.0' but 'China Opportunity 2.0' for the world.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (through official document)
statements.context: Official position paper 'China's Position on the So-called Excess Capacity Issue'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The U.S. Inflation Reduction Act, which plans to provide a total of USD750 billion in various subsidies from 2022 to 2031, requires that electric vehicles eligible for these subsidies shall be produced and sold in the U.S. or North America, effectively excluding other WTO members. The U.S. provides far more industrial subsidies for artificial intelligence (AI) than any other country. According to available statistics, the European Commission is set to provide EUR1.44 trillion in various subsidies between 2021 and 2030. The EU Industrial Accelerator Act links local content to fiscal support through the EU origin requirement.

statements.speaker: Ministry of Foreign Affairs (through official document)
statements.context: Official position paper 'China's Position on the So-called Excess Capacity Issue'
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: It is imperative that all countries make the pie of global development bigger and introduce subsidies and other industrial policies in a rational and compliant manner, rather than use them as a tool to constrain the development of others. China stands ready to engage in discussions on the subsidy policy with all sides under the WTO framework to jointly bring relevant practices into compliance.

article_title: Xi Speaks to Lula - Xi Thought on Rule of Law at Heart of Legal Propaganda & Education Plan

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: China and Brazil, as important members of the Global South, should stand firmly on the right side of history and of the progress of civilization, and play a greater constructive role in reforming and improving the global governance system and defending international fairness and justice.

statements.speaker: Xi Jinping
statements.context: Phone call with Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, reported in People's Daily
statements.quote_or_paraphrase: The two sides should join hands to promote the high-quality development of Greater BRICS cooperation, keep the direction of cooperation on track, maintain the momentum of unity, deliver more outcomes, and write a new chapter in the solidarity and self-strengthening of the Global South.
